store_data.about_the_game:
Story Background: The Figure Lost After Rural School

In a rural area of China in 2002, the chirping of cicadas masks the silence of a primary school. Daming, the protagonist, has a younger brother named Xiaoming. As usual, Xiaoming headed to school with his faded canvas schoolbag—but never came home. Determined to find his brother, Daming steps into the deserted school after hours, only to find it shrouded in an eerie atmosphere: faint children’s sobs echo from the end of the corridor, strange basketball bounces ring across the campus... Every anomaly seems to point to the truth behind Xiaoming’s disappearance, and hides untold secrets of this rural school.

Core Gameplay: Solve Puzzles Amidst Weirdness, Seek Clues in Fear

Puzzle-solving & Scene Exploration

You’ll need to explore every corner of the primary school—dusty classrooms, dim stairwells, the sealed principal’s office, and overgrown corners of the playground. Solve 机关 puzzles tailored to the rural school setting: find the key to the office, evade Granny Tang in the janitor’s room, navigate the maze-like cemetery, and take part in childhood games... Each puzzle is deeply tied to scene details; careful observation of your surroundings is essential to progress.

Deduction & Truth Reconstruction

As your exploration deepens, you’ll collect items like Xiaoming’s diary, other students’ doodles, and the principal’s old files. By piecing these clues together, you’ll gradually reconstruct the full story: Is Xiaoming’s disappearance linked to an old school violence incident at the school years ago? Could those bizarre supernatural phenomena be projections of left-behind children’s loneliness and fear? Your final choices will determine whether you find Xiaoming—and whether you uncover the truth deliberately hidden in this rural school.

Game Core: Beyond Horror, a Deeper Reflection

When the horror fades, the game aims to draw attention to two real-world issues: In 2002’s rural areas, with large numbers of parents migrating for work, left-behind children faced loneliness and safety predicaments; and how overlooked violence and bullying in schools left indelible scars in silence. The "truth" you uncover in the game may not just be an answer to a disappearance, but a look back at the living conditions of rural children in that era.

Determined to find his brother, Daming steps into the deserted school after hours, only to find it shrouded in an eerie atmosphere: faint children’s sobs echo from the end of the corridor, strange basketball bounces ring across the campus... Every anomaly seems to point to the truth behind Xiaoming’s disappearance, and hides untold secrets of this rural school.

Core Gameplay: Solve Puzzles Amidst Weirdness, Seek Clues in Fear

Puzzle-solving & Scene Exploration

You’ll need to explore every corner of the primary school—dusty classrooms, dim stairwells, the sealed principal’s office, and overgrown corners of the playground. Solve 机关 puzzles tailored to the rural school setting: find the key to the office, evade Granny Tang in the janitor’s room, navigate the maze-like cemetery, and take part in childhood games... Each puzzle is deeply tied to scene details; careful observation of your surroundings is essential to progress.

Deduction & Truth Reconstruction

As your exploration deepens, you’ll collect items like Xiaoming’s diary, other students’ doodles, and the principal’s old files. By piecing these clues together, you’ll gradually reconstruct the full story: Is Xiaoming’s disappearance linked to an old school violence incident at the school years ago? Could those bizarre supernatural phenomena be projections of left-behind children’s loneliness and fear? Your final choices will determine whether you find Xiaoming—and whether you uncover the truth deliberately hidden in this rural school.

Game Core: Beyond Horror, a Deeper Reflection

When the horror fades, the game aims to draw attention to two real-world issues: In 2002’s rural areas, with large numbers of parents migrating for work, left-behind children faced loneliness and safety predicaments; and how overlooked violence and bullying in schools left indelible scars in silence. The "truth" you uncover in the game may not just be an answer to a disappearance, but a look back at the living conditions of rural children in that era.
store_data.short_description: A 2002 China rural primary school-set horror puzzle game: The protagonist’s younger brother vanishes mysteriously after school. Searching the school, they face eerie supernatural events, solve mechanical puzzles to deduce the truth, and reflect on left-behind children and school violence.

store_data.about_the_game:
Carol and the Bells: A Cozy Strategy Game is a turn-based strategy roguelike Minesweeper-style game set on a snowy night.

The game is played on a small grid-based board, where every tile is drawn from the deck you build.

Before each level, you choose and construct a deck that determines what may appear on the board — rewards, tools, and unexpected events. As you explore, you must use hints to infer where enemies might be hiding, decide which tiles to reveal, how much risk to take, and whether it’s time to ring the bell and leave safely.

Resources gained during exploration can be spent to acquire new board elements and upgrades, allowing you to shape a strategy that fits your playstyle.

There is no single correct path. Play cautiously or take bold risks — and enjoy this quiet Christmas adventure.

Inspirations: Mr. Magpie’s Harmless Card Game

store_data.about_the_game:
The city is dying. Your only mission is to leave it alive.

Evac Point is a survival shooter built around one clear objective: start at one end of a devastated town and reach the evacuation point. The map is large, the journey is long, and the danger never stops. Expect a minimum 2+ hour run where every detour costs time, every fight drains resources, and every decision can decide whether your squad makes it out.

Play solo or in online co-op (up to 3 players). Switch freely between third-person and first-person view to match your style, aim, and awareness. Scavenge buildings and streets for supplies, craft essential items on the move, and keep your team alive while hunger and thirst pressure you to keep searching.

Zombies are not the only threat. Armed groups roam the city, guarding key areas and turning the streets into sudden firefights. You don’t build a base. You don’t “settle in.” You push forward, adapt, and survive long enough to see the extraction zone.

Key Features

  • A Long-Form Escape: a large level designed for a minimum 3+ hour journey to evacuation

  • Solo or Online Co-op (Up to 3 Players): coordinate, share supplies, revive, and fight as a team

  • TPS/FPS Toggle: switch viewpoints anytime for comfort and tactical advantage

  • True Survival Pressure: manage hunger and thirst by finding food and clean water

  • Scavenge & Craft: gather resources, manage inventory, and craft essentials while moving

  • Multiple Threats: face zombies and hostile factions across a collapsing urban route

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE LAST OPERATOR

IRON GRAVES is a tactical roguelike where you pilot a squad of remote-controlled drones to board and scavenge procedurally generated derelict spaceships.

Stranded in a graveyard of dead ships, your survival depends on fuel, scrap, and unstable technology. From the safety of your shuttle, you guide your drones through breached airlocks into the unknown.

  • Remote Command Interface: Use a pseudo-terminal interface and tactical map to issue commands. Open doors, disable security systems, and override generators.

  • Procedural Derelicts: No two ships are the same. Explore military cruisers, industrial haulers, and research vessels, each with unique layouts and hazards.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Rely on motion sensors and limited camera feeds. The dark is not empty. Monitoring your surroundings is key to avoiding what lurks in the shadows.

  • Permadeath: Once a drone is lost, it's gone forever. If your shuttle runs out of fuel or is destroyed, the game is over.

  • Drone Customization: Scavenge upgrades like motion scanners, towing arms, and mining lasers. Repair and adapt your drone fleet to survive deeper expeditions.

  • Resource Management: Every jump costs fuel. Every breached door risks hull integrity. Manage your resources carefully to reach the next sector alive.

!! MAC USERS: If the game crashes on launch, please check the pinned workaround in the Discussion forum.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hold the Line. Together… or Not.

The world is ending, and your checkpoint is the last barrier between humanity and total collapse.

Quarantine Multiplayer is a multiplayer checkpoint survival game where 2–6 players work together to inspect survivors, manage resources, and defend a fragile quarantine zone all in real time.

Every player has a role. Every role has power.
And every mistake affects everyone.

Multiplayer by Design

This is not a single-player experience with co-op added on.

  • Each player controls a unique station at the checkpoint
    (medical scans, paperwork, security, supply control, communications)

  • Information is incomplete and asymmetric

  • Players must communicate under time pressure

  • Arguments, mistrust, and panic are part of the experience

One player might spot symptoms.
Another controls the gates.
A third decides whether you can afford to let anyone in.

And sometimes… someone lies.

Inspect. Decide. Live with It.

Survivors arrive with documents, injuries, hidden traits, and secrets.

You’ll need to:

  • Perform medical checks

  • Verify identities and stories

  • Detect infection, smuggling, or sabotage

  • Decide who enters, who waits… and who doesn’t leave alive

Let the wrong person in, and the infection spreads.
Turn away too many, and your own people may revolt.

Shared Resources, Shared Blame

Food, power, medicine, ammo, morale: all shared across the team.

  • Shortages cause internal conflict

  • Some players can override decisions

  • Others can secretly hoard, misreport, or sabotage

  • Emergencies force snap decisions with lasting consequences

Not everyone has to play fair.

Events, Attacks, and Consequences

Between inspections, the outside world pushes back.

  • Horde attacks

  • Internal riots

  • Blackouts and equipment failures

  • Moral dilemmas that split the team

Survival isn’t about perfect play, it’s about surviving each other.

Play It Your Way

  • Fully co-operative

  • Soft role-play encouraged

  • Emergent stories every session

  • Optional hidden objectives and traitor mechanics

Trust is optional. Consequences are not.

The Question Isn’t Who Gets In
It’s Who You Can Still Trust When It All Falls Apart

There are several biomes that can be entered with different features. There are 100 obstacles ranging from trees to bosses. Big constructions can be built using different buildings and grounds. There is space for your creativity. Ships can be built to cross water. The story is as follows.

You have the mission to visite a planet from your mothership to buy compressed food for the journey. During landing your rocket breaks in parts and you have to repair it. Good for you that the residents on this planet have the needed parts to repair the rocket. Complete their quests to return to your mothership.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the 1970s Soviet Union, you are Imry, an ordinary geologist sent deep into the Siberian taiga to investigate anomalous ore deposits. What begins as a routine expedition quickly turns unsettling. Instruments whisper patterned noise, compasses spin without reason, and maps no longer match the land. The forest itself seems alive.

Attempting to retreat, Imry discovers there is no way back. Direction loses meaning. Impossible animals roam the wilderness. Strange people appear and vanish without warning - some hostile, some claiming to be agents of the U.S. government. None offer clear answers.

Lost in a shifting taiga limbo, you must explore haunting landscapes, piece together fragments of truth, and confront a reality that refuses to stay still.

This is an isometric, story-driven RPG focused on exploration, atmosphere, and meaningful choice. Your decisions shape the world and determine how - or if - you escape.

Inspired by the novels of the Strugatsky brothers and classic RPGs of all time.

ACT I AVAILABLE NOW | ACT II COMING Q2 2026 AS FREE UPDATE

Music by DavidKBD - The Last Pack

store_data.about_the_game:
Flush your friends. Burn the deck. SHED everything.

SHED is a competitive card-shedding game where your goal is simple: get rid of everything before your friends do. Perfect for game nights, parties, or friendly rivalry.

  • Clever, reactive rounds with surprising turnarounds

  • Special cards that shift the flow instantly

  • Distinct deck styles for every personality

  • Full offline singleplayer and multiplayer modes

Maybe you are just out to beat your mates. Maybe you are trying to survive a boss that absolutely hates you. Maybe you are just here to ruin someone's evening in a private lobby. Whatever your angle, SHED turns every match into a tiny story: sometimes glorious, sometimes catastrophic, usually hilarious.

The core loop

  • Play cards, clear your hand, and push your opponents into disaster

  • React to chaos and adapt when everything goes sideways

  • Jump into multiplayer or play solo against bots, boss bots, or single player tournaments

  • Unlock cosmetics, avatars, and whatever bragging rights you can grab


Key Features

  • Multiplayer: Play with up to 8 friends, or join a random game through the lobby browser

  • Singleplayer: Play tournaments, bosses, and solo matches without an internet connection

  • Tutorial mode: Learn the rules quickly and get into real games fast

  • Boss fights: Strange, rule breaking encounters that do not play fair

  • Solo tournaments: Offline brackets against bots that do not go easy on you, perfect for testing your skills

  • Unlimited solo games: Play as many matches as you like against up to six bots, with the option to increase the number of decks you use in quick game.

  • Cosmetic shop: Earn coins to unlock avatars, decks, decorations, and more (Everything is earned by playing, no extra purchases needed)

  • Achievements: A full set of challenges across multiplayer, bosses, and solo play (Soon to be tied into steam achievements) 

  • Hidden challenges: A few rewards stay secret until you earn them

  • Player stats: Track your wins, losses, boss clears, and progress over time (Works in both multiplayer and singleplayer.

  • Original soundtrack: A simple lofi set I made before SHED was even an idea (you can pause it in game if you prefer your own banging gaming playlist)

  • Chaotic, humorous gameplay: Easy to learn, tricky to master, impossible to stay calm

  • Low spec friendly: Runs on almost anything

Roadmap: Features in Development

  • Ongoing: Quality of life updates and UI improvements

  • Multiplayer tournaments: Host your own tournament and run a full bracket with friends or whatever community appears (almost ready, just fixing the rage quit flow)

  • New bosses and modifiers: More chaos and more surprises (there are always new bosses on the cards, and when I open a Discord I would love to hear your ideas)

  • Steam achievements and cloud saves: Track everything, keep everything (That’s the plan anyway)

  • Expanded cross platform support: Android first, because iOS wants me to buy a Mac and I am not emotionally ready for that

Wishlist

Wishlist SHED to follow development and support the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Focus Knight is a relaxing focus and productivity RPG where every minute of concentration becomes real progress inside the game.

While you study, work, or create in the real world, your hero explores dungeons, fights enemies, collects items, and evolves automatically.

⚔️ TURN FOCUS INTO PROGRESS

During focus sessions, your character:

  • Explores living dungeons

  • Fights enemies and bosses

  • Encounters random events

  • Collects equipment and treasures

  • Progresses automatically

The longer you stay focused, the greater the rewards.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 FOCUS IS BETTER TOGETHER

In addition to the solo experience, Focus Knight also offers cooperative sessions, allowing you to focus and play together with friends.

  • Share focus sessions

  • Progress side by side

  • Turn study and work into a light social experience

But if you prefer to play alone, you are never truly alone.

During solo sessions, your pet will always be by your side, following your progress, reacting to your sessions, and keeping you company.
It doesn’t replace friends — it completes the experience, making focus feel lighter and more welcoming.

Whether you focus alone, with your pet, or together with friends, progress happens naturally always at your own pace.

🎒 ITEMS, CRAFTING, AND CHARACTERS

Throughout your journey in Focus Knight, you will have access to more than 150 different items, including:

  • Equipment and weapons

  • Crafting materials

  • Gems and special items

These items can be obtained through enemy and boss drops, events during focus sessions, dungeon exploration, and crafting and equipment upgrade systems.

NPCs play a central role in the experience: they bring life to the world, offer services, unlock new features, and provide daily and weekly quests, encouraging steady and natural progression over time.

Everything connects to turn every focus session into meaningful progress inside the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Manifest Anything is a creative sandbox game and world-building platform that allows players to generate and explore playable games using AI.

Players can create their own projects, generate worlds, environments, and gameplay systems, and immediately step inside those creations to play them. Rather than following a fixed storyline, Manifest Anything focuses on creation, experimentation, and exploration, giving players the tools to shape their own experiences.

The current version includes a playable demo environment designed to showcase the platform’s core gameplay and AI-assisted creation systems.

Core Features

  • Create and manage multiple game projects

  • Generate playable worlds and environments using AI-assisted tools

  • Explore and play inside generated worlds in real time

  • Experience foundational gameplay systems including player movement, combat, inventory management, interaction mechanics, and enemy AI

  • Iterate on creations by refining prompts and systems

  • Use genre-focused asset packs and templates to build different types of experiences

Manifest Anything is designed as an evolving platform, with additional tools, systems, and content planned to be added throughout Early Access.

 Chat With Manifest AI

  • Chat with Manifest AI — A full in-game chat to plan, ask questions, and drive creation and edits in your project.

  • Stays in context — The assistant can use what you’re working on (where you are, what you have selected, and a snapshot of the scene) so answers match your current map and project better than a generic web chat.

  • Takes action when it can—ask in plain language; supported requests can tweak the world, open tools, or run structured “make this happen” steps the same way the main assistant can (depending on your setup and phrasing).

  • Your conversations, your account—Chat history is saved locally and separated by login

 World Generation

  • Describe → World — Type what you want (e.g. genre/mood). The game picks a matching starter environment from validated templates or falls back to a structured “build a world” path when needed—then loads and compiles that environment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build your legion and military camp, providing your legionnaires with everything they need. Find friends of Rome through diplomacy or seize resources and turn your enemies into slaves. You will immerse yourself in a harsh Roman world where there is no place for the weak.

The Empire is an ever-hungry beast. Its greatness is built upon the bones of conquered tribes, and its heart beats only as long as the legions bring gold and thousands of new slaves back to the capital. Slave labor is the fuel of the Roman economy, and expansion is the only path to survival.
The Emperor does not forgive weakness. He has entrusted you with the command of a legion and sent you to the edge of the known world. You are his will, his punishing sword, and his architect. Your task is clear: conquer the wild lands, secure a steady flow of resources, and establish the law of Rome where chaos once reigned. In this wilderness, only your legion’s discipline stands between the Empire’s triumph and its total collapse.

In the untamed lands, the legion is the only thing standing between you and oblivion. You must establish a seamless cycle of military preparation. Recruits arrive green and inexperienced, but they must leave the camp as hardened killers. The camp is both your fortress and your factory: here, rations are produced, armor is repaired, and the army prepares for the next march.
Managing such a machine requires absolute control. Rely on your Centurions—they will oversee training efficiency and the soldiers' daily lives. You must plan schedules with precision: while one century stands guard, another builds fortifications, and a third recovers its strength. In a world where the loss of a single veteran is a catastrophe, medicine becomes a strategic resource. Return the wounded to the front lines, or watch your legion dissolve into a crowd of the doomed.

The legion brings war, but it also brings order. A field camp quickly attracts a civilian settlement—the forge of a conquered region’s economy. Trade with passing caravans and local production transform yesterday’s wasteland into a province of the Empire.
You must manage this symbiosis. As your soldiers spend their coin in local taverns and lupanars, the settlement grows. Increase its population with enslaved tribes to squeeze every drop of productivity from the land. Remember: when the trumpet calls the legion to new frontiers, this city will remain your outpost. You are not just seizing land—you are forging Rome for centuries to come.

Before you lie vast, untouched lands, hiding both immeasurable riches and the ancient ruins of forgotten eras. Send scouts into the unknown to find valuable resources and points of interest. But remember: you are not alone. Dozens of tribes watch your every move.
Will you be a wise patron, aiding merchants and protecting the weak, or will you move through their lands with fire and sword, enslaving the survivors? The choice is yours, but every action has a price. Tribes communicate; your cruelty may unite them into a single fist against the legion. And while you deal with the locals, the cold breath of Germanic and Hunnic hordes nears from the north and east. Their raids are a force of nature that is almost impossible to withstand.

When all arguments are exhausted, the legions take the field. But victory is not granted—it is forged long before the first clash. Through optimized supply chains and the forges of your camp, your soldiers will be equipped with the finest gear. Constant drills will turn recruits into an elite force whose skills are second nature.
Form specialized units for any task, from the crushing advance of heavy Praetorians to the swift strikes of light Velites. On the battlefield, your command mastery is more important than the enemy's numbers. Timely maneuvers and the strategic use of different troop types will allow you to crush massive barbarian armies, carrying the will of Rome into the very heart of hostile territory.

store_data.about_the_game:
DIG. DISCOVER. PROFIT.

In Mine Digger, you start with nothing but a shovel and an empty patch of land. Beneath your feet lies a world of valuable ores, rare materials, and unexpected discoveries. Dig deeper, plan your descent, and decide how far you’re willing to go.

What begins as a simple hole quickly turns into a complex underground operation.

SATISFYING DIGGING GAMEPLAY

Every block you remove brings progress. Dig through layers of earth, stone, and valuable minerals, watching your mine grow deeper and more intricate with each run. The core loop is simple, tactile, and deeply satisfying.

UPGRADE YOUR TOOLS & OPERATION

Sell what you extract to earn money and reinvest it wisely:

  • Upgrade your digging speed and efficiency

  • Unlock better tools and equipment

  • Increase your carrying capacity

  • Optimize how deep and how fast you can go

Smart upgrades mean deeper runs and bigger payoffs.

DEPTH HIDES SECRETS

Not everything underground is just rock and ore. The deeper you dig, the more unusual and valuable things you’ll uncover. Some layers are richer than others, if you can reach them.

A MINIMALIST, ADDICTIVE EXPERIENCE

Mine Digger focuses on clean visuals, clear progression, and a strong sense of momentum. No complex tutorials, just dig, upgrade, and dig deeper. Perfect for short sessions or long, obsessive runs.

HOW DEEP WILL YOU DIG?

The surface is only the beginning.

store_data.about_the_game:
About The 4 Masked

The 4 Masked is a 4-player co-op jungle adventure built around teamwork, movement, and chaotic coordination.

At its core, the game has one simple rule:

No one gets through alone.

Players control four different characters, each with a unique role in the team. You will swing across vines, climb cliffs, move between branches, gather resources, craft equipment, survive dangerous environments, and travel from island to island together.

This is not a game where one fast player runs ahead and finishes the level alone. Every level is designed around coordination, timing, communication, and role-based teamwork.

The jungle is not just a place to cross. Every island, rune, obstacle, and hidden path is part of a deeper mystery waiting to be uncovered.

Four Characters, Four Roles

Each character has a different purpose within the team.

Takumi

is the team’s crafting specialist. He uses gathered resources to create equipment and ammunition. His crafting is especially important for keeping GagaraGogo supplied with TufTuf ammo, allowing the team to deal with wildlife safely.

Tarzan

is the team’s movement specialist. With high stamina and strong traversal ability, he can move ahead, scout dangerous routes, and help determine the safest path forward.

Shaman

is the team’s support character. He can heal injured players, revive fallen teammates, and read ancient rune stones that only he can understand.

GagaraGogo

Controls danger from a distance using the TufTuf weapon, which can temporarily calm wildlife. However, his ammo is limited, so the team must choose carefully when to use it.

The Path Opens Only Together

Progress in The 4 Masked is not only about moving well. Players must wait for each other, use the right character at the right time, and make decisions as a team.

One player can scout the path.
One player can craft the tools.
One player can keep the team alive.
One player can control danger.

But the path only opens when the team works together.

Survive, But Do Not Destroy

The jungle is alive, and it reacts to the players. Monkeys, piranhas, and other animals are not traditional enemies that exist only to be killed. They can block your path, interrupt your movement, or punish risky decisions.

In The 4 Masked, the goal is not to kill wildlife.

Players must avoid danger, distract animals, move around threats, or temporarily calm them with the right tools.

Your goal is not destruction.
Your goal is to survive together.

Movement, Physics, and Chaos

Players run, jump, climb, hang from branches, and swing across vines to move through the jungle. Every movement choice can create both an opportunity and a risk.

A bad jump can break the team’s rhythm.
One fallen player can change the entire plan.
A simple crossing can turn into a chaotic and funny co-op moment.

This is where The 4 Masked comes alive:

You make a plan, the jungle breaks it, and your friends make it worse.

The Jungle Pushes Back

Players must also manage survival conditions such as stamina, hunger, and heat.

Staying under the sun for too long can become dangerous.
Wasting resources can make progress harder.
Moving away from the team can put everyone at risk.

Smart planning, proper role usage, and teamwork are the key to surviving each level.

Start Together, Finish Together

Every level is built around group progression. Portals, paths, and key moments require the team to regroup and move forward together.

The 4 Masked puts friendship, teamwork, failure, rescue, and co-op chaos at the center of the experience.

Four characters.




Four different roles.


One path: together.

is the team’s crafting specialist. He uses gathered resources to create equipment and ammunition. His crafting is especially important for keeping GagaraGogo supplied with TufTuf ammo, allowing the team to deal with wildlife safely.

Tarzan

is the team’s movement specialist. With high stamina and strong traversal ability, he can move ahead, scout dangerous routes, and help determine the safest path forward.

Shaman

is the team’s support character. He can heal injured players, revive fallen teammates, and read ancient rune stones that only he can understand.

GagaraGogo

Controls danger from a distance using the TufTuf weapon, which can temporarily calm wildlife. However, his ammo is limited, so the team must choose carefully when to use it.

The Path Opens Only Together

Progress in The 4 Masked is not only about moving well. Players must wait for each other, use the right character at the right time, and make decisions as a team.

One player can scout the path.
One player can craft the tools.
One player can keep the team alive.
One player can control danger.

But the path only opens when the team works together.

Survive, But Do Not Destroy

The jungle is alive, and it reacts to the players. Monkeys, piranhas, and other animals are not traditional enemies that exist only to be killed. They can block your path, interrupt your movement, or punish risky decisions.

In The 4 Masked, the goal is not to kill wildlife.

Players must avoid danger, distract animals, move around threats, or temporarily calm them with the right tools.

Your goal is not destruction.
Your goal is to survive together.

Movement, Physics, and Chaos

Players run, jump, climb, hang from branches, and swing across vines to move through the jungle. Every movement choice can create both an opportunity and a risk.

A bad jump can break the team’s rhythm.
One fallen player can change the entire plan.
A simple crossing can turn into a chaotic and funny co-op moment.

This is where The 4 Masked comes alive:

You make a plan, the jungle breaks it, and your friends make it worse.

The Jungle Pushes Back

Players must also manage survival conditions such as stamina, hunger, and heat.

Staying under the sun for too long can become dangerous.
Wasting resources can make progress harder.
Moving away from the team can put everyone at risk.

Smart planning, proper role usage, and teamwork are the key to surviving each level.

Start Together, Finish Together

Every level is built around group progression. Portals, paths, and key moments require the team to regroup and move forward together.

The 4 Masked puts friendship, teamwork, failure, rescue, and co-op chaos at the center of the experience.

Four characters.




Four different roles.


One path: together.
store_data.short_description: A 4-player co-op FPS adventure where you swing through trees using vines, escape wild animals, and survive dangerous biomes. Each player has a unique role, and teamwork is the key to survival.

Control a warhead to destroy enemies, avoid guarded zones, and land on platforms to complete missions. With limited fuel, every maneuver is a critical decision.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Trash Cash, you don’t just run a waste management company—you rule a kingdom of filth where your bottom line is measured by how many pockets you’re willing to line.

Welcome to the gritty world of industrial sanitation, where efficiency is secondary to influence. Your goal is to build a sprawling empire of garbage collection, recycling, and disposal, but the path to the top isn't paved with green initiatives—it’s paved with cold, hard cash and strategic corruption.

Key Features:

  • Manage the Mess: Build and optimize your infrastructure to handle the city's endless tide of waste. From fleet management to processing plants, every gear must turn to keep the "Trash Cash" flowing.

  • The Art of the Bribe: Success isn’t about how much you recycle; it’s about who you know. Navigate a complex web of shady politicians, union leaders, and inspectors. Use your profits to buy silence, secure lucrative contracts, and bypass those pesky environmental regulations.

  • Expand Your Empire: Scale your operations from a single truck to a city-wide monopoly. Outmaneuver rivals who play by the rules—or simply buy them out.

  • Moral Dilemmas: Every decision has a price. Will you invest in cleaner tech to keep the public happy, or spend that money ensuring the local council looks the other way while you dump in the river?

In this city, everyone has a price. The question is: are you willing to pay it to become the ultimate Trash Tycoon?

Remember: In Trash Cash, the real dirt isn't in the bins—it's in the boardroom.

With 190 hand crafted rooms, you explore a vast, interconnected temple filled with secrets, hidden paths, and one very strange tentacle-dwelling cowboy who’s a little too happy about his situation.  

Dodge enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and chain your growing moveset in true Metroidvania style as you unravel the temple’s deadly mysteries.

Will you claim the Rune… or become another ghost in the shadows?

store_data.about_the_game:
**A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience.

Help Is On The Way is a sci-fi security simulation where survival depends on what you can’t see directly. You play as Kassandra, a security officer stationed behind a malfunctioning terminal in a remote mining facility. When something goes terribly wrong, your coworker Conor is left navigating the facility’s corridors alone, while you guide him from afar using unreliable security systems.

Conor must finish the remaining work for the day before the escape pod can launch, but an alien presence now stalks the facility. If he dies both your lives are over.

From your terminal, you’ll monitor the facility by shuffling between security cameras, watching for hazards, locked-down areas, and signs of the creature lurking in the dark. You can open, close, and lock doors remotely to control Conor’s path, protect him from danger, or trap threats; if your system allows it.

Your terminal is unstable. Overheating systems will shut down your view, forcing you to cool them manually before you can regain control. On top of that, strict corporate protocols mean you’ll need to sign access papers to authorize certain actions, slowing you down when every second matters.

Balance limited information, failing hardware, and bureaucratic obstacles as you guide Conor through a deadly workday. Help is on the way; but only if you can keep the terminal working long enough!

store_data.about_the_game:
A Deadly Parade Marches Across the World

A relentless procession of monsters threatens everything in its path. Choose your character, weapon, and signature ability power — then craft a unique build to survive escalating waves and impossible odds.

This is a rogue-like auto-battler single-tower defense where smart decisions, clever synergies, and adaptability matter more than reflexes.

Build Your character, Your Way

Every run begins with meaningful choices:

  • Choose from multiple characters, each with distinct strengths

  • Select a unique starting weapon to enhance your strategy

  • Equip a powerful auto-ability that empowers your offense, anti-air capabilities, defense, utility and more

No two runs play the same.

Deep Build Customization & Synergies

Your power grows through layered customization:

  • Upgrade your character with new abilities and passives

  • Augment abilities to unlock devastating effects and unique interactions

  • Fine-tune your stats and modifiers to create powerful synergies

Experiment, adapt, and break the game in unexpected ways.

Strategy Is More Than Just Damage

Offense alone won’t save you:

  • Prepare for enemy waves with different tactics and compositions

  • Balance burst damage, damage-over-time, and area control

  • Invest in anti-air options to counter flying threats

  • Use defensive tools like shields, healing, safe zones, and retaliation effects

Every parade tests your build in new ways.

Manage Your Economy

Between waves, visit the shop:

  • Purchase powerful upgrades and enhancements

  • Reroll the shop to search for better solutions

  • Bank your gold to earn interest and scale your economy

Smart financial decisions can be just as important as combat power.

Accept the Risk, Reap the Reward

Feeling confident?

  • Opt into 0–3 optional challenges each round

  • Each challenge makes the wave more dangerous

  • Greater risk means greater rewards — if you survive

  • Balance snowballing economy through challenges VS interest

Push your limits or play it safe. The choice is yours.

Choose Your Battles

Before every wave:

  • Choose between two different monster parades

  • Inspect enemy types and special abilities

  • Decide which threat your current build can best handle

Adapt or perish — foresight is survival.

Can you survive and defeat wave 33?

store_data.about_the_game:
On a distant world, a tiny research probe splashes down into an alien ocean. A curious discovery awaits just beneath the restless waves.

We're not gonna get too much into physics here, but here's a primer: you take a bubble and an identical antibubble, put them together, and they vanish with a bang, releasing a bunch of energy.

Those antibubbles can have quite complex structures. For a successful annihilation, you need to create a bubble structure that perfectly matches its counterpart.

Luckily, there is enough material to work with. All you need is to figure out how to connect these bubbles together in just the right way...

  • A short puzzle game that will take 1.5 to 2 hours to complete

  • Simple input, complex reactions: connect bubbles together and discover the ways they react to your actions

  • Handcrafted puzzles designed to encourage observation and experimentation

  • Enjoy atmospheric music and visuals as you're figuring out the solution

store_data.about_the_game:
Cyan Soul is a fast paced, action-puzzle, boss-rush game inspired by games like Cuphead and Galaga. 

In this demo, you play as a small, but cute ghost-looking dude. You can move up, down, right and left with WASD, and Spacebar for a quick dash that gives you invincibility for a moment. This lets you move around the stage with ease while also damaging smaller enemies! The Spacebar also lets you throw objects that you pick up. Be careful though, you can't hold an object and dash at the same time!

When you get enough points from smashing enemies and whittling down the boss health, you can push E to gain a powerful move. The first one, a small red orb, works as a normal projectile and deals 10 HP damage. If you wait for a maximum power-up bar, you gain access to Cyan Fire– a powerful form that grants invincibility and lets you run right into the boss to deal 30 HP of damage! Watch out, if you get hit, your power-up bar takes a hit, too!

With this demo, you choose between 3 stages:

Swamp Romp, a straightforward vine-covered swamp monster (I recommend beating this guy first) 

Cow-spiracy, which is a creepy little alien abduction (There's more to the story if you look hard enough)

Big and Hexy, where you battle a big ugly witch and her cute cat!

Your objective is to pick up objects from around the stage and hurl them at the boss! The health bar for the boss is located at the bottom of the screen. Aim for 3 stars and the best time and score!

Keep in mind that this is just a free demo. I'm hard at work on the full game! Stay tuned!

None of the art, sound, or music assets were AI-generated.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Developer is a defense game where the protagonist, a developer, successfully activates a control device to defend the planet from alien lifeforms and secure planetary domination.
Turrets pre-installed by the vanguard are scattered across the map and are used to fend off alien waves.
Each wave consists of a unique combination of monsters including melee, tank, ranged, and assassin types. A boss monster appears in the final wave.
When all monsters in a wave are eliminated, the wave ends.

Turrets include Cannon and Missile types, each with 3 levels. The number of bullets or missiles they can fire increases by level.
Since turrets operate within the total power capacity of the control device, the player must manage turning them on and off strategically.
The player also has a weapon, allowing them to lure enemies and defend blind spots of the turrets.
If either the player or the control device runs out of health, the mission fails and the game is over.
If the player successfully survives all waves, the mission is considered a success and they move on to the next planet.

The game is story-driven, allowing players to immerse themselves more deeply by following the storyline.

store_data.about_the_game:
“When the wells of the Atlas mountains run dry, a young shepherd follows the moon’s reflection into the depths below…”

Amalu is a mystical, atmospheric pixel-art 2D Metroidvania platformer inspired by Amazigh and North African folklore.

“Amalu” is a Tamazight word meaning “shadow,” “reflection,” or “symbol.” It’s a concept rooted in Amazigh storytelling, a word often tied to memory, spirit, and the things that remain even when everything else fades. 

Thoughtful Platforming & Exploration

Amalu blends precise 2D platforming with exploration and puzzle-solving:

  • Carefully crafted levels that reward curiosity

  • Environmental puzzles that evolve as worlds shift

  • Non-linear and backtracking that reveals new meaning, not repetition

A World Written in Symbols

The game’s environments are shaped by glyphs, sigils, and symbolic systems inspired by ancient Amazigh tradition and folklores from North Africa

  • Read and activate mystical glyphs to alter the environment

  • Shift between interconnected worlds to reveal hidden paths

  • Use knowledge, not force, to overcome obstacles and puzzles

Every symbol tells a story. Every puzzle is a sentence waiting to be read.

Features

  • Narrative-driven 2D platformer with a strong sense of place

  • World-shifting mechanics tied to symbolic magic

  • Handcrafted pixel art environments

  • Atmospheric soundtrack and sound design

  • Designed for keyboard and controller play


    ✦ Atmospheric exploration

✦ Spell-casting puzzle mechanics

✦ Amazigh/North African mythology

✦ Emotional storytelling

✦ Combat against spirits, djinn, and corrupted myths

✦ A unique “Well Travel” mechanic between worlds (There will be a lot of wells!)

store_data.about_the_game:
You woke up in a cold body of stone with no memory of your past. In a rush to find out what happened, you stumble upon an abandonned underground complex. Parkour your way through hazardous places, fight dangerous encounters, and discover the history of the Cursed Realm.

Explore

Find your way in an interconnected world with many shortcuts. Enjoy the timeless experience of an open metroidvania level-design. Explore thoroughly to find upgrades. Feeling stuck? Go somewhere else!

Jump and climb

2D Platforming with precise and snappy controls. Master quick movement with permissive air-control for a feeling of smooth platforming. Use your down-attack to bounce off enemies and hazards. Enrich your movement palette by progressing the game and breeze through difficult platforming feats.

Fight

Difficult but fair bosses that will relentlessly throw varied patterns at you. Be quick to find attack windows between two deadly strikes. Vary your playstyle with different weapons and upgrades.

Discover

Piece together a broad story of clashing ideals and betrayal by finding documents from previous inhabitants. Get to know historical actors of the Cursed Realm, a strange place where people were turned into tiny stones that forgot about their past. Will you try to cling to your humanity or will you embrace this new existence?

Made by a solo developper.

store_data.about_the_game:
Amanecer is a 2D psychological horror game designed to deliver a brief yet intense experience.

A young boy wakes up in a strange house, with no memory of who he is or how he got there. To uncover the truth, he must explore unsettling environments, solve puzzles, and collect letters and clues that piece together fragments of the story.

  • Narrative exploration: Wander through eerie rooms filled with secrets and hidden details.

  • Environmental puzzles: Unlock doors, activate mechanisms, and overcome logical challenges to progress.

  • Item collection: Gather letters and symbolic objects that reconstruct the protagonist’s past.

  • Character progression: Each discovery brings the boy closer to understanding why he is trapped and how to escape.

  • Oppressive atmosphere: Minimalist pixel art and haunting silence reinforce the psychological tension.

Amanecer invites players to embark on an emotional journey where every clue reveals a new piece of the mystery, and every step leads closer to the final revelation.

store_data.about_the_game:
Are you tired of good, over-stimulating games?
Then this is the perfect game for anyone who wants to play something but refuses to be stimulated, or perhaps you just want something to keep that mind nice and mushy.

Unstimulated Simulator is a collection of 20 ‘minigames’ that turn mundane and anticlimactic tasks into a mundane and anticlimactic gaming experience. 10 are initially available. Find and complete the secret game to unlock the other 10.

Whether you're waiting, clicking, swiping, partially thinking, or just waiting some more, Unstimulated Simulator offers what many would call ‘dull’ and ‘mind-numbing’ gaming at its finest.

Supposed Features:

  • A variety of questionably entertaining minigames.

  • Gameplay loops so short you’ll wonder if you actually played anything.

  • Gameplay loops so long you’ll want it to end while still pushing for the finish line.

  • Rare audio queues, along with real queues.

  • There’s fun somewhere too, without the joys or excitement though as that’s a bit much.

  • Oh, and 120 FPS, if that seems good.

store_data.about_the_game:
My NEET Life is OUT NOW on Steam, baby!

Step into the shoes of Akiko Amaya (Lynn Ashwood) as she navigates a rocky road full of odd jobs and well, life experience in this short, zany anime-style video game!

With the help of Ryu Shoto (Melissa Mirren), a clever but struggling business woman - she must learn to get back on her feet and start socialising again... or risk being a forever NEET.

How you spend your time is up to you — will you keep coasting or finally break free?

FEATURES

  • FULL ENGLISH VOICE ACTING - This game comes packed with a splendour of talented voices, from the unique witchy range of Lynn Ashwood (Kino Kurosawa etc.)  to the spunky, ecstatic and booming voice of Josh Portillo (My Deer Friend Nokotan, Talking Tom, etc). You're sure to have a hell of a time enjoying both the dialogue and what screams NEET!

  • SHORT AND SWEET STORYLINE - Step into a semi-open world full of characters just waiting for their requests to be fulfilled from different walks of life, bond with your job-seeker and leave your shell! In this story, you'll see, experience and feel the experience of someone with potential.

  • FULL ORIGINAL GAME SOUNDTRACK - Composed by chrisgrammers.

And that's not all...

  • 8 ODD JOBS - From looking for the dancing man to saving a cat from high up in a tree, you're the NEET for the job!

  • DEVELOPED IN UNREAL ENGINE 5 - This one of a kind game runs on UE5, what a treat!

  • DIALOGUE HEAVY - If you're a fan of narrative stories, this story might fit your interests!

  • CONTROLLER SUPPORT - Switch between standard controls to gamepad for the best comfort!

store_data.about_the_game:
Overview

You wake up in a gym bathroom stall with no memory. You have nothing but what you're wearing, a gym bag, $20, a protein drink, a mobile phone, and a flyer for a chems dealer. Suddenly you start receiving orders from gym bros for gym supplements. It's time to start the hustle. 

This game will take you on a journey from potty jockey to the ultimate ubermensch Heisen-Bro Hustler.

A light hearted, tongue-in-cheek, self deprecating play on gym bros and culture through the lens of a supps dealer, with an absolute banger of a soundtrack.

Game Play

Start with $20 in your bank and a chems supplier contact, you receive an order for a supplement from a gym bro.

Buy chems from your supplier to craft supplements ordered by gym bros to make money, raise your rep and gain XP.

With each successful order completed you gain rep and XP. Raise your rep to unlock new chems and the ability to craft new supplement products.

Raise XP to level up to unlock new features such as hiring associate bros who can sell supplements on your behalf.

Miss orders and you lose rep and XP.

Raise your rep with bros and they refer new bro to you.

There are 30 bros to unlock in the game. 

Features

Colorful and vivid gym characters that bring the idiosyncrasies of gym lifestyle and culture alive through gameplay and game character building.

Choose your game difficulty with either Chill, Cardio or Capitano Insano.

Playful and flamboyant, retro 80s style.

Fun mini games that let you unlock achievements.

Absolute banger of a soundtrack with includes over 30 light-hearted songs about gym life and culture.

store_data.about_the_game:
Intro

You find yourself waking up in a dark house, your house to be precise. An old CRTV still humming, the static flickering before you. Your eyes adjust to the darkness and before you lays a message, "Find Me" buried deep within TV static. You rise from your old recliner, checking each room of the house, methodically turning the lights on and off. You arrive at the kitchen, the flash of white overtakes the room for a moment, and you see it, just for a moment, the man in the trenchcoat.

Synopsis

In this game you take the role of an unknown man, in an unknown place. Your job is simple, get a good night's rest. Though the task is simple, it doesn't mean it will be easy. Each night a new threat will emerge, you must use your wits to deal with these threats. Along the way, you will piece together a complete story by finding notes, and deciphering cryptic messages.

Features

  • The game includes 7 days that progressively get harder and harder.

  • An unlockable eighth day, which requires some sluething to unlock.

  • A custom night with modifiers that can turn the game on its head.

  • An unlockable model viewer.

  • Simple controls, with difficult to master mechanics.

  • Steam achievements

  • Hidden secrets and lore for you to find and uncover.

  • 3 different endings with animated cutscenes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Clicky Bunny is a shameless, dopamine-pumping NSFW Clicker with light Resource Management made for people who just want to click a ridiculous number of times on a cute anime bunny girl and unlock lewd animated loops.

No story. No complicated systems. Just you, one very eager bunny, and an endless stream of carrots.

Core gameplay loop 🥕

  • Click the bunny to earn Carrots

  • Spend Carrots on upgrades (stronger clicks, multiplier, auto-clicker, special chance…)

  • After enough clicks → enter a quick minigame to earn Hearts

  • Ascend when you're ready → get a precious Key, reset your progress + choose one effect for the next run: more Hearts or Carrots or a small inconvenience for extra Key ...or to just change things up.

Rewards & Content ❤️

  • 30 scenes and 12 effect cards you can view in...

  • Gallery "shop" system - spend Hearts & Keys to view what you want (or unlock all at once)

  • Set your favorite unlocked animation/image as the main game background

  • Select from 12 unique effect cards to vary each prestige run - kinda roguelite, but not really

The whole experience is designed to be completed in ~4–5 hours (more or less). Perfect for short bursts of clicking or long cozy "just one more prestige" sessions.

Sometimes you don't need hours of plot or complex mechanics… you just need one very clickable bunny girl and plenty of reasons to keep coming back.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reborn is a visual novel, written as a psychological horror game. It follows the life of a man who is given a second existence – not as a mercy, but as an experiment carried out by the devil.

You are reborn into a new life with no memory of who you were or why the world feels wrong.
Strange whispers follow you.
Events turn against you.
Opportunities decay without explanation.

As the story unfolds, your choices begin to matter in darker ways. Situations escalate. Tests appear. Lines are crossed, and once crossed, they cannot be undone.

This is not a story about heroism.
It is a story about what happens after justification comes to an end.

A TURNING POINT YOU CANNOT UNDO

Midway through the game, the nature of your existence changes.
What once felt abstract becomes personal.
What once felt optional becomes unavoidable.

PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR — NOT JUMP SCARES

Reborn focuses on slow-burn, atmospheric horror:

  • Unease built through implication, silence, and inevitability

  • Disturbing situations revealed gradually

  • Violence treated as consequence, not spectacle

  • Horror rooted in psychology, not monsters

The most unsettling moments come not from what you see, but from what you understand too late.

CHOICES UNDER PRESSURE

Your decisions influence:

  • How the story unfolds and ends

  • Which characters remain in your life

  • Which paths close permanently

Some choices lead to tests — interactive scenes where success or failure alters the narrative direction.
These are not skill challenges alone. They are reflections of the path you have already chosen.

MULTIPLE ENDINGS 

Reborn features multiple endings shaped by your actions.
Some are louder.
Some are quieter.
None erases the past.

Even attempts at repentance carry consequences.

FEATURES

  • Deep, branching narrative with irreversible outcomes

  • Psychological test scenes are integrated into the story

  • Slow-burn horror with an oppressive atmosphere

  • Minimal UI to maintain immersion

  • Designed for replayability without repetition

  • A story that continues after damnation

CONTENT WARNING

This game contains mature themes, including psychological distress, violence, moral coercion, death, and emotional manipulation. It is intended for an adult audience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Discover what a young child’s imagination can create with a simple set of toy trains. Step into a world of warmth, beauty, and wonder with Locomochi!

Cozy, No-Pressure Puzzle Gameplay

In this cozy, no-pressure logic puzzle game, there are no timers, no stress, and no wrong answers: just the satisfaction of watching everything fall into place.

Each level is a small, handcrafted playset filled with cute, chibi-style toy characters and animals.

These tiny friends you meet throughout your journey give you missions, react to your actions, and gently introduce new mechanics as the game unfolds.

Express Yourself with Cosmetics

As you progress, you’ll unlock new ways to express yourself through cosmetics for your locomotive. Add hats, tweak the smoke, customize the wheels, and play with small details to make each train feel uniquely yours!

Keep in mind that collecting all the cosmetics will require helping the toys across all 4 worlds!

Evolving Worlds and Environmental Storytelling

The worlds you play in continually evolve, introducing fresh mechanics, challenges, and charming new aesthetics.

As you explore, the boundaries between the toy world and the imagination of the child playing with it may begin to blur. Paying attention to details may reveal quiet surprises, hinting that there’s more to these trains than meets the eye.

Experience the magic of Locomochi

  • Cozy, no-pressure logic puzzles with direct train control

  • Handcrafted, living playsets filled with charming toy characters

  • Cosmetic customization to express your creativity

  • Evolving worlds with new mechanics, challenges, and aesthetics

  • Subtle storytelling revealing the child’s imagination behind the toys

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the brand-new world of "Dynasty Rush"!

With the permission and support of Ironhide Game Studio (the developer of the "Kingdom Rush" series)regarding the gameplay and art style, , a new independent tower defense game, "Dynasty Rush", has officially sounded the drums of war and embarked on the journey. This is not just a game, but a summons across time and space, inviting you to personally wield military power, devise strategies, and write your own Chinese-style journey.

You will lead a legendary army that transcends time and space, traversing magnificent landscapes. From the misty water towns of the south of the Yangtze River to the ancient Silk Road of Loulan with its vast sandstorms, every stage is a vivid picture scroll that condenses Chinese geography and culture. Your mission is grand and arduous: to resist the omnipresent and malevolent Eastern pirates, to quell the internal rebels who vent their violence, and reclaim the lost territories of the Western Regions that have been degraded due to heresy. On this path filled with flames of war, you are not only conquering battlefields, but also exploring the time-honored governance principles of "peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation" through "bloody" practices, and witnessing the inclusive and ever-growing power of Chinese civilization.

We deeply understand the strategic essence of tower defense games and infuse them with a unique Chinese soul.

10 elite troops at your disposal: Each stage features 10 unique advanced towers, forming an unbreakable battle line for you.

Among them is the "Supreme Master" who follows the natural Tao: summoning heavenly thunder and earthly fire, applying talismans and array formations, and purifying evil with the power of heaven and earth.

The ultimate "Firearm Arsenal" of craftsmen: combining ancient black technology, from swarm rockets to sky-shaking mines, covering the battlefield with overwhelming firepower.

The "Imperial Corps", united as iron: forming a formidable steel phalanx, they will not concede an inch of ground, using their flesh and blood to build the most reliable fortress.

Heroes emerge in abundance, heed your call: heroes and warriors from history and legend will come forth at your behest, ready to follow your command. Leading the charge is General Guan, known for his unwavering loyalty and Green Dragon crescent moon blade. Wherever his blade strikes, victory awaits. And this is merely the beginning of the dazzling constellation of heroes.

Deep mechanisms, endless strategies: inheriting the classics and pioneering the future. In the future, we will introduce a dynamic "right time and place" system - the battlefield weather and time changes will directly affect the battle situation; as well as a deep "military strategy" growth tree and clever strategies, allowing every choice you make to incorporate the wisdom of Sun Tzu's Art of War and the philosophy of Chinese civilization.

The game combines a distinctive classic style with traditional elements, making each scene resemble a classical scroll that can be traveled and inhabited. The bgm is masterfully composed, with war drums, flutes, and guzheng interweaving to create a magnificent epic of the expedition. There are also rich historical illustrations and cultural allusions embedded within, allowing you to savor the profoundness of Chinese culture amidst the battles.

"Dynasty Rush" is not just a game; it embodies a romantic vision of Chinese civilization and represents a harmonious fusion of strategy and culture. The vast landscape serves as the board, with heroes and warriors as the pieces. This epic tower defense game, transcending time and space, awaits every strategist to deploy troops with precision and make decisive moves.

The beacon has been lit, and the journey has begun. This land of mountains and rivers welcomes your arrival, my lord!

store_data.about_the_game:
Waste of Space

The universe didn’t fall apart in a war.
It fell apart in a meeting.

Waste of Space is a space-based card-collector and deck-builder set in a future where interplanetary governance has collapsed into bureaucracy, opportunism, and quiet rebellion. You assemble crews, ships, and equipment from a growing pool of catastrophically unqualified assets, deploy them on missions across the Solar System and beyond, and decide which broken vision of the future survives.

Earth’s ruling authority, the Strategic Mandate for Earth Governance, is failing from the top down. Mars controls the life support. The outer systems are fortifying, hoarding, and drifting away. Beyond Neptune, something new is forming; post-human, patient, and unconcerned with Earth’s relevance.

Every encounter is a battle of attributes, ego, and bad decisions. Cards clash, systems fail, incidents escalate, and nothing ever goes entirely to plan. Victory is measured in acceptable losses. Failure is meticulously logged.

Your choices shape the political endgame:

  • Dismantle Earth’s mandate and break the system entirely

  • Suppress the outer continuity before humanity becomes obsolete

  • Or navigate a fragile coexistence, balancing control, adaptation, and survival

The further you travel, the stranger the universe becomes and the less it cares about where you came from.

Key Features

  • Card collecting and deck-building focused on crews, ships, and equipment

  • Attribute-driven confrontations inspired by classic card face-offs

  • A branching political narrative shaped by faction diplomacy

  • A bleakly comic sci-fi universe where paperwork outlasts civilisation

The universe is vast. Your crew is terrible.

Proceed anyway.

store_data.about_the_game:
JOTT: Jump Over The Time is a fast-paced 2D precision platformer built around real-time hero swapping, mouse aiming, and movement mastery.

Designed for keyboard and mouse, the game combines tight platforming with free-aim targeting for maximum control and skill expression.

Use a mouse-controlled cursor to place spells, interact with the environment, and execute precise actions while platforming at full speed. Combined with instant hero swapping, this system lets you chain abilities, bypass cooldowns, and create powerful movement combos on the fly.

Combining abilities across heroes opens countless routing possibilities and rewards creative problem-solving.

With 6 playable heroes and 12 unique spells, every level becomes a challenge of execution and decision-making. Choosing when to swap heroes, where to aim, and which spell to use can drastically change your route, and your final time.

Levels can be completed at your own pace, but earning Gold Medals demands perfect timing, precise aiming, and a deep understanding of how abilities interact. Mastery comes from constantly refining your strategy and optimizing every action.

FEATURES:

• Real-time hero swapping with 6 playable characters

• 12 unique spells that can be aimed and placed with a mouse cursor

• Precision 2D platforming combined with free-aim targeting

• Fast-paced, combo-based gameplay built for speedrunning

• Gold, Silver, and Bronze medals on every level

• 43 handcrafted levels (23 Speedruns, 10 Puzzles, 10 Advanced Speedruns)

• Asynchronous leaderboards to compete for the best times

• Instant retry and short levels designed for a smooth die & retry experience

• Clean visuals focused on readability and performance

• Global ranking system unlocked after completing all levels

Play casually, or push your skills to the limit, master the cursor, optimize every swap, and chase the perfect run.

store_data.about_the_game:
After death, you are a soul condemned to drift. Venture into the Great Beyond, traverse an eerie archipelago, and discover the mystery behind your punishment.

Will you find eternal rest, or succumb to the fog?

Stealth is your tool, escape is your salvation

Move through the shadows with cunning and tactics. If discovered, the calm shatters, giving way to a frantic pursuit. Run, improvise, and fight in a desperate escape.

Traverse a shifting archipelago

Every time you set sail, the geography transforms. You must adapt to new routes, unforeseen dangers, and unknown terrains with every attempt. The path to the afterlife is rewritten with every tide.

Face the extraordinary

You will encounter creatures that, though powerful and extraordinary, inhabit the physical and tangible dimension, roaming as naturally as wild animals. Face them with fear and daring.

Mysticism and roots

Immerse yourself in a narrative inspired by the folklore and worldview of Chiloé. An atmosphere that transports you to the heart of the archipelago, featuring an original soundtrack by Grupo Chilhué.

Game Features

  • Organic Stealth: Seamlessly transition from silent planning to reactive action. Being seen is not a restart, but the beginning of a tense pursuit.

  • Procedural Navigation: A procedural generation system ensures that every island and every route is a unique challenge. You will never cross the same sea twice.

  • Mythic Reality: Discover a story inspired by the Chilotan mythos: mythical beings that are not mere symbols, but the very fabric of reality.

  • The Mystery of the Punishment: Reveal the fragments of your past life, understand the origin of the fog, and find a way to break the chains that bind you to the archipelago.

  • Roguelite Progress: Death is only the beginning; face a different challenge every time and learn from your mistakes in every cycle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Trans-global Railroad of Undeviation! Your job as crew member is to postpone the inevitable collapse of the planet. Manage strange machines on the eternally linear train to ensure the balance of the planet is maintained while watching that the few inhabitants left do not bring about an early demise to the crew.

A true cooperative experience, any mistake made by any crew member contributes to the slow death of the planet via orbital decay. You must work together to ensure each one of your crew members never falters, or face a domino-effect of mistakes that are sure to come.

Key features:

  • Fast-paced, chaotic management of train mechanics and other strange items in micro-game fashion

  • In a co-op environment, communication with teammates is highly encouraged. For the valiant single player, one must do the work of many.

  • Time management

  • Team-wide health bar that all players contribute to

  • Mechanical skill in the various micro-games aboard the train

  • Permadeath: if you die, start from the beginning

  • Rare saving opportunities

  • On-the-fly puzzle solving

  • Breaks from the fast-paced game-play interwoven:

    • Train stations that include ways to modify your train and general experience as well as secret side-content

    • Tunnels players must take on foot and navigate through mazes, puzzles, and other tasks in a creepy environment

store_data.about_the_game:
The Giants have returned, corruption is spreading, and suspicious things are happening behind the stage... 

Stack Order is a narrative roguelite deckbuilder set in a world defined by tense, one-on-one duels against bosses, where raw power is as important as foresight.

Every turn is a tactical puzzle: the enemy reveals their plan, and you must construct the perfect response with your cards. Will you panic and defend? Or will you take the hit to build a combo that ends the fight next turn?

STACKING FOR THE WIN

Forget standard card play. Here, you must stack your actions. The order matters, cards placed next and above each other interact, trigger synergies, and modify abilities.

  • Chain Reactions: Inflict a weakening blow before a strong punch to multiply your results.

  • Delayed Gratification: Set up cards in attack for next turn while preparing a defense pile for this turn.

PREDICT THE UNSTOPPABLE

Bosses in Stack Order telegraph their every move. Once you have learned all of them, the challenge no longer lies in reacting to the unexpected, but in finding a solution when the odds are stacked against you. Each boss has unique patterns and weaknesses you must acknowledge. Beware, a strategy that defeated a boss might get you in trouble against the next one.

A LIVING GRAPHIC NOVEL

More than just a boss-rush, you will discover an original world and a myriad of characters, all animated entirely by hand. Uncover the mysteries of these places: why have the giants returned, and what secrets does their reappearance hold?

The story is integrated into the gameplay sequences, told through dynamic dialogues and illustrated sequences. You follow the journeys of several characters to discover the true conclusion of the story.

BUILD YOUR DECK, YOUR WAY

Progress comes with experimentation. As you move forward, you will unlock cards, modifiers and items that will transform your playstyle. Overwhelm your opponents before they can attack with risky offensive combinations, or take your time and opt for a defensive counterattack. Find the right combination of cards and modifiers for devastating turns that leave your enemies defenseless!

FEATURES

  • Unique stacking mechanic: a new approach to card games in which sequences and anticipation create deep strategic layers and satisfying rewards.

  • Anticipate attacks: enemies announce their intentions, turning each turn into a mini logic puzzle.

  • Roguelite progression: refine your deck, boss knowledge, and strategy with each playthrough, unlocking new ways to play.

  • Narrative: a deep story of corruption and manipulation told through rich environments and character interactions.

  • Multiple playable characters:  each with their own cards, archetypes, and personalities.

  • Over 100 different cards: collected from your opponents or traded with other characters, each new card has the potential to transform your deck.

  • Over 30 unique encounters: hand-crafted bosses and NPCs that reshape your playstyle with each playthrough and reveal the game's lore.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build. Automate. Dominate the Chip Market.

The year is 2047. A decade after the Great Chip Drought collapsed the semiconductor industry, mega-corporations lie in ruins. From the ashes, a new breed of manufacturer has emerged:

the μFabbers — small, agile micro-fabricatorswielding cutting-edge nano-manufacturing technology.

You are one of them.

Build your chip fabrication empire from the ground up. Design intricate production lines, unlock advanced technologies, and scale from simple processors to legendary quantum chips worth fortunes. But beware — Helena Voss and her Voss Dynamics mega-corp are watching, waiting to crush any μFab that threatens their monopoly.

Features

Deep Factory Automation

  • Design sprawling production lines across 3 factory floors — plus secret dimensions

  • Route materials with conveyor belts, splitters, sorters, lifts, and throwing belts

  • Manage defect rates, optimize throughput, and exploit the black market

  • Watch your factory come alive with satisfying visual feedback

Complex Chip Manufacturing

  • Process silicon wafers through multiple stages: etching, chemical treatment, ion implantation, and EUV lithography

  • Create 13 chip tiers — from basic X1000 processors to legendary DC4000 Dual Cores.

  • Master L4 production paths: dice wafers into mini chips for quantity, or fuse cores for maximum value

  • Manage the delicate balance between speed and quality — too many defects and your wafers shatter

Alternate Dimensions

  • Unlock the Pocket Dimension: 50% faster processing at double the power cost — but beware the void decay

  • Discover the Temporal Rift: slower time means fewer defects, with rotating platforms offering 95% defect reduction

  • Route items through dimensional portals for advanced production strategies

Strategic Progression

  • Research 50+ technologies across 7 branches: Logistics, Automation, Control, Manufacturing, Power, Quality, and Black markets

  • Unlock powerful machines like the floor-spanning Lithography Machine, Laser Reflector arrays, and the Dual Core Combiner

  • Navigate dynamic market prices with saturation mechanics — flood the market and watch prices crash

  • Choose exclusive research paths: Wafer Dicing OR Dual Core Combining — specialize your factor

Prestige System

  • Reset your factory to unlock permanent upgrades that persist forever

  • Earn prestige points based on your lifetime chip sales

  • Unlock dimension access, bulk discounts, defect reduction, and factory blueprints

  • Each run gets stronger — how far can you push your empire?

Automation Mastery

  • Deploy Controllers, Counters, and Terminals to create smart factory logic

  • Write custom automation scripts with the Terminal machine's built-in programming language

  • Set up threshold triggers, logic gates, and event-driven automation

Build self-sustaining production lines that run while you plan your next expansion

NAND Challenges & Mini-Games

  • Machines jam! Pay a hefty fee or solve logic puzzles to get back online

  • Master NAND gate challenges that scale in difficulty

  • Push your luck with overclocking — faster machines that risk more jams

  • Discover secret codes for bonus rewards and easter eggs

  • Play Snake on Dr. Chen's virtual PC when you need a break

Polished Presentation

  • Watch items transform visually as they're processed — more layers mean more intricate patterns

  • High-tier chips shimmer with holographic effects and rainbow sparkles

  • Customize your factory with unlockable machine skins

  • Three graphics quality settings with advanced fluid dynamics on high

  • Atmospheric factory ambiance with dust motes and machine sparks

Characters & Story

  • Meet Dr. Maya Chen, your brilliant (and coffee-fueled) research scientist

  • Trade with Rico "Junkyard" Martinez for bulk material discounts

  • Face off against Helena Voss, the ruthless CEO determined to rebuild her monopoly

  • Uncover the story through milestone events and rival confrontations

Three Difficulty Modes

  • Easy: Learn the ropes with reduced defects and cheaper rent

  • Medium: The intended challenge

  • Hard: Punishing margins for factory optimization veterans

The Factory Awaits — Again and Again and Again

Start with a single etcher and a dream. End with a multi-dimensional automated megafactory churning out dual-core

quantum processors. Every belt placed, every research unlocked, every chip sold brings you one step closer to

dominance.

Prestige your factory. Unlock new dimensions. Master the market.

The semiconductor revolution won't wait. Will you rise to meet it?

MicroFab is fully playable in English, Spanish (Español), Portuguese (Português), French (Français), German (Deutsch), and Hindi (हिन्दी) — including complete UI, tutorials, and all in-game text. I want every player to experience the game in their language. I will add more translations on request!

An ADVENTURE/INTERACTIVE NARRATIVE made using RPG Maker VX Ace.

You take the role of Isabelle in search of her Uncle.

You approach his house and all is not what it seems.

You must explore every room, collect key items and tools and navigate your way around the SHADOWS.

What exactly are these SHADOWS?

Where is Isabelle's Uncle?

Well that is up to you to discover...

MECHANICS

You have a collection of tools, that you find throughout.

These allow you to build barriers, lockpick drawers, access secret areas.

There is an INFECTION throughout that you must avoid, otherwise you'll be fighting off SHADOWS and having to deal with LOW HP and STAMINA.

Speaking of STAMINA, you require STAMINA to push objects and build barriers, in order to BLOCK SHADOWS.

There is the NOTE system, which offers information and lore.

You have LIMITED resources, so you have to SKILLFULLY DODGE SHADOWS, which get increasingly faster and harder to avoid.

There are many puzzles that require different items, the main objective being the "STONES"

store_data.about_the_game:
GRUNGE is a single-player, atmospheric FPS set in a decaying post-apocalyptic world. It combines methodical pacing with highly lethal combat. There are no bullet sponges here. Combat is fast, deadly, and relies on positioning rather than stats.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Lethal "Glass Cannon" Combat: You are not a tank. Enemies die in 1-2 shots, but so do you.

  • The Repeater Mechanic (Quick-Save): You are equipped with a "Repeater" unit that allows for instant manual quick-saving. Death is frequent, but reloading is instant. Quick-save as often as you reload.

  • Equipment-Based Progression: You get better gear as you progress, and combat effectiveness is primarily driven by what you're carrying.

  • No Survival Chores: Focus purely on exploration and combat. There are no hunger, thirst, or stamina meters to manage.

CONTENT & REPLAYABILITY

  • The World: Explore dense, hostile, and interconnected levels filled with environmental storytelling, hidden secrets, and blocked paths.

  • Atmosphere: Powered by a custom rendering pipeline in Unreal Engine 5, designed for retro-styled visuals, high performance, and a responsive "old-school" game feel.

  • The Playtime: Roughly 8-hour experience.
