store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to New Sterling.

The networks are dead. The towers went dark. What was once the hottest financial district in the world is now a maze of diesel fumes and flickering streetlights. Light industry crawls back online. Heavy machinery rumbles in the distance. And in the gaps between... plenty of dirty work for those willing to take it.

You've got three thugs, five bucks, and a hideout that's seen better days. Build your crew, take on jobs, and carve out your piece of the city—or watch everything fall apart.

Getting Started

Your hideout is home base. From here, browse incoming job offers, check your roster, and head into the city. Jobs come in throughout the day—collection runs to shake down local businesses, goods exchanges to move product, or riskier operations that pay better but demand more. Select your crew carefully: up to four thugs can deploy on any job, but sending wounded or unmotivated members is asking for trouble. Navigate menus with the arrow keys, confirm with Space or Enter. Use Shift + number keys to switch between locations in the toolbar.

Gear Up

Fists won't cut it for long. Visit the Hardware Store for basic weapons—bats, pipes, crowbars—or hit the Black Market for something with more bite. Weapons break with use, so keep your crew equipped. Every thug carries up to six items, so manage your inventory before heading out.

Stay Alive

Combat takes its toll. Health doesn't recover on its own. The Clinic patches up your crew at a cost. A beaten-down thug is a liability. Keep them healthy or leave them behind.

Keep Them Loyal

Your crew expects to get paid. Every week, wages are due—two dollars per head, minimum. Pay well and they'll stick around. Underpay, and motivation drops. Hit zero, and they walk. Good jobs boost morale. Bad calls drain it.

Build Your Reputation

Every job has consequences. Work with the community and they'll open doors for you—new recruits, better tips. Cross the wrong people and the heat rises. Push too hard and the cops take notice. High heat unlocks dangerous jobs, but also dangerous attention.

Story Events

Some mornings bring more than routine work. Special events appear as the days pass: territory disputes, rival stash houses, witnesses that need handling, recruits looking to join. These jobs demand more but define who you become in New Sterling.

The Grind

The city runs on a clock. Shops open at eight, close at eight. Jobs stop coming after ten at night. At dawn, it all resets. Build your capital. Expand your crew. Equip them for the fights ahead. New Sterling doesn't forgive the unprepared.

Tips

> Don't send your whole crew on risky jobs. Keep reserves healthy for when things go wrong.

> Weapons are investments. A well-armed thug survives longer and earns more.

> Watch motivation closely. A disloyal crew member walking out mid-week can derail your plans.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story Overview

You wake up alone in an abandoned subway station.

No memories. No signal. No way out.

Something is very wrong here.

The staff... they're still moving. Wandering endlessly in the dark. Something worse waits deeper down — twisted things that were never human.

Every step reveals more questions. Every answer brings you closer to the truth.

This disaster was no accident. And your awakening... was no coincidence.

Third-Person Female Protagonist

Play as a third-person female protagonist equipped with firearms and customizable outfits.

As exploration progresses, players can obtain new weapons and clothing to survive increasingly dangerous areas.
The combat system features rich animations, including execution moves, melee combat, and ranged gunplay.

Core Gameplay

Escape before your sanity completely collapses.

Exploration and survival are equally important.
The subway station is composed of multiple interconnected areas.
Players must explore under limited time and resources, searching for key items and routes to progress.

Environmental Storytelling

The game does not directly explain the full story.
Instead, players piece together the truth through environmental details, documents, and changes within the world.

A second playthrough offers a different experience from the first, revealing new details and perspectives.

Puzzle Design

Interconnected Environmental Puzzles
Each area features puzzles tightly integrated with the environment, guiding players deeper into different sections of the subway.

Danger During Problem-Solving
Enemies and environmental threats may appear at any time while solving puzzles, keeping tension constant.

Combat and Survival System

Resource-Driven Combat
Ammunition and healing items are scarce, forcing players to carefully choose between fighting and evasion.

Enemy Variety

The game features both zombies and special mutated creatures.
Each enemy type has unique behaviors and weaknesses, requiring different strategies to overcome.

store_data.about_the_game:
Spin fast. React faster.

In Felinia, a realm of cats kept in balance by sacred gems, the return of Muris, an ancient mouse sorcerer, has thrown everything off.
You play as Shurigatto, a ninja cat tethered to a magic shuriken, fighting through corrupted worlds to reclaim the gems and restore some kind of order.

Preferably without exploding.

Shurigatto is a fast, precise top-down action game about momentum, timing, and clean execution. You swing, rotate, and dash through compact levels built to be replayed again and again.

Every move matters. Every mistake is yours.

Rotation changes the rules

Rotation isn’t just movement — it’s how you survive.

Rotate clockwise to turn Blue.
Rotate counter-clockwise to turn Orange.

Your color changes how you interact with enemies, hazards, and the environment. Knowing when to rotate, commit, reverse direction — or dash out of trouble — is the core of the game.

Short levels. Tight design. Instant retries.

Shurigatto is built around quick attempts and constant improvement:

  • 49 handcrafted levels, short and readable

  • Instant restarts

  • Clear routes that can always be played cleaner

Finishing a level is quick. Mastering it — finding the right line and shaving off time — is where the game opens up.

Worlds, bosses, and pressure

Across 6 worlds, you’ll face 6 bosses, each guarding a stolen gem. Every fight has its own arena, patterns, and rhythm, asking you to apply everything you’ve learned under pressure.

The tone stays light and slightly absurd: cats, sacred artifacts, and one very old mouse with a lot of unresolved issues.

Where it comes from

The game grew out of a love for old rotation-based arcade games, then picked up speed along the way. Everything is built around pushing a single movement system as far as it can go.

Features

  • Fast, precise top-down movement

  • Rotation-based color switching (Blue / Orange)

  • Dash mechanic for speed and recovery

  • 49 handcrafted levels

  • 6 boss fights across distinct worlds

  • Arcade-style scoring and time chasing

  • A playful 2D style influenced by classic games and the goofy energy of 90s anime

store_data.about_the_game:
What is a home?

The safest place — or at least, that is what it is for Camila…

In this psychological horror and interactive narrative experience, you play as Camila, a child wandering through a house shaped by memories, cracks, and scars that are not always visible.

The story unfolds through exploration, symbolism, and environmental narrative, inviting the player to interpret events and piece together a fragmented truth.

Nothing is shown directly.

Everything is felt.

This project was born from the desire to explore psychological horror from an emotional perspective.

This experience seeks reflection — not shock value.

Craft, Build, Develop

Experiment, evolve, and consume everything in your path.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a single‑player, sci‑fi horror game focused on stealth, puzzle solving, and narrative exploration.

You wake up alone inside an abandoned facility. As you explore its corridors, you must avoid deadly threats, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the mysterious AI entity known as Nexus.

Gameplay is built around careful movement, observation, and decision‑making. Players are not combat‑focused; survival depends on stealth, timing, and understanding the environment.

Key features include:

- First‑person exploration in a dark sci‑fi facility

- Stealth‑based gameplay with patrolling robotic enemies

- Environmental puzzles involving lasers, power systems, and security mechanisms

- A narrative‑driven experience guided by an in‑game AI character (Nexus)

- Atmospheric sound design and cinematic presentation

- A progression system where new areas and mechanics unlock as the story advances

The game emphasizes tension and immersion, encouraging players to learn the environment, manage risks, and piece together the story through gameplay rather than exposition.

store_data.about_the_game:
Kuroba is a historical real-time strategy game set on the brutal frontier of 13th-century Anatolia.

Build a settlement from the ground up, command disciplined armies, and survive in a land shaped by invasion, shifting borders, and constant conflict.
There is no fantasy here — only economy, logistics, and leadership decide who endures.

From a humble camp to a fortified stronghold, every structure you place defines your future.

  • Classic RTS base-building with modern quality-of-life systems

  • Resource chains and supply lines that directly affect your army

  • Expand, fortify, and adapt to seasonal pressure and enemy threats

Your economy is not a background system — it determines how long your soldiers can fight.

Victory in Kuroba is earned through planning, positioning, morale, and timing — not reflexes.

  • Infantry, archers, cavalry, and specialized units

  • Tactical formations, morale systems, and counter-unit mechanics

  • Command range and positioning matter — overextension breaks armies

  • Real-time battlefield decisions that punish mistakes

Watch formations collapse, lines break, and battles turn with a single poor decision.

Inspired by real conflicts of medieval Anatolia, Kuroba delivers a grounded and immersive historical experience.

  • Historically inspired factions including Seljuk, Byzantine, and Mongol forces

  • Period-accurate architecture, weapons, and battlefield layouts

  • A serious, atmospheric tone focused on realism and tension

No magic.
No heroes.
Only war, survival, and strategy.

Each match unfolds differently, shaped by terrain, supply, and leadership choices.

  • Multiple maps and historically inspired scenarios

  • Different factions encourage distinct strategic approaches

  • Designed for both RTS veterans and thoughtful newcomers

Whether you dominate through economic control or decisive campaigns, every victory is earned.

Communication is key

To succeed, you will have to work together... but that can be difficult when things get heated

Keep your cool and try not to get too upset with your driving partner when they forget to brake — or turn left instead of right.

Split Controls (and Role Swaps)

The game is built around coordination, whether you’re communicating constantly or swapping roles to handle different challenges.

Trade responsibility and adapt to a multitude of timings and precision.

Car Physics

The car isn't just a prop; It has its own physics simulations that can make for some dramatic (and wacky) fails and saves.

Solo or Co-op

If you work better alone, play solo, where you manage both inputs.

store_data.about_the_game:
🐾 Paws-On Management You aren't just clicking menus; you are physically running the shop!

  • Physics-Based Gameplay: Pick up ingredients, arrange your counter, and try not to knock over the syrup bottles.

  • Temperature Control: Keep an eye on that fridge! Leave the milk out too long, and it will spoil.

☕ Express Yourself Coffee is an art, and you are the artist.

  • Cup Canvas: Use the in-game drawing tool to scribble names, cute doodles, or masterpieces directly onto the cups.

  • Character Customization: Design your critter to match your vibe. Be the most stylish Rat in the city.

  • Shop Layout: Organize your workspace however you see fit—just make sure you can reach the beans when the timer is ticking!

🤝 Chaotic Co-Op Running a coffee shop is hard work—why not drag your friends into it?

  • 1-4 Player Multiplayer: Team up to divide and conquer. One person on bar, one on register, and one frantically restocking the fridge.

  • Solo Mode: Prefer to work alone? Take full control of the shop and prove that a single Possum is a capable business owner.

📦 The Business Side It’s not just about pouring drinks; it’s about keeping the lights on.

  • Inventory Management: Monitor your stock levels. Purchase new syrups, beans, and machines before you run dry.

  • Time Management: Serve drinks quickly! Quality degrades over time, and customers won't pay top dollar for a lukewarm latte.

store_data.about_the_game:
【Is Bigger Always Better?】

You’ve heard of "Hachishakusama" (the 8ft tall woman), but what if she was 12 times larger? Introducing "Hyakushaku-sama"—a towering 100ft (30m) tall entity. At this scale, it's not just a ghost; it's a natural disaster!

Experience the overwhelming presence of this massive anomaly in a peaceful rural setting.

【Story】

A college student travels to the countryside to visit his grandparents for some peace and quiet. However, the village holds a dark legend: a giant woman who kidnaps young men.

"The seal has held for 70 years. It should be fine to invite our grandson over."

...And so, the flags are set. In a village of elderly residents, the protagonist spots a young woman in white who shouldn't be there. When he tells his grandparents about the "100ft tall" woman he saw on his first day...

As night falls, the quiet countryside transforms into a "BIG Night" beyond all proportions!

【Features】

  • Overwhelming Scale: Forget 8ft. This is the 100ft (30m) "Hyakushaku-sama"!

  • Playable with Just a Mouse: No complex controls. Even if you aren't a pro at FPS games, you can face the giant with just a few clicks.

  • A Dense 20-Minute Experience: A BIG 20-minute journey packed with surreal horror and comedy.

  • Linear Narrative: No branching endings. Just follow the "BIG conclusion" prepared for you!

【About Streaming and Videos】

Streaming is more than welcome! > Share the "BIG night" with your audience and enjoy the absurdity together. (No prior permission needed, but please include the game title and Steam store URL in your video description.)

store_data.about_the_game:
BUDGE

Is an online co-op adventure about carrying big loads through a perilous journey.

Strength of arm and tightness of grip is second only to the teamwork of lift buddies!

...that is, only if you can remain "buddies" during this raucously funny and infuriating challenge which tests the bonds of your friendship.

...and when in doubt just remember, "BUDGE" - "Big Undertakings Demands Group Effort"

As for the task before you...

It has been confirmed by the shamans and astrologers that indeed the 5th world is coming to its end. The ground shakes, cities lay in ruin, the fabric of reality tears, and berserk gods run amok in the last sputters of this cosmic engine!

Yet...amidst this maelstrom, the remnants of man have mustered one final offering to the gods. Your gather what help you can and carry humanity's last offering to the great altar.

...pray the god's find it worthy enough to bring us with them....

Features:

  • online co-op with up to 8 players

  • physics based cooperative movement mechanics

  • campaign with multiple sections with distinct mechanics

  • ride in a palanquin carried by your friends

  • encounter odd creatures and perform ancient rituals

  • scream and yell at your friends until you find the precise movements needed

store_data.about_the_game:
DWELL is a first-person psychological horror game about being stranded overnight in a remote mountain region where familiar spaces slowly turn strange, and every ordinary detail starts to feel wrong.

Dwell

Minh Thu, a 26-year-old young woman trying to escape the pressure of her life, drives deep into the mountains for a quiet break. When her car breaks down in the middle of nowhere, she’s forced to take shelter in a stranger’s house on the edge of a dark forest. As the night goes on and the atmosphere grows increasingly unsettling, she begins to suspect something out there is watching—and she might only survive if you make the right choices.

The Gameplay 

This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator focused on slow-burn tension, exploration, light environmental puzzles, and tense chase-and-hide sequences instead of combat.

Estimated playtime: ~1.5 hours (depending on exploration).

Key Features

  • Atmospheric psychological horror set in a remote, grounded mountain environment.

  • Story-driven experience with a strong focus on mood, unease, and small details.

  • Explore a strange house and the surrounding forest at night.

  • Light environmental puzzles and clue-finding through notes, objects, and numbers.

  • Intense chase and hiding moments where you can only run, hide, and hope you weren’t seen.

  • No combat or power fantasy—just limited light, vulnerability, and growing dread.

  • Multi-language support for UI and subtitles.

content_descriptors.notes:
Dear players,

DWELL is a psychological horror experience built around a tense atmosphere rather than graphic imagery. Throughout the game, you may encounter scenes of being watched, stalked, or chased in the dark, unsettling audio and visual effects, and references to disturbing events.

In later sections, an inhuman entity begins patrolling certain areas. You’ll need to avoid this presence while exploring the environment and solving puzzles in order to progress.

There is no graphic gore, sexual content, or explicit self-harm depicted in the game. However, the overall tone is intense and may be disturbing for some players, especially those sensitive to themes of isolation, pursuit, and unseen threats.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Should take it?"

It was just another ordinary day. While taking out the trash, you discover an abandoned wooden mannequin. But the moment you bring it inside, your sanctuary vanishes, and a chilling dread fills the void.

Breaking Point is a first-person escape-room horror game where your 'gaze' is the ultimate key to survival. You are not alone in this house. Something is hunting you, and it only moves when you aren't looking.

[Key Features]

  • Survival: Navigate the suffocating darkness of your home, relying solely on your flashlight. Whether you're turning around, searching for hints, or forced to toggle the lights, the mannequin inches closer with every blink.

  • Escape-Room: Scour every corner of the house to uncover hidden clues. Use found keys and objects to unlock the path to freedom. Remember, the solution might be closer than you think.

  • Branching Fates: Breaking Point offers more than a single path. Your interactions and the order in which you solve mysteries will determine your ultimate fate. Will you find the way to a 'Happy Ending,' or will you be trapped in an eternal, terrifying loop?

store_data.about_the_game:
Women of Xal II is a high-stakes political adventure and multi-path visual novel. You play as Xjena, the newly appointed Matriarch of Xanasca, navigating dangerous politics, personal vendettas, and an impending catastrophe known as The Great Silence.

Full-Game Features

20+ Hours of Gameplay – A rich, story-driven adventure packed with meaningful choices, emotional arcs, and hidden layers to discover.

Branching Story Paths – Every decision shapes relationships, plot outcomes, and the fate of the world, with multiple endings to uncover and expanded world-building.

Deeper Character Development – Familiar faces return with more mature themes, richer dialogue, and nuanced growth across the sequel. There's even a player morality system.... 

Next-level visuals - A new artist brings new life to our beloved characters! 

Romance Routes - The first game's options for romantic or platonic character routes are back! At least 10 romanceable characters are planned.

store_data.about_the_game:
🎨 PURE RELAXATION
Pixelbound is designed as a sanctuary for your mind. There are no "Game Overs," no ticking timers, and absolutely no stress. Play at your own pace—whether you have 5 minutes or 5 hours—and watch chaos turn into order, pixel by pixel. It is a game designed to be finished, not to frustrate.

⛏️ MINE, COLLECT, AUTOMATE
Start by manually chipping away at raw pixels. Soon, you’ll turn your manual labor into automated art factory.

  • Miner: Let him do the heavy lifting for you.

  • Pixel Picker: Automatically gather dropped resources.

  • Auto-Building: Watch images assemble themselves while you sip your coffee.

and other mechanics to discover yourself


📈 EXPANSIVE UPGRADE TREE

Reinvest your hard-earned currency into a deep upgrade tree. Increase mining damage, reduce click cooldowns, unlock special abilities, and fine-tune your production. Choose your strategy: Keep your paintings to generate Artistic Points, or sell them for better technology?

🖼️ FROM BLOCKS TO MASTERPIECES
Your journey begins with simple, chunky 4x4 grids. As you progress, you will unlock increasingly complex canvases. Progress through 8x8, 16x16... all the way to massive, detailed 256x256 pixel art.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Afterclass is an adventure-simulation RPG about what really happens when school is over.

When the final bell rings, the campus doesn’t go quiet. It gets unpredictable.

You’re free to live your after-school life at your own pace. Walk the halls, hang out with friends, join clubs, and choose how to spend your time once teachers disappear and rules loosen. Conversations, routines, and relationships slowly shape your experience.

Then, without warning, the school changes.

Ordinary afternoons can suddenly feel different. Students act strangely coordinated. Familiar spaces take on new meaning. A harmless favor, a casual chat, or a club activity can spiral into a full-blown adventure that pulls in half the campus.

The game begins grounded in everyday school life, then gradually escalates into controlled chaos. Small moments connect into larger stories. Side activities grow into multi-step quests. Normal days end with you wondering how things escalated this far… and how you somehow survived it.

Key Features

🎒 Explore the Campus

After school, the campus opens up. Classrooms, hallways, rooftops, courtyards, and hidden corners become places to socialize, investigate, or cause mild trouble. As days progress and situations change, familiar locations can feel completely different, revealing new interactions and opportunities.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Meet a Colorful Cast

Every student has their own schedule, personality, and problems. Some need help with serious issues. Some thrive on drama. Some are just trying to make it through the day without embarrassment. How you interact with them shapes relationships, unlocks new storylines, and influences how they react when things get weird.

🌀 Absurd Quests with Real Stakes

Quests often start small and harmless. Deliver something. Talk to someone. Help a friend. Then they escalate. What begins as a simple task can snowball into a campus-wide situation with unexpected consequences, strange rules, and memorable outcomes.

💘 Light Romance & Friendships

Build friendships naturally through shared time and choices. Flirt awkwardly, misread signals, bond during quiet moments, or grow closer in the middle of chaos. Relationships develop organically and can open unique scenes, quests, and endings.

⏰ After-School Freedom

No classes. No strict objectives. Decide how you spend each afternoon. Follow routines, chase curiosity, or lean fully into whatever strange situation is unfolding. Your choices shape how the day ends and what tomorrow looks like.

store_data.about_the_game:
• Choices that matter: what you pick now changes what you can do later.

  • Between every fight: decisions: recruit, upgrade, brace for the next impact.

  • Tactical auto-battler: positioning, synergies, and power spikes make the difference.

  • A 10-planet galaxy: the deeper you go, the more brutal it gets.

  • Up to 4 factions per campaign: unlikely alliances, dirty combos, “unnatural” plans.

  • Conquest tree: between runs, unlock options and expand your arsenal.

Pick your heroes… and cross your fingers

NeuroForge is a fantasy roguelite auto-battler where you control nothing during fights…

…but you’re responsible for EVERYTHING else.

Especially the bad decisions.

Every adventurer comes with:

  • their skills

  • their role

  • their synergies (sometimes brilliant, sometimes… not)

Build a team of heroes, mix classes and bonuses, and hope it holds together for more than 10 seconds.

Prepare… or perish

Between fights comes the prep phase.

At each step, choose between 2 events:

  • Training: improve your characters and make them slightly less terrible.

  • Recruitment: pick new heroes.

  • Trade: gain economic upgrades.

  • Research: gain military upgrades.

  • Healing: because no, they don’t magically regen their health.

  • Production: generate more resources to fund your bad ideas.

Auto combat, very real consequences

Fights are fully automated:

  • You watch

  • You panic

  • You regret your choices

Positioning, synergies: everything matters before the fight. After that, it’s too late.

A GALAXY TO TAKE

Ten planets. Ten vibes. Ten ways to test you. Every win opens the path forward. Every loss sends you back to the start with a better idea… and a grudge against the galaxy.

You don’t clear levels: you run a campaign. You’re not a hero. You’re a commander. You’re not trying to find “the right answer”: you force your approach.

80+ HEROES (AND PROBLEMS) TO BRING ALONG

Every character arrives with their signature power.

Specialists who trigger chain reactions, guardians who hold the impossible, threats who flip a duel all by themselves…

With 10 factions available, you build a squad like casting a show: you pick faces, not numbers.

THE CONQUEST TREE

Between campaigns, you strengthen your arsenal — not your luck. You unlock options, expand your routes, and make your plans more ambitious… without ever removing the challenge. The galaxy stays dangerous. You just get better.

If you like:

  • demanding auto-battlers

  • roguelites that punish optimism

You’re in the right place.

store_data.about_the_game:
Drop blocks that shatter into gravel particles! Connect same-colored areas across the full board width to clear them and score big. Chain reactions and combos reward strategic thinking in this retro arcade puzzler. Include also two players mode.

The blocks don't just stack — they crumble.

In Gravelix, every falling block shatters into individual gravel particles the moment it lands. These particles tumble, slide, and settle into unpredictable formations, transforming the classic block-dropping formula into something entirely new.

Your goal: connect areas of the same color stretching from the left edge to the right edge of the board. When a color forms a continuous path across the full width, the connected particles explode and earn you points. The more connections you trigger, the higher your combo will be.

Gravel Physics Changes Everything

Unlike traditional puzzlers where blocks sit neatly in rows, Gravelix's particle system means every placement creates a unique landscape. Particles fill gaps, create slopes, and form unexpected connections. You'll need to think about how gravity affects individual particles — not just whole blocks.

Game Modes

Single Player 

  • Face escalating difficulty as you chase the high score. The speed increases, the pressure builds, and every decision counts.

Two Player Split-Screen

  • Go head-to-head locally with a friend. Both players receive the same pieces, so it's pure skill that decides the winner.

Choose from 5 difficulty levels that control how many colors appear on the board (2 to 6). Fewer colors mean easier matches — more colors demand sharper strategy. As you play, the fall speed increases, tightening the window for each decision.

What is in the game?

  • Full single-player arcade mode with progressive difficulty

  • Local 2-player multiplayer

  • Online multiplayer for 2 players with Remote Play Together technology

  • 5 difficulty levels (Very Easy to Impossible)

  • High score table with name entry

  • Gamepad support (up to 4 controllers)

  • Steam Achievements and Cloud Saves

  • Enjoy retro pixel aesthetics - clean pixel art with satisfying particle effects

  • English and Czech localization

Who is this game for?

Gravelix is for fans of arcade puzzle games who want a fresh twist on the genre. If you enjoy quick-thinking strategy, chasing high scores, and the satisfying crunch of particle physics — this one's for you. Best enjoyed with friends in short intense sessions or long marathon runs.

Breeze of Hope is a cozy puzzle adventure about exploring peaceful fantasy worlds, solving gentle environmental puzzles and overcoming challenges in each world , and uncovering a light emotional story about hope and discovery.

Travel through atmospheric levels, collect crystals, activate ancient gates, and unlock new paths as you move from one world to another. Each area is designed to reward observation, curiosity, and calm thinking rather than fast reactions or combat.

There are no enemies, no time pressure, and no fail states. Breeze of Hope focuses on a relaxing journey where players can slow down, explore at their own pace, and enjoy a warm, storybook-like adventure.

Features:

• Cozy third-person exploration

• Multiple peaceful fantasy worlds

• Gentle environmental puzzles and Challenges 


• Crystals, gates, and unlockable paths

• Light emotional storytelling through atmosphere and discovery

• No combat, no time pressure, and no fail states



With peaceful environments, gentle gameplay, and an original soundtrack composed specifically for the game, Breeze of Hope is designed to feel like a quiet escape into another world — a calm journey that helps players slow down, breathe, and enjoy the moment.

More languages may be added in future updates

Welcome. Cameras are live. There is no escape.

Dr. Ragnam is a ruthless doctor running his own twisted reality show.
He abducts four monkeys and forces them to survive inside a nightmarish hospital–dungeon, broadcast live for everyone to watch.

You and your friends are those monkeys.

And nothing is fair.

Each player starts the game with a severe limitation:

  • One monkey wears headphones → Cannot hear anything.

  • One monkey has a taped mouth → Cannot speak, but can hear.

  • One monkey is blindfolded → Cannot see, but can hear and speak.

  • One monkey is paralyzed → Cannot move and must be carried by another player.

To survive, you must cooperate
without full communication.

Dr. Ragnam is always watching.

Cameras are everywhere—walls, corridors, rooms.

Each round, he demands an item:

“Enter my dungeon. Find it. Bring it back.”

But the hospital is alive.
Hallways shift, lights go out, and things start hunting you.

And you try to escape…
with broken senses.

  • Dark and oppressive environments

  • Unexpected threats

  • Absurd yet unsettling objects

  • A blend of tension and dark humor

Every mistake slows the team.
Panic turns into disaster.

This is not a solo game.

You want to warn your team—but you can’t speak.

You want to listen—but you can’t hear.

You want to see—but you’re blind.

Miscommunication is the core mechanic.

And that’s where the chaos begins.

Dr. Ragnam smiles.
Cameras zoom in.
The audience watches.

There is only one question:

Will you escape the show alive,

or be sacrificed for higher ratings?

store_data.about_the_game:
A brutal medieval arena fighter and singleplayer combat game with realistic physics-based combat, effective armor, visceral dismemberment, and deep character progression. Rise through the arena, hunt bandit leaders, and forge your revenge in steel and blood.

Step into a ruthless medieval world in a skill-based medieval combat game where combat is governed by precision, timing, and physical interaction.

You are an arena fighter driven by vengeance. Rising from a mid-tier combatant, you will battle through brutal arenas, clash with heavily armored enemies, and hunt bandit leaders responsible for the destruction of your village. Every strike must physically connect, every block must be positioned correctly, and every victory is earned through mastery and precision.

Steel has weight, armor has purpose, and mistakes are punished.

GAME MODES

Three distinct modes test your mastery of melee combat:

Story Mode

Fight through the arena in this arena fighter experience while pursuing revenge against ruthless bandits. Assault bandit camps, defeat their leaders, and carve a path toward justice through blood and steel.

Champion of the Arena

Engage in intense 1v1 arena battles against skilled opponents where timing, positioning, and weapon control decide the outcome.

Survive the Arena

Endure relentless waves of enemies and test how long your skill, stamina, and decision-making can keep you alive.

CORE FEATURES

Realistic Physics-Based Combat

Characters and weapons are driven by active physics at all times. Your weapon must physically strike the enemy, and improper blocking will not stop every attack.

Every strike is resolved through active physics, delivering weighty and convincing hit reactions.

Effective Armor System

Armor meaningfully affects combat. Each piece protects specific body parts, absorbing damage and reducing the chance of severe injuries or limb loss. Heavy armor can prevent devastating wounds, while exposed limbs remain vulnerable.

Melee Weapon Variety

Master a wide range of medieval melee weapons, each with unique handling and impact:

Short swords and long swords

Axes, maces, and warhammers

Shields — usable for both defense and offense

Visceral Blood & Dismemberment

Combat is brutal and uncompromising. Limbs can be severed, blood persists on the battlefield, and every hit delivers raw, physical impact.

Character Progression

Improve your combat abilities, unlock stronger weapons and armor, and evolve from a capable arena fighter into a feared champion.

Arena-Centered Battles

Each arena offers open space for movement, positioning, and tactical decision-making, rewarding awareness and control rather than scripted encounters.

About This Game

🌐 When the online world is a warzone, and being "UwU" is your deadliest weapon.

Welcome to a totally fucked-up near future, where neon lights hide the rot and everyone is addicted to their screens... In this world, "Views" are God, and "Clout" is your golden ticket to everything.

Play as Lumina, the Queen V-Tuber currently hyping up the network. On-camera, her image is a bright, innocent, cutesy idol... But let me tell you, all of that is total "Cap" (BS)!

Project: Idol / Empire isn't some sunshine-and-rainbows idol raising sim, just so you know. It’s a mind-bending Cyberpunk Thriller / Management game. It mashes up base-defense Action with world domination strategy and a super dark story. You get to play the "Ultimate Villain Queen" using a streamer persona as a front. The real goal? Hack this entire damn city and hold it in the palm of your hand!

🎭 The Double Life (Two-Faced as Hell)

  • On-Cam (The Idol): Roleplay as sweet "Lil' Lumina." Livestream, crack jokes, do fan service, and keep that "internet's darling" image absolutely flawless to farm views and siphon as many donations as possible!

  • Off-Cam (The Mastermind): Stream off, mask off! You are the genius hacker behind "Project: Masquerade." Plan how to use your idol money to upgrade systems, breach databases, and silently spread your dark influence to take over the network.

🎮 Key Features (Don't Miss These)

📡 Live Stream Defense: I Run This Stream!

The livestream screen is your battlefield. While you're busy with fan service on cam, you gotta prepare to deal with real-time cyberattacks!

  • Action-Paced Gameplay: Use Hacking skills to slap down Spam Bots, wipe out viruses, and block troll hackers trying to crash your stream.

  • Risk Management: Manage your Energy and skill cooldowns perfectly. One slip-up, and the "mask" you built might fall off mid-stream!

🗺️ World Domination Strategy: Stream's Over, Time for Real Business.

The real war starts when you go offline. Use the "Network Map" to plan long-term cyber world domination.

  • Claim Turf, Control Zones: Open the network map and personally hack and seize key Nodes across the entire map! Expand your dark influence and farm new resources to strengthen your army.

  • Upgrade Attack Commands: Use donation money to upgrade brutal Hacking skills to counter hackers, slap Spam Bots, and completely eradicate viruses.

🖥️ The Dark Room Narrative: Dark Stories Behind the Mic.

Dive into a detail-rich Cyberpunk-style room. Consume intense lore delivered through Visual Novel storytelling.

  • Information is Power: Snoop on encrypted emails, lurk on social media drama, and dig up hidden Lore to understand your enemies and this world.

  • High-Pressure Choices: Got a blackmail email, now what? Every decision you make today might affect how hard tomorrow's stream will be.

🎨 Cyberpunk Aesthetics: Stunning Visuals & Vibes.

  • Distinctive 2D Anime Style: Perfectly blends the bright cutesy idol aesthetic with intense neon lights and a dark dystopian atmosphere.

  • Sleek UI: An interface designed to make you feel like you're actually sitting in command behind a futuristic computer screen.

Are you ready to wear the mask and build an empire on lies?

store_data.about_the_game:
Dwarf Guild Mania is a turn-based economic strategy game where rival dwarf guilds battle for wealth, influence, and control across a procedurally generated world. Lead your clan of profit-hungry dwarves into untamed lands rich with gems, gold, and opportunity. In this realm, fortunes are claimed through clever trade, ruthless espionage, and industrial ambition. Which guild will rise above the rest?

Expand your guild from a modest mining operation into an unstoppable economic empire. Grow from guild, to company, to empire. Every decision shapes the prosperity of your dwarves and the future of the realm.

  • Establish thriving settlements, prospect for rare gems, and construct sprawling mines deep beneath the mountains.

  • Compete against rival guilds for territory, trade routes, and dominance over valuable resources.

  • Balance expansion with stability as your growing industries reshape the economy around you.

  • Procedurally generated worlds ensure every campaign presents new opportunities, rivalries, and challenges.

Gold alone will not secure victory. Influence, sabotage, and information are just as valuable as armies.

  • Dispatch spies to infiltrate enemy guilds, disrupt production chains, and steal valuable intelligence.

  • Manipulate markets and exploit shortages to cripple competitors while enriching your own coffers.

  • Outmaneuver rival leaders through cunning diplomacy, strategic investments, and economic pressure.

  • Risk everything on ambitious ventures that could either create legendary wealth or bankrupt your guild.

Beyond the mountains lies a living world filled with opportunity and danger.

  • Discover rich veins of precious minerals, hidden locations, and lucrative trading hubs scattered across the realm.

  • Adapt to changing economies where supply, demand, and competition shape the flow of wealth.

  • Build trade networks that connect distant settlements and fuel your industrial expansion.

  • Encounter rival guilds with competing strategies, personalities, and ambitions.

Dwarf Guild Mania reimagines the traditional 4X strategy formula by focusing on economics, espionage, and industrial growth rather than endless conquest.

  • Victory is achieved through wealth, market control, and strategic influence — not just military might.

  • A reactive economy creates dynamic opportunities for trade, monopolies, and sabotage.

  • Spies and covert operations provide alternative paths to dominance beyond open warfare.

  • Procedural generation keeps each campaign unpredictable and highly replayable.

  • Designed as a fast-paced but deep strategy experience, blending accessibility with meaningful long-term planning.

For the Guild!

store_data.about_the_game:
Wildcraft is a sandbox open-world survival crafting game.

Key features:

  • A living world. Animals and mobs grow, die, eat, and reproduce based on their environment to create a working food chain. Take part in an ecosystem that breathes and evolves alongside you.

  • Versatility over quantity. Two instances of the same item may have entirely different stats, completely changing how you use them.

  • Physics-based items. Items obey the laws of physics. Their mass adds real weight to your character, requiring you to carefully manage what you carry.

  • Organic crafting. Crafted gear inherits the stats and behavior of the materials used to make it. This makes every weapon and tool you forge truly unique, giving you endless opportunities to customize your build.

  • Skill-based combat. Face smart, dangerous creatures in a high skill-ceiling combat system featuring attack combos, blocking, and dodging, inspired by Vermintide.

  • Skill tree and unique abilities. Customize your adventure through a unique progression system where XP isn't just a number, it has a physical form that you must carry and store.

  • Build and defend your base. The more XP you hoard in your base, the more dangerous the creatures you will attract. Build strong defenses and fight fiercely to protect your hard-earned progression.

  • Play your way. There are no fixed objectives or guided quests. Forge your own path, set your own goals, and survive on your own terms.

store_data.about_the_game:
Goobers is an idle creature collector game, in which various flowers can be planted in a garden to attract creatures - "Goobers". As the player's collection expands, they will encounter new unique Goobers to add to their ever-growing collection.

Goobers come in various tiers of rarity:

  • Common (contains 8 Goobers)

  • Uncommon (contains 8 Goobers)

  • Rare (contains 8 Goobers)

  • Very Rare (contains 8 Goobers)

  • Legendary (contains 8 Goobers)

  • Mythical (contains 8 Goobers)

  • Cosmic (contains 3 Goobers)

    And 1 extremely rare 'Anomaly' Goober to collect.

Petting your Goober collection and planting exotic flowers improves your odds of finding rarer Goobers in your garden, but remember that you can find any Goober at any moment. It's like watching nature, searching for the rarest species.

Goobers will remain permanently in your garden, as long as the game is properly exited using the escape key, which saves and exits the game.

هي لعبة رعب نفسي بنظام الحلقات Something Awful
تحكي كل حلقة قصة تُروى من ذاكرة الشخص الذي نجا.

Static في هذه الحلقة

تؤدي دور أحمد، شاب يبدأ اول وظيفة له بعد فترة طويلة من العطالة. في موقع ناءٍ، بعيد عن كل شيء.

ما يبدو كدوام ليلي هادئ، يتحول تدريجياً الى تجربة صعبة لا يمكن تفسيرها بسهولة.

مدة الحلقة الأولى (40 دقيقة - ساعة)

Something Awful is an episodic psychological horror game.
Each episode tells a short, self-contained story, experienced through the memories and perspective of the one who survived.

The game focuses on grounded horror, subtle storytelling, and realistic environments—
where fear does not come from monsters, but from isolation, responsibility, and human error.

In this episode, Static, you step into the role of Ahmed, a young man starting his first job after a long period of unemployment.

What begins as a simple night shift slowly turns into something deeply unsettling.

Gameplay

  • First-person exploration focused on immersion and atmosphere

  • Interact with realistic objects, environments, and documents

Key Features

  • Episodic psychological horror experience

  • Short, narrative-driven episode (40 m–1 hour)

  • Realistic environments inspired by real workplaces

✦ Quiz Game Museum ✦

A history of games, built through play

Quiz Game Museum is a quiz game that lets players naturally learn about the knowledge and history of video games through four-choice questions.

Going beyond simple general trivia,

the game is built on a vast database covering the entire game industry—

from the history of console hardware by Nintendo, Sony, and Sega,

to the Magnavox Odyssey, the starting point of both PC and console gaming,

all the way to the latest hardware, the Nintendo Switch 2.

Players can explore quizzes about legendary home consoles and handheld systems,

PC hardware and the iconic games born from each platform,

as well as the people who shaped and drove the game industry.

The experience feels like walking through a full-scale exhibition of video game history.

In addition, the game includes quiz sets focused on titles released in South Korea,

allowing players to explore the evolution of Korean game culture as well.

At launch, the game features a total of 68 quiz sets and 1360 questions,

with more quizzes planned to be added in future updates.

If you love games,

Quiz Game Museum invites you to play, learn,

Genigods: Nezha is a hardcore action role-playing game set against the chaotic backdrop of ancient Chinese genesis mythology. You take on the role of the Spirit Pearl—the first life forged by Nüwa, the Goddess of Life, from earth, water and fire—who is reincarnated as Nezha. Immerse yourself in iconic tales of Chinese genesis mythology, battle against Colossal Gods, and master the one-of-a-kind combat of Chinese-style celestial showdowns.

A World in Ruins, A Hero’s Call

Pangu, the Genesis God, has succumbed to an eternal slumber, plunging the realm into utter chaos. Ten suns sear the land, birthing a crimson desert. Gods wage ceaseless wars that rend the sky asunder. With celestial pillars collapsed, ferocious monsters ascend from the abyss.

Nüwa gifts you the “Heart of the Spirit Pearl”—a heart infused with divine water that is both your constant companion and the wellspring of your power.

Your destiny is forged by three titanic quests: MEND the shattered sky with the Five-Colored Stones, UNCOVER the truth of your own origin, and DESCEND into the Abyss of Return to SEAL the spacetime rifts devouring the world.

Celestial Combat: Dual Stances, Fluidmystic, Relic-Fusion

Experience the dynamic scale of Chinese mythic warfare, where battle flows seamlessly between heaven and earth:

  • Experience the dynamic scale of Chinese mythic warfare, where battle flows seamlessly between heaven and earth:

    Dual Stances: Switch seamlessly between ground and aerial combat. Wield Nezha’s iconic Fire-Tipped Spear for close-quarters combos and parries on land; take to the skies with Wind Fire Wheels for high-speed raids and aerial combos.

  • Fluid-mystic: Tap into the Spirit Pearl’s heart to awaken fleeting mythic abilities, like the Wind Fire Wheels’ devastating mid-air strike. Focus its power to imbue your weapons with sacred water, triggering potent EX effects.

  • Relic - Fusion: Pair mythic treasures for unique skills. Combine Hou Yi’s Bow with Three Heads and Six Arms for Rainbow-Piercing-the-Sun Archery, or match the Palm Leaf Fan with Water Prisons to trap and disable foes.

Colossal Gods and the Sun Tree

Built with Unreal Engine 5 and optimized for Playstation, the game delivers a one-of-a-kind Chinese-style colossal adventure: climb ancient gods towering like mountains and fight by traversing the contours of their bodies. With the help of the giant Kuafu, scale the Sun Tree that bridges mortal and celestial realms and draw your bow to shoot down inine suns and save the devastatingly scorched realm.

Water Philosophy & Jeet Kune Do Mechanics

The combat embodies Bruce Lee’s “Be Water” philosophy through the Divine Water within Nezha (the Spirit Pearl). Channel this flowing power by focusing it into Nezha’s and utiilise mystic artifacts to enhance your combat prowess. Combat tecnhiques adapt the essence of Jeet Kune Do: condense water into a piercing One-Inch Flash for armor-breaking blows, or unleash it as a sweeping Dragon’s Kick for fluid crowd control. This system encourages players to master a defensive, reactive style—requiring precise parrying and countering with the adaptable precision of water itself.

Genigods: Nezha – From Legend to Legacy

We have not just admired Nezha—China’s iconic rebel—but have been haunted by her. Haunted by her tales, by the faded murals of Nuwa mending the sky and Hou Yi shooting down the suns. They were untouchable legends, sealed in ancient texts.

No longer.

In Genigods: Nezha, you do not watch the myth. You live it. You wield the heart of creation, soar between realms, awaken the three-headed, eight-armed form, and step onto the primordial battlefield to mend the shattered heavens. This is not about hearing a story; it is about etching your name into its very fabric.

Our mission is to ignite the epic celestial battles of Chinese mythology. Here, every skill you cast, every choice you make, writes a new line in an ancient epic—forged in your image.

We invite you to feel the divine fury, master the flowing combat, and claim your place in the myth. The legend awaits its newest author.

About Genigods Lab

For two decades, our veteran team has been obsessed with one vision: to restore the epic essence of Eastern mythology. We handcraft visceral combat and seamless immersion, not just retelling, but reinventing the legendary battles for you to experience firsthand.

Nüwa gifts you the “Heart of the Spirit Pearl”—a heart infused with divine water that is both your constant companion and the wellspring of your power.

Your destiny is forged by three titanic quests: MEND the shattered sky with the Five-Colored Stones, UNCOVER the truth of your own origin, and DESCEND into the Abyss of Return to SEAL the spacetime rifts devouring the world.

Celestial Combat: Dual Stances, Fluidmystic, Relic-Fusion

Experience the dynamic scale of Chinese mythic warfare, where battle flows seamlessly between heaven and earth:

  • Experience the dynamic scale of Chinese mythic warfare, where battle flows seamlessly between heaven and earth:

    Dual Stances: Switch seamlessly between ground and aerial combat. Wield Nezha’s iconic Fire-Tipped Spear for close-quarters combos and parries on land; take to the skies with Wind Fire Wheels for high-speed raids and aerial combos.

  • Fluid-mystic: Tap into the Spirit Pearl’s heart to awaken fleeting mythic abilities, like the Wind Fire Wheels’ devastating mid-air strike. Focus its power to imbue your weapons with sacred water, triggering potent EX effects.

  • Relic - Fusion: Pair mythic treasures for unique skills. Combine Hou Yi’s Bow with Three Heads and Six Arms for Rainbow-Piercing-the-Sun Archery, or match the Palm Leaf Fan with Water Prisons to trap and disable foes.

Colossal Gods and the Sun Tree

Built with Unreal Engine 5 and optimized for Playstation, the game delivers a one-of-a-kind Chinese-style colossal adventure: climb ancient gods towering like mountains and fight by traversing the contours of their bodies. With the help of the giant Kuafu, scale the Sun Tree that bridges mortal and celestial realms and draw your bow to shoot down inine suns and save the devastatingly scorched realm.

Water Philosophy & Jeet Kune Do Mechanics

The combat embodies Bruce Lee’s “Be Water” philosophy through the Divine Water within Nezha (the Spirit Pearl). Channel this flowing power by focusing it into Nezha’s and utiilise mystic artifacts to enhance your combat prowess. Combat tecnhiques adapt the essence of Jeet Kune Do: condense water into a piercing One-Inch Flash for armor-breaking blows, or unleash it as a sweeping Dragon’s Kick for fluid crowd control. This system encourages players to master a defensive, reactive style—requiring precise parrying and countering with the adaptable precision of water itself.

Genigods: Nezha – From Legend to Legacy

We have not just admired Nezha—China’s iconic rebel—but have been haunted by her. Haunted by her tales, by the faded murals of Nuwa mending the sky and Hou Yi shooting down the suns. They were untouchable legends, sealed in ancient texts.

No longer.

In Genigods: Nezha, you do not watch the myth. You live it. You wield the heart of creation, soar between realms, awaken the three-headed, eight-armed form, and step onto the primordial battlefield to mend the shattered heavens. This is not about hearing a story; it is about etching your name into its very fabric.

Our mission is to ignite the epic celestial battles of Chinese mythology. Here, every skill you cast, every choice you make, writes a new line in an ancient epic—forged in your image.

We invite you to feel the divine fury, master the flowing combat, and claim your place in the myth. The legend awaits its newest author.

About Genigods Lab

For two decades, our veteran team has been obsessed with one vision: to restore the epic essence of Eastern mythology. We handcraft visceral combat and seamless immersion, not just retelling, but reinventing the legendary battles for you to experience firsthand.

Dive into iconic Chinese genesis tales, battle Colossal Gods, and experience the unique combat of Chinese-style celestial showdowns.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bullet Head is a single-player action shooter set in a post-war world where a private military organization has seized control and imposed its own brutal order. You play as a lone heroine fighting back against overwhelming forces in dense, hostile environments where every second matters.

The game focuses on:

close-quarters firefights,

high enemy density,

fast decision-making,

and maintaining momentum under pressure.






Momentum Combo (Aggression Combo)

Chain kills within a 4-second window to build momentum and amplify your combat power.

• Base health regen: 2 HP/sec — +10% per kill in combo
• Movement speed: 0.95 base — +5% per kill (up to 1.25 max)
• Score multiplier: +10% per kill
• Combo ends if no kill within the timer
• Bonuses smoothly return to base over 1 second

Stay aggressive. Keep the chain alive. Dominate the arena.

At the heart of Bullet Head is Rage Mode — a temporary ability that shifts the flow of combat:

slows down time,

accelerates health regeneration,

increases weapon accuracy.

Rage Mode is designed to be tactical, not overpowered. Knowing when to activate it is key to survival.

Levels are compact and intense, pushing players forward while encouraging smart movement, awareness, and resource management. Ammo and health supplies are limited and must be used wisely.

Additional Features

Dynamic Music System
Bullet Head features a dynamic, adaptive soundtrack that reacts to the intensity of combat. Music builds up as enemy pressure increases and shifts during key moments, reinforcing the pace of firefights and maintaining constant tension. The audio design is intentionally aggressive and rhythmic, ensuring the player never experiences downtime or loss of momentum.

Endless Arena Mode

In addition to the main campaign, Bullet Head includes an Endless Arena Mode focused on pure survival. Enemies spawn in escalating waves, with each wave increasing in number and intensity. As the arena progresses, pressure continuously rises, pushing the player’s reflexes, positioning, and resource management to the limit. The mode is designed for high replayability and skill mastery, offering a relentless challenge with no predefined endpoint.

CLASSIC ARCADE FEEL. MODERN EDGE.

store_data.about_the_game:
This casual puzzle game features beautiful graphics that make up:

Kumu Village in Wuming City, a beautiful rural area located in Wuming District, Guangxi, China.

Game starts:

Click on 'start game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen

Game process:

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small images move to the correct position, and the game ends

End or start the next game:

All the small fragments move to the correct position, and the game ends. At this point, click "try again" to repeat the game.

在数字娱乐日益臃肿的今天，我们选择做减法。这款掼蛋游戏专为追求极致清爽体验的玩家设计：

  • 买断式体验：一次购买，永久拥有。无任何形式的弹窗广告、无金币充值、无内购陷阱。

  • 纯单机运行：无需网络连接，不占用社交资源。没有繁琐的日常任务，没有冗长的剧情对话，开机即玩。

【舒适视觉，清爽交互】

我们重新打磨了棋牌游戏的视觉标准，让每一次出牌都成为享受：

  • 清晰视界：牌面数字与花色经过重绘加粗，配合高对比度设计，确保在各种显示环境下均能轻松识别。

  • 深色护眼背景：采用经典深绿桌面配色，有效降低长时间沉浸博弈时的视觉疲劳。

  • 零学习成本：极简的 UI 布局，操作逻辑直观明确，无需在复杂的菜单中迷失方向。

【轻松对弈，随心掌控】

生活需要博弈，但不需要压力。

  • 友好型 AI：内置多级难度 AI。即使在最高等级下，算法也倾向于提供具有互动感、合理且温和的对抗体验，告别“作弊感”较强的硬核逻辑，主打放松与消遣。

  • 本地数据统计：简单的胜负记录，让您的每一场对局收获清晰可感。

【极低负载，流畅如初】

底层代码高度优化，这可能是您电脑上运行最轻松的程序之一：

  • 全机型适配：几乎不占用系统资源，无论是多年前的陈旧机型还是性能强劲的专业办公设备，均可实现秒速启动与丝滑运行。

  • 小巧精悍：占用极少的磁盘空间，安装卸载均无残留。

store_data.about_the_game:
After a failed revolution, Mexico lies in silence.
The streets are empty, the people have been broken… and only one survivor remains.

You.

You stand before the gates of the old palace of power.
Inside awaits the last figure keeping the country under oppression:
the supreme authority of the regime.

There are no armies.
No allies.
Only steel, reflexes, and determination.

This is a focused and intense soulslike, built around a single monumental confrontation where every mistake is costly and every victory is earned through pure skill.

Key Features

⚔️ Soulslike Combat
Face a boss designed to push you to your limits, with complex patterns, punishing attacks, and a demanding learning curve.

🛡️ Parries, Combos, and Devastating Attacks
Master perfect timing to deflect blows, chain precise combos, and unleash powerful attacks at the right moment.

👑 One Boss, One Great Challenge
No filler. The entire game revolves around an epic battle against an enemy that will test your patience and skill.

🇲🇽 Mexico-Inspired Setting
Architecture, symbols, and atmosphere that evoke a country scarred by war and abandonment after the collapse of order.

🌑 Environmental Storytelling
The story isn’t told—it’s felt. The environment reveals what happened before your arrival and why this fight is inevitable.

🔥 Free the People from Oppression
Mexico’s fate rests on one final confrontation. Defeat the tyrant and break the cycle.

When a kid is abandoned by his parents and left alone for a day, they start to go insane and start seeing creatures of their own nightmares. Driven by sleep deprivation, they must manage their energy and take quick naps while surviving against the never ending threats to survive only one night.

Gameplay

Only One night is a Fnaf-Like game with Rogue-Like elements such as enemy scaling and powerups. Instead of the usual night formula the game is split into many fast paced hours, and you must manage your energy by taking naps which leave you vulnerable. Every hour you can get a powerup which can be as small as a stat up or the ability to parry the nightmares.

About Only One Night

The game is inspired by many Rogue-likes such as Binding of Isaac, Fnaf, and it's many Fan Games, such as One More Night (Roblox) and Too Many Nights. The game was made previously for a Game jam with the theme "Only One", and was originally released with a v1 demo. The game has been polished ever since, with many new features such as enhanced music, sounds, sprites, and a more refined gameplay loop.

Features:

  • Survive 12 Hours that get more difficult

  • 20+ Achievements to collect

  • Survive using a variety of powerups

  • Custom Hour

  • Plushies

  • And References + Easter Eggs

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

You are an Investigator of the Compromise, belonging to neither the Day nor the Night. When someone breaks the rules, you're the one who goes to the scene and files the report. What happens after surely is none of your concern.

Investigate Strange Cases

Examine breached crypts and ransacked graves. Track down an illegal fortune-telling operation run by Pixies. Investigate a strange human child strolling the streets at Night. Decide what makes it into your report and what gets left out.

Each case is a self-contained little story but everything is connected and it might require multiple playthroughs for you to truly grasp the underlying truth.

Multiple Playable Investigators

Play as a character from a variety of races and backgrounds. Whether you're of the Day or Night, the curfew doesn't apply to you. That doesn't mean you're welcome.

The same case plays out very differently as a Human than as a Vampire. Certain witnesses will speak freely to one and immediately attack another.

A Persistent, Reactive Town

The town remembers. Factions react to how you handled past cases. Characters return with altered attitudes. Tensions between the Day and the Night shift over time. Small choices escalate into larger conflicts, and early decisions can lock, alter, or unlock later storylines. Some events can even lead to complete town altering disasters.

There are no perfect resolutions, no ways to make everyone happy.

Character Progression

As the cases accumulate, your character changes.

  • Gain permanent afflictions that alter stats, abilities, appearance, and dialogue

  • Evolve those afflictions as you level up

  • Collect unusual items and affliction with completely game-altering effects

Progress comes with drawbacks. You don't just become stronger, you'll also change into something different.

Things Can Turn Violent

Combat is avoidable, but extremely dangerous.

  • Turn-based combat revolving around throwing dice

  • Your stats, abilities, afflictions, and items, all interact dynamically

  • Afflictions gained can carry beyond a single encounter

Features

  • Case-based investigative RPG with branching outcomes

  • Multiple playable races and backgrounds

  • Day-Night cycle with curfew mechanics

  • Many reactive factions that track your reputation

  • Permanent afflictions that evolve as you level up

  • Dice-based skill checks affected by your stats

  • Turn-based combat when the investigation gets violent

  • Enemy AI driven by their INT and WIS stats. Debuff them to make them stupid

  • Items and afflictions that dynamically alter your abilities

  • Lorebook that fills in as you play and persists across runs

  • Day Market and an unlockable Black Market with an ever-expanding inventory

  • Random events driven by items, afflictions, and faction reputation

  • Original soundtrack with dynamic day-night and combat crossfades

  • Hand-crafted pixel art with some limited combat animations

store_data.about_the_game:
In this sci-fi turn-based RPG, you play as Blade, a survivor left homeless after Earth was destroyed in a nuclear war. Alone in the vastness of space, he travels from planet to planet in search of a new place to call home. Combat combines tactical grid-based movement with intense bullet-hell mechanics, requiring careful planning and precise positioning. Every playable character features unique attacks and gameplay mechanics, and enemies follow the same rule, making each battle challenging, varied, and deeply strategic. By Blade’s side fights Bananan, a mysterious creature he once discovered on a distant planet and took along as both a companion and a loyal ally during his lonely journey through space.

In the first chapter, Blade arrives on FRP-928B, a planet famous across the galaxy for its rich mineral deposits and valuable land resources. There, you will encounter the Slavemaster Duke and his subordinates, who rule both the planet and the powerful corporation that exploits it. Captured and thrown into the deepest level of their massive facility, you must battle your way upward floor by floor and ultimately take revenge on Duke himself.

store_data.about_the_game:
Find, eat, and hide: Till Dawn.

Eat food, avoid ghosts, and survive for 15 minutes. After 14 minutes, the ghosts disappear, giving you 1 minute to explore freely.

In each round, buildings, furnishings, and food are placed with some degree of randomness.

Eat a balanced diet. If any of your carbohydrates, proteins, vitamins, water, or hunger reaches 0, your HP will slowly decrease. If your HP reaches 0, you die.

If possible, it's best not to run. Ghosts can hear you running from afar and will come looking for you.

If a ghost is nearby, it may be better not to move at all. When you're very close, the ghost can even hear you walking or moving while crouching. And if a ghost is nearby, a warning image will appear at the bottom right of the screen.

Level up your skills to increase your chances of survival.

Survival times stack. The longest survival time is saved.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOUR FRIEND CONTROLS WHEN YOU SCREAM.
Lock your friends in the basement and unleash terrifying jumpscares on them with optional real camera reactions.
Dare each other, lie about success, sabotage, negotiate, and argue.
A 2–4 players horror game where your friends control your fear.
The longer you play, the worse it gets — while everyone is watching.

  • Friends Control Your Fear
    Fail a dare and you get locked in the basement. Darkness closes in. Sounds stalk you...
    Then your friends trigger a jumpscare while laughing and watching your live reaction upstairs on the in-game TV.

  • Friends Decide Your Faith
    Your friends judge your success. They can lie, sabotage, or push you too far on purpose.
    They can fail you just to watch you scream.

  • Friend Triggered Jumpscares
    Jumpscares are triggered by players, not systems.
    While you're in the basement, your friends upstairs will be arguing with each other on how best to scare you.

  • Avenge Your Friends
    Feel betrayed? Trigger a revenge on your friend and lock them in the basement.
    Then it's simple: one click = jumpscare => your friend screams.

  • Physics Dares
    Dare your friend to stack a tower of books. or to throw a ball into a cup.
    or to reveal their darkest secret. There is no limit.

  • Escalating Fear System
    The longer the session goes, the worse it gets.
    The basement locks for longer. The haunting gets more intense.
    And your friends? They get even more jumpscare triggers to use on you.

  • Real Camera Reactions (Optional)
    Optionally turn on your webcam or phone camera, and when your friends scare you, it won't just be a scream, it'll be a live camera reaction on the in-game TV.

  • Haunted Basement
    It starts out as a normal night time hang out with friends.
    One failed dare later... You'll do anything to not be the next person heading downstairs.

  • Fast 25-Minute Sessions
    Instant tension. Instant payoff. No setup, no downtime. Just pure escalating panic.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to WREKD — a chaotic, couch-friendly, friendship-destroying bumper car party game where physics is optional and flying is guaranteed.

WREKD is a fast-paced co-op and multiplayer arcade game where tiny cars cause huge problems. Smash your friends, launch your enemies, steal goals, win races, and turn every arena into a metal scrapyard of screams and laughter.

Whether you’re flipping rivals into the sky in Deathmatch, drifting like a maniac in Races, or committing vehicular football crimes in Car Football, one thing is always true:

👉 Someone is getting WREKD.

🚗 Deathmatch

Hit opponents from the side to launch them into the air, send them flying off the map, and rack up points. If they’re not airborne, you’re doing it wrong.

🏁 Race

Boost, bump, shortcut, and sabotage your way to the finish line. Winning is good. Making everyone else lose is better.

⚽ Football (with cars, obviously)

Goals, explosions, accidental own-goals, and absolutely zero respect for traffic laws.

Features

  • 🔥 Local & online co-op / multiplayer chaos

  • 🎮 Easy to play, hard to stay alive

  • 💥 Physics-based hits, boosts, jumps, and ridiculous crashes

  • 🏟️ Multiple arenas and modes with different twists

  • 😂 Built for laughs, rivalries, and “one more match” syndrome

WREKD is not about driving perfectly.
It’s about hitting first, flying far, and laughing the loudest.

So grab your friends.
Start your engines.
And get absolutely WREKD. 💥

store_data.about_the_game:
Prophecy Lost is a PvPvE extraction RPG where every run is a race against time into escalating danger and greater rewards. Each match reshapes the world with procedural map modules—revealing rare bosses, mythic weapons, and unexpected encounters around every corner.

A High-Stakes Fantasy PvPvE Extraction Adventure

Time is running out.

In Prophecy Lost, adventurers venture into a dangerous continent where monsters, rival players, and fate itself stand between you and escape. Every adventure is a race against the clock. Gather powerful weapons, explore an untamed continent, and survive long enough to find a way out.

But when time runs out the match isn’t over yet: the prophecy phase begins. Stick around long enough for a glimpse into the fate of the world, where new dangers—and opportunities—emerge for those who remain.

Prophecy Lost fuses class RPG-style customization and exploration with the high-stakes tension of an extraction game, creating a unique PvPvE experience where every decision matters.

Explore Deeper Match by Match — Risk Grows With Every Step

Journey from region to region through self-contained multiplayer matches, pushing deeper into the world to uncover greater rewards. Prophecy Lost features escalating risk tiers, from safer green regions to deadly yellow and red-level territories where powerful enemies and elite loot await.

The farther you go, the higher the stakes.

Immersive Classes That Fit Your Playstyle

Say goodbye to your everyday warrior and wizard archetypes.

Classes aren't just builds—each class is a character with a past, a role, and a place in the world.

Select from a roster of unique classes—each with distinct weapons, abilities, and ultimate moves that shape how you fight. Whether you prefer crushing foes head-on, controlling the battlefield with magic, or striking from the shadows, mastering your class is key to outlasting both monsters and rival adventurers.

Experiment and utilize the playstyle that strikes joy for you.

Anti-Gear Fear Design — The Encyclopedia Remembers Your Loot

Afraid of losing your loot? Fear not!

Extracted weapons, items, and accessories are permanently registered in your Encyclopedia. Once unlocked, gear can be repurchased/reforged in future expeditions—encouraging bold plays instead of cautious hoarding.

Risk powerful equipment. Chase greater rewards.

Procedural Map Modules Create a Classic Dungeon Crawl Experience

No two runs are the same.

Each match rearranges a region's layout, loot, monsters, and points of interest, creating unpredictable encounters and a need for new strategies every run. From claustrophobic corridors to sprawling valleys filled with danger and treasure, exploration stays interesting with new monsters, loot, discoveries around every corner.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Summer Coming" is a touching and comforting campus pixel-story game. The story begins on the afternoon of the college entrance exam, as you step into university life and experience the unique rhythms of campus under lockdown: oversleeping for morning classes, laughter and banter in the dorm, and that unexpected flutter of the heart.

Freely explore a campus brimming with life, interact with roommates and classmates of all kinds, and shape the story through your choices. You can work part-time at a Japanese restaurant, join in the hustle of club recruitment, take walks by the lovers' lake, or enjoy relaxing mini-games like shooting hoops and playing chess. All of these moments will weave together into a summer memory filled with friendship, budding romance, and personal growth.

With delicate pixel art and a fresh soundtrack, relive those sun-drenched, cicada-filled days of youth.

store_data.about_the_game:
Upstairs is a short point-and-click game with a verb-based interface and dialogue choices, inspired by all those classic adventures you’re thinking of right now.

You’ve been trapped for years. Now you finally have a chance to escape.

Find your way through a strange building full of unsettling people, dark humor, and strange mysteries. Every floor brings you closer to freedom… or deeper into an ancient, terrible secret.

Upstairs has been carefully crafted, late at night and piece by piece, by a single developer using Unity, Adventure Creator and Aseprite.

-Short, focused experience (about 1–2 hours)

-Classic point-and-click gameplay

-Verb-driven interface with a visible inventory

-Handcrafted pixel art

-A happy ending

-A friendly severed head you can talk to (responses are not guaranteed)

-No AI-generated content

MOUSE - Interact with the world

ESC - open the game menu

A game by Jaime Herrero

Original Music: The Coven

"Watch the Skyline Catch Fire" by Of the Wand & the Moon, written by Kim Larsen, distributed by Tesco Distribution Germany

Cover art and logo by Clara Soriano. 

---------------------------------------

Upstairs is a small personal project made during late nights. If it sticks with you after finishing it, sharing your thoughts on Steam means a lot.

store_data.about_the_game:
When your grandpa falls ill, he fears he doesn't have much time left. However, there is a legend passed down in Megamisawa Village of a fishgirl guardian spirit capable of healing any injury or illness. Fortunately, you meet Gyoin-san, an expert angler who teaches you all about fishing. With his help, make your way upstream to Hakuro Falls, where the guardian spirit resides, and reel her in!

Discover and catch various species of fish as you travel up the Megami River in intense fishing battles, where timing and perseverance are key. Along the way, help out the people of Megamisawa Village to unlock new areas and come ever closer to catching the guardian spirit. Just don't get careless—this is no leisurely fishing trip, and the path ahead isn't without its fair share of danger! Tussle with increasingly powerful animals as you make your way upstream, proving yourself as Megamisawa's strongest. And if you ever need a break from the action, you can view all the fish you catch in your aquarium!

Catch a wide variety of fish in fast-paced fishing battles and view them in your personal aquarium! Lock horns with powerful foes, including the legendary Oni Kabuto!

store_data.about_the_game:
WHAT THE HOUSE REMEMBES

What the House Remembers is a short, narrative-driven psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, observation, and slow-building dread.

You are alone in a quiet house.

But the house remembers what you did.

Your visuals fade as your sanity deteriorate...

This is a slow, methodical psychological horror experience focused on tension rather than sudden jump scares.

There are no objective markers or constant guidance.

What the House Remembers is designed to be experienced slowly by observing your surroundings, listening carefully, and piecing together the story through the environment itself.

Exploration and interaction are simple attention is everything...

  • The story is told indirectly.

  • Through rooms.

  • Through objects.

  • Through moments that don’t feel quite right.

As your sanity deteriorates, the house begins to respond, revealing fragments of a past that may be impossible to escape.

Your Sanity and Mental state is held together by the light, Darkness Eats your Sanity...

FEATURE

• Short psychological horror experience (2-3 Hour approximately)

• Focused on atmosphere and mental deterioration

• Narrative-driven, Linear progression

• Sanity-driven visual and audio effects

• Environmental storytelling

• Minimal Hand-Holding

• A short, tightly paced narrative experience

• With Multiple endings

• Single-player only

⚠️ Content Warning ⚠️

This game contains themes of psychological distress, hallucinations, guilt, self-harm ,disturbing imagery and Flashing Lights.

Important Notice

This Game is Designed as a single-sitting experience, intended to be played from beginning to end,

in one uninterrupted session.

About the Developer

What the House Remembers is a Solo-developed psychological horror project and my first commercial release.

The game was built with a focus on quiet tension, environmental storytelling, and themes of guilt and memory inspired by slow-burn psychological horror with Environmental Story telling rather than simple and no-buildup jump-scare driven design.

As a solo developer, I relied on a mix of traditional development workflows and modern tools to prototype, iterate, and refine ideas efficiently. AI-assisted tools were used selectively during development for ideation and problem-solving, while all final creative decisions, gameplay systems, and narrative direction were handcrafted.

This project is deeply personal, and I’m grateful to everyone who takes the time to explore it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Frog & Roll is a platformer where movement precision and reaction speed decide everything. Slide, glide, jump across platforms and dodge obstacles to reach the exit as fast as possible.

Pigs invaded Frogville and stole the frogs’ beer, scattering the bottles as they fled. Now the frogs have only one goal: clear every course, survive the trials, and get their damn beer back

Surf is sliding along sloped surfaces, where balance and speed control are essential, a mode that formed within modifications for Half-Life and Counter-Strike 1.6.

Bhop is a series of precise jumps that allow you to maintain and gain speed, a mechanic that originated in Quake. In Frog & Roll, maps of this mode expand the classic gameplay with unusual platforms and obstacles.

Climb is a mode inspired by games like Only Up, where it is important to gradually progress along a challenging course with precise jumps. Maps in this mode are not only vertical but also horizontal, and completing them requires not only speed but also careful movement.

If speed and the fight for leaderboard positions are not enough, look for beer bottles hidden on every level of the game. Who knows what will be revealed to those who manage to find them all?
