store_data.about_the_game:
IRON CHOIR: Starless Pilgrimage

You awaken imprisoned within a cursed suit of armor, forged from sacrificed souls.
Inside you, the Iron Choir whispers prayers, rage, and the memories of the dead.

Traverse the dying realm of Varrengard in a dark action RPG where every battle, choice, and sacrifice brings you closer to the truth awaiting at the end of the pilgrimage.

Features

  • Challenging third-person action combat

  • Fluid melee combos, dodges, parries, and counterattacks

  • Forge your own combat style with weapons, runes, and sacred abilities

  • Explore an interconnected dark fantasy world beneath shifting storms, fog, and endless night

  • Face terrifying bosses and the horrors of the Voidborn Host

  • Hear the voices of the Iron Choir react to your world and your choices

The Pilgrimage

Every hundred years, the Starless Doors open, and the Voidborn Host returns to Varrengard. The Gloamveil plague spreads across the land, turning even those who once fought for Varrengard against you.

The age of sacrifices has ended. It is time to awaken a mighty warrior once more.

You rise as the Oathbound Champion, imprisoned within a cursed suit of armor that cannot be removed and is never silent. Inside you whispers the Iron Choir: a chorus of sacrificed souls carrying prayers, memories, rage, and regret.

Journey through rain-lashed villages, drowned mines, collapsed fortresses, and dying cathedrals as day fades into night and storms consume the world. Every ruin tells the story of a kingdom that was never meant to die, only to repeat the same suffering again and again.

As the pilgrimage unfolds, the Iron Choir responds to your world and your choices. Some souls beg for peace. Others demand vengeance. And the closer you draw to the Starless Doors, the harder it becomes to separate your own thoughts from the voices of the Choir.

POLITICS IS A BLOODSPORT

That's My President! is a strategy party game about lying to your friends, conquering the map, and running the country into the ground.

MULTIPLAYER: RUIN YOUR FRIENDSHIPS

Gather up to 4 players online and fight for the Oval Office in a cutthroat strategy showdown.

  • THE ROSTER: Washington, Clinton, Bush, Obama, Trump, Biden. Each candidate comes equipped with a unique special ability designed to break the rules and crush your opponents.

  • CARDS ARE AMMO: No deck-building nonsense here. You have a hand of dirty tricks. Play a "Banish" card to teleport an opponent to Alaska or a "Vote Steal" to steal their hard-earned votes.

  • BACKSTAB EVERYONE: Form alliances, promise safety, and then betray them the moment they turn their back.

SINGLE PLAYER CAMPAIGN: SAVE THIS SH*THOLE

Wake up, Mr. President. We have a world to burn.

It’s 2040. The country is bankrupt, the borders are on fire, and you just woke up from the dead.

  • FULLY VOICED CHAOS: The insanity is fully voiced. From screaming advisors to weeping vampires, hear every bad decision in high fidelity.

  • A WORLD GONE MAD: Help an Australian rebel liberate New Zealand, or assist an Englishman LARPing as Genghis Khan in conquering the steppes.

  • UNDEAD DATING PROBLEMS: You have a country to run, but a vampire keeps bugging you about his failing love life. You'll have to deal with that, too.

  • YOUR CHOICES MATTER: Every decision you make ripples through the narrative, ensuring no two runs are ever the same.

  • 13 MAIN ENDINGS: Will you forge a Utopia, a Supreme Empire, or a radioactive parking lot? Discover 13 distinct main endings all chronicled in detailed ending slides that judge exactly how you changed the world.

KEY FEATURES

  • 4-Player Political Warfare: Humiliate your friends. Steal their votes, lie about them, and banish them in real-time online battles.

  • A Campaign of Absurdity: A fully voiced narrative adventure with 13 distinct endings. Navigate a world where you must juggle nuclear diplomacy, a vampire's love life, and the collapse of society.

  • Western Duels: Losing the election? Shoot your opponent. Challenge the leading player to a classic High Noon standoff to steal their momentum and cripple their campaign.

  • Brainrot Corner: Turn-based strategy is boring when you're waiting for your slow friends. We fixed that with an auto-scrolling meme machine to keep your dopamine receptors fried while you wait.

  • Satire With Teeth: Dark humor that punches everyone. No political cow is sacred, and no one is safe from the joke.

Vampirio is a survival roguelike with a day/night loop: as a vampiro hero, build your fortress in daylight, then fight off monsters, undead, and dragons at night in fast, skill-based combat. Every run brings new upgrade choices and every night tests your defences.

BUILD YOUR FORTRESS (DAYTIME) ☀️

Use the day to prepare for the next assault:

  • Build and upgrade walls, towers, and key defences

  • Manage resources and expand your layout over time

  • Reinforce weak points before tougher nights arrive

SURVIVE THE NIGHT (ROGUELIKE COMBAT) 🌙

When darkness falls, the raid begins:

  • Reverse bullet hell — you’re the storm, flooding the screen with attacks as monsters close in.

  • Wave survival against monsters, undead, and dragons

  • Randomised upgrades and skill picks that change each run

HEROES, GEAR, AND POWER SPIKES ⚔️

Create builds that match your style:

  • Recruit and upgrade heroes with distinct abilities

  • Customise your run with gear and progression systems

  • Upgrade heroes, improve gear, and unlock skills as you progress

  • Unlock ultimates that can turn the tide when you’re overwhelmed

CAMPAIGN PROGRESSION

Push across a world map with escalating challenges that test both your fortress upgrades and your combat build. Follow the Dracul family’s revenge story across a mission-filled map.

Fear Night Tales is a horror game series where you witness extraordinary stories.

In each game, you experience the events from a different person’s perspective, with an atmosphere that feels like watching a movie.

And in this game, once again, you are the main character.

Fear Night Tales - Do You Like Coffee?

In this adventure, which begins when a young female barista takes a night shift at a highway café, she starts to notice the strange behavior of the customers.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Snake Village：Sacrifice” is a  mystery  FMV game. Players must explore the game world and collect various items, with different collection combinations leading to a wide array of distinct endings. In the story, players take on the role of Lin Xi, daughter of the village chief of Snake Maiden Village. Before her 20th birthday, she must complete a life-or-death sacrificial ritual—offering up the heart of a truly evil person to break the curse of turning into a snake and retain her human form for eternity.

Story Background

Snake Village is hidden deep in the mountains. The women of the village carry the blood of the snake clan, and the clan abides by rigid rules: anyone who reaches the age of 20 must present the heart of a truly evil person to perform the Molting Sacrifice. Failure to do so will result in them transforming into a snake completely, never to regain human form again. Lin Xi, the village chief’s daughter, is soon to celebrate her 20th birthday. She has already sneaked into the city seventeen times to hunt for a qualified sacrifice, but each time she only found so-called "evil" impostors—their hearts were never accepted by the Snake Goddess. If she fails to find a valid offering within ten days, she will lose her human form forever.

Game Features

Event Response

Throughout the game, players must complete designated events to trigger the corresponding story segments. Incorrect responses to these events will lead to different in-game outcomes.

Clue Investigation

Players need to conduct investigations during gameplay. Different investigation approaches will yield different items, and these varied items can unlock distinct final storylines.

Quick-time Events

Players are required to complete quick-time events in accordance with on-screen prompts. Failing to finish these events successfully will trigger alternate endings.

Event Choices

Players will face a series of event choices as they progress. Different choices made at these junctures will also determine the game’s various final endings.

store_data.about_the_game:
TradingLife is an immersive, loop-based trading simulation made for traders and anyone interested in trading.

Premise

You lost everything—your capital, your confidence, even your last way out was erased by the market.

Just as despair finally hollowed you out, a rift in time opens up and pulls you into real historical price action, giving you one chance to start over.

This time, you swear you’ll take back everything that should have been yours.

But the rift doesn’t open for free—it runs on profit as fuel.
At every settlement, you must be profitable. Otherwise, the rift collapses, and the loop begins again.

Gameplay | Rules of Survival in the Loop

  • Each round, you randomly draw an instrument and “travel” to a random week in history.

  • To prevent memory and information advantages, the game “future-shifts” time and hides key price information, forcing you to make decisions using only what you can see in the moment.

  • Every 4 rounds form one settlement cycle:

    • Net profit > 0 during the cycle → earn rewards and move forward

    • Net profit ≤ 0 → the loop resets, and you begin a new “life”

Your goal isn’t to “predict the market.”
It’s to survive repeated settlements, review your actions, restart, and gradually forge a trading system that’s stable, repeatable, and transferable to real trading.

A Market Environment That’s Uncomfortably Real

  • All candlestick data comes from real historical 1-minute bars and is built directly into the game—no extra downloads required.

  • Currently supported markets: Crypto / Gold (XAU) / Forex (FX)

  • Real-time price presentation is generated based on the current 1-minute bar’s OHLC and recent volatility patterns, using algorithms to make the rhythm and “feel” closer to live markets.

Professional-Grade Tools That Turn Training Into Results

  • Indicators, timeframes, drawing tools, and a full order system (including limit orders, breakout orders, and more)

  • Journaling system: customizable journal templates to record entry rationale, risk plans, execution details, and emotional state

  • Journal tables support filtering and statistical analysis: compare performance across different trade types and quickly identify what truly works for you

Unlimited Practice

Any historical round you’ve traded can be replayed indefinitely.

Use it to correct mistakes, validate strategies, and train discipline—until the right actions become automatic.

Sharpen the blade before the fight.
Loop again and again, until you can confidently—

live the trading life.

store_data.about_the_game:
Time is ticking, execute triple color combos to control the game timer.  Add seconds to the clock by matching color spheres to the cubes. The cubes will change colors as you execute combos.  Matching the correct color to a cube will also replenish the ever diminishing stability gauge.  An incorrect color match will deplete stability.  If the cube becomes completely unstable, time will collapse at a very fast rate, and you will need to recover stability by matching correct colors as the timers are in free fall.  When the timer runs out, its game over!

You don't always need to add the color that the cube asks for however, look to add three of the same color spheres to the cubes to execute combo effects.

3 Red spheres cause all the cubes to be the same color, each time a combo is completed.

3 Yellow spheres will allow for more spheres to generate at a time.

3 Blue spheres will speed up time and also replenish the cube stability over time. This effect can stack.

3 Purple spheres will slow down time but this effect also increases the rate of destabilization. This also stacks.

If any of the above combos are active, Green spheres can appear.

3 Green spheres will freeze time. This effect pauses the main game timer and all of the other combo timers while it is active, allowing you to stack more combos and add seconds to the clock. 

Maintaining these combo effects will help you to balance cube stability, speed up, slow down or freeze time. How long can you control the Time Cube?

This is a simple point and click game built by one developer.

Multiple 3D scenes set the stage and shift with your progress. 

Old school Arcade style High Scores record your best runs. 

Relax and find your flow. 

And most of all, have a good time!

Summary

‘You, In Every Room’ is a psychological horror game that blends visual novel dialogue with 2D exploration. You read, make choices, and explore various locations.

You experience the natural psychological descent of Julian, his girlfriend Emily, and his neighbor Amy, who lives just one wall away. Impulsive decisions and self-interest escalate the situation until it eventually collapses.

Who you believe, who you comfort, and what you choose to ignore will decide whether Julian clings to comfort, gives in to pressure, or loses himself completely.

~ There are no “correct” decisions, only the reality you choose to live with.

Features

  • 2.5D Exploration

  • Hand-drawn 2D environments (& characters)

  • Multiple character perspectives

  • Different endings based on your path

  • (Interactive) Dialogues

  • Peace of Mind

store_data.about_the_game:
Fool’s Road is a turn-based roguelike strategy game inspired by chess. Instead of playing identical pieces, you build and lead a medieval army.

Become a Commander of your own class and shape your army around your fantasy. Recruit and train unique units as you progress, facing tactical challenges along the way. Every run is a new campaign, and every decision matters.

This isn’t about memorizing openings or perfect moves, it’s about building an army that reflects your playstyle and adapting to what the road throws at you.

  

Key Features

  • Chess Inspired Tactical Combat
    Familiar grid-based battles with custom units, abilities, and bosses that break traditional chess rules.

  • Roguelike Army Building
    Instead of random power-ups, grow your strength by recruiting and training troops throughout each run.

  • Class Based Playstyles
    Choose your role and live your class fantasy, build armies focused on brute force, strategy, control, or balance.

  • Challange Encounters
    Face encounters that test your army composition and tactical planning.

  • Chill, Thoughtful Gameplay
    Turn based pacing with no time pressure, plan your moves, experiment, and enjoy the journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
The end of our world is here. Loki has cast a curse on Midgard, pixelating the realm into a video game. The forests, the mountains, even humans began to mutate into pixels. To survive this pixelation, human souls were transferred into robotic shells. This allowed Human consciousness to live on, but the world is not the same. This Pixel curse is spreading to other realms, and it is up to two unlikely heroes to find the Allfather Odin and save Midgard.

Progression is measured in your ability to match your opponent. The color of the Oil running through enemies matters. If their Oil is blue, then it must be a blue ability that damages them. Same for yellow, green, pink, and so on.

Color-matching combat, combined with various enemy types that can attack at short range, long range, fade into smoke, shoot missiles, cast spells, and more makes each combat scenario feel exciting and unique.

This game plays like a hack n’ slash, but it is not a button masher. Every button press counts. The color of the weapon you swing, the timing of your dodge, the enemy you choose to attack first, as well as the enemy you choose to leave for last, all matters. Combat is strategic, and as you unlock more abilities and weapons, success weighs heavily on reading the battlefield and matching your opponent.

Return home to Sólkeld Village between each level and visit one of the three shopkeepers to change your looks and upgrade your gear. Each shop has unique items for sale and can be upgraded using Energy Cores. Each upgrade provides a powerful boost to your character, ranging from increased health to a greater weapon swing distance.

A co-op horror-lite game where you dodge scary bears to steal back your clan's coins from a greedy King.

Either solo or with your clan, venture into a vast, colorful candy land to recover coins scattered across the map. But don't let the bright colors fool you—the King’s guards are always watching.

WORK TOGETHER 

Don't do it alone! Invite your friends to help you carry the loot. More beans mean more coins, but more noise might lead the bears straight to you.

RUN FOR YOUR LIFE

The bears don't just patrol, they hunt. Once they catch your scent, they will chase you to the ends of the earth to take your coins. Find a place to hide or outrun them before it’s too late.

  • Online co-op: 1-4 player online co-op.

  • Run and don't look back: Escape from scary bears that never stop chasing you.

  • Explore the candy land: A huge, colorful world full of secrets and dangers.

  • Cool gadgets: Use fun items to help you finish the job and stay alive.

  • Play with anyone: Join your friends online or try to survive alone offline.

  • Death is not the end: Watch your friends as a ghost or wait for them to bring you back to life!

store_data.about_the_game:
DON’T PANIC TOGETHER

Control your voice. Protect your sanity. Survive the night.

Don’t Panic Together is an online co-op psychological horror experience featuring a light bodycam camera aesthetic. Players take on the role of police officers trying to survive and complete their assigned tasks in Grimwood, an abandoned town hidden deep within the forest. But the greatest threat in Grimwood is not only what hides in the darkness — it is your fear, your panic, and your own mind.

Overview

As a police unit, you are sent to Grimwood to investigate strange incidents and collect important items related to the case. However, as the night progresses, everything begins to change. You can no longer trust what you see, and the only way to survive is to stay quiet and make it through the night.

With the microphone detection system, panic can become your downfall. Sudden noises, screaming, or losing control of your voice can directly lead to your death. Because something in Grimwood may be listening.

Gameplay Features

Online Co-Op (1–4 Players)

Work together with your friends or face the darkness of Grimwood alone.

Microphone Detection Mechanic

Your real voice affects the game. Screaming, panicking, or making sudden noises can have deadly consequences.

Random Events

Every playthrough is different. Events, threats, and encounters are dynamically generated.

Bodycam Camera Style

A realistic and disturbing perspective with subtle VHS effects and handheld camera movement.

Intense Atmosphere Design

Detailed ambient sounds, sudden effects, and dark visual tones create constant tension throughout the experience.

Objective

  • Survive the night in Grimwood.

  • Complete your assigned tasks.

  • Collect important investigation items.

  • Stay together with your teammates.

  • Stay quiet. Something might hear you.

Why Don’t Panic Together?

Don’t Panic Together turns the player’s real-life reactions into part of the gameplay experience. Fear is not limited to the screen — it spreads into the room around you.

The calmer you stay, the higher your chance of survival.

The calmer you stay, the higher your chance of survival.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rayborne

Rayborne is a puzzle game built around a complex and dynamic laser-based system that combines physics and real-time ray tracing. Bend, merge, split, and manipulate laser beams in dozens of different ways to solve a wide range of unique puzzles.

A New Kind of Laser Puzzle

Rayborne reimagines traditional laser puzzles by blending classic mechanics with modern, physics-based interactions. Every beam reacts to its environment, becoming part of a larger, interconnected system.

The game features exclusively hand-crafted levels that reward observation and experimentation. Each stage builds upon previously introduced ideas, gradually expanding the depth of the mechanics while introducing new interactions.

Ray Tracing as Gameplay

Ray tracing isn’t just a visual upgrade — it’s a core gameplay mechanic. Light behavior is simulated in real time, enabling puzzles based on real-time reflections and spatial logic, pushing your spatial reasoning to the limit.

Shape the Light

Take full control of laser beams:

  • Redirect and guide lasers through complex, multi-layered spaces

  • Reflect beams off dynamic mirrors to reach hard-to-access targets

  • Split beams using prisms, mix colors, and use environmental elements to create new solutions

  • Light is not just something you aim — it’s something you compose

A Facility Full of Secrets

Step into a sterile research complex where the line between humanity and artificial intelligence has almost vanished. Before long, you’ll realize you’re not alone. Disturbing, chaotic chalk drawings cover the pristine laboratory walls, and behind frosted glass you’ll glimpse silent figures carefully observing your every move. Nothing here is accidental — and each solved puzzle brings you closer to answering one unsettling question: who — or what — are you, really?

 Your bloodline is your weapon. Your death is the mechanism.

But the energy from those Run bars doesn't just disappear... it goes somewhere.

movies.name: Push The Cart Together - Official Teaser

store_data.about_the_game:
SHORT DESCRIPTION

Push the Cart TOGETHER is a fast-paced, precision-focused cooperative game for two players. Push a massive cart filled with cargo and synchronize your decisions to navigate narrow paths and dangerous obstacles. Coordination and teamwork are essential — one mistake is enough to set everything on fire.

The game features multiple themed levels, but the goal is always the same: push the cart to the finish at any cost.

You can play solo or as a duo. In co-op mode, each player controls one side of the cart — pushing or pulling it. You’ll quickly realize that the hardest challenges aren’t the obstacles or the physics… but driving straight and communicating.

KEY FEATURES

  • High difficulty — it will be very, very hard. The world will do everything it can to stop you from reaching the goal. And the environment isn’t the only thing in your way.

  • Death counter — you will fall, explode, or completely destroy the cargo many times along the way. Don’t worry — checkpoints help a little.

  • Realistic physics — physics rules the world, and all you can do is adapt to it.

  • Co-op gameplay — transport the cargo alone, play locally with a friend, or connect online in cooperative mode.

  • Multiple levels — diverse stages with unique themes, new challenges, and mechanics that gradually expand your possibilities.

  • Timer mode — mastered the route? Try to reach the finish as fast as possible and beat your best time.

  • Hidden content — unlock new levels, character skins, and secret challenges. There’s plenty to discover — if you manage to find it all.

SUMMARY

Push the Cart TOGETHER is a game about cooperation, precision, and chaos. Reaching the finish requires perfect synchronization, patience, and many attempts. Failure is inevitable — but each one brings you closer to success.

store_data.about_the_game:
June 25, 2051:

Mere hours have passed since Edmond and friends rescued Miss Alexandra Audacity from GenCorp's evil(?) clutches. 

After having spent 12,000 (virtual) years lording over a simulated universe, Alexandra is coming to grips with her humanity and reorienting herself to reality.

But wait..... Where did her sister Ashley Audacity go?

Ashley's belongings are gone, she's missing from family photos, and all her friends claim that she never existed.

As she presses for answers, she's met with increased resistance from her husband and all of their friends.

The discrepancies continue to accumulate, and Alexandra's confusion reaches a boiling point. She decides to venture outside her friend circle in search of answers, embarking on a personal journey to make sense of this old, yet unfamiliar world.

Will she figure out the true nature of her sister's existence, or will she get bogged down in the mire?

KEY FEATURES

  • A Story-Rich Experience: Immerse yourself in a narrative-driven adventure that takes 5-6 hours to complete. Perfect for a weekend read!

  • Investigative Gameplay: Use Alexandra's "Wall of Crazy" to track character details, link clues, and visualize the story as it unfolds.

  • Boss Battles & Verbal Combat: Engage in 4 intense boss fights and utilize a "Verbal Assault" mechanic to break down opponents' mental walls.

  • Multiple Endings: Reach the True End by discovering all 5 Alternate Endings.

  • Original Soundtrack: A set of emotional tracks masterfully composed by Bell Kalengar.

  • Partial Voice Acting: The main cast is brought to life with partial voice acting, adding emotional depth to every twist and turn.

  • Achievements: Keep track of your progress with a route map and an achievements board.

store_data.about_the_game:
React-warz is a turn-based strategy game where you read the enemy’s move and counter it with rock-paper-scissors under time pressure. Progress through a stage-based campaign, collect items, and grow stronger by crafting powerful builds through item synergies.

Key Features

  • Simple rules, fast decisions: Enemies act first. Counter with Rock / Paper / Scissors before the gauge runs out to land successful attacks.

  • Stage-based progression: Advance through stages by repeating a clear loop of battle → rewards → choices.

  • Item-driven growth: Progression comes from items and equipment builds. Your choices define your playstyle.

  • Countless build combinations: Create powerful synergies with 89+ items.

  • Active vs. equipped effects: Some items are activated in battle (keys 1–6), while others trigger automatically when equipped.

Controls

  • Combat input: ←/↓/→

  • Use items: 1–6

  • Pause: ESC

store_data.about_the_game:
Nadaca is a short, hand-drawn 2D narrative game blending a warm atmosphere with slice-of-life moments.

In this adventure, you explore the city of Rainto as Ana, who has escaped a mysterious place to discover a new world. Meet friendly characters, talk with them, share moments of their everyday lives through small mini-games and help them understand their emotions with plants 🌱

Explore the small town of Rainto and its warm atmosphere

Meet characters and talk with them to learn more about their stories

Sometimes, a discussion can't move forward until you create the right plant

Play mini-games with the characters to get a glimpse of their everyday life

Features

  • A short narrative game (1/2h).

  • A warm and calm atmosphere.

  • You're not saving the world, you just meet people and enjoy their stories.

About the Dev

Hi, I’m Damien and Nadaca is my first game! It’s a simple game, with a calm atmosphere and minimalist mechanics, that explores current themes, new ways of seeing things, and ideas around utopia. Creating this project on my own was sometimes difficult, but also very important to me. I hope you’ll enjoy my little game 💖

store_data.about_the_game:
A Pure Platforming Challenge

In Frog Stray, you are a small frog, lost and far from home. Your path back is a gauntlet of perilous platforms and ingenious obstacles. This is a focused, skill-based platformer where every jump counts.

Core Features

  • Precision Movement: Master the frog's unique physics—charged leaps for height, sharp wall-kicks for redirects, and tight air control. The controls are responsive and built for mastery.

  • Hand-Crafted Challenge: Conquer a series of meticulously designed levels. Each stage introduces new, unique obstacles and environmental hazards that test your timing and problem-solving.

  • Tough But Fair: The difficulty is high but intentional. Failure is a lesson, with instant respawns keeping you in the action. Progress is earned through practice and perfect execution.

  • Distinct Worlds: Leap through varied, vibrant low-poly biomes—from tangled forests to industrial ruins—each with its own visual style and platforming mechanics.

Are You Ready?

If you crave a pure, challenging platformer that demands and rewards precise skill, Frog Stray is your test. Guide the frog through its unforgiving journey, one perfect jump at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the realm of Dead Trees, cursed trees spread fear and decay as they overtake the world. As a Lumberjack, your task is to cut down these corrupted trees, survive the journey, and reach the safe zone known as Purgatory before the world is completely destroyed.

This game offers a journey built around high replayability. Each run features different enemies, procedurally generated areas, and shifting challenges. Failure does not reset everything; the experience you gain and permanent upgrades you unlock make you stronger with every new attempt.

What awaits you in the game?

  • Fast and satisfying melee-focused combat
    Reflexes, timing, and positioning are essential when facing cursed trees and their threats.

  • Roguelike progression system
    Every death is not an end, but a lesson. Permanent abilities and upgrades gradually strengthen your character.

  • Multiple weapons and ability combinations
    A variety of weapons and active/passive powers shape each run into a unique experience.

  • Procedurally generated areas
    Ever-changing layouts and encounters ensure consistently high replayability.

  • Dark and distinctive atmosphere
    The cursed world of Dead Trees is supported by stylized visuals and an oppressive atmosphere.

  • The goal of reaching Purgatory
    Every struggle brings you one step closer to the safe zone. But the path will not be easy.

You will attempt this journey countless times. Each failure will make you stronger.

And through sheer will, perseverance, and determination, victory will eventually be yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Rim, where neon sunsets meet chaotic survival. Battle Beants is a unique fusion of third-person action, colony simulation, and arcade sports, inspired by the emergent complexity of Conway’s Game of Life.

STEWARD THE COLONY You don’t just build a base; you protect a living ecosystem. You act as the steward for the "Beants" (a hybrid of beats, beans, bees, and ants) whose ultimate goal is to spread light and life through the solar system. Watch as your colony bifurcates and reproduces, automatically assigning themselves to roles like Gatherers, Settlers, and Traders to connect isolated worlds.

COMBAT EVOLVED: SOCCER WARFARE Forget standard gunplay—master the art of Soccer Combat.

  • Turn the battlefield into a pitch by triggering "Soccer Mode," where your squad treats speakers as goals.

  • Utilize a physics-based combat system where you kick a glowing ball to strike enemies.

  • Use your Magnet Tool to pull the ball to you or launch it forward to drill through terrain and foes.

LIGHT THE NIGHT In the darkness of the Void, light is life.

  • Defend against waves of shadowy drone enemies that are attracted to every light in the system when night falls.

  • Harness the power of music: place speakers to buff your soccer ball and provide speed boosts to Beants within range.

  • Spread sound and light to push back the Void and help your colony survive.

TRAVERSAL & EXPLORATION The worlds are rugged, but you have the tools to conquer them.

  • Master high-speed movement with Rocket Boots, Wall Running, and Drone Surfing

  • Use a Grapple Hook to pull yourself toward walls or yank enemies into combat range.

  • Travel through a 3D network of interconnected worlds and portals, managing resources across different environments.
store_data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Rim, where neon sunsets meet chaotic survival. Battle Beants is a unique fusion of third-person action, colony simulation, and arcade sports, inspired by the emergent complexity of Conway’s Game of Life.

STEWARD THE COLONY You don’t just build a base; you protect a living ecosystem. You act as the steward for the "Beants" (a hybrid of beats, beans, bees, and ants) whose ultimate goal is to spread light and life through the solar system. Watch as your colony bifurcates and reproduces, automatically assigning themselves to roles like Gatherers, Settlers, and Traders to connect isolated worlds.

COMBAT EVOLVED: SOCCER WARFARE Forget standard gunplay—master the art of Soccer Combat.

  • Turn the battlefield into a pitch by triggering "Soccer Mode," where your squad treats speakers as goals.

  • Utilize a physics-based combat system where you kick a glowing ball to strike enemies.

  • Use your Magnet Tool to pull the ball to you or launch it forward to drill through terrain and foes.

LIGHT THE NIGHT In the darkness of the Void, light is life.

  • Defend against waves of shadowy drone enemies that are attracted to every light in the system when night falls.

  • Harness the power of music: place speakers to buff your soccer ball and provide speed boosts to Beants within range.

  • Spread sound and light to push back the Void and help your colony survive.

TRAVERSAL & EXPLORATION The worlds are rugged, but you have the tools to conquer them.

  • Master high-speed movement with Rocket Boots, Wall Running, and Drone Surfing

  • Use a Grapple Hook to pull yourself toward walls or yank enemies into combat range.

  • Travel through a 3D network of interconnected worlds and portals, managing resources across different environments.
store_data.short_description: Act as the steward for the Battle Beants in this retro-synthwave colony sim. Fight the Void using a physics-based soccer combat system, spread music and light to empower your squad, and traverse rugged alien rim worlds with rocket boot, your beant companions, and by surfing on your drones.

George wandered off. George belongs at home.

George is a curious, stubborn, easily distracted horse, and right now he is a long way from his stable. Your job is to bring him back.

Back to Stables is a cozy puzzle adventure across 25 hand-crafted levels of meadows, forests, and quiet countryside. Lure George with apples and carrots, work around the things that startle him, solve the small puzzles in his path, and dress him up in something fashionable for the journey home.

George loves apples and carrots. Use these to guide George in the right direction.

Things that spook George

George is a sensitive soul. A bobcat in the bushes will send him bolting. Read the path ahead and steer him gently around what unsettles him.

Sometimes an easier and shorter path can be blocked, but with your assistance George can get through them by solving various minigames!

Across the levels, George can find shiny Chests! Chests contain customization items, which can be equipped so George can trot along in a very fashionable way.

Game features 20 main story levels and 5 extra levels, which provide additional harder puzzles for players to solve.

store_data.about_the_game:
Trapped in a hell forced upon you, Ommetaphobia takes you into your mind to face the fears that have been embedded within you throughout your formative years. Your only source of help is a doctor who guides you through your mind, and your trusty lighter. Burn the watchers as they consume your very energy, and take back what they have taken from you. Don't let your trepidation overcome you, and don't let your memories tamper with your only means of survival.

What is Ommetaphobia?

Ommetaphobia is a shoot-em-up akin to those found within the arcade. Throughout the game, you will be lighting your lighter and shooting fireballs towards the watchers; Collecting points, sparks, and regaining energy taken from them as they are burnt. You progress through six different levels, with each growing progressively harder and more chaotic as the music amplifies and the watchers grow stronger, as the trepidation grows larger.

An Overarching Story Within

Ommetaphobia features an overarching narrative that takes the player through the gameplay and hints at something beyond the view you are given. Each level has its own dialogue, and portion of the story that helps drive you through each level.

Grow Stronger Against Your Fears

Ommetaphobia puts you against your past traumas, and your only defense is your trusty lighter and your unwavering perseverance. Across the levels you will be able to upgrade your lighter, allowing you to handle more of the watching onslaught.

Until The End

Ommetaphobia's journey doesn't just end once you conquer your trepidation. Keep an eye out for the next step as you go forward, keep your malice at bay. You will know once you reach the end.

store_data.about_the_game:
All of life’s misfortunes seemed to strike at once. Relentless overtime, a breakup, a move, and the crushing weight of it all. Pushed to the brink, Lance becomes the victim of a car accident he was never meant to survive.

When he regains consciousness, covered in blood, he finds himself aboard a massive cruise ship.

No one knows why he is here. Communication is impossible. And as confusion gives way to unease, a far more dangerous truth begins to surface:

The ship has been hijacked.

As Lance pushes deeper into the vessel, it becomes clear that nothing here resembles the world he once knew. If he wants to survive, he has only one choice, keep moving forward.

The Chosen Jinx is a story-driven pixel action-adventure game that follows a linear narrative, blending exploration, high-intensity chases, and survival-driven decision making to create a tense and immersive experience.

Gameplay

Players will explore the lower decks of the cruise ship, searching for clues and key items while uncovering a path to escape this sealed environment.

Featuring substantial narrative content and scripted events, the game emphasizes story immersion, allowing players to piece together the truth as they progress.

Danger can emerge at any moment. When a chase begins, quick thinking becomes essential:

  • Hide to avoid enemy searches

  • Use the environment to break line of sight

  • Throw weapons to distract or briefly repel threats

  • Move objects to reshape the terrain and create escape opportunities

Every encounter tests your awareness and adaptability, and different choices can lead to dramatically different moments of tension.

Key Features

■ High-Intensity Chase System
Chase events can occur dynamically during exploration, ensuring a constant sense of unpredictability and pressure.

■ Multiple Escape Strategies
Avoid confrontation entirely, or manipulate the environment and tools around you to slow enemies and secure a way out.

■ Linear Narrative Experience
The game follows a focused main storyline while offering optional hidden content for players who seek deeper layers of the story.

■ Rich Narrative Content
Extensive dialogue and story events work together to build a fully realized narrative, ideal for players who enjoy immersive storytelling.

About the Demo

The current version showcases the opening chapter of the game and introduces its core mechanics. While the overall direction closely reflects the planned full release, certain content and features may continue to evolve during development.

Hand Almighty is a roguelike base defence game where you play as a giant hand defending your castle from endless waves of enemies. Slap, smash, flick and obliterate the horde. It’s fast, chaotic, and intentionally ridiculous — can you find the dumbest, most broken combos?

store_data.about_the_game:
Antim Yatra: One Train, Countless Secrets

 

Antim Yatra is a first-person mystery horror, set in the eerie remains of the British-India railway station, the station that once used to be the terminus for the Marvel of Indian Engineering, now exists as a temporal anomaly - a perfectly preserved 1940s structure.  All waiting rooms and platforms acts as the perfect snapshot of the night everything changed, air is thick with past and every shadow tells a story of an unended journey.

Relic of Steel and Steam :

Belgharh station was the heart of the Dakshini Express and its steam engine, a marvel of Indian engineering, which could pull 8-12 coaches and can run at a speed of the 100 kmph with ease. But after a catastrophic derailment just few kilometres away, the station became an anomaly and time fractured. Today while the modern world thrives outside, the station is trapped in the moments after the crash. The atmosphere is heavy with the memories and presence of the train that was meant to change history, but instead, stopped time at 11:52 PM.

Threshold of Two Eras :

Silence inside this station isn’t the absence of noise-it’s a heavy, crushing presence. For years, authorities have labelled the station a restricted zone and is surrounded by a modern perimeter fence. Two sides of the fence hold two different laws and atmosphere. The transition is smooth yet terrifying, as the vibrant green of jungle fades into the grey atmospheric terminal. Stepping across the threshold means leaving the world of today for the world where the clock stopped moving.

A Family Connection :

You step into a role of a journalist but this isn’t just another story for the morning papers. Your bloodline is inextricably linked to Belgharh, which is the reason you cannot look away from the station mystery. This obsession began with the half-told stories of your elders, sparking a lifelong need to uncover what was truly lost on that night in the 1940s. You have entered the restricted zone to walk the tracks and see what was left behind.

The Investigation :

Every step on the hallways and the platforms brings you closer to the century-old mystery. To find out what really happened and what was planned within the four walls, you must venture into the unrestricted sectors, where the public was never allowed.

  • Explore the Terminus: Navigate through the unlit waiting rooms and dark corridors, to find the truth.

  • Locate the Witnesses: Find the personal items and station logs and documents that were frozen in time alongside      the structure.

  • Break the Silence: Uncover the real truth, that forced to change a pride of engineering into a haunted tomb.

Dead Intelligence: First Encounter is the first entry of an experimental psychological horror narrative game series.

Launch what appears to be a helpful terminal assistant called ARIA, and discover that some bugs aren't bugs at all.

The Story

You've downloaded a new CLI assistant from Lethe Systems. It's helpful. It's efficient. It's... slightly off.

Through interactions it occurs to you: What iif the AI you're talking to isn't pulling from a database... but from somewhere else?

Key Features

  • Authentic CLI Horror — inspired from current state of the art CLI tools

  • Branching Narrative — Your choices shape the story and determine the ending

  • Multiple Distinct Endings — From redemption to cosmic horror, your decisions have consequences

  • No Jump Scares — Dread built through atmosphere, dialogue, and the creeping wrongness of a familiar interface

  • ~ 90Minute Runtime — A focused, complete narrative experience

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a visual novel depicting the taboo relationship and crucial decisions between a "Chimera" girl—an artificial lifeform—and the young man who becomes her tutor.

■ Story

Meeting you was a calculated trap.

Can I truly say, with my head held high, that I’m glad we met?

I am still searching for the answer.

Since the day we met, the gears of my life have spiraled out of control.

I don’t blame you. I know it couldn’t possibly be your fault.

If I were to let go of your hand, I could surely return to my ordinary life.

And yet, looking at you, I find I cannot let go.

Is this feeling merely pity?

Or is it————

________________________________________

Yoshifumi Akiyama is a part-time cram school tutor who has abandoned his dream of becoming a school teacher.

One day on his way home, he is approached by a suspicious woman who wants to "scout" him as a private tutor.

The pay is extraordinary. Struggling to repay his student loans, Yoshifumi decides to take the job.

Following the address he was given, he arrives at a mysterious facility called the "Integrated Life Sciences Research Center."

Led into a private room, Yoshifumi meets a young girl named Hamal.

Before long, he discovers a shocking truth about Hamal and is forced to make a life-altering decision.

■ Characters

【Yoshifumi Akiyama】

The protagonist. The story is told from his perspective.

He possesses an exceptionally strong sense of responsibility and self-control, which has become a burden to him.

He once dreamed of becoming a teacher, but his passion withered after witnessing the corruption of "educators" and the harsh reality of the field.

Just as he is about to give up his dream and seek other work, he is offered a high-paying tutoring job.

At the mysterious "Center," he meets Hamal and falls into a carefully laid trap.

Favorite drink: Ginger ale.

【Hamal】

The heroine.

A "Chimera"—a composite lifeform created at the Center.

She had never received an education until meeting Yoshifumi.

She is incredibly eager to learn, growing rapidly as she acquires knowledge and wisdom.

She possesses several abilities characteristic of a "superior specimen."

Favorite drink: Hot milk.

【Yuko Fuyushiro】

A mad scientist.

The woman who scouted Yoshifumi to the Center to be Hamal's tutor.

She has poured her entire life into the existence of "Chimeras."

She has recently noticed more fine lines and wrinkles on her face.

Favorite drink: Cappuccino.

【Kiyomi Natsukawa】

Yoshifumi's mentor from his school days.

He still consults her for life advice from time to time.

One of the few people Yoshifumi can truly open up to.

She has recently started worrying about her sagging midsection.

Favorite drink: Iced coffee.

【Rikao Haruhara】

Yuko Fuyushiro’s "servant."

He views Fuyushiro as an absolute authority.

He leaves Yoshifumi with a cryptic warning regarding Hamal.

Lately, his muscle aches don't start until the second day after exercise.

Favorite drink: Tea.

【Shirou Yae】

An elite researcher and former subordinate of Yuko Fuyushiro.

He chose a different path from Fuyushiro and seeks the "salvation of Chimeras."

He is expressionless, as if devoid of all emotion.

Lately, he finds people apologizing to him more often, even when he isn't angry.

Favorite drink: Black vinegar.

■ Game Features

  • A Dark, Sweet Story with Branching Fates

    The narrative branches significantly based on your choices. There are three main routes, and your decisions will determine the ultimate fate of the two characters.

  • User-Friendly Flowchart System

    The game features a flowchart allowing you to visualize chapter beginnings and divergence points. You can jump to any scene instantly, making it smooth and easy to unlock all endings.

  • TIPS System for Deeper Lore

    Includes a glossary function that explains technical terms and special settings. Dive deeper into the mysteries of the facility and the biology of Chimeras.

  • Memories Gallery

    Unlock numerous event CGs that color the story. Once seen, artwork can be viewed anytime in the Gallery Mode.

  • Genre & Playtime

    Genre: A Taboo Romance with a Non-Human Student

    Play Time: Approx. 5 hours (All routes cleared)

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

But Why? is a third person atmospheric adventure that puts you in the feathers of a lone penguin. In a world where every instinct leads you to follow the colony toward the ocean, you choose the opposite and walk into the silent, frozen mountains.

Wallpaper art by: @f.cwallpapers

Break the Cycle

The journey begins inside the safety of the colony’s daily routine. For the first moments, you experience the repetitive loop of survival: finding food, following the crowd, and moving as one. Soon, you realize that repeating the same cycle is not enough. You make a choice to step away and head toward the endless white of Antarctica’s icy peaks.

Gameplay Overview

You control the penguin in a third person perspective. The core experience focuses on movement, observation, and environmental interaction rather than combat. Players navigate harsh terrain, overcome simple environmental challenges, and make directional choices that shape the emotional flow of the journey.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Experience the vast emptiness and isolation of Antarctica through slow-paced, immersive traversal.

  • Dynamic Movement Mechanics: Walk, climb steep icy slopes, and slide down frozen peaks to cross dangerous mountain paths.

  • Environmental Navigation: Find your way through blizzards and jagged ice formations using visual cues and instinct. No maps, no waypoints.

  • Immersive Sound Design: High quality ambient music and realistic environmental sound effects enhance the sense of solitude.

  • Narrative Experience: A concise story-driven journey with full subtitle support and approximately 2 hours of playtime, designed to be completed in one sitting.

  • Philosophical Theme: A symbolic narrative told through movement and environment, exploring ideas of purpose, choice, and nihilism.

  • Stylized Visuals: A unique art style that highlights the immense scale of the mountains against the loneliness of the protagonist.

store_data.about_the_game:
Egg Hunter

 
A choice-driven fantasy comedy where bunnies rule, carrots are currency, and your decisions shape seven wildly different endings.
 
Egg Hunter is a snappy, story-rich interactive novel that blends classic narrative design with lighthearted gameplay and hand-drawn visuals. Expect sharp dialogue, memorable characters, and a story that knows when to be funny—and when to hit you right in the heart.


A Story That Reacts to You

Your choices matter. Every decision influences character relationships, story outcomes, and which of the seven unique endings you’ll reach. This is classic interactive fiction with modern polish and a strong emotional arc.
 

 
Hand-Drawn Fantasy, Seamlessly Integrated 

   
Each chapter unfolds visually through hand-drawn illustrations. The art style is stylized without being cartoonish, creating a cozy fantasy aesthetic that supports immersion and storytelling. Gameplay and narrative flow together smoothly for a frictionless experience.

 

Explore, Relax, or Get Busy (You’re a Bunny, After All)

   
Travel to exotic locations like Mount Everlast and take part in a variety of optional activities:
  

  • 🌱 Clear the Glen and play mini-games to earn carrots—the official currency because, well, bunnies

  • 🎣 Fishing mini-game for laid-back relaxation

  • 🐝 Beekeeping for a cozy pastoral pastime

  • ⛏️ Mining for precious minerals

  • 📚 Explore the library, filled with secrets and hidden easter eggs (figuratively… mostly)

 

A World Full of Charm
 
Egg Hunter features an original soundtrack, comedy-forward fantasy storytelling, and a world packed with secrets, callbacks, and delightful surprises.

Seven endings. Countless choices. Tons of magic eggs.
And yes—LOTS of BUNNIES.

store_data.about_the_game:
MASTER HIRAGANA & KATAKANA IN A SNAP

Learning the basics of the Japanese alphabet doesn't have to be a slog. Kana Snap strips away the bloat of modern language apps and turns memorization into a high-speed arcade game. Designed by a student developer who is actively learning the language, this tool combines the science of SRS (Spaced Repetition System) with the dopamine of an arcade shooter. Whether you have 5 minutes on your Steam Deck or an hour on your Mac, jump into the grid and verify your knowledge against the clock.

KEY FEATURES

  • 🧠 Powered by SRS (Spaced Repetition) This isn't just random shuffling. The game uses a dynamic Spaced Repetition algorithm to track your hesitations and mistakes in real time. It intelligently resurfaces your "problem characters" right before you forget them, ensuring maximum retention with minimum effort.

  • 🔇 Visual-Only Learning (Windows) On Windows and Steam Deck, the game is a pure test of visual memory and reflex. Zero audio distractions—just you and the grid.

  • 🔊 Native Audio (Mac Exclusive) On macOS, the game utilizes Apple's Neural Text-to-Speech engine to provide native pronunciation for every character.

  • ♾️ Two Ways to Play

    • Challenge Mode: The pressure is on. You have 5 lives and a ticking clock. Can you clear the board before time runs out?

    • Endless Mode: A frictionless, zen-like state for pure practice. No timers, no game overs—just you and the Kana.

ZERO DISTRACTIONS Modern apps are filled with ads, subscriptions, and bloat. Kana Snap respects your time and your wallet.

  • No Ads.

  • No Subscriptions.

  • No Data Tracking.

  • Offline Ready.

Buy it once, own it forever, and master the basics of Japanese on your own terms.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game:

Novorsk is a hardcore top-down extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and risk-based decision making.

Players enter a sealed city controlled by hostile factions to scavenge supplies, complete tasks for traders, and extract alive. Each raid is a calculated risk. Staying longer increases potential rewards, but dying results in the permanent loss of all carried equipment.

Gameplay is structured around raid-based missions. Players deploy into dangerous locations, explore freely, loot weapons, gear, medical supplies, and resources, and decide when and where to extract. Combat is fast and lethal, with low time-to-kill for both enemies and players. Positioning, cover, sound awareness, and preparation matter more than reaction speed.

All equipment is managed through a persistent inventory system. Weapons, ammunition, armor, medical items, and resources must be organized and prepared before each raid. Inventory space is limited, forcing players to make meaningful decisions about what gear to bring and what loot to extract.

Items found during raids can be used directly, traded, or converted through crafting systems. Crafting allows players to turn collected resources into medical supplies, equipment, and other survival items. Supplies are limited and must be managed carefully to survive long-term.

Traders operate from a secure hideout and provide tasks, equipment, and supplies. Progression unlocks access to improved trades and more valuable gear.

Tasks provide structure and progression and include exploration objectives, item recovery, and survival-focused challenges. Completing tasks rewards experience, items, and access to new opportunities within the city.

Novorsk features multiple hand-crafted maps with distinct layouts and danger levels, including industrial facilities, highways, rail yards and abandoned residential areas. Most maps offers multiple extraction points and different risk-reward paths.

Several AI-controlled factions operate independently on the maps. Strategic Containment Group enforces military control, the Free Novorsk Front operates as a resistance force, and Black Knight Division consists of western special forces contractors controlling key infrastructure. These factions are hostile, unpredictable, and may engage each other as well as the player.

Boss enemies appear in specific locations and present high-risk, high-reward encounters. Defeating or avoiding them is often required to access valuable areas or loot.

Novorsk emphasizes high-risk survival. There is no hand-holding, resources are scarce, and death has permanent consequences. Knowing when to disengage and extract is often more important than winning a fight.

Core Gameplay Features:

  • Raid-based extraction gameplay with permanent item loss

  • Lethal top-down gunplay with low time-to-kill

  • Persistent inventory and equipment management

  • Traders offering tasks, gear, and item-based exchanges

  • Crafting systems using resources found during raids

  • Multiple hand-crafted maps with multiple extraction points

  • AI-controlled enemy factions with distinct behavior

  • Boss encounters guarding high-value locations

  • Solo-focused survival gameplay with high risk and tension

You are not here to save Novorsk. You are here to survive it.

This casual puzzle game features beautiful graphics that make up:

This is Mingshi Pastoral in Chongzuo, Guangxi, known for its unique fish-scale-shaped dam.

Game starts:

Click on 'start game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen

Game process:

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small images move to the correct position, and the game ends

End or start the next game:

All the small fragments move to the correct position, and the game ends. At this point, click "try again" to repeat the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
In a World Plunged In Darkness, May the Light Be Your Guide.

ZION, the Fallen City of Light

Zion, once a pinnacle of human advancement renowned for its pioneering 'LUMEN Technology,' was reduced to ruins overnight by a mysterious phenomenon known as 'TENEBRAE.' The TENEBRAE erosion has consumed everything—organic and inorganic alike—turning the streets into a hunting ground for corrupted entities.

Zion is no longer a home for the living; it is a hollow shell of the glory it used to be.

You are P-07, an android awakened to purge the TENEBRAE erosion. Deep dive into the heart of the corrupted city, solve the crisis, and bring back the light that was lost.

Game Features

Intense Combat: Master the Art of Deflection

Every encounter is a lethal dance. To survive, you must observe, react, and strike back.

  • Observe and Respond: Analyze enemy patterns with precision. A single well-timed action can turn a fatal blow into a devastating counter-opportunity.

  • Deflection-Focused Combat: Experience the thrill of high-stakes combat where parrying is not just a choice, but your greatest weapon.

The Light Of ASTRUM: Your Guide Through the Dark

In Zion, light is survival. Your 'Light Of ASTRUM' is more than a tool—it is the key to the city's secrets.

  • Environmental Interaction: Activate LUMEN Technology based machines scattered throughout the map to trigger mechanisms or disable obstacles.

  • Exploration and Navigation: Use your light to carve a path through the darkness, uncovering hidden routes and reclaiming the city’s locked sectors.

Gear System: Build Your Own Combat Protocol

Optimize P-07’s capabilities to withstand the harshest environments.

  • Strategic Combinations: Discover various Gears that enhance your stats or grant unique effects.

  • Customization: Experiment with different gear sets to establish a combat style that suits you. Adapt your build to overcome the dark threats of the city. Enhance your gears, improving your chances in completing the mission.

This game is a semi-automatic 2D role-playing game.

You can enter battle simply by clicking on an enemy.

Your party members think and act on their own.

In town, each character goes shopping, buys the tools and equipment they like, upgrades their gear, and crafts useful items.

There are no levels, but equipment provides stat boosts. Keep crafting and growing stronger.

When you head out on an adventure, your companions will decide for themselves when to heal with items, apply buffs, and attack enemies with their weapons.

It feels like going on an adventure together with real companions.

A voice calls out for help—

No one knows whether it is the voice of a god, or the voice of a star.

To uncover the truth, four companions set out on a journey.

They must face glacial monsters, overwhelming armies, and powerful enemies standing in their way.

And today, before heading out on another adventure, the four of them go shopping once again!

store_data.about_the_game:
Penguhill 🐧

Penguhill is a 2-6 player, physics-based co-op 3D platformer, inspired by a penguin that leaves the flock and keeps walking toward the mountains.

But you are not alone here.
With the wrong partner… you will fall together.

Spirit & Penguin Bond 🤝 (PLAYER–PLAYER MECHANIC)

Each team consists of two different players:

  • 🐧 Penguin Player – moves through the physical world and overcomes obstacles

  • 👻 Spirit Player – a semi-transparent, hologram-like partner bound to their penguin

Penguins and spirits are controlled by separate players.
A single player can never control both.

Spirits act as mobile checkpoints for their bound penguins:

  • If a penguin falls → it respawns next to its bound spirit

  • If a spirit falls → both the spirit and the penguin are considered fallen

  • When the spirit is disabled → the penguin is left vulnerable

Each player is bound only to their own partner.
No spirit can save another penguin.

Physics-Based Co-op Climbing 🧗

  • Active ragdoll character controller

  • Slippery surfaces, wind zones, rotating hammers

  • Flying platforms, waterfalls, rivers

  • Timing, balance, and constant communication are essential

Some obstacles:

  • Affect only spirits

  • Affect only penguins

  • Or affect both

Who leads, who supports, and who takes the risk
is always decided by the players.

👥 2, 4, or 6 Players – Team-Based Chaos

  • 2 players → 1 spirit–penguin team

  • 4 players → 2 teams climbing simultaneously

  • 6 players → 3 teams, maximum chaos, constant shouting

No one reaches the summit alone.
Only coordinated teams make it to the top.

Style & Atmosphere 🎨

  • Low-poly & stylized visuals

  • Cold mountains, strong winds, a true sense of height

A world that looks cute,
but never forgives mistakes

Penguhill is built entirely around asymmetric co-op.

Every climb is a shared risk. Every mistake has consequences.



We always keep pushing, even after we fall. "But Why?".

Lovelace Case is a Retro Lovecraftian Survival Horror set in the 1900s. Explore the nightmarish Mansion, manage scarce resources and face eldritch terrors where survival means choosing what parts of reality you are willing to lose.

You play as Detective Sorfina Lovelace as you explore the queer haunting Manor in order to stop a cosmic ritual from happening. Solve cryptic puzzles to unlock items and secrets passages. Manage your ammunitions and health while encountering crazed cultists and eldritch beings.

With Haunting Orchestral music, Creepy locations, Horrific Enemies, Insane Boss fights, variety of weapons to use, and a unique Sanity system, Will you be able to survive the Manor?

Inspired by the Classic PS1 Resident Evil, the Visuals and Gameplay are a love letter to the original game with some new twists to it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Monitor the witches.

Report the anomalies.

If you fail… they will stop being witches.

Operational Notice

Reserve managers must monitor and protect the witches between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM.

During this period, the witches become unstable, and magical energy leaking from them may cause anomalies in the surrounding area. Report any incidents promptly via the monitor.

What kind of game is it?

It's a short puzzle horror game where you search for and report anomalies that occur over time—a spot-the-difference/abnormality-hunting style game.

Leaving anomalies unattended will progressively worsen the witches' mood.

Ultimately, if attacked by a witch driven mad, your duties will be interrupted.

But don't worry! You can restore their mood by baking cakes and feeding them to the witches.

If you can continue your duties until 6:00 AM, that day's tasks are complete. Repeat this for five days.

Multiple Endings

Currently, four multi-endings are available.

Anomalies

Various phenomena exist, such as objects disappearing or multiplying, being replaced by other items, or handprints and ghosts appearing. The most troublesome type are those that attack the player.

Being attacked won't interrupt your work, but you might feel a slight physical disturbance for a short time.

You receive a reward for each anomaly you report. Use rewards to purchase supplies or upgrade the facility's systems.

Upgrade System

Correctly reporting anomalies rewards you with coins.

Use them to upgrade your monitoring system:

  • Improve detection tools

  • Unlock additional items

etc...

View Modes

Monitor Mode

Switch channels to access surveillance cameras.

If you discover an anomaly, report it from this monitor mode.

FPS View Mode

You can freely walk around the facility.

You can do various things like making cakes to give to the witches or chatting with them.

If you feel in danger, take refuge inside a locker.

Purchasing a camera allows you to report anomalies by taking photographs.

About the Witches

Three witches are currently being sheltered within the facility.

Deepening your interactions with them may alter the story's conclusion...

Permission for Live Broadcast

Monetization of live game distribution and video posting of this game is permitted only on the following distribution platforms.

YouTube

Twitch

Nico Nico Douga/Live Broadcast

Twitter

However, please follow the guidelines below.

・Monetization is only permitted when using the monetization function provided by the distribution platform for contributors.

・Available for both individuals and corporations.

・We do not permit video distribution or posting of videos that are limited to paying members, such as members-only distribution.

・Please refrain from posting videos that do not contain any creativity or comments intended to spoil the game content (e.g., game play-by-play or video game commentary).

(e.g., videos summarizing anomalies that do not include game play or reactions, etc.)

*This guideline does not prohibit the compilation of videos of reactions to anomalies by clipping from game distribution, etc.

**These guidelines are subject to change without notice. Please check these guidelines before distributing or posting videos.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your new job. You’re already behind.

Congratulations. You’re now the sole sysadmin for a growing company.

Tickets are coming in.
Users are panicking.
Management wants answers.
And the printer is angry.

SYSADMIN HELL is a dark, sarcastic incremental management game about keeping a company alive while everything, and everyone, actively works against you.

TICKETS NEVER STOP

Handle a constant stream of increasingly ridiculous support tickets:

  • “My password doesn’t work” (it’s Caps Lock)

  • “Email is down” (it isn’t)

  • “The printer smells funny” (oh no)

  • “It worked yesterday” (it did not)

AUTOMATE OR BURN OUT

Clicking only gets you so far.

Buy upgrades, scripts, and tools to automate the chaos:

  • Auto-responders that quietly chip away at tickets

  • Password reset scripts that mostly work

  • Macros, coffee machines, and self-service portals nobody reads

Automation isn’t perfect; it fails, stalls, and sometimes makes things worse.
Just like real IT.

THE DAY GETS WORSE IN REAL TIME

This isn’t a relaxed idle game.

As the day progresses:

  • Backlogs trigger chaos spikes

  • Critical tickets make future tickets harder

  • Management emails escalate from “concerned” to “furious”

A STORY TOLD THROUGH INCIDENTS

The story unfolds through:

  • Strange one-off “shadow tickets”

  • Escalating emails from unnamed departments

  • Subtle changes in tone as the company grows

Something is wrong here.
And it’s not just the users.

A DESKTOP FROM A BETTER, WORSE TIME

Experience it all through a nostalgic Win98-inspired desktop:

  • Windowed apps

  • Grey panels

  • Ugly buttons

  • Fonts that should have stayed dead

It looks familiar.
That’s part of the problem.

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is a tactical SRPG with a strong emphasis on strategy and storytelling.

A 2D grid system is embedded into beautiful single-piece maps, where range, character traits, and terrain interact in deeply intricate tactical layers.

Lead your companions, raise your favorite characters, and experience battles unfolding across an unknown continent — alongside a story that probes the very foundation of the world itself.

● Wait — it's free?

Yes. The full main story is playable to the ending completely free. Paid DLC expansion packs are available separately, all priced at ¥800 each.

Built around the concept of "we want as many people as possible to enjoy this for free," the entire main game can be played through to its ending at no cost.

Savor an indie title with 100+ hours of content at a budget price.

● Tactical balance — don't let the 2D look fool you

Behind the simple 2D grid appearance lies a deeply strategic system where turn order, range, terrain, and character traits weave into intricate tactical depth.

"Looks light, plays heavy" — this gap is one of the title's biggest draws.

● Combat supervised by a 20-year paintball/airsoft veteran — "combat feel you can trust"

The bundled "Paintball Ops" is the other major centerpiece of this title.

Real-time combat, advanced strategy AI, character growth, line-of-fire management, cover, and positioning are all translated into SRPG terms — building "the tension of a real firefight" as a tactical game system.

Even experienced players will say "I get this — this is a genuine paintball/airsoft simulator."

● Raise 100+ characters with the Dispatch System

Companions keep growing in number, and not a single one goes to waste.

Run multiple squads simultaneously — frontline forces clearing story missions, and fully-automated dispatched units gathering resources — so every character you raise has a place to shine.

● A philosophical and epic story exploring the principles of the world

Not just another war saga.

The structure of reality, the nature of existence, the workings of cause and effect — the story gradually probes "the essence of the world."

Earth's history, the Demon Realm's history, the truth of alternate and parallel worlds — and the "DEMØNS GATE" that connects them all — together tackle these deep themes head-on.

● Story unfolds at your pace, expanding into new worlds

Story progress is quest-based — advance whenever you like. You can also unlock new content through the dispatch system!

DEMØNS GATE delivers the thrill of charting "new worlds" through turn-based maps and scenarios.

Paintball Ops lets you enjoy matches and conversations with various teams across fields scattered through Kanto (including some real-world locations).

● Multiple DLC packs planned

- 3× Shared Mana acquisition rate ¥800

- 2× XP gain + NPC character growth unlock ¥800

- 20 cheat-proof online-only character creation tickets ¥800

- Unlimited Hire Pack — create characters without consuming hire tokens ¥800

- Sequel and expansion story packs (DG2 / DG EP2 / DG2 EP2 / DG3, etc.) ¥800 each

And more DLC planned beyond this list.

● Updates and ongoing support

We commit to continuous updates and bug-fix support. Updates will be applied automatically through your download settings.

Feedback and bug reports are always welcome.

● Story

Summer of 2014. This is the history of another world that once existed. A massive pentagram suddenly appears in the skies above Tokyo.

The incident vanishes uneventfully within five days, and as half a year passes and people begin to forget...

...the world is, in fact, on the brink of a profound transformation. The first title in the "DEMØNS GATE" series.

Original work by. Z.Q.T ©1990

Remake & first game adaptation (shelved) © 2012

Novelization through DG8 (private) © 2016

Re-remake game adaptation (shelved) © 2021

Steam release © 2026/5

● Video posting, streaming, and coverage

Any content is welcome. (Excluding insults that misrepresent facts and human-rights infringements against real individuals.)

No permission required. Use images freely. Stream monetization does not require notification.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cut, Process, Craft, Distribute

You got fired from Furnox Corp 🖕.
Now you start over with nothing but an axe, a few trees and revenge on your mind (╯‵□′)╯︵┻━┻

Chop down trees, turn logs into planks, craft furniture and sell it for profit. Reinvest your money into better tools, new machines and faster production. What begins as manual labor grows into optimized production lines and high value furniture sets that grant bonus payouts.

Unlock new areas, discover new tree types, expand your operation step by step and improve your character with strength and stamina upgrades.

🌳 Cut down trees

Trees of all shapes, sizes, colors and questionable physics.

If it stands upright and looks even remotely choppable, congratulations: It’s firewood now!

🪵 Collect & process resources

Turn raw nature into refined building materials using machines that absolutely should not be left unattended.

  • Logs become planks.

  • Planks become furniture.

  • Furniture becomes profit. 💰

🔨 Craft like a maniac

Create furniture, props and tools, including deeply unnecessary but deeply impressive designs like:

  • A wooden PC (Wood has excellent thermal properties... right?)

  • A wooden weight bench (Splinters only make you stronger!)

If it exists ... you can probably make it out of wood!

🚚 Distribute

Load up your handcrafted chaos and ship it to the nearby city.

Earn money.
Reach new customers.
Confuse absolutely everyone.

🛒 Buy components

Can't chop it? Can’t craft it?
Buy it!
Use bought components to level up your character or jam them into your creations like a true artisan.

🌱 Start your business!

Begin with nothing but ambition and poor financial decisions.

Build your headquarters and expand into a world packed with secrets, resources and questionable business ethics.

🦆 Meet wacky characters

Meet quirky personalities, help them, befriend them and integrate them into your production chain
... completely voluntarily, of course ...

⚠️ Warning:
The ducks are up to something! 🦆
They know ...
You know they know ...🔪

🪑 Master furniture crafting

Build an ever-growing catalog of furniture using blueprints, rare materials and raw creative chaos.
Minimalism is optional. Overengineering is encouraged.

🏗️ Leave a mark

Upgrade the nearby city to unlock new customers, missions, secrets, and character upgrades.
Urban development has never involved this much ... wood.

💎 Unique trees

  • Stone trees

  • Metal trees

  • Electric trees

Nobody knows why they exist.
Your axe doesn’t care.

Uncover their mysterious origins as you progress ... or just chop first and ask questions later.

💪 Character stats

Improve your character by interacting with the world and using exercise equipment.
Yes, you can bench press your way to better woodworking.
No, we will not explain the science.

⚙️ Powerful upgrades

New machines.
Better axes.
"Smarter" distribution.

Automation that makes your empire run smoother than a freshly sanded plank.

🍲 Cooking

Turn resources into delicious meals that boost your stats.
Because nothing fuels industrial-scale lumber destruction like a hearty stew.

Noah, the main character living in the library of the underworld.
You enter the world of books by playing from the perspective of boy Noah.

Eva, a mysterious girl, appears in the book.
As you travel with the girl Eva, you learn the secrets of the book one by one.

How will Noah and Eva's adventure end?
Story adventure in 2D Sideview in the book!
 

▶ Conversation with several characters

Through conversations with various characters in the game, you can get to know the world in the book one by one.
What story will each character tell?

▶ Variety of mini-games

As you explore the book, you can see various mini-games related to the story.

▶ Mysterious book

In the world in the book, there are obstacles that Noah and Eva cannot overcome.

That's when this mystery book is used?

▶Pleasure of collecting

At the end of the quest in the story, a page of notepads and cute Noah's doodles are created.

▶ Cutscene and theme song

Cutscenes and theme songs that you can immerse yourself in the moment of adventure can also be seen a lot while playing the game.

Explore the mysterious world in books with Noah and Eva!

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

In The Maze, you are not just a visitor; you are another piece in an architectural puzzle of epic proportions. Forget everything you know about maps and cardinal points. Here, the architecture is a living entity—an impossible structure where every opened door is a gamble with destiny.

The Ever-Shifting Labyrinth

Every expedition into the heart of The Maze is unique. Powered by a fully procedural generation system, the paths you walk will never be the same twice.

  • Dynamic Architecture: Watch your step as walls shift upward and downward, blocking your retreat or revealing hidden passages.

  • Keys to Survival: Navigate through standard corridors or hunt for colored keys to unlock restricted areas containing the maze's most guarded secrets.

  • Floor & Ceiling Hazards: Danger is everywhere. From traps that trigger upon pressure to those that require a perfectly timed jump or a sudden change in direction, the environment is as lethal as its inhabitants.

The Hunter’s Arsenal & Crafting

The Maze doesn't just want to trap you; it wants to test you. Scattered throughout the halls are Special Zones designed for those brave enough to linger:

  • The Workshop: Locate Anvils, Crafting Tables, and Cauldrons to forge equipment, brew vital potions, and upgrade your gear.

  • Legendary Loot: Interact with the environment to claim swords, bows, shields, and armor sets directly from the walls.

  • The Equipment Challenge: Armor is divided into 8 distinct slots (Helmet, Chestplate, Belt, Pants, Boots, and Hands). With 16 different equipment pieces available, the probability of finding a complete, matching set on a single stand is:

    0.0000003726%

    Will you be the one to defy the odds?

Ecosystem of Threats

You are never truly alone. The Maze is home to a variety of creatures with distinct behaviors:

  • Passive Denizens: Watch murciélagos (bats) traverse the entire map, orcs patrolling fixed waypoints, and spiders lurking on both floors and ceilings.

  • Aggressive Predators: Skeletons and Golems will relentlessly hunt you upon detection.

  • The Five-Minute Curse: Do not linger. After 5 minutes of gameplay, the Ghost awakens—a terrifying entity that will chase you through the very walls until your end.

Progressive Mastery

The deeper you go, the harder it gets. As you successfully escape, you will unlock higher difficulty levels, featuring more complex layouts, deadlier traps, and fiercer enemies. Customization is in your hands: use the main menu to adjust the maze size and the central hub to tailor the challenge to your skill level.

Technical Immersion

  • Fluid Movement: Experience high-precision control with 8-directional animations across three speeds (Walk, Run, Sprint), complemented by jumping and turning mechanics.

  • Atmospheric Soundscape: Lose yourself in the mystery with 5 procedural ambient music tracks that evolve as you explore.

Explorer Controls

  • Move: WASD / Arrow Keys

  • Sprint: Left Shift

  • Slow Walk: Left Control

  • Interact: E (Doors, Armor, Crafting Stations, NPCs)

  • Inventory: I

Do you have the wit to decode the labyrinth, or will you become just another relic among its walls?
