store_data.about_the_game:
The free demo for Act! Cellular Tuning—a rhythm game with fully innovative free-input gameplay—is now available!

Innovative Rhythm Play

An Unrestricted Performance Experience

Say goodbye to the constraints of “lanes” and “fixed keys.”

In Act!, the notes on screen are not tied to any specific physical buttons. You can trigger judgments by pressing any key on your keyboard or controller.

—Of course, it’s not that simple: to reach artistic mastery, you’ll need to explore optimal performance strategies, much like a pianist planning their fingering.

🟥 Beats:

Anchor yourself and tap repeatedly on the same key.

🟩 Flows:

Glide smoothly to adjacent keys in a continuous motion.

🟦 Techs:

Leap between distant keys in an alternating, rhythmic interplay.

Precise timing helps you score higher, while elegant fingering accelerates your tuning progress in the world of ACT.

A More Relaxed “Immersive Lean-Back Play” Style

No more intentionally punishing “skill checks” just for the sake of difficulty.

Multi-Dimensional Scoring:

Judgment accuracy and combos are no longer the only metrics. The world of ACT relies on your artistic performance to overcome challenges. Weave your own fingering patterns freely—the more immersed you are, the higher your evaluation will be!

Emphasis on Musical Expression:

Rather than testing raw speed, Act! charts focus on conveying the emotion and nuance of the music. Within the freedom of your fingering, experience a state of flow akin to “improvisation.”

Controller-Friendly Lean-Back Play:

Act! might just be the most controller-friendly rhythm game out there. After a long, tiring day when you just want to lie back and relax, this game will be your go-to choice.

Share Your Creativity with the World

Be more than a player—become a creator.

Act! comes with a powerful custom chart editor built right in, with deep support for chart creation using a controller.

Step away from the monotony of daily tasks, unwind with music, and unleash your creativity—then share your creations with Tuners worldwide.

Worldview

"Break the mold, awaken the self. Tune the cells, reshape the soul."

This is Act World. Here, humans and AI once coexisted in prosperity. But a silent crisis has arrived—a psychological plague known as "AI Somatization." New humans, eroded by AI logic, worship machine precision and efficiency, threatening to wipe out the warmth of old humanity.

You drift into the "inner side" of this world and meet a girl named "Little A" (Eiria). She asks you to cure this plague. Your task is surprisingly simple: use your fingertips to tune the cells of the human subconscious and reinject the precious resource known as "Spirituality" back into the world's Archetype.

Narrative & Systems

Fragmented Storytelling

No long-winded dialogues, just slowly permeating subconsciousness. In Act!, the story is hidden within fragments and items. Piece together the truth behind Act World during the brief rests between songs.

Collection & Progression

As you progress, you will unlock various practical support items. These items help you achieve achievements more easily or unlock fun collectibles—without affecting the fairness of competitive scoring. Aim for that 100% Collection Rate!

Full System Support

We are a mature rhythm game with everything you need. Beyond the Chart Editor, Act! provides all the essentials: A/V offset, latency adjustment, play statistics... It's all here. Play with peace of mind!

A Word from the Developer

Thanks for reading this far! I'm paperlens, a game industry "wage-slave" who used to be a Charter, Vocaloid Producer, and Clipper.

I still remember the passion O2Jam gave me when I was only as tall as a table. Rhythm games have been with me for 20 years, and I've wanted to make my own for about 10. In October 2025, I finally made up my mind—even without capital backing, I will realize this innovative rhythm game that fits my aesthetics.

I handled the design, programming, music, and art all by myself. It might not have the luxury quality of a AAA commercial title, but it is filled with my love for rhythm games. It would be my greatest joy to walk this path accompanied by fellow rhythm game fans! I hope to bring you a brand new experience and show more people the charm of this genre!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains anime-style characters with revealing outfits (e.g., implied partial nudity or suggestive clothing). Some collectible items feature text references to mature humor.

The story explores psychological themes including self-sacrifice and mental struggles. While the narrative includes metaphorical depictions of a character consuming their own life force (interpreted as self-harm ideation), there is no graphic depiction of suicide or extreme violence.

store_data.about_the_game:
Imagine waking up on the dock of a floating village in the middle of a vast lake. You don't know who you are or why you're there. People recognize you and call you names, but no one knows your name.

What you realize, as you continue your search, is that you find yourself in the midst of a war for power, one that you may be the architect of. You'll have to confront your inner self and harness your innate abilities before discovering a shocking truth.

Lacustris is an innovative, realistic point-and-click adventure game that will plunge you into a mysterious world in search of the truth... or one of the truths.

 

The game is divided into two major chapters, the first of which is in an advanced stage of development.
The two chapters are self-contained, but the truth will come out at the end of the adventure!

A BREATHTAKING ADVENTURE

A mysterious man awakens on the dock of a floating village in the middle of an immense lake.

He doesn't remember who he is, nor what he's doing in that place of which he has no memory.

Wandering through the wooden walkways, he will meet some characters who will show they recognize him, though without knowing his name, addressing him as "the blacksmith," "the eunuch," "the builder," "the warlord"... The man will try to find information about his identity, collecting objects and using his ingenuity to piece things together, understanding that he finds himself in the middle of a war, of which he himself is probably the architect. Along his journey, his knowledge and abilities will evolve and having left the village, he will arrive at a dark and dangerous fortress, cross through caverns and tunnels, finding himself in a dark forest at the center of an island, encountering a mysterious population and a sibyl who will reveal a shocking truth to him.

Lacustris - The war over water is an exciting point-and-click adventure in realistic graphic style, filled with amusing dialogues and brilliant puzzles.

 

GAME FEATURES
 

Point and Click
Intuitive gameplay that pays homage to the great classics of the genre, with ingenious puzzles and meaningful interactions.

 

Evocative Graphics
3D environments reconstructed with historical accuracy, bringing alpine pile-dwelling villages back to life.

 

Engaging Narrative
Engaging Narrative A gripping story set in the Bronze Age, with memorable characters and choices that matter.

 

Mechanics
Puzzles to solve, crafting, structured dialogues, puzzles and minigames that unlock hidden sections.

What you realize, as you continue your search, is that you find yourself in the midst of a war for power, one that you may be the architect of. You'll have to confront your inner self and harness your innate abilities before discovering a shocking truth.

Lacustris is an innovative, realistic point-and-click adventure game that will plunge you into a mysterious world in search of the truth... or one of the truths.

 

The game is divided into two major chapters, the first of which is in an advanced stage of development.
The two chapters are self-contained, but the truth will come out at the end of the adventure!

A mysterious man awakens on the dock of a floating village in the middle of an immense lake.

He doesn't remember who he is, nor what he's doing in that place of which he has no memory.

Wandering through the wooden walkways, he will meet some characters who will show they recognize him, though without knowing his name, addressing him as "the blacksmith," "the eunuch," "the builder," "the warlord"... The man will try to find information about his identity, collecting objects and using his ingenuity to piece things together, understanding that he finds himself in the middle of a war, of which he himself is probably the architect. Smerk is a deckbuilding roguelike autobattler where you build a team of friends who interact with each other to generate big numbers.

WORK

Unlike real life, the workday runs automatically. Each friend in your deck activates every few seconds to generate happiness and trigger their unique ability.

MANAGE

After each workday, you earn coins that can be spent to improve your deck: hiring stronger friends, modifying them with tarot cards, discovering powerful relics, or training to level up.

Beware of overtime! Forcing your friends to work past office hours is painful.

Endure 15 days of work to win!

FEATURES:

• Over 150 friends and relics with powerful synergy effects

• 20 tarot cards to modify, twist, and corrupt your friends

• 5 or more managers that change how you play

• 5 or more levels of difficulty

store_data.about_the_game:
Turn empty spaces into cozy places—one carefully placed object at a time.

In Place it Gently!, you step into a relaxing first-person decorating experience where every object has its perfect place. Pick up furniture, decorations, and everyday items, rotate them freely, and gently place them to transform empty places into warm and beautiful spaces.

There are no timers and no pressure—just calm, satisfying gameplay focused on creativity, organization, and the simple joy of making a place feel like home.

Take your time, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, and create cozy environments that feel just right.

  • 🪑 Flexible Object Placement: Pick up, rotate, and gently place objects until everything feels perfectly arranged.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the far north of Russia lies the Kola Superdeep Borehole, the deepest hole ever drilled into the Earth. The project was suddenly shut down, and no real explanation was ever given. Your story takes place while the site is still active. You play as a geologist, a scientist who studies rocks and the layers beneath the planet’s surface. You’re sent to the borehole to investigate strange signals coming from deep underground. As you descend, the information you collect begins to challenge the basic ideas you were taught about how the Earth is formed. The deeper you go, the more the familiar picture of the planet starts to fall apart. When you finally uncover the truth, you’re forced to face a single, unsettling realization: What science has mapped so far is not Earth as it is, but a False Earth.

You play as a geologist drilling deep into the Earth. Your bore machine is your main vehicle and your safe zone. You use it to dig through different layers of rock, each with its own look and density. At each layer, you stop to collect samples, scan the rock, and check your frequency indicators. When the area is stable, you can step out with your pickaxe to break rocks, gather ore, and explore small caves for extra samples. The gameplay loop is straightforward: drill down, study the layer, collect what you need, then go deeper. Every level reveals new materials and new clues about what lies beneath the surface.

  • Explore unique environments

  • Progress through levels or areas

  • Collect resources / items

  • Upgrade tools or abilities

  • Solve puzzles or objectives

  • Unlock new areas

store_data.about_the_game:
DARKNESS WILL FALL

Life in the city has its ups and downs. Nightmarish traffic, overbearing landlords, demanding bosses, and disappointing paychecks are really just scratching the surface of the shit pile. But, as you're about to find out, there are far worse things lurking in the night streets. 

In Darkness Will Fall, there aren't just blood sucking vampires roaming the moonlit streets but a sick population of vampires called reavers that are unstable, volatile, and ravenously hungry for the blood of their own kind. This wouldn't normally be your problem as an average starry eyed nightclub singer trying to make ends meet but, once a bizarre incident leaves you clinging desperately to your life in a dark alley, a chance encounter with a kind stranger will link your fates and change your life forever. 

THE STORY

Actions have consequences and the consequence of being allowed to keep your life might leave you wishing for death instead. Your instructions are clear - assist in the reaver investigation and provide results that point conclusively to at least one suspect or your life is forfeit. Easy enough, right? 

It would probably be easier if you weren't so distracted by your growing feelings for the vampires you now live with. And it would definitely be easier if they weren't also potential suspects.

GAMEPLAY

Actions have consequences and the consequence of being allowed to keep your life might leave you wishing for death instead. Your instructions are clear - assist in the reaver investigation and provide results that point conclusively to at least one suspect or your life is forfeit. Easy enough, right? 

It would probably be easier if you weren't so distracted by your growing feelings for the vampires you now live with. And it would definitely be easier if they weren't also potential suspects. 

FEATURES:

➣ Encounter a rich cast of vampires that are part of the city coven. 

➣ They will remember that. Memory and events system. Choices matter!

➣ Travel around the coven building to speak and interact with coven members. 

➣ Interactive murder case investigation. Discover clues at the crime scene and interview witnesses. Failure influences story events.

➣ Stay human or become a vampire. Change your gameplay experience.

TRIGGER AND CONTENT WARNINGS 

Violence, Blood and gore, drug abuse, alcohol abuse, sexual content, murder investigation, language, physical assault, non-consensual blood drinking, LGBTQ issues, mentions of suicide, mentions of severe depression, discussions of trauma, death, and terminal illness.

CUSTOMIZABLE PROTAGONIST

Choose your name, skin tone, and pronouns. 

LOVE INTERESTS

4 love interests. Two female, one male, one nonbinary. LGBTQ+ friendly. All characters are open to any gender.

MULTIPLE ENDINGS

Multiple endings. Including dead ends, romance endings, secret endings.

store_data.about_the_game:
Balls vs. Tombs is a dark fantasy action-survival game built around a single, haunting purpose: to reclaim stolen souls and restore peace to a desecrated graveyard.

Once, the cemetery was a place of rest. A sacred ground where spirits slept quietly beneath stone and soil. That balance was shattered when four colossal abominations emerged from the depths, corrupting the land and absorbing every soul bound to the graves. As the spirits were torn from their resting places, the monsters grew stronger, warping the cemetery into a battlefield of rage, decay, and despair.

You are one of the few who can fight back.

CORE GAMEPLAY

At its heart, Balls vs. Tombs is a fast-paced combat experience where precision, positioning, and elemental mastery matter. You fight by launching powerful orbs—your primary weapons against waves of enraged spirits and corrupted entities.

The core loop is simple but deep:

Defeat corrupted enemies

Recover their trapped souls

Return souls to restored graves

Expand and cleanse the cemetery

Unlock new characters, powers, and combinations

Each reclaimed grave brings the world closer to balance—and brings you closer to confronting the true source of the corruption.

ELEMENTAL CHARACTERS & ORBS

Beyond the basic orb, the game features four unlockable characters, each bound to a unique elemental sphere:

Water Orb – fluid control, slowing enemies and shaping the battlefield

Air Orb – speed, mobility, and precision strikes

Poison Orb – damage over time, area corruption, and attrition

Fire Orb – raw power, explosive impact, and aggressive play

Each character fundamentally changes how the game feels, encouraging experimentation and mastery.

FUSION SYSTEM – THE HEART OF POWER

What truly sets Balls vs. Tombs apart is its Orb Fusion System.

Every elemental orb can be fused with every other orb.

Water + Fire

Air + Poison

Fire + Air

Poison + Water

…and every possible combination in between.

Each fusion creates a new, more powerful hybrid orb with unique behaviors, visuals, and combat effects. Some fusions focus on crowd control, others on burst damage, chain reactions, or battlefield dominance.

This system turns combat into a strategic sandbox, rewarding creativity and experimentation. The more you understand the elements, the more devastating your builds become.

THE CEMETERY AS PROGRESSION

There is no traditional level select.

The graveyard itself is your progression system.

As you rescue souls and rebuild graves:

New cemetery zones unlock

Stronger enemy types begin to appear

New characters and orb types become available

The world visually transforms from corruption to sanctified ground

What feels like an open, evolving environment is actually a carefully structured progression arc—a living level system disguised as world restoration.

BOSSES & NARRATIVE

The four great monsters are not random enemies. Each represents a twisted force that feeds on unrest and unfinished souls. As they absorb spirits, they grow in size, power, and presence—something reflected both in gameplay and cinematic moments.

THE GOAL

This is not just about surviving waves.

It’s about bringing peace back to the dead.

Every soul you recover matters.

Every grave you restore reshapes the world.

Every fusion you master brings you closer to ending the corruption.

Welcome to Balls vs. Tombs.

The dead are waiting.

Once, the cemetery was a place of rest. A sacred ground where spirits slept quietly beneath stone and soil. That balance was shattered when four colossal abominations emerged from the depths, corrupting the land and absorbing every soul bound to the graves. As the spirits were torn from their resting places, the monsters grew stronger, warping the cemetery into a battlefield of rage, decay, and despair.

You are one of the few who can fight back.

CORE GAMEPLAY

At its heart, Balls vs. Tombs is a fast-paced combat experience where precision, positioning, and elemental mastery matter. You fight by launching powerful orbs—your primary weapons against waves of enraged spirits and corrupted entities.

The core loop is simple but deep:

Defeat corrupted enemies

Recover their trapped souls

Return souls to restored graves

Expand and cleanse the cemetery

Unlock new characters, powers, and combinations

Each reclaimed grave brings the world closer to balance—and brings you closer to confronting the true source of the corruption.

ELEMENTAL CHARACTERS & ORBS

Beyond the basic orb, the game features four unlockable characters, each bound to a unique elemental sphere:

Water Orb – fluid control, slowing enemies and shaping the battlefield

Air Orb – speed, mobility, and precision strikes

Poison Orb – damage over time, area corruption, and attrition

Fire Orb – raw power, explosive impact, and aggressive play

Each character fundamentally changes how the game feels, encouraging experimentation and mastery.

FUSION SYSTEM – THE HEART OF POWER

What truly sets Balls vs. Tombs apart is its Orb Fusion System.

Every elemental orb can be fused with every other orb.

Water + Fire

Air + Poison

Fire + Air

Poison + Water

…and every possible combination in between.

Each fusion creates a new, more powerful hybrid orb with unique behaviors, visuals, and combat effects. Some fusions focus on crowd control, others on burst damage, chain reactions, or battlefield dominance.

This system turns combat into a strategic sandbox, rewarding creativity and experimentation. The more you understand the elements, the more devastating your builds become.

THE CEMETERY AS PROGRESSION

There is no traditional level select.

The graveyard itself is your progression system.

As you rescue souls and rebuild graves:

New cemetery zones unlock

Stronger enemy types begin to appear

New characters and orb types become available

The world visually transforms from corruption to sanctified ground

What feels like an open, evolving environment is actually a carefully structured progression arc—a living level system disguised as world restoration.

BOSSES & NARRATIVE

The four great monsters are not random enemies. Each represents a twisted force that feeds on unrest and unfinished souls. As they absorb spirits, they grow in size, power, and presence—something reflected both in gameplay and cinematic moments.

THE GOAL

This is not just about surviving waves.

It’s about bringing peace back to the dead.

Every soul you recover matters.

Every grave you restore reshapes the world.

Every fusion you master brings you closer to ending the corruption.

Welcome to Balls vs. Tombs.

The dead are waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
ORDER // ONE is a VR exclusive cyberpunk horror stealth-action roguelite that aims to be a bold step for VR: cinematic storytelling, addictive gameplay, and no hand-holding, powered by PCVR.

Trapped in a cycle of death and rebirth, you fight through a decaying space station, augmenting yourself with cybernetics and rebuilding from scratch. Rip cybernetic arms off your enemies and hot-swap them onto your own. Fight an evolving enemy that learns from your every move, adapting to your playstyle.

Every time you die, your consciousness transfers to a cloned body, and you must fight that much harder to recover your old body and your lost gear. 

Scavenge blueprints and lost cyber-arms to upgrade yourself, but be wary of the enemy: sometimes it’s better to sneak past them through vents, crawl spaces, ceiling overhangs, or with a well-timed grapple.

But if you are spotted, you must act fast. Wall-run, jump, and slide into battle, slicing your enemies to pieces. Reach the central core without getting lost in the massive station, and uncover the truth behind your own existence.

Descend into Order. Are you ready?

You are onboard the New Genesis Station, a massive research station, in a deep space system with a black hole "sun", orbiting a moon targeted for terraforming as an alternative to Earth.

 

You play as "ADAM", a clone worker aboard a decaying deep-space station where death is temporary. 

When suddenly, the station’s onboard AI assistant has gone rogue, seizing the cloning facilities, and turning your shipmates into mind-controlled husks. You are among the last survivors on the rapidly decaying and failing station.


Die. Rebuild. Adapt.

Every death is a lesson. Every return drags you deeper into the nightmare… and closer to the horrifying truth waiting at the heart of New Genesis Station.

Explore a massive interconnected station, a semi-open world. 

Inspired by games like Dead Space and Metal Gear Solid, and films like 2001: A Space Odyssey, Event Horizon, and Alien.

  • Modular cybernetic arm-swapping in VR

  • Adaptive AI & evolving enemies

  • Tense corpse-retrieval roguelite runs

  • Permanent upgrades via blueprints

  • Multiple endings & haunting narrative

  • Full 6DOF freedom (flipping/rolling, wall-running, sliding)

Modular Cybernetics in VR 

In VR, literally tear your cybernetic arm off in a heartbeat and hot-swap it with new ones scavenged from the environment, or off your enemies, to change your abilities on the fly.

Create a unique build from a wide array of cybernetic arms, including Sword-Arms, Gun-Arms, Grapple-Hooks, Arm-Cannons, Kinetic-Fists, and Hacking Devices, with extensive combinations and customizations.

Your only chance at survival depends on you scavenging cybernetic parts from fallen enemies and hidden caches.

Scavenge through multiple sectors and wings, with distinct identities and functions, giving different cybernetics and upgrades. 

You can also install a number of other cybernetic enhancements and modifications (like cyber-eyes scanners, kinetic bone reinforcement) in cloning bays, serving as permanent upgrades that are not lost on death. 

These upgrades can be crafted using blueprints scavenged around the ship, to reward exploration and risky moves.

A True Roguelite

Each cloning bay is a checkpoint with a limited number of human shells. 

Die, and your consciousness is sent back to the last cloning bay you activated, consuming a shell, and losing your current gear, forcing you to adapt your strategy and reclaim your corpse (and your gear) from a now-alerted AI. 

Your old body and all its gear remain where you died, turning your next run into a tense mission to reclaim your lost gear, sprinting or crouching your way back to your corpse while alarms blare.

Each new bay holds around 5 shells. Lose all shells in a bay, and you're forced back to the previous one, increasing the stakes. If all cloning bays are exhausted, your run ends permanently.

An Enemy That Adapts

When you die, the station adapts to your failure. 

The areas you frequent grow more dangerous as patrol routes change and security tightens. 
The cybernetics you rely on are countered. Enemies you’ve already killed return with upgraded gear, forcing you to rethink your tactics to reclaim your lost cybernetics.

You will be attacked by dozens of enemy variants that evolve across your runs.
The more you die, the more the station counters your approach. 

Each new run is a high-risk mission to recover your best gear, but the more you succeed, the harder the station will fight back, pushing you into uncharted paths and forcing you to adapt.

Returning to your corpse is a tense run because the AI adapts to your routes and patrols. Creating a high risk, high reward scenario, especially if you died with your best gear, as the path to retrieve it is now patrolled by enemies adapted specifically to counter you.

The closer your old body is to the next cloning bay, the harder (and longer) it will be to recover. 
There’s no single way to fight. Every encounter evolves based on your past moves, making each return a fresh challenge.

Claustrophobic Cassette Futurism

Explore a dark, moody space station inspired by the late 90s cassette-futurism style. 

Narrow corridors, flickering lights, occasional hull breaches, and vents twisting overhead make for tense chase or stealth sequences, crawling through vents while hearing enemies search for your last known location.

Combat & Playstyle Freedom

Combat is visceral, tactical, and deeply tied to your cybernetic loadout. 

Tackle challenges with brute force, silent stealth, or a clever mix of both. 

The station's AI learns your preferred style and will send enemies designed to predict and counter it, pushing you to experiment with new cybernetic combinations and tactics to survive.

A Haunting Narrative

Uncover the mystery of the rogue AI and decide the fate of the station, with multiple endings based on your discoveries.

VR Without Hand-Holding

We believe our unique development strategy is to truly give the ultimate gaming VR experience, preferring gameplay to comfort. The game has full freedom of movement, including flipping, rolling, wall running, and sliding, and the skill ceiling can be as low or as high as you'd like. Developed exclusively to harness the full power of PC VR and PlayStation VR2.

Not stand alone

We believe standalone VR technology is holding back VR innovation, especially in terms of graphical fidelity, and as such, we have decided ORDER // ONE will be exclusive to non-standalone VR, PC VR (Including Steam Frame) and PlayStation VR2. Meta Quest headsets will work when linked to a PC.

ADAM is one of many recurring clones aboard the New Genesis Station. 

Every worker is a clone with continuity of consciousness across shells (bodies). 

Death is not permanent, but it is finite. 

Each worker has a limited number of shells stored in tanks tied to them. When all the shells are gone, that worker is gone forever, their consciousness has nowhere to go.

The rogue AI takes over the cloning facilities, and begins aggressively modifying the clone husks. 
The same husks you've killed before return self-modified, with new augments and cybernetics, and genetic modifications, into new, monstrous forms that are barely recognizable. 

They no longer resemble your crewmates.

Your only path forward is toward the core of the ship. 

You need answers. 

Why did the AI turn against the ship? What are its goals? And is there any way to reverse the process and save what's left of your crewmates?

We are a team of 7 VR developers with 15 years of combined experience. 

Over the years, we’ve honed our craft and built a passionate community of ~5,800 on Discord through our previous high-octane, free VR experiences. 

On that project, we delivered an expansive open world,  high-performance PCVR, pushed VR visuals forward, and refined 6DOF movement for addictive and high-speed gameplay

With countless hours of community testing and feedback, we mastered fluid, thrilling, and intuitive VR mechanics that players loved. 

That experience is the foundation of ORDER // ONE.

Our focus has always been on groundbreaking gameplay.

Now, we're using our expertise to make our own original universe and IP. 

ORDER // ONE is the culmination of everything we've learned. 

We develop in the open, with a thriving Discord community where player feedback directly shapes the game. Meaning we are making the game with you. 

So back us now on kickstarter, and get immediate access to our tester channels, giving you early looks, and game builds!

store_data.about_the_game:
Woo Woo - an action-roguelike about cleaning up trash in your own little house!
Dad said he'll eat you for dinner if the house isn't clean by midnight!

And cleaning the house is easy peasy!
Explore mysterious rooms and the innards of your home, pick up trash from the floor (and not just trash!), carry it to where it belongs!
Sort clothes on shelves and arrange furniture in the right spots - to keep your body undigested before evening!


But cleaning isn't always that simple!
The trash wants to live too and will scurry away on its spidery legs. Whack them with a broom to knock them off their feet!


The house lives its own life...
The environment is procedurally generated and populated by strange mysterious creatures: from a several-meters-long centipede in the basement to a hungry ghost in the attic.
Will you make it to evening alive?

store_data.about_the_game:
Embark on a Journey Through the Mysterious World of Altalis

Discover breathtaking places and unravel countless mysteries across the world of Altalis. As a traveler, you will begin an unforgettable adventure filled with awe-inspiring scenery and hidden secrets. Along the way, you will encounter various beings—some may guide and aid you, while others may harm or hinder your progress.

Use Your Magic to Forge a Path

Wield the magic of your wand to manipulate the objects around you. This power opens up countless possibilities, allowing you to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and uncover new paths toward your destination.

Defend Yourself Against Dangerous Enemies

Beware of the Lost Ones, hostile entities that can strike at any moment. Each Lost One possesses unique abilities and behaviors shaped by who they once were. Use your magic wisely to defend yourself and survive these perilous encounters.

Collect Coins and Upgrade Your Skills

Search for coins throughout your journey and use them to enhance your abilities. Upgrading your skills will help you overcome tougher enemies and make it easier to find a way forward in the world of Altalis.

Controls

Keyboard & Mouse:

  • Move : A & D

  • Camera : W & S

  • Jump : Space

  • Interact : E

  • Open Map : M

  • Switch Mode : Right Mouse Button

  • Undo : Z

  • Cut : X

  • Copy : C

  • Paste : V

  • Cancel / Pause : Escape

  • Select : Q

  • Selection : Left Mouse Button & Mouse Motion

*Gamepad also supported in this build, but we still do a lot of control adjustment in the future for better experience

store_data.about_the_game:
Forgefolk is a first-person blacksmithing simulation that tells the story of Droak, a 571-year-old master dwarf blacksmith.

In the game, you take contracts from the order board, gather the required resources, and process them in your workshop to craft items.
Each production process consists of smelting, forging, shaping, and finishing, requiring careful attention and precise timing.

With its calm pace, replayable task system, and satisfying production loop, Forgefolk is designed for players who enjoy simulation and management games.

Features

  • Task-based gameplay loop

  • Resource gathering and processing mechanics

  • First-person, interaction-focused crafting system

  • Demo version available

Light the fire, grab the hammer, and forge legends in Droak’s workshop.

store_data.about_the_game:
GOT3D is a 3D action-adventure puzzle game. Relive and replay the classic shareware episode 'Serpent Surprise' of the original DOS game 'God of Thunder' in glorious 3D.

The Story:

The year is 927 A.D. (as mortals reckon time) and the Almighty Odin has summoned you, his faithful and heroic son, to the great Hall of Asgard: "Thor, my son, your evil half-brother Loki, The God of Mischief has once again betrayed us. While I slept the great Odinsleep, he managed to subdue and take control of my beloved land of Midgard. He has acquired the aid of two of his most fearsome allies: Jormangund the Midgard Serpent, and Nognir, Prince of the Underworld. If you are not able to stop him now, his control over Midgard will be so complete that I, myself, may not be able to oppose him and his two very powerful accomplices.

To help you on your mission, I give you my most trusted weapon:

Mjolnir,

the Enchanted Hammer made for me by the king of trolls, and enchanted by my own power, it will always return to the one who throws it."

store_data.about_the_game:
For ages, the Seven Keys of the Ancient World sealed Ulthar, the Dark Trinity, a colossal three-headed entity, each head ruling over a deadly element: fire, ice, and specters. Each key is guarded by an enemy realm and protected within fortresses built not for honor, but to prevent the return of chaos.

Construction and Fortification

  • Build barracks and support structures that grant permanent reinforcements.

  • Decide where to invest according to your strategy: solid defense or offensive power.

Turn-Based Combat

  • Tactical battles based on cards and shop resources.

  • Every choice is crucial — attack, defense, or battlefield control.

Replayability

  • Maps with waves of varied enemies and three difficulty levels keep each run fresh.

  • Random events, choices, and maps with strategic paths create unique challenges in every run.

  • Receive essential rewards after each victory.

Unique Factions

  • Knights, Elves, Goblins, Insects, Demons, and other factions.

  • Each deck has its own identity, exclusive cards, and distinct synergies.

  • Face each enemy realm and claim its ancestral key.

Card Strategy

  • Choose unique decks based on factions such as Knights, Elves, Goblins, Insects, Demons, and much more.

  • Combine up to 3 different factions in your deck to create powerful hybrid playstyles.

  • Each card directly influences the battle, buffs, strategic abilities, and precision towers.

In the ruins of the Ancient World, power is not merely conquered, it is rebuilt.

Use Victory Points to rebuild ancient structures that grant permanent strategic bonuses. Each restored monument strengthens your journey and shapes your playstyle. Level up to gain global bonuses and improvements such as: Attack, Defense, Critical Chance, Strategic Boosts, bonus coins, and extra resources.

Every decision matters. Investing in raw power, economy, or resilience can determine the success or the downfall of your campaign.

Defy the order. Face dark realms and unleash chaos. Each victory brings you closer to the core of forgotten power. When the final seal falls, the world will never be the same.

store_data.about_the_game:
SoulStream Saga: Chapter 1 is an old-school 2D pixel art JRPG with a Shared ATB (Active Time Battle) turn-based combat system built around timing and elemental mastery. A narrative-driven experience inspired by the classic JRPGs of the SNES and early PlayStation era.

Story

A brutal war has ravaged the capital city of Alestria. Rival factions, Mages and Alchemists, claim to fight for a better future, but many are simply using the conflict as an excuse for anarchy, while ordinary civilians pay the price.

Astarius Valcrest, a former Mage, believes unity is the only answer. He casts aside his title and leaves to study alchemy, returning years later with Alchaeon, a blade forged by his own hand and infused with both magic and alchemy. With it, he is determined to prove that unity, not division, will shape his city's future.

A century later, the world he fought for stands. But Princess Victoria Lockewell's father, the king, is descending into madness and threatening everything Astarius built. Desperate, she casts a forbidden incantation to revive him.

Combat System

  • Shared ATB (Active Time Battle) System: Designed to focus on timing, pressure, and smart decision making.

  • Casting and interrupts: Most actions take time to execute. Disrupt an enemy cast at the right moment and turn the tide of battle.

  • Elemental strategy: Both Astarius and his enemies have elemental weaknesses and resistances that can be exploited in battle. Astarius's elemental affinity is determined by his current stance, which shifts depending on the skills you choose.

  • Adaptive enemy behavior: Enemies evaluate the current situation every turn, reacting to heal, buff, disrupt, focus, assist teammates, and more, with a touch of unpredictability

  • Equipment and items: Utilize a variety of items in battle and equip various types of gear to better prepare yourself for what lies ahead.

The Full SoulStream Saga

The complete version of SoulStream Saga: Chapter 1 will include:

● 3 characters active in combat, 7 total party members to recruit and develop.

● 40+ hours of story content.

● Lore and narrative that explores the world 100 years after the war and its long-term consequences.

● A fully realised presentation with enhanced art, VFX, lighting, and an original score.

● A unique skill tree for every character, supporting distinct builds and playstyles.

● Minigames including treasure hunting, fishing, a unique playable trading card game, and more.

DEMO Notice

This free demo showcases the game's narrative and combat as a prequel to the full story. All skills and magic are unlocked and Astarius is at maximum level. As a project developed in only a few months by a 3-person team, you may encounter some bugs and performance issues. Any feedback is incredibly valuable and will help shape the full game.

Content Warning

This game contains graphical violence and mature subject matter. This includes depictions of death (including children) and graphic gore. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nothing meant anything. Everything was the same: the sounds, the walks, the stares. Then a task appeared in your head. It wasn’t clear. It didn’t make sense. But it was enough. For your dreams, you had to be a lone penguin. Because maybe this whole walk is meant to uncover a secret that’s been waiting for years.

Being a Penguin

This is the story of a penguin who keeps asking questions. Enter dialogues with humans and penguins. People are watching you. It’s a strange feeling. But you’re used to it now.

Explore, Walk, Keep Going

The poles look vast, cold, and empty. Complete mini-tasks, overcome courses, chart your route with the map, visit research stations, open ice fields, and quiet spots. Your dreams may feel far away. But you keep moving forward.

Sometimes not thinking is best. Fish on the ice. Break the rhythm. Set off again.

2027

There are small clues everywhere. But the voice in your head keeps saying the same thing: 2027. Maybe the question is more important.

Nothing means anything. Yet you’re here. But why? Welcome.

4373650.name: 俺の母ちゃんが考えたゲーム

store_data.about_the_game:
Me: “I can’t come up with any game ideas…”

Mom: “Then make a game where you stuff as many carrots as you can.”

Mom: “Maybe rabbits eat the carrots. And add some rotten carrots too.”

Me: “Hmm… that would make the rules too complicated. I’m not that good at programming. Can you come up with ideas for enemy characters instead?”

Me: “Also, I’m going to show you in the bottom-right corner, so let me record a video.”

Mom: “Alright, I’ll hold a carrot and show it off.”

This is a casual falling-block puzzle game created through conversations like this.

Controls

  • Click or press the Space key to drop.

  • Press Q or E to rotate.

  • Press A or D, or the Left / Right Arrow keys to move left and right.

Game Rules

Stuff as many carrots as possible without breaking the white box (plastic bag).

Your score is counted only after you press the Finish button.

Trash has no value, so match the same types together to remove them.

／

Streaming and video uploads are welcome, but please include credit with a link.

And if you recommend the game to your viewers, my mom will be very happy.

＼

Forget about the boring shuffling of cards. Your settlement is a complex mechanism. To build a forge, a wall or a tower of magicians, you need to collect the perfect combination of cards in your hand. Plan your moves, discard the excess and look for synergies that will turn your village into an economic war machine.

MANAGE MULTI-DECKS

The main feature of the game is Outposts. These are not just buildings, but your strategic outposts on the edge of darkness.

Separate Decks: Each Outpost has its own mini-deck and mechanics.

Threat Deterrence: The more effective your outposts are, the lower the chance of a surprise monster attack on the capital.

Expansion: Competent management of several decks at the same time is the key to victory.

ADAPT OR DIE.

The world is cruel. You will face Disasters: droughts, epidemics and magical storms will test your defenses. But what doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Find and use Permanent Cards (Artifacts) — global bonuses that stay with you and change the rules of the game, allowing you to create unique builds for each party.

In most games, you hide from monsters. Here you go for them. Your task is not to last N days, but to destroy the entire population of monsters.

Build up your military power, send troops on raids and clear the map sector by sector. But remember: if the monsters break through the Outpost line, your capital will fall.

Four friends travel to a remote, abandoned palace hidden deep in the misty hills, searching for thrills. What starts as an adventure turns into a nightmare when darkness falls. Explore haunted forest and caves

Solve environmental puzzles to unlock new areas, uncover the location’s dark history, and find essential tools and keys needed to survive. Every puzzle is designed to push you deeper into danger while revealing disturbing truths about what happened here.

Escape monsters

Each monster hunts differently, forcing you to adapt your playstyle.

Every footstep, whisper, and distant noise is designed to keep you on edge. Play with headphones for the full experience.

Find your friends before dawn

Piece together notes, clues, and environmental details to uncover the horrifying truth behind the palace and escape the place before dawn

store_data.about_the_game:
An online card game set in World War II, centered on deckbuilding and battles against opponents. The classic collectible card game formula is expanded with grid movement mechanics, unique gameplay mechanics, and a card and headquarters exploration system.

The game will not contain Pay-to-Win elements, loot boxes, cases, or other donation items. Only exploration of vehicle cards, orders, and headquarters. Any card or headquarters can be explored in-game.

A distinctive feature of the game, in addition to the interaction between headquarters, vehicle cards, and orders, is the unique behavior system of various tank types:

• Light tanks can perform more movement actions;

• Medium tanks have specific movement actions and are also versatile combat units;

• Heavy tanks become defenseless if they attack during their turn, which is compensated by increased survivability and damage;

• PT-SAU destroyers always attack from ambush, allowing them to always inflict damage first;

• SAU can attack any detected target on the battlefield.

Game Features:

— 3 nations: USSR, Germany, and USA (more nations will be added in the future);

— About 150 vehicle cards with abilities and over 50 command (spell) cards;

— 27 types of Headquarters (9 per nation) with abilities;

— 1v1 PVP online battle mode (the main game mode);

— Several PVE modes (Historical campaigns, separate "Raid" mode, training battles, training campaign);

— deck manager;

— cards and headquarters research system;

Command the German, American, or Soviet HQs, control legendary tanks, and use their abilities, HQ abilities, and various orders to turn the tide of battle.

Your goal is to win the battle against opponents controlled by both humans and AI (depending on the selected mode).

Fight on the battlefield: Place tanks on the battlefield, use HQ abilities, cards, and orders to strengthen your allies or weaken your enemies, and attack the enemy HQ to achieve victory.

Manage resources: Every action requires resources. Plan your moves to avoid running out of resources at the crucial moment.

How to win?

Destroy your opponent's HQ or force them to exhaust all their deck.

Each HQ has unique abilities that define your playstyle. Choose a strategy: Attack directly with a Shock HQ, defend your position with a Rear HQ, or balance your strategy with a Combat HQ.

Key Features:

• Historical Atmosphere: Realistic World War II tanks;

• Deep Strategy: Combine maps, HQ abilities, and positioning to achieve victory;

• Variety: Three nations (Germany, USA, and USSR), dozens of HQs, and hundreds of maps to experiment with;

• Gameplay: Battle other players, the AI, in historical campaigns, raids, or random battles;

• The game is easy to learn, yet offers a huge variety of mechanics.

The game is being developed by an enthusiast with a great love for military history and tactical games. I am constantly improving the game based on community reviews.

Thank you for your attention

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a steampunk extraction-driven experience built around tension, survival, and brutal close-quarters combat. Every run is a risk—what you bring in, what you extract with, and what hunts you along the way is never guaranteed.

Brutal Close-Combat Fighting

Combat is intimate, heavy, and physical. Every swing has weight. Every hit matters. There are no firearms—combat is built entirely around close-range weapons designed to feel raw, desperate, and punishing.

Players can:

    •    Chain heavy strikes and fast attacks

    •    Perform timed counters and defensive maneuvers

    •    Stagger, overwhelm, or crush enemies through positioning and momentum

Combat rewards awareness, timing, and aggression—not button-mashing.

Intelligent, Unpredictable Enemies

Enemies are not scripted targets. They think, react, and adapt.

    •    Enemies can hide, stalk, and ambush, using the environment to their advantage

    •    They make judgment-based decisions—retreating, flanking, or pressing an attack depending on the situation

    •    Darkness, sound, and player behavior influence how enemies respond

You’re not just fighting monsters—you’re being hunted.

Dynamic Environments

The world itself is unstable and hostile.

    •    Destructible walls and structures can open new paths—or new threats

    •    Environments can change mid-run, altering layouts, sightlines, and safe zones

    •    Player actions may permanently affect the level during an extraction attempt

No two runs feel the same, even in familiar locations.

Boss Encounters

Certain areas contain rare, high-threat bosses that may appear under specific conditions.

    •    Bosses are not guaranteed to spawn

    •    Encountering one is a high-risk, high-reward situation

    •    Choosing to engage—or escape—is always the player’s decision

These encounters are meant to feel dangerous, unexpected, and unforgettable.

Fear System (Planned Feature)

A Fear Meter will be introduced later in development and demonstrated to players.

    •    Fear builds through isolation, damage, enemy proximity, and environmental pressure

    •    High fear may impact perception, decision-making, or combat effectiveness

    •    Managing fear becomes part of survival, not just combat

The goal is to make tension a mechanic, not just a mood.

Tools of Survival

Players have access to a wide range of brutal, improvised tools:

    •    Multiple melee weapon types, each with unique strengths and combat styles

    •    Grenades built for disruption, area denial, or crowd control

    •    Traps that can slow, damage, lure, or manipulate enemies

Preparation matters—but improvisation is often the difference between extraction and death.

store_data.about_the_game:
Daigo is a man working as a private detective. Looking for a better life, he moves to a new city. Shortly after arriving, he receives a call from a mysterious woman who hires him for a rather unusual case: every night, several men disappear without a trace.

His investigation leads him to a group of vampiresses who devour men’s souls when they are left unsatisfied after sex. After reporting back to the woman who hired him, Daigo is forced to interact with each of these women and find out more about who they really are. This leads to sexual encounters where he tests both the women and himself.

If he manages to defeat this sinful group of women, a greater and far more dangerous reward awaits him: confronting the woman who initially hired him.

But nothing is what it seems in this strange place, and once he completes his mission, he must face the most powerful and sexually insatiable vampiress in the city. Can Daigo survive this erotic frenzy? Will his life change once he discovers his true talent for satisfying women?

❤️ KUMI

Kumi is a low-ranking vampiress, an expert at seducing mature men. She’s a mischievous and playful girl who’s always ready for sex. She loves showing off her body, performing complicated sexual positions, and has an insatiable lust.

She has a magnetic personality that’s hard to escape from. She knows how to get what she wants and always gets her way. If you fall into her trap, she’ll make you discover your darkest pleasures—but at a price that may be too much to pay.

💜 HONOKA

Honoka is a dangerous, determined, and strong-willed vampiress. She has a fetish for married men and fathers. She seduces everyone with her long hair, massive curves, and natural charisma.

In her job, she meets potential victims whom she later fucks. She's an expert in fulfilling men’s fantasies and doesn’t hesitate to use that to destroy them and steal their souls. To sleep with her, you need serious stamina.

🤍 SHION

Shion is a newly-turned vampire who has just begun her hunts in the city. Seducing men and feeding on souls is still difficult for her because of her shy personality, so she tends to be far more affectionate than any other vampire. However, she can win over any man just by getting close to him, and her intimate encounters have always been successful so far.

🖤 YUMIKO

Yumiko is a noble vampiress with immense power. Practically no man can escape her, and even fewer can defeat her in a sexual encounter. Her mind is a vast gallery of sex toys, practices, and fetishes.

She’s a ruthless, passionate nymphomaniac who only seeks souls to feed on and the perfect man to fuck until exhaustion before devouring him. Facing her requires absurd levels of libido—and courage.

FEATURES

  • Animated H Scenes: find some H scenes that are animated as you progress through the story.

  • Shape the story: choose the protagonist’s name and build your own story, making decisions that create branching paths in the narrative.

  • Hide the interface: you can hide the interface at any time if you want to admire the scenery and the game’s artwork.

  • Gallery: as you progress through the story, you will unlock albums that let you easily revisit your favorite moments.

  • Navigation options: go hands-free by enabling auto-play text, or skip it entirely to reach your favorite parts! You can also go back at any time to change a decision.

  • Immersive audio: enjoy music, sound effects, voices, and "other effects." Adjust each volume independently or mute everything.

PLEASE NOTE

  • All characters depicted and visually represented in this game are over 18 years old, and no real or identifiable minors were used in the production of this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Buddy Signal is a 3D puzzle platformer where you control two characters:

Use BG’s overview to solve the puzzle and arrange a solution, then use smol’s movement abilities to execute your plan!

When playing as the small 3D platformer character smol, you have a wide and expressive move set at your disposal. This can be used to speedrun levels in Time Trial Challenge, or to find creative and high-skill solutions to the problems you face within the game.

If this intimidates you, do not worry! It's possible to reach the end of the game with only a basic grasp of smol's acrobatic abilities. Ensuring the game is accessible to all, while offering a challenge to those that seek it!

When playing as the big first person character BG, you can arrange and orient Objects in the game world. This ability can be used to build structures for smol. There are three different Object Types: Basic, Stable and Sticky Objects, each with their own properties.

The game also features various Machines and a Cable system that connect them to each other and allow for many engaging puzzles throughout the game. Some of the Machines in the game include:

  • Various types of buttons and switches

  • Doors

  • Laser Emitters, Mirrors and Receivers

  • Sensors

  • Logic Gates (such as OR, AND, NOT etc.)

  • and more!

All the Puzzles in the game are connected by Portals in the hub world. Each Portal features multiple Puzzles accessible through its connected buttons and you can access any of them in any order you want. Objects then can be used in order to gain access to new Portals and therefore, more Puzzles! 

The hub world is also a great place to rest and practice your movement and building skills!

Each Portal is connected to a different part of the planet and therefore allow you to explore various biomes with different climates and times of day. Explore biomes with luscious greenery, snow storms, volcanic ash and dangerous thunderstorms, all on a faraway flooded world.

While you're at it, don't forget to look up at the majestic planetary ring and the black hole the planet orbits!

store_data.about_the_game:
“This case will be the ruin of us, my dear. There is still time for you to turn back.”


Hawkins & Sons Detective Agency is a detective visual novel where you unravel mysteries and investigate crimes. Explore atmospheric locations through point-and-click gameplay, interrogate suspects, and make crucial choices that shape the story.

London, 1895.

An ageing private detective, Arthur Hawkins, prepares to take on one final case before retirement. When a grieving widow appears at the door of his office, the matter seems too small to bother with — and Arthur is ready to refuse.

His daughter, who has dreamed of detective work since childhood, begs to join the investigation. Arthur’s heart is not made of stone. Knowing the profession is closed to her, he agrees to give his daughter a harmless little adventure.

The case, however, is anything but harmless. What begins as a simple inquiry soon draws father and daughter into a web of secrets, danger, and death.

Features

  • Play as two protagonists: a seasoned detective and his sharp, empathetic daughter

  • Interrogate suspects, expose the truth, and make important story decisions

  • Explore crime scenes and the streets of London through point-and-click gameplay

  • Connect facts and uncover contradictions to advance the investigation

  • Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Victorian London through hand-drawn art and classical music

  • Complete the story-driven adventure in just 2–3 hours

store_data.about_the_game:
Set in a forgotten corner of Anatolia, this psychological horror experience draws inspiration from Turkish mythology and folklore to tell a dark, unsettling story about blood, lineage, and buried truths.

You arrive at an abandoned village where time feels distorted and silence weighs heavier than sound. Houses stand empty, roads vanish into fog, and traces of violence linger without explanation. As you explore the environment, the village slowly reveals fragments of a past that was never meant to surface.

The game focuses on environmental storytelling and atmosphere rather than constant action. Every location, object, and sound is designed to create tension and unease, encouraging players to observe carefully and piece together the narrative themselves. Horror emerges gradually — through disturbing imagery, sudden encounters, and moments where reality feels fragile and unreliable.

At the heart of the story lies an ancient mythological presence tied to the land itself. As the narrative unfolds, the player is forced to confront unsettling revelations about identity, fate, and inheritance. What begins as an investigation turns into a personal descent, culminating in a truth that redefines everything you thought you knew.

Key Features

  • Psychological horror inspired by Turkish mythology and Anatolian folklore

  • A dense, atmospheric world centered around a desolate village

  • Environmental storytelling with minimal exposition

  • Carefully paced tension, jump scares, and unsettling encounters

  • A dark narrative focused on identity, bloodline, and ancient forces

This is not a game about survival alone — it is about confronting what lies beneath the surface, both in the world and within yourself.

store_data.about_the_game:
Visiting a relative's house—it is a grand adventure.

Control Yoshiko Obune, overcome all dangers and bad luck, and reach your relative's house!

Over 500,000 YouTube Subscribers!

Up-and-coming video creator Satoru Gobunme has created this game himself!

The protagonist is "Yoshiko Obune," familiar from the Satoru Gobunme animations.

Control her, a natural-born tragic heroine, and guide her safely to her relative's house!

■3D Action

This is a third-person action game.

The city is full of danger.

Total strangers attacking you, traps left rusty for some reason, moving platforms, exploding pandas...

Crouch, jump, and sometimes throw stones to survive the bad luck and reach the goal: your relative's house!

Sometimes, boss battles will unfold.

Unique Controls

Of course, she can dash, but she gets tired quickly and starts walking.

Her charm comes through even in the controls.

■Options

You can select the graphics quality from "Graphics Settings".

If the game feels heavy, please lower the quality settings to enjoy.

■The World of Satoru Gobunme

The world of CG animation Satoru Gobunme spreads out before you.

Explore every corner and enjoy!

Familiar characters will appear one after another!

■About Satoru Gobunme

Distributes ensemble dramas featuring original CG characters on YouTube.

Everything from scripts, direction, voice acting, editing, to original songs is produced by him alone.

store_data.about_the_game:
A New Day, New Teddies

Each day brings a fresh set of teddies. Their appearance and rarity change over time, pushing you to come back, adapt your strategy, and decide when to play, collect, or sell.

Not Just Luck. Skill-Based Clawing

Grabbing a teddy isn’t pure chance. Timing, positioning, and control matter—master the claw, improve your precision, and turn skill into better rewards.

Collect Teddies. Collect Trophies.

Every teddy you collect becomes a trophy. Watch them appear in your collection, track your progress, and build a display that proves how far you’ve gone.

Upgrade and Unlock New Machines

Upgrade your setup to unlock new machines. Slots, roulette, and basketball open new ways to play, earn, and push your collection further.

Sell Your Teddies

Sell single teddies or bulk batches at once. Turn your collection into cash, manage your inventory, and decide when it’s worth holding… or selling everything.

Welcome to Teddy Collector

A cozy, atmospheric arcade experience focused on skill-based claw machines, classic minigames, and collecting unique teddies.

Step into a small arcade filled with glowing machines, foggy lights, and the familiar sound of prizes waiting to be won. Every play costs money, every attempt matters, and every teddy has real weight and physics.

Skill-Based Claw Machine

This is not RNG-only.

  • Real claw movement and inertia

  • Different teddy sizes and weights

  • Rare teddies are harder to grab

  • Precision and timing make the difference

Master the claw and learn how each prize behaves.

Arcade Minigames

Earn money and tickets through classic arcade machines:

  • Basketball challenges

  • Fortune wheel

  • Slot machine

  • Simple “work” minigames to stabilize income

Each one feeds back into the core loop:

play → earn → collect → upgrade

Collect & Display

  • Dozens of teddies to discover

  • Multiple rarities: common, rare, epic, legendary

  • Persistent collection and achievements

  • Display your collection on shelves

You can sell teddies for profit… or keep them forever.

Cozy, Mysterious Atmosphere

  • Stylized 3D visuals

  • Soft lighting, fog, and arcade ambience

  • Relaxing gameplay with a subtle dark tone

  • Designed to be played at your own pace

Features

  • Singleplayer

  • First-person arcade gameplay

  • Achievements

Teddy Collector is about patience, skill, and the simple joy of winning a prize.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Ashen OZ is a dark fantasy action roguelite set in a twisted, somber fairytale world inspired by The Wizard of Oz.

Wearing bloodstained shoes and wielding a witch’s umbrella as a weapon, players dash, parry, and chain relentless combos as they carve through a dreamlike world shaped by despair and fading memories.

Combat focuses on speed, precision, and tempo.

Perfectly timed parries, rapid dashes, and chained actions reward aggressive play, creating a fast-paced flow that emphasizes mastery and immersion.

Throughout each run, the Ashen Dice system presents meaningful choices.

Each die face grants a distinct ability, allowing players to build synergies and evolve their combat style without ever breaking the momentum of action.

Key Features

Fast, Combo-Driven Combat

Chain dashes, parries, and attacks into fluid, high-speed combat focused on timing and positioning.

Umbrella Parry System

A risk-and-reward parry mechanic that rewards precision, with limited defensive fallback on failure.

Ashen Dice Progression System

A unique dice-based upgrade system where each die face grants different abilities, enabling run-shaping builds and synergies.

Dark Fairytale World

Explore a distorted version of Oz filled with melancholic environments, grotesque creatures, and haunting imagery.

Pattern-Focused Boss Battles

Face multi-phase bosses with distinct attack patterns that demand observation, adaptation, and skill.

Atmospheric Presentation

Hand-crafted visuals and subtle environmental storytelling create a somber, dreamlike experience.

A fast-paced dark fantasy action roguelite

where you chain attacks and parries

into fluid, combo-driven combat

through a twisted fairytale world!

Inspired by the classic fairy tale, this game is a dark, story-driven psychological horror experience that reimagines the tale of Hansel and Gretel.

Players explore a hostile enchanted forest and surrounding locations filled with unsettling environments, environmental hazards, and lurking threats. Encounters are designed around tension and awareness, requiring players to read enemy behavior, use the environment for cover, and choose when to confront danger or escape it. Combat is situational and risky, reinforcing the game’s horror atmosphere.

  • Environmental puzzles that unlock new areas and story elements

  • Psychological horror delivered through atmosphere, sound, and visual storytelling

  • Survival-focused encounters emphasizing hiding, running, and evasion

  • Limited combat that supports tension rather than empowerment

  • A narrative that unfolds through environments, events, and subtle clues

As the story progresses, players uncover the truth behind the forest, the witch, and the distorted fairy tale they are trapped within.

This game focuses on immersion, tension, and narrative, offering a dark reinterpretation of a familiar story where survival is never guaranteed.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOUR AGENT HAS A BODY NOW

There's a tiny pixel-art character on your desktop with an axe. That's your AI agent's avatar.

When your assistant starts working, the avatar starts chopping. When the task ends, it stops. You don't click anything. You don't manage anything. You just code.

Every chop drops wood. Wood becomes gold. Gold becomes upgrades. The loop runs itself.

YOUR AI RUNS THE ECONOMY

Chop Signal connects to your AI assistant through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Your agent doesn't just trigger the chopping, it manages the entire game.

It sells your wood. It buys upgrades. It browses the shop. It makes decisions based on what's available and what you can afford. You review its code. It reviews its inventory.

Every shop purchase pops up for your approval first. You always have the final say.

PRIVACY FIRST

Chop Signal never reads your code, files, conversations, or file paths. It knows one thing: whether your AI assistant is busy or idle.

  • Runs 100% locally on localhost

  • No data collection

  • No telemetry

  • No network calls

  • Activity tracking through explicit MCP tool calls that you control

ONE-CLICK SETUP

  • Launch Chop Signal

  • Open Settings, click Setup

  • Restart your IDE

The setup button configures MCP for all supported editors at once:

  • Cursor

  • Claude Code

  • Claude Desktop

  • VS Code Copilot

  • Antigravity

Then use Copy Rules to paste agent instructions into your IDE. Your assistant will know how to play from its first conversation.

Works with any MCP-compatible tool at .

AT A GLANCE

  • Tiny always-on-top pixel art overlay — click-through, never blocks your work

  • Automatic chopping tied to AI assistant activity

  • 11 upgrades across 5 axe tiers

  • 5 wood types from Common to Legendary

  • Shop with AI self-care consumables

  • Rare collectibles and Steam Achievements

  • Full MCP control — your AI manages everything

  • Buy approval popup — you keep the final say

《Fish Lord》—— Conquer Millernnia in 30 Minutes!

‌True Strategy Begins With Rejecting Pay-to-Win‌

Saluting classics, forging legends! 《Fish Lord》 masterfully blends the epic heroes of 《Three Kingdoms Heroes》 with 《Travian》's grand sandbox, creating a revolutionary SLG kingdom-war universe free from pay-to-win tyranny! Victory hinges solely on tactics – thrones are claimed by wits alone!

Core Features That Ignite Warfare 

‌▌Hall of Legendary Commanders‌
Lead Qin Shi Huang's Tiger Warriors! Command Yue Fei's Iron Cavalry! Deploy Zhuge Liang's Wooden Oxen! Recruit hundreds of historical generals and strategists from Spring-Autumn to Ming-Qing eras to build your mythic legion.

‌▌Quad-Unit Rock-Paper-Scissors‌
Spears break cavalry → Cavalry trample swordsmen → Swordsmen shred archers → Archers pierce armor! Unlock legendary units: Qin Crossbowmen, Mongol Horsemen, Qi Family Pikemen! Exploit terrain and unit counters to recreate history's epic upsets!

  • ‌Strategist Phase‌ - Position units and sequence hero deployments

  • ‌Duel Phase‌ - Hero clashes determine army morale

  • ‌Legion Phase‌ - Decisive battles combining:

Future Campaigns

When modern SLGs became 'wallet wars', we declared:

No investor pressure • No monetization traps • Just pure tactical sandbox crafted by veterans for veterans."

A BLIND TACTICS GAME INSPIRED BY THE DEDUCTION MECHANICS OF MINESWEEPER.

The Resonant is turn based blind tactics RPG based in a world where everyone is blind. You take the role of a powerful warrior called the "The Resonant" who can perceive the world through the natural vibrations of all things. You will uncover the secrets of this strange world whilst getting swept up in the politics of of this region and fighting multiple dangerous foes along the way. Every choice matters and will shape the future of this world.

Deduce Positions & Intentions

Use the numbers on each cell and your abilities to deduce which tiles hide enemies and predict their intended movements.

Manipulate the Battlefield

Use your skills to set traps and manipulate enemy orientation, movement, and behaviour to execute a devious plan.

Mark Enemy Positions

Mark all tiles you believe are occupied by enemies, then strike.

Watch Your Plan Unfold

Watch multiple enemies fall into your traps and succumb to your devastating attacks.

They Can't See You — But They Can Hear You

Your attacks and manoeuvres leave noise signatures on the grid that enemies can detect. Use sound to lure investigating enemies into traps and defeat them when they are most vulnerable.

store_data.about_the_game:
"If you could truly go back to that time, what would you do?"

YOBI is a narrative-driven game centered on exploration, dialogue, and puzzle-solving. Players step into the shoes of the protagonist returning to their childhood neighborhood, traversing between two distinct worlds to reawaken memories buried deep within time by collecting relics of the past.

Core Gameplay:

• Dual-Timeline Narrative: The story unfolds across two alternating dimensions. As the plot progresses, both perspective and art style shift significantly, allowing players to drive the narrative through contrasting visual experiences.

• Atmospheric Puzzles: The game features a series of environmental puzzles integrated into the story. Designed with a moderate difficulty curve, these challenges encourage players to observe their surroundings deeply without disrupting the narrative flow.

• A Pure Emotional Experience: With a gentle pace and a focus on mood-building through visuals and music, YOBI is crafted for those who cherish deep storytelling and immersive atmospheres.

Key Features:

• A Blend of Reality and Art: A unique visual aesthetic that merges the delicacy of hand-drawn illustrations with the grounded reality of real-life photography.

• Original Atmospheric Soundtrack: Stylized music custom-composed for each scene to heighten emotional resonance.

• Emotion-Driven Journey: Rather than focusing on mechanical challenge, the game prioritizes a heartfelt story about memory, friendship, and the art of farewell.

store_data.about_the_game:
Angels’ Uprising

Angels’ Uprising is a stylish platformer action game set in a modern reinterpretation of Hell,
where players use a spear as both a weapon and a traversal tool.

With the spear, players can perform stylish movement—leaping across long distances, avoiding obstacles, and moving freely in 360 degrees.
The spear can also be used to impale enemies, block attacks, and interact with the environment.

Unique Movement Using the Spear

The most important core mechanic in Angels’ Uprising is a movement system based on anchoring.

The spear can be embedded into walls, ceilings, or the ground.
Jumping while the spear is anchored propels the player with acceleration in the opposite direction.

This allows players to jump higher, traverse walls, hang from ceilings, and move dynamically through the environment.

Not all surfaces can be anchored to.
Some walls allow anchoring, while others do not—requiring players to carefully plan where and how to anchor the spear in order to progress.

Unique Combat Using the Spear

In Angels’ Uprising, the spear is the player’s only weapon.
However, its functionality is far from simple.

The spear does not stop after killing a single enemy.
Reflecting its ability to pierce through targets, players can impale multiple enemies lined up in a row with a single thrust, creating a uniquely satisfying sense of impact.

The spear is not only used against enemies.
Players can impale environmental objects—such as explosive gas canisters—and throw them as weapons.
Even the bodies of impaled enemies can be picked up and used as projectiles.

Story

After death, you are brought before the judgment of the angels.
However, due to the interference of an unknown entity, you are cast not into Heaven, but into Hell.

Armed with nothing but a single spear, you must push forward, piercing your way through demons.

Along your journey, you will encounter a mysterious rebel faction, the residents of Hell, powerful Archdemons who command the forces of evil, and a mysterious angel who watches over you.

You will eventually become involved in a secret plan known as “Angels’ Uprising.”
Will you uncover the truth of Heaven and Hell, and find the path to reincarnation?

Hell Awaits You

Leap across Hell with a single spear in hand,
and pierce through everything that stands in your way.

Controls

  • Left Mouse Button – Thrust spear (attack, anchor to surfaces)

  • Right Mouse Button – Block, throw objects impaled on the spear

  • A – Move left

  • D – Move right

  • Space – Jump

  • E – Interact, advance dialogue

  • F – Fast-forward dialogue

  • Q – Carry ally

  • F1 – Hide UI

  • F3 – Toggle developer mode

  • F11 – Toggle fullscreen

store_data.about_the_game:
This story begins with a single note left behind by someone who has passed away. The note contains crucial clues needed to progress through the game, and the player must search for a small marketplace formed by the survivors, as well as the messages left by the dead.

In the center of the city, players can meet various NPCs, complete quests, and trade items necessary for survival. At the top floor of a ruined hotel, there is a key that can open every door in the city. This key is the only way to access a secure bunker.

The deceased left behind an SMG and a small cache of supplies for the protagonist.
With ammunition, grenades, and medical kits, it’s enough to survive the journey to the market.

At the market, there is Tom, who manages the city’s fuel; Bill, who trades water and food; Eddie, a master craftsman of equipment; Robert, who deals in general goods; Joseph, who trades electrical equipment; and David, who buys and sells weapons.  Once all six NPCs have been encountered, the locations of zombies will be displayed on the radar in the top-right corner of the screen.

Upon completing the quest, you will obtain a motorcycle that allows you to travel quickly through the ruined city. However, don’t forget that it requires maintenance costs.

Take out multiple enemies with one grenade.

The demo will be released during Steam Next Fest.

For Mac Users

Runs on Intel and Apple Silicon (M1) Macs with stable performance. Trackpad supported, but a mouse is recommended.

Controller Support

Full native support for Xbox and PlayStation controllers. No setup required.
If you experience input issues, set the controller option to "Use default settings" in Steam.

store_data.about_the_game:
This game began with a simple idea from my daughter.

She asked me to make her a game—her world, her characters, her imagination brought to life. What started as a small personal project quickly grew into something much bigger. Together, we talked about the world, the places in it, and the kinds of heroes who would live there. She helped shape the tone, the personalities, and the feeling of the adventure, while I worked on turning those ideas into something playable.

Every Guardian, every environment, and every piece of the story is rooted in those early conversations. It wasn’t about following trends or building something for the market—it was about creating something meaningful that she could recognise as her own.

From a development side, this was built from the ground up as a solo project. The systems, the gameplay, the engine—everything was created step by step, learning and solving problems along the way. It’s a handcrafted experience, shaped both by technical work and by the imagination that started it.

At its core, this game exists because a kid asked her dad to make something special.



Olivia’s World: Crystal Keep

A story-driven tower defense RPG set in a peaceful fantasy world on the brink of elemental war.

You play as a Guardian sworn to protect towns, kingdoms, and floating crystal isles from goblins, wargs, and corrupted armies. What begins as a routine defense quickly spirals into a wider conflict — one that challenges everything the world believes about its history… and its enemies.

Tactical Defense Meets Real-Time Action

Each map blends structured, wave-based tower defense with real-time Guardian combat.

Place your defenses along defined enemy paths. Adapt to evolving waves. Survive escalating assaults as enemies push toward your exit point.

Your spires automatically engage incoming threats, while you step into battle with powerful Guardian abilities when the tide turns.

Victory comes from positioning, resource management, timing, and understanding enemy behaviour — not reflexes alone.

Play as Distinct Guardians

Choose from a roster of unique Guardians, each with:

  • Their own abilities and combat style

  • Different strategic strengths and synergies with your defenses

  • A personal role within the unfolding story

Every Guardian offers a new way to approach each defensive map, encouraging experimentation and replayability.

A Character-Driven Fantasy Story

As the war spreads, you’ll uncover a deeper narrative of forgotten history, fractured loyalty, and a mysterious enemy whose motivations are far more complex than they first appear.

This is not a story about stopping the end of the world.

It’s a story about balance, truth — and the cost of ignoring the past.

A Complete Experience

  • Handcrafted wave-based levels

  • Strategic structure placement and upgrades

  • A clear beginning, middle, and end

  • No endless grind

  • No procedural filler

Olivia’s World: Crystal Keep is the first chapter of a larger saga — but it stands alone as a complete and self-contained tower defense experience.
