store_data.about_the_game:
Blind Nature is an audio-game that is designed to be played without visuals. Follow Liora's story as she escapes from her burning home village, and sets out to explore the West to understand the curse that has taken ahold of her home forest. Interact with local characters to begin quests that lead to a variety of environments with unique audio-centered gameplay mechanics.

Team up with your companion

With a magical companion bird called Kestrel at your side, learn how to navigate and understand your environment from the audio cues that Kestrel makes. Solve puzzles based on shapes, direction and sound to uncover new ancient locations with lore fragments and quest items.

Shoot a magical bow

Learn how to shoot a magical bow while relying on both your own hearing and aid from Kestrel in tense reaction-based encounters. Listen, aim, shoot and dodge in a unique radial 360 archery system.

Explore a rich world of sound

Explore forests, rivers, caves, snow, day and night scenes with rich 3D spatial sound. Take a break at any time to set up your campfire, listen to the environment, cook and play minigames.

Imagination as visuals on the screen

Everything Liora hears and learns about her surroundings combine to create a colorful visual experience on the screen. As you move, turn and go from place to place, the visuals adapt to match Liora's imagination.

Blind Nature tries to push the limits of unique and experimental gameplay for audio games and pairs that with diverse worldbuilding, environment sound and music design.

store_data.about_the_game:
🛡️ IRON SIGHT

See first. Strike first. Survive.

IRON SIGHT is a top-down tactical tank combat game built around vision, positioning and information control.

From a bird’s-eye perspective, you command armored vehicles on hostile terrain where what you see matters more than what you shoot.
Enemies outside your line of sight are invisible. Poor positioning means ambush. Good reconnaissance wins battles before the first shot is fired.

This is not about reflexes.
It’s about awareness, angles and timing.

🎮 Core Gameplay

👁️ Advanced Vision & Spotting System

  • Dynamic line-of-sight and fog of war

  • Enemies are only visible when detected

  • Terrain, obstacles and distance affect visibility

  • Flanking and ambush tactics are essential

🛰️ Top-Down Tactical Combat

  • Clear overhead view for strategic decision-making

  • Control tanks with realistic movement and turret behavior

  • Use cover, elevation and sightlines to your advantage

⚙️ Armored Vehicles

  • Realistic tank-inspired designs

  • Different roles: scouts, brawlers, support units

  • Positioning and awareness matter more than raw firepower

🧠 Tactical Depth

  • Engage or disengage based on information

  • Punish careless movement

  • Outsmart opponents by denying vision and controlling space

🌍 Battlefield Features

  • Varied maps with terrain that affects sight and movement

  • Urban ruins, forests, open fields and chokepoints

  • Environmental objects that block vision and create ambush opportunities

🎯 Designed For

  • Players who enjoy tactical gameplay

  • Fans of World of Tanks–style spotting mechanics

  • Strategy-minded players who value positioning over reaction speed

  • Indie and retro-inspired combat fans

store_data.about_the_game:
[Important Note: This game is currently available in Traditional Chinese only.]

To survive, you must speak up. Fa Zheng's plan for destruction is built on the silence of the people. In Voice of the loop, you must use your voice to break down barriers. Prove within the 7-day time loop that only by echoing one another can we survive the end of the world.

◆ Beloved by All: An Adventure from a Female Perspective

Experience a world that treats you gently because of your cuteness.

  • A "Reverse Harem" Experience: Recruit teammates and enjoy sweet storylines where everyone competes for your favor. Utilize the "Walk & Talk" system to watch intimate bonding moments between besties or see male characters get jealous over you—all without taking up main story time.

  • A Microcosm of Society: Residents will reveal the cruelty of this dictatorship, but they will also slip you precious items and starting funds simply because you are adorable. It pays to chat with everyone.

  • Fashion is Eternal: Collect 14 meticulously designed outfits (with color variations) and exclusive accessories. The best part? Your fashion carries over through death. When you wake up in the next loop, you will still be the most beautiful one there.

◆ Dual Gameplay Modes: Speed vs. Strategy

Switch playstyles at will, but remember: only by mastering the cycle of day and night can you maximize your rewards.

Undead Tracking Mode (High-Speed Pathfinding):

  • Real-Time Decisions: This is the ultimate challenge of route judgment. Monsters begin their pursuit the moment you enter.

  • Vision & Traps: In narrow mazes filled with traps and limited vision, you must instantly analyze the map, plan the optimal path, collect Runestones, and evacuate safely.

Turn-Based Combat (The Tactical Quartet):

  • Traditional yet Deep: Attack, Skill, Defend, Item—all four commands are equally critical.

  • The Reality of Defense: Powerful skills consume TP, and reckless attacks invite death. You must use "Defend" strategically to manage aggro (hatred) and regenerate TP.

  • Items are Trump Cards: Items are scarce but game-changing. Using them at the precise moment during an enemy's turn is the key to a perfect tactical counter.

◆ Ultimate Builds: Luck x Construction

  • Randomized Classes: At the start of each run, the four characters' classes are randomly selected from three variants. Every loop offers a completely different skill set and playstyle.

  • Godly Gear & Luck: Get lucky and assemble all three parts of the "Horn of Apocalypse" to instantly max out your team's level, or build the "Rocket Launcher" to obliterate hidden bosses.

  • Creative Theory-Crafting: Found a piece of "trash" with -0% to all stats? With the right class, it might double your damage. Risk it all with cursed equipment for extreme power, or seize your exclusive gear amidst the waves of random professions.

◆ Deep Game Theory: Black Market & Psychological Traps

  • The Prisoner's Dilemma: Equipment isn't bought with money; it's bought with gambling. There are no standard answers in the Black Market. Betrayal yields massive profits but depletes the remaining goodwill. Will you be the one to topple the dominoes of trust, or the cornerstone that rebuilds order? The choice is yours.

  • Unexpected Events: Face 14 psychological traps rooted in behavioral economics. Most people make the wrong choice due to "Loss Aversion" or the "Anchoring Effect." Can you overcome your instincts and make the truly profitable decision?

◆ More Features:

  • Fast-Paced Rhythm: Time flows rapidly on the world map (7 days can pass in under a minute). Teleportation is instant, and the story can be skipped quickly. Spend your time on what you find fun!

  • Fun Side Quests: Challenge well-designed Sokoban (box-pushing) puzzles and endure the sharp tongue of the Psychological Test Machine. Clearing them unlocks conveniences like the "Black Market Anchor," allowing seamless switching between shopping and adventure without wasted travel time.

  • Philosophical Core: In a 2D world, touching "Superfluid" allows time to flow non-linearly. This game seriously explores parallel universes and time travel, but ultimately, it serves to highlight the brilliance of humanity. In an economic system full of traps, only your persistent voice of kindness can create an echo that changes everything—just like a memory traveling through time.

store_data.about_the_game:
🎮 About This Game

A Roguelike + Auto-battler strategy adventure game where every run features a completely different route. Recruit Emoji partners along the way to build a squad, arm your team with unique weapons, obtain powerful relics that change the rules, arrange your formation for automatic battles, and experience unknown random events. Lead your squad through five distinct worlds and try to survive until the end.

🗺️ No Two Maps Are the Same

In every adventure, a brand new route map unfolds before you. With winding and intersecting paths, you cannot set foot on every node. Challenge the elites, or take a detour to strengthen your lineup? Every fork in the road is a gamble, and different choices lead to different endings.

⚔️ They Fight on Their Own

When the horn sounds, the Emojis charge into the battlefield on their own. Who takes the hits, who deals the damage, and who turns the tide—you cannot intervene. The only thing you can do is plan before the battle starts: who stands in the five positions, and what weapon each should hold. Leave the rest to them.

✨ Train Your Emojis

Three identical Emojis can be merged to star up, multiplying their stats. But starring up is just a quantitative change; Awakening is the qualitative leap. Awakening reshapes skills, adding brand new mechanics to ordinary abilities. Starring up gives you power; Awakening gives you possibilities.

🔮 Equipment Rewrites Rules 

Weapons do more than just increase numbers; they change the way Emojis fight: the trajectory, rhythm, and even the purpose of attacks. Relics directly tamper with the rules, bringing qualitative changes to your entire lineup. Try different combinations, and you might invent a playstyle that belongs only to you.

⛺ Respite Between Battles

Not every node leads to combat. You will encounter treasure chests, merchants, and camps to replenish supplies and awaken new skills. But gold is never enough, and inventory slots are always limited. Every supply run and trade-off sets the stakes for the next fierce battle.

🎭 Anything Can Happen on the Road

You might gain a partner from a stranger's proposal, or lose your strongest teammate due to a rash answer. Generosity comes with a price, while desperation may hide a turning point. Across five journeys, something is waiting for you around every corner.

store_data.about_the_game:
Slackball is a minimalist Pachinko-style marble game designed especially for those little “slacking off” moments at the office. Built around lightness, transparency, and stress relief, it blends perfectly into your desktop environment.

Game Features

  • 🖥️ Floating Desktop, Seamless Slacking
    The game features a fully transparent, borderless window that quietly floats in a corner of your screen. Always on top yet never intrusive, it’s your most discreet relaxation companion during busy workdays.

  • 🎲 Strategic Betting, Heart-Pounding Thrills
    More than simple bouncing! A unique betting and multiplier system adds tension and strategy:

    • Random Multipliers: Each time you confirm a bet, the system randomly assigns an x2, x4, or x8 reward multiplier.

    • Dynamic Slots: As the multiplier increases, the number of winning slots decreases—challenging you to balance high risk with high reward.

  • 💰 Marbles Rewind, Zero-Stress Play
    Worried about losing all your marbles? Just click the “Marbles Rewind (💰)” button to reset your marble count to the initial state. This is a truly zero-pressure game, letting you restart anytime, anywhere.

  • 🏆 Push the Limits
    Your highest score is tracked in real time. Watch the numbers climb and enjoy the pure satisfaction of achievement collecting.

How to Play

  • Bet: Use [+] and [-] to adjust your wager.

  • Confirm: Click [OK] to lock in the multiplier and activate the winning slots.

  • Launch: Hold down the bottom Plunger to charge, then release to fire the marble.

    Your highest score is tracked in real time. Watch the numbers climb and enjoy the pure satisfaction of achievement collecting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Yoga with Sensei is a story driven visual novel that blends cozy slice-of-life comedy, romance, and optional yoga mini-games.

After saving money from years of hard work, Yuto Nakamura moves to the city to pursue an unusual dream, opening his own yoga studio. It’s a fresh start, but also a risky one. To succeed, he’ll need students… and a little luck.

Soon, four women with completely different personalities step into Yuto’s studio. What begins as simple yoga lessons slowly turns into something more as daily routines, playful banter, and intimate moments bring everyone closer together.

Your choices shape how relationships grow, leading to multiple romance routes and endings. Will Yuto find love with one student, end up alone, or balance feelings with everyone at once?

Relax, stretch, and enjoy a lighthearted journey filled with humor, charm, and just a hint of spice.

Key Features

  •  Visual novel gameplay with anime-style presentation

  •  Four romance routes, each with a unique heroine

  •  Multiple endings, including individual, harem, and lonely endings

  •  Optional yoga mini-games that enhance bonding (can be skipped at any time)

  •  Wholesome comedy with light ecchi elements

  •  Stylized 3D anime characters

Content Notice

This game contains mild sexual themes, suggestive dialogue, and revealing outfits.
There is no explicit sexual content.
All characters depicted are adults.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tache Noire is an exploration based survival horror game where you can explore every single building in any order you like. Explore, fight and solve puzzles. Experience the story of five friends getting together for a reunion in Lucenille.

Non-Linear Exploration

  • Explore at your own pace.

  • Go anywhere and complete the game in any order.

  • Explore every single building and house.

  • Meet different NPCs.

  • 10 Hours of exploration.

Adaptive Enemies

  • Shoot specific parts of the enemy to change their behaviors.

  • Close doors on them to slow them down.

  • Lure them into traps and Conserve your Ammo.

  • Fight different kinds of enemies and find their weakness.

Weapons and Weapon Customizations

  • Change the way your weapon works with attachments.

  • Upgrade your weapons at the coffee shop.

  • Manually reload your revolvers and your shotgun. Grab those bullets and slam them into the cylinder.

Rumour and Notes

  • Stuck on a puzzle? Open the rumour tab and get a short summary of the events up to this point.

  • Forgot something? Important codes are automatically written in the notes tab.

Procedural Loot and responsive enviroment

  • Loot everything.

  • Get loot based on the equipment you have.

  • Grab phyiscs objects and stack them.

  • Crawl through vents.

  • Remove barricades.

Multiple Choices and Endings

  • Have Conversations with the inhabitants of the town. Decide wheter or not you want to help them.

  • Trade with them.

  • Achieve all the different endings for Tache Noire.

       当队伍遇到发狂的烈马，且看他们如何保护路过的金发少女：

       当玩家返回门派后，主角会进入人物培养模式，每旬（十天）可以选择在门派练功或下山闲逛，练功可以提升你的武功（招式和内功，也就是技能）等级和属性，闲逛可以触发不同的剧情事件。

       你所做的选择将会造成短期或深远的影响，甚至可能造成伙伴的死亡，当他们面临危险，你能否拯救他们？当你面临一次次选择，你能否写完这一段传奇？

       总而言之，这是一封由作者本人写给儿时单机RPG的一封情书。

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a worker at the “White Whale” factory. The dystopian world of the future reminds you of the most horrible times from the past. The poverty that reigns in the country and is practically all-consuming does not allow anyone like you to climb the social ladder.

You have a small chip implanted in your brain, automating your work. Annoying and uncomfortable vibrations always causedaversion. However, once you come to the job, it seems to you that your head is about to split. It hurts right in the middle of the brain, where the board is. After barely making it to the medical unit, you realize there's no help coming. No one is gonna help you.

You were agonizing for several days when you suddenly found out about “The Black Whale,” the only drug that can relieve the pain. At the same time, it sends you on an amazing journey on the back of flying whales.

Although there is a problem, “The Black Whale” is very expensive. You have to find money. No matter where, no matter how.

GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW

The Black Whale is a first-person psychological linear horror that combines the elements of exploration and story progression.

The main character, suffering from horrible pains, can do nothing but try to get enough money to buy another dose of “The Black Whale”.

  • Plot progression. Observe the moral and physical fall of the main character. Follow the story, at the same time, trying to find anything that you can sell. Notes, NPCs, and other interactable things that will tell you the story of this dystopian world.

  • After using “The Black Whale”, you come to another world, far away from all the cruelty and suffering of the harsh reality. The most beautiful creatures in the world—black whales—allow you to ride them and taste life once again.

  • Returning to reality. You understand that you need more. Sell your property, gradually descending nearer and nearer to the social bottom.

  • The core gameplay loop consists of exploring locations, reading notes, interacting with NPCs, finding required items, and completing simple objectives.

KEY FEATURES

  • A short psychological horror game (approximately 20 minutes long). It includes the full story experience, several in-game days, and multiple locations to explore.

  • Dive into the deepest social bottom. Being a junkie, you have nothing that can stop you on the way to get the new dose.

  • Sell your property and steal others’. You have to find everything you can to get money from. When you have nothing left, there will be no choice but to turn to theft.

store_data.about_the_game:
Slimepatch is a cozy top-down arena survivor focused on relaxed progression and satisfying combat.

Step into a peaceful forest clearing and take on your first job as an adventurer: clearing out waves of slimes. Each round introduces new challenges, but you’ll grow stronger by collecting resources and upgrading your skills between battles.

There’s no timer pressure or punishment for taking your time — just steady progress, clear goals, and a gameplay loop you can settle into.

Gameplay

  • Fight through escalating arena-style rounds filled with colorful slimes

  • Earn resources and upgrade your abilities between rounds

  • Unlock higher ranks by meeting skill requirements

  • Face boss encounters every 10 rounds

  • Defeat the final boss at round 40, then continue into endless mode

Slimepatch is designed as a focused, complete experience with a clear endpoint. Players progress through ranks and face the final boss as part of the core journey, with an optional endless mode available for those who want to continue surviving against increasing waves of enemies.

Progression & Ranks

As you improve, you’ll climb a full rank ladder — starting at F and working your way up to SSS.

Each rank reflects mastery of the game’s systems. Play well, build smart, and advance naturally as the difficulty increases.

Cozy by Design

Slimepatch is designed to be:

  • Low-stress and approachable

  • Bright, colorful, and easy on the eyes

  • Easy to pick up and play

  • Satisfying to replay at your own pace

Controls

  • Keyboard and mouse support

  • Controller support (tested with modern controllers)

store_data.about_the_game:
Nun and Vampire -  An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

London was shrouded in thick fog in 1889, and the ripples of the River Thames hid all dark secrets. You will take on the role of Alicia, a Holy Blood maiden, stepping into the Gothic castle of Count Dracula Kane, the vampire prince, with an assassination mission from the Church. Your Holy Blood is not only the fatal weapon to end him, but also the only redemption to break his curse of eternal life. The secrets of the misty city, the grievances of the vampire clan, and the witch's conspiracy are waiting for you to experience this entanglement of love and hate immersively.

Core Game Features

  • Forbidden Love Between Two Powerhouses: Depict the equal rivalry between the immortal vampire and the Holy Blood maiden, with well-rounded characters, delicate emotional tension, and full of appeal.

  • Pure Immersive Experience: Abandon unnecessary distractions, focus on plot immersion, allowing you to fully engage and experience the dark fate journey of the misty city.

Highlights of Female Character Interaction Scenarios

  • With Dracula Kane: A gentle redemption on the tip of a knife. Listen to him tell the centuries-old stories on a rainy night, survive the crisis together in the tomb, and feel the forbidden tension immersively.

  • With Seraphina: Meet the centuries-old resentful spirit in the Tower of London, witness her obsession with love and hate and her choice of blood curse, and experience the turning point of the plot firsthand.

  • With Evelyn: Join hands with the hunter descendant who stands on the opposite side to investigate the truth and fight side by side, and experience her struggle between family rules and inner feelings.

  • With Clara: Engage in dangerous transaction games with the dark witch, and take control of the plot initiative in the collision between Holy Blood and black magic.

Exclusive Immersive Scene Features

  • Exclusive High-Definition Scenes: Create a variety of high-definition scene images, covering core scenes such as Gothic castles, the Tower of London tombs, and foggy stone roads.

  • Restoration of Dark Aesthetics: Perfectly present the Victorian Gothic style, with full details such as stone walls, scarlet velvet long tables, and flickering white candles to enhance the atmosphere.

  • Immersive Engagement: Smooth scene switching and delicate details make you feel as if you are in London's misty city in 1889, experiencing the ups and downs of the plot firsthand.

Immersive Function and Gameplay Features

  • Offline Play Support: No network connection required, start the plot anytime and anywhere, not limited by scenes, and immerse yourself freely.

  • One-Click Rewind Function: Easily revisit the touching and thrilling moments of the plot, savor the classic scenes repeatedly without restarting.

Step into Nun and Vampire, embark on an eternal love in the name of Holy Blood, and immerse yourself in this centuries-old vampire fate in the high-definition Gothic scenes!

store_data.about_the_game:
Homeless Farmer is a small adventure for a couple of hours.

Get ready to face the harsh reality. No help, no leniency, you will have to rely on your mental abilities and common sense.

After years of school and university, you have finally found your calling - living among the garbage. Your possessions are a piece of apple and a couple of bottles. Your capital is an empty bottle.

One night, after spending it in the trash can, you decide that it's time to change something. Your path of the dark one begins.

"Homeless Farmer" is a survival strategy where you start from scratch, even a little bit in the red. Your goal is not just to survive, but to save up for an apartment in a world where prices are rising every day.

The first money 

Look for trash in trash cans, landfills, and anywhere else. Sell it to a merchant to earn your first money.

At first, this money won't even be enough for a small garden. But over time, you can save up for a full-fledged farm. The key is to carefully plan your purchases. Every mistake can cost you your life.,

Farming

Grow food and flowers for sale.

Selling flowers is your main source of income, especially at first. You can find rare seeds in bird feeders or in the park, and rose and sunflower seeds are sold in the store. You can also grow food in a greenhouse, this will help you not to starve.

Market analysis

Study the market, adapt to its requirements. Look for rare items, but keep in mind the rising prices. The cost of apartments is increasing, while garbage is becoming cheaper. Therefore, you will need to find new sources of income, optimize production, and update your equipment.

Electricity

Once you have enough money from selling flowers, you can start building your own 3D printer farm (or even a mining farm). But don't forget that printing requires electricity and plastic, so don't spend your last money on a printer, or you'll end up digging through the trash again.

This game is designed to be fun, both during development and while playing. Don't take everything too seriously. I hope you enjoy it!

Abyss Chamber is a story rich, psychological horror game. You will explore an underground research facility full of monsters. Solve the mystery that the ruthless company is trying to hide. You’re the new hire, an ordinary cog at the job, and with the help of your supervisor, you must maintain the facility’s daily operations while uncovering the truth.

A HAUNTING TALE OF MYSTERY:

It’s 1998. An old research facility in Pennsylvania needs new workers. As Henry, a former journalist with a troubled past, you accept the offer. What starts as an ordinary maintenance worker job soon turns into an endless nightmare as you confront abyss entities. store_data.about_the_game:
[BEFORE YOU BUY]: Hey! I want to make it super clear that this game is essentially Early Access (even though I labeled it incorrectly). I am working on it and updating it constantly. I'm very active in the official Discord and there is a free demo on the official website that you can check out ahead of time (link in the right column)!

ALSO: Although the game launched with AI placeholder art, I have been actively replacing that art with handcrafted art (115 items so far replaced) -- so you will see that change over time. Furthermore, I use Claude Code to scale my development work. To be clear, all game design, ideas, universe building, storylines, and all things creative come from me, but things like bug fixes, modularization, i18n localization, I use Claude to help with those tasks. I am unable to update the AI disclosure on Steam, so I wanted to make sure you saw this before purchase, just in case you are not comfortable with these tools.

Thanks for checking the game out!

Build a guild. Recruit from 41 classes of adventurers. Send them into a 100-floor tower where death is permanent and your best warrior might not come back.

Every adventurer is procedurally generated with their own zodiac sun and moon signs, personality, stats, ambitions -- and flaws. An Aries berserker won't take orders the same way a Virgo tactician will. A Capricorn won't appreciate the Gemini kleptomaniac skimming off the top after every quest.  Your job is to recruit them, train them, pay them, and try not to get too attached.

THE TOWER AWAITS

A massive buried tower has awoken beneath the frontier town of Hiltcrest, spewing monsters across the land. The Crown has authorized independent adventurer guilds to fight back. You are one of many Guild Masters who answered the call -- and most of them won't make it.

RECRUIT & DEVELOP

  • Scout and sign adventurers across 41 unique classes, each with distinct stats and zodiac-driven personalities

  • Train your heroes in combat, unlock traits through milestones, and watch raw recruits become legends (and eventually retire)

  • Manage contracts, wages, chemistry and morale -- push them too hard and they'll walk; coddle them and they'll never survive the tower; put them with the wrong party and things could get interesting

  • Guide your guild across generations as veterans retire and new blood takes their place

BUILD YOUR GUILD ACROSS GENERATIONS

  • Construct guild facilities: barracks, armory, infirmary, training grounds, and more

  • Hire specialized staff: scouts to find talent, astrologers to read the stars, craftsmen to forge gear

  • Climb the guild tier system from scrappy upstart to renowned institution

  • Compete in annual rankings against 30 rival guilds -- or trade and negotiate with them -- each with their own personality, agenda, and desire to take down the Tower

CONQUER THE TOWER

  • Deploy parties on quests ranging from simple bounties to full-scale raids

  • Descend 100 floors of increasingly deadly challenges, each with unique threats

  • Face powerful bosses and ultimately confront the mysterious final power

  • When adventurers fall, the Guild must be rebuilt

A LIVING SIMULATION

  • Hundreds of interacting systems: economy, reputation, weather, guild politics, adventurer relationships

  • Procedurally generated adventurers ensure no two playthroughs build the same guild

  • 30 rival guilds with their own ambitions, rosters, and diplomatic stances

  • Your decisions ripple — a bad call on floor 47 can reshape your guild for years

store_data.about_the_game:
“This is how your desire draws me — like in hentai fantasies.” 
Oolah's words when he first hallucinated.

Stranded on a breathtaking yet completely abandoned island, a man struggles to stay alive as his mind slowly unravels under the crushing weight of absolute solitude. What first appears to be a tropical paradise soon reveals itself as a place marked by silence, decay, and forgotten lives.

Experienced in first-person perspective, Far Beach places players inside the thoughts of a castaway who turns to the island’s strange mushrooms as a way to escape pain — and the unbearable loneliness. Through their effects, a mysterious and beautiful woman appears in vivid hallucinated video chats, becoming his only companion, emotional refuge, and the center of his growing desires.

What begins as comfort and pleasure slowly transforms into dependency.

As this imagined relationship overtakes his reality, the island itself seems to respond. Disturbing visions surface, shadows move where nothing should be, and fragments of the island’s past emerge — hinting at former inhabitants who vanished under unclear circumstances. Abandoned structures, personal belongings, and a long-forgotten lighthouse stand as silent witnesses to a tragedy that left the island completely deserted.

Far Beach is not only about surviving hunger and isolation — it is about uncovering a hidden mystery buried beneath the sand, and exploring how loneliness, desire, and the human mind can shape both paradise… and madness.

Far Beach is a first-person survival experience centered around exploration, resource management, and psychological progression. Players navigate a fully interactive island using a complete inventory system, allowing them to collect food, manage supplies, and use items to stay alive.

Hunger and fatigue are core mechanics. Food must be gathered and consumed to maintain energy, while rest and sleep are necessary to recover from exhaustion and continue exploring the environment.

Among the island’s resources are strange mushrooms that provide bursts of energy — but also trigger a unique video-based chat system. When consumed, a mysterious nude woman appears in a simulated conversation, interacting with the player through pre-recorded visual responses and dialogue, blending survival gameplay with narrative-driven hallucinations.

The game supports keyboard and mouse as well as gamepad controls. For the most precise interaction and immersive experience, keyboard and mouse are recommended.

store_data.about_the_game:
A pachinko roguelite dungeon crawler where every shot is a gamble, every bounce is a build, and every dragon is another reason to break the board.

Drop balls. Deal damage. Slay dragons.

Launch balls onto a pachinko board to attack enemies. Where they land, what they hit, and how you've built your board determines whether you survive or start over.

PACHINKO COMBAT

Each encounter plays out on a physics-driven board. Drop your balls, watch them bounce through pins and placeables, and rack up damage. Timing and positioning matter, but so does the chaos. Learn to engineer your luck.

BUILD YOUR BALL DECK

Balls aren't just ammo, they're your arsenal. Each has unique stats and abilities. Buy, sell, and reorder them at shops like a deck-builder. Find synergies, craft combos, and make every drop count.

EXPLORE PROCEDURAL DUNGEONS

Navigate a randomized node map. Fight monsters, face dragons, make choices at events, and gear up at shops. No two runs play the same.

LOOT & EQUIP

Gather strong artifacts and amplify your synergies even more. There are tons of incredible builds to discover.

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

Die, learn, unlock. Persistent upgrades and unlockable content. Share seeds with friends to challenge the same run.

store_data.about_the_game:
AUTO-BATLLER

Real-time combat. Your ship auto-fires while enemies swarm in escalating waves. Each sector increases danger, introducing elites and ambushes that punish or reward greedy builds.

INCREMENTAL UPGRADE

Earn XP from every encounter and invest it into permanent, incremental meta upgrades. Prestige to unlock new ships and return stronger for the next run.

PICK-1-FROM-3

Harvest drifting wreckage for credits and resources. Install modules, augments, drones, sockets, and weapon upgrades to shape your ship into a finely tuned machine, or a reckless experiment.

STORY LOGS

Uncover scattered logs, corrupted transmissions, and forgotten distress calls hidden among the wreckage. Each sector reveals more about what happened out here and the forces shaping your path through the void.

40+ Installable Modules, Augments, Drones, and Sockets (completed)

From durable fortresses to high-risk glass cannons, combine modules, drones, augments, and sockets to craft powerful synergies and redefine weapon behavior. 

10 Core Upgrade Branches (completed)

Permanent meta progression with branching paths that unlock automation layers, new systems, and long-term scaling power across future runs.

5 Distinct Weapon Systems (completed)

Auto-battler archetypes that define your playstyle. (rapid fire, burst, precision, scatter, and heavy impact)

4 Enemy Factions (completed)

Distinct combat behaviors and tactics, including an Unknown faction that merges them all into unpredictable late-game threats.

6 Bosses and 1 Flagship (WIP)

Unique boss fights with environmental counters and system-based weaknesses, ending in a massive Flagship battle with breakable subsystems and relentless pressure.

9 Points of Interest (completed)

From salvage-rich derelicts to hazardous Unknown zones and supportive outposts that can repair or reshape a failing run.

30+ Choice-Driven Encounters (completed)

Respond to unidentified coordinates through event prompts with actionable outcomes. Each response may reward salvage, modify systems, alter faction threat, or escalate into combat.

15 Unlockable Ships (completed)

Ships that alter core mechanics and synergize with specific build archetypes.

21+ Unlockable (WIP)

Gradually expand your arsenal with automation, meta upgrades, ship systems, challenge modes, weapon control, and late-game modifiers that reshape how every run plays.

3 Game Modes (completed)

  • HYBRID: Forgiving progression with sector checkpoints and full item retention. Designed for steady advancement and build experimentation.

  • PROGRESSIVE: Mid-core challenge with persistent sector progress but harsher resource and integrity penalties.

  • ROGUELIKE: Full reset on death. Limited fuel, no meta progression, and high-stakes decision making every jump.

The Gauntlet (WIP)

Every 10th Sector reveals a hidden POI beyond the sector gate: The Gauntlet.

A timed trial built to stress-test your loadout. Upon entry, select one modifier from each group to define the combat parameters, then endure escalating reinforcements as bosses chain in succession and the survival clock tightens with every kill.

Story (WIP)

The game follows a fractured escape across derelict-littered space. What begins as a simple flight for survival slowly reveals something sinister and repeated attempts to aid you. Each jump uncovers more about the mysterious helper, the forces observing your existence, and the truth behind the unending loop.

The story builds toward a definitive ending. A final confrontation that breaks the cycle and reveals the intelligence behind it.

The game has a clear direction and long-term plans, but it is still growing. New items, encounters, ships, and progression layers will continue to be added, with ongoing updates expanding mechanics and content over time.

ONE GOAL: BE THE FIRST TO REACH THE SUMMIT — AND SAVE HIM!

Deep in Antarctica, there is a lonely penguin who has lost all hope, waiting for death at the top of a mountain.
Time is running out. The cold creeps into your bones.
Will you be the hero who pulls him back… or will it be your friends?

Lonely Penguin brings competition and cooperation together in a freezing, unforgiving atmosphere.
When the 60-minute countdown begins, you’re not only racing against nature —
you’re also racing against the players beside you.

RACE AGAINST TIME — PROVE YOUR FRIENDSHIP

Reach Him First

Do everything you can to be the hero who reaches the penguin at the summit, embraces him, and carries him back to his flock.
This is a race — the fast survive, the slow disappear into the snow.

Save Your Friend

The parkour is ruthless. One mistake can send you tumbling into the abyss.
Your only hope is your friends.
They can pull you back up… or leave you behind and continue toward the penguin.
The choice is theirs.

Challenging Vehicle Mechanics

You won’t make it on foot alone.
Use specially equipped vehicles to cross frozen lakes and steep cliffs.
But be careful — speed can be fatal. One wrong move, one rollover, and it’s over.

Co-Op Struggle

Play solo or with up to 3 friends.
Will you move together… or sacrifice each other to be the one who claims the penguin first?

60-Minute Time Limit

The penguin’s heart can’t endure much longer.
If you fail to complete the mission and reach the safe zone within one hour, everything ends.

At the top of that icy mountain, every second is a decision.
Will you reach out a hand to your friend — or leave them behind on the path to the penguin?

Time is ticking.
Save him… or witness him die alone in the cold.

⏱️ 60 MINUTES — ONE CHANCE

When the countdown starts, it never stops.
Fail to reach the penguin within 60 minutes, and it’s over.

A wrong path, a small fall, a moment of hesitation…
Each one leads to irreversible consequences.

🤝 CO-OP: WHO’S FASTEST?

Play alone or enter Antarctica with up to 3 friends.

But one critical question remains:

Who will save the penguin first?

  • Each player chooses their own route

  • Takes their own risks

  • Sets their own pace

Even when playing as a team, one thought lingers in everyone’s mind:
“Who will reach him before the 60 minutes run out?”

store_data.about_the_game:
Ever wondered if you could organize a hoard?

Enjoy seeing BEFORE and AFTER transformations?

Here's your chance to organize over 15,000 objects!

There are 30 levels... NO time limits, NO rules.

Organize everything EXACTLY how you want it.

Organize everything with precise controls (shoe at the end of the video is showing the game mechanics).

What to expect:

You will enter a main lobby (with music) where you can select any level 1-30.

Each level is it's own individual scene. Expect a variety of objects to organize in each scene.

With 30 levels, expect to spend approximately 1 hour in each level, so approximately 30 total hours of playtime to complete the game.

Because of the high volume of objects, expect longer than normal loading/saving times.

What this game is not:

This is not a cleaning game. There is nothing gross to clean. The game focuses strictly on decluttering and organizing.

This game has no story, no character, no built-in challenges/quests, no variety of game modes. It is simply taking objects from a pile and placing them where you want.

This game is NOT FOR EVERYONE. This game is ONLY for those who enjoy arranging items and seeing the before and after transformations of a space.

----------------------------------

store_data.about_the_game:
One evening, a small foal gets separated from the herd and finds itself deep in the forest.

During the day, the woods seem quiet and almost friendly, but when night falls, everything changes: shadows grow longer, sounds become distorted, and the darkness feels as if it’s trying to reach your very heart.

Gameplay Features

  • Atmospheric side-view survival adventure focused on exploration and environmental interaction.

  • Day-based survival loop: explore the environment, find food, avoid hazards, and reach a safe location before nightfall.

  • Night dramatically increases environmental danger, requiring the player to secure shelter before darkness falls.

  • Food system with multiple plant types providing different levels of nutrition; some food sources must be discovered through gameplay.

  • Scent-based mechanic used to identify edible objects, detect nearby threats, and navigate in low visibility without direct UI indicators.

  • No dialogue system: narrative is delivered through animation, sound design, visual effects, and environmental changes.

  • Three life stages with evolving mechanics, difficulty progression, and changes in world behavior.

  • Gradually increasing threats, including predators and more complex survival challenges.

  • Interaction with forest animals that can affect situations, progression, and available paths.

  • Later stages introduce mechanics focused on leading other creatures, territory protection, and stronger influence on the game world.

To survive, the foal must find food, explore the surrounding world, and return to safe places before night comes. Not everything that looks scary is truly dangerous - some things need to be sniffed, observed, and understood.

The journey is divided into three stages of life.

With each new cycle, the hero grows, and the world changes along with them:

  • In childhood, fear hides in the dark.

  • In adolescence, it takes the shape of shadows of wild beasts.

  • In adulthood, the hero no longer runs away, but protects others and leads them forward.

Along the way, the foal will meet strange inhabitants of the forest: a mocking crow, a pushy raccoon, a silent deer, and other creatures. Each encounter can change not only the hero, but the world itself.

In Hoofprints, there are no dialogues or explanations. The story is told through movement, sound, light, and the hoofprints left on the ground - even after the path has already been walked.

A cooperative fantasy horror where you and your bros must deliver a wagon of magical artifacts to the enchanted kingdom.

FIGHT MONSTERS AND GATHER LOOT

On the road to the enchanted kingdom, your cart will frequently break down, making you easy prey for monsters. Destroy them and remember to search abandoned villages for spellbooks or artifacts.

USE YOUR VOICE NOT ONLY FOR SPELLS, BUT ALSO TO CONTROL THE CART

Yes, in this game you must cast spells with your voice. Aim at monsters (or your bros), and remember that the main goal is to reach the kingdom. But the horse won't budge until you command it to. It will stand there even if skeletons are eating it...

store_data.about_the_game:
Six months ago, you exposed PROJECT NIGHTFALL — an illegal government surveillance program responsible for 23 deaths. The story was buried. The architects walked free.

Now someone is trying to reach you. And they're using a dead woman's photograph to do it.

HELLO HACKER 2: PROJECT DAYBREAK

Project Daybreak is a story-rich hacking simulation played entirely from within a fully realized Linux desktop environment. Every tool, every application, every terminal window is yours to use. The conspiracy is real. The commands are real. The consequences are real.

THE STORY

A single encrypted dead-drop leads you to a name: Dr. Maren Solís — a senior intelligence analyst who was supposed to be dead. Buried in the image's metadata is one word: DAYBREAK.

Following the trail pulls you into something far larger than Nightfall ever was. A private AI firm called Meridian Systems has been quietly building an autonomous threat-assessment system called AURORA — trained on the surveillance data Nightfall spent years collecting. AURORA doesn't just watch. It decides. And it has already acted, without human review, eleven times.

You join a loose collective of hackers, journalists, and defectors who call themselves Daybreak. Their goal: expose AURORA before its twelfth decision is made.

But AURORA is watching the network. And it learns.

A FULL HACKING DESKTOP — NOT JUST A TERMINAL

Project Daybreak runs inside a simulated Linux desktop environment. Open multiple applications simultaneously, pivot between tools, and work the way a real analyst would.

  • Terminal Emulator — A full Unix command set with pipe support, redirection, SSH session stacking, command history, and tab completion. Navigate multi-host networks, read logs, enumerate services, and cover your tracks.

  • Network Scanner — Map target subnets with stealth, standard, or aggressive scans. Every scan mode generates a different noise signature on the target's intrusion detection system. A Canvas-rendered topology map shows your discovered network in real time.

  • Browser with Request Interceptor — Access internal web applications. Pause, edit, and replay HTTP requests to find and exploit vulnerabilities — SQL injection, IDOR, SSRF, and more.

  • Crypto Workbench — Decode ciphertexts, run frequency analysis, crack hashes, derive keys, and operate GPG-style encryption. A built-in frequency chart helps you identify substitution ciphers visually.

  • File Analyzer & Steg Tool — Inspect files at the byte level. Extract hidden data from images using LSB steganography, find files embedded after EOF markers, and read EXIF metadata that was never meant to be found.

  • Forensics Workstation — Browse disk images and recover deleted files. Parse network captures and extract credentials from plaintext protocols. Correlate events across multiple log sources into a unified timeline.

  • OSINT Console — Search simulated social media profiles, WHOIS records, certificate transparency logs, code repositories, corporate registries, and news archives. Build intelligence dossiers and visualize connections between entities on a live link analysis graph.

  • Comm Suite — Craft spear-phishing emails, execute social engineering campaigns, and navigate vishing scenarios through a branching dialogue system.

  • Disassembler — Analyze binaries in a readable in-game intermediate representation. Annotate functions, trace cross-references, and patch instructions to bypass license checks and unlock restricted access.

  • Exploit Console — Match discovered service versions to a library of exploits. Configure payloads, open remote shells, and manage active sessions.

  • Malware Sandbox — Run captured malware samples in isolation. Watch behavior events fire in real time — file writes, network connections, registry modifications. Write detection rules based on what you observe.

  • Password Manager & Cracker — Store discovered credentials, identify hash types, and run dictionary, mask, and rainbow table attacks. Weak passwords fall fast. Strong ones take time.

  • OPSEC Dashboard — Monitor your operational security posture across every host you've touched. Manage your proxy chain, track forensic artifacts you've left behind, and watch AURORA's global threat level climb.

  • Script Editor — Automate repetitive tasks with a bash-like scripting environment. Schedule scans, chain commands, and build your own tools from the same commands the terminal uses.

OPSEC: THE MECHANIC NO OTHER HACKING GAME HAS

Every action you take leaves a trace.

Every SSH login, every file you read, every failed password attempt — it all generates noise on the target host's intrusion detection system. Push a host's alert level too high and Meridian's security team gets involved. Push it further and AURORA begins to respond directly — rotating credentials, deploying honeypots, hunting the source of the intrusion.

The OPSEC Dashboard tracks your threat posture in real time. Clean log entries with shred. Clear your bash history. Route traffic through a proxy chain. Operate within credential rotation windows. Work fast enough that nobody notices you were ever there.

Ignore OPSEC and the mission gets harder. Ignore it long enough, and AURORA locks you out entirely.

REALISTIC CHALLENGES ACROSS 12 CATEGORIES

Every challenge in Project Daybreak is grounded in real cybersecurity concepts taught in CTF competitions and professional penetration testing. The game covers:

  • Network reconnaissance and service fingerprinting

  • Web application exploitation — SQL injection, IDOR, SSRF, XSS

  • Cryptographic analysis — XOR, RSA weak keys, padding oracles, hash cracking

  • Steganography — LSB extraction, whitespace encoding, EOF file hiding, EXIF metadata

  • Digital forensics — deleted file recovery, PCAP analysis, log timeline reconstruction

  • Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) — the deepest OSINT mechanic in any hacking game

  • Social engineering — phishing, pretexting, vishing

  • Reverse engineering — binary analysis, backdoor identification, patch mode

  • Privilege escalation — SUID abuse, cron job exploitation, misconfigured sudo

  • Operational security — artifact cleanup, proxy chaining, IDS evasion

  • Exploitation — service fingerprinting, CVE-analog matching, payload configuration

  • Malware analysis — behavioral sandbox, IOC extraction, detection rule writing

YOUR CHOICES SHAPE THE OUTCOME

The evidence you collect determines which ending is available to you. How you handle OPSEC determines how hard Meridian pushes back. Characters you help — or fail — carry those choices forward.

Three endings. One conspiracy. The truth is in the data.

BUILT FOR CYBERSECURITY LEARNERS AND ENTHUSIASTS

Project Daybreak is designed to be genuinely challenging for people who know cybersecurity — and genuinely educational for people who are learning it. Every technique the game asks you to use maps to a real-world concept. Every tool works the way the real-world equivalent works.

Whether you're preparing for CTF competitions, exploring a career in security, or just want a hacking game that doesn't insult your intelligence — this is it.

KEY FEATURES

  • A fully realized Linux desktop environment with 15 interactive applications

  • Story-rich single-player narrative across three acts with three branching endings

  • OPSEC system — every action has a noise signature; AURORA responds dynamically

  • 12 challenge categories grounded in real CTF and penetration testing disciplines

  • The most in-depth OSINT mechanic in any hacking simulation game

  • Multi-host network simulation with SSH pivoting and lateral movement

  • 52 Steam Achievements for completionists and challenge hunters

  • Built with Rust for a native, performant experience on Windows and Linux

Project Daybreak is a standalone sequel. You do not need to have played Hello Hacker to enjoy it — but if you did, you'll recognize the world.

Release date TBA - Late 2026 / Early 2027

store_data.about_the_game:
Hey — I wanted to make a game you can just jump into and have fun with right away.

Duball Dash is a simple, hyper-casual endless runner set inside a fast-moving tube. You play as a green ball with some seriously cool white ski goggles, rolling forward and dodging metal walls with black-and-yellow hazard tape, plus plenty of red cylinders trying to ruin your run.

You get 10 lives every run. That’s on purpose. I want you to experiment, mess up, learn the patterns, and keep going — without feeling punished for every mistake. This isn’t a rage-quit game. It’s more of a “one more try” game.

The art style is intentionally playful and a bit silly — like something drawn in Paint — because the game doesn’t take itself too seriously. It’s kid-friendly, fast, and all about improving your run little by little.

If you like quick games, endless runners, and chill trial-and-error gameplay, I think you’ll feel right at home here.

Roll fast. Crash. Laugh. Try again.  

Controls: Move left and right using A & D or the Left & Right Arrow keys.

store_data.about_the_game:
Horn of the Warlord

Horn of the Warlord is a turn-based strategy game about ruthless conquest, calculated risk, and outthinking your enemies. Take the role of a Warlord, expand your dominion region by region, and prove that victory belongs not to the strongest army, but to the smartest commander.

Every decision matters. Every war has consequences.

About This Game

In a fractured world inspired by early medieval kingdoms and Viking-age warfare, rival Warlords rise to claim dominance. There are no chosen heroes, no scripted victories - only ambition, strategy, and the will to conquer.

Horn of the Warlord focuses on strategic mastery, offering fast-paced yet deep campaigns where preparation and timing decide the outcome of wars.

Conquer a Dynamic World

The game includes a fixed set of maps that were procedurally generated during development. While map layouts are fixed, every campaign reshuffles the strategic situation through randomised resources, population distribution, and starting positions.

Depending on map size, matches can range from short 30-minute skirmishes to large-scale wars that last several hours.

Each region matters. Controlling territory grants access to resources, income, and population needed to support your armies and expand your power.

  • Regions provide food, wood, stone, iron, and population

  • Different biomes affect expansion and movement

  • Strategic positioning is as important as territorial size

Losing a key region can be just as impactful as winning a battle.

Wage War Through Strategy, Not Reflexes

Battles are auto-resolved, but never automatic.

Victory depends on:

  • Army composition and unit roles

  • Timing and positioning

  • Fatigue and readiness of your forces

  • Choosing when and when not to fight

There is no single best unit and no winning spam strategy. Only well planned armies survive.

Siege Warfare and Castles

Castles play a central role in both defense and progression. Upgrading them improves regional security and unlocks stronger unit types.

Sieges require careful planning. You must decide how to spend limited siege points and which tactics to employ based on the situation.

  • Build and upgrade castles to unlock stronger units

  • Defend key regions with improved fortifications

  • Conduct sieges using ladders, battering rams, or trebuchets

  • Spend limited siege points to execute the right tactic for the situation

Every siege is a strategic puzzle, not a numbers check.

Challenge Warlords, Not Cheating AI

Face up to five rival Warlords, controlled by human players or AI.

The AI plays by the same rules you do:

  • No hidden bonuses

  • No artificial advantages

  • Decisions based on risk, reward, and long-term gain

If you lose, it’s because you were outplayed - not out-cheated.

Play Alone or Together

  • Single-player skirmishes and scenarios

  • Structured campaign introducing mechanics and systems

  • Local hot-seat multiplayer, where multiple players take turns on one machine

Perfect for competitive strategy nights and shared campaigns.

Designed for Strategy-Focused Players

Horn of the Warlord is intended for players who enjoy thinking several turns ahead, adapting to changing conditions, and solving strategic problems rather than relying on fast reactions.

If you enjoy planning, experimentation, and learning from defeat, this is the kind of game built for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
You rented a house on Dunmore Street to finish your degree. Quiet neighbourhood. Cheap rent. Exactly the kind of place where nothing ever happens.

The night you arrived the Johnsons had a baby. The whole street came outside. Firecrackers. Laughter. One of those rare moments where strangers feel like family.

You went to bed thinking this place was going to be fine.

That was the last normal night.

Something happened on Dunmore Street that night. Something that has kept it frozen in that one moment ever since. The neighbours seem fine. The lights stay on. And every time you try to leave you end up exactly where you started.

The deeper you go the less the world holds together.

NULL is a first person psychological horror game about grief, obsession and what happens when love refuses to accept an ending. You talk to people who seem completely normal until they turn and look at you in a way that makes you wish they hadn't. You find what was left behind by someone who could not say goodbye. And slowly the picture forms — what happened here, who did it, and why they thought love was a good enough reason.

Follow where the night leads.

  • First person exploration across a neighbourhood that changes the longer you stay
  • Branching conversations and hard choices that shape how the world responds to you
  • Environmental investigation through recordings, objects and spaces between them
  • Reality sequences that take you somewhere the street does not want you to see
  • Three full length endings — each a completely different answer to the same night

The horror here is not loud.

No monsters. No health bar. No jump scares. The dread in NULL builds through what you piece together yourself — and the choices you make shape how the world responds. What you cannot unlearn once you have found it stays with you. The horror is not something chasing you. It is something you slowly understand — which is worse.

Three ways out. Only one truth.

NULL ends with a choice. Three paths. Three completely different answers to the same night. One has no name. None of them are wrong. Not exactly.

People say dreams are an escape from reality.

NULL asks what happens when you stop wanting to wake up.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Evenkeel Harbor!

Ye Old Seadog puts you behind the bar at the most chaotic establishment on the known seas. As the newly appointed tavern keeper in Evenkeel Harbor, your goal is simple: keep the ale flowing out and the Crowns flowing in. But in a port full of thirsty pirates, nothing goes according to plan.

Master the Chaos

It's a difficult task, trying to appease to a difficult customer base. Running a pirate tavern is a test of speed and strategy. You must manage your resources, pour drinks with precision, and keep your customers happy before their patience runs out. A happy pirate tips well; an angry one might just leave you high and dry. A drunk pirate is a happy pirate, mostly.

Manage The Tavern

Keep a close eye on your inventory. You aren't just a bartender; you are the manager. ensuring your kegs are full and your tables are clean is the only way to survive the rush. Every day brings a new wave of customers with different demands. Learn to be flexible, like a pirate flag in the wind.

Build Your Legend

Start with a humble shack and work your way up. Will your tavern become the crown jewel of Evenkeel Harbor, or will you walk the plank? The fate of the seas  your tavern is in your hands.

Catverse is a 3-4 player party game where players become the brain cells of a quirky cat to control its actions.

The cat constantly moves based on the combination of lights in the rooms of its mind. Thought you safely landed on the next platform? Did the other players think so too? The cat's state of mind changes the moment someone presses or releases a button. And when the state changes? The cat will immediately do something wildly unpredictable. But you can't just stand still, either! Standing still in a room might be the exact right move, or standing still itself could trigger a specific action combination. You pressed a button to prevent a mistake? Well, turns out that was the 'long jump to the leeeeft' button. Cats are unpredictable by nature, right?

Key Features

Simple Controls

Once the game starts, your only job is to turn the room lights on and off! Everything happens with just a click of a button. You can easily recommend this to anyone, regardless of age—especially someone you want to get closer to.

The Cat's Behavior

The cat is always on the move depending on the light combinations in its head. It might jump, or it might just walk. If its mind gets too tangled, it might just do a "cat loaf" or take a stretch. Because the cat never stops moving, players must constantly communicate, strategize, and act accordingly to pull off the right moves. Wait, the person you wanted to get closer to couldn't keep up with the plan? And the cat just double-jumped you all the way back to the starting point? Congratulations. This is a great opportunity to get really close.

Various Cats with Their Own Universes

There isn't just one cat! And as we know, every cat lives in its own world. As you clear stages, you'll meet a variety of cats, each with their own unique universe and rules!

store_data.about_the_game:
Releasing Feb.16 2025

Mayday is a wave-based sci-fi shoot 'em up where every clear makes you stronger… and weaker.

Pilot the Skylon, a prototype combat craft built to adapt on the fly. Survive enemy swarms, dodge dense projectile patterns, and wipe out targets fast—then after each wave, choose a tradeoff upgrade in a brutal triangle system: Attack lowers Defence, Defence lowers Speed, and Speed lowers Attack.

Core Gameplay Loop

  • Fight through waves of enemies with escalating bullet patterns and retaliation attacks.

  • Clear a set number of enemies to progress through each area.

  • After a wave, pick a stat specialization with a downside:

    • Attack ↑ / Defence ↓

    • Defence ↑ / Speed ↓

    • Speed ↑ / Attack ↓

  • Learn enemy behaviour, build the right stat path, and survive long enough to reach each boss.

Story Mode

In a future where peace is protected from the shadows by the Agent Society, a rogue group, the Fallen Star Organization, is hunting a myth and trying to awaken a superweapon.

You’re deployed as Agent Mayday, linked with the Skylon’s operating system, Elizabeth, and sent into the Alyphs Quadrant to shut down the enemy bases before Nova changes everything.

Arcade Mode

Arcade Mode is pure action: no cutscenes, just continuous progression through stages of enemy waves leading to bosses. If you’re here for the gameplay grind, the dodging, and the build decisions.

  • Wave-based shoot ’em up combat focused on dodging projectile patterns and fast clears.

  • A triangle stat-tradeoff upgrade system that forces real build decisions every run.

  • Boss fights and escalating enemy pressure as you push toward the finale.

  • Story Mode with cutscenes + Arcade Mode for replayable runs.

THE YEAR IS 2078. The Robotics and Animal Technologies laboratory has imprisoned you and your family for nefarious test experiments. You are Buck - a freshly escaped cybernetic rabbit with one mission in mind: find your family and escape. Using your trusty Carrot Bat and a newly acquired Shotgun, you must quickly find your way through the labs by any means necessary. Run and Bullet Jump through the air to navigate your way around bottomless pits and gunfire. Smash and bounce your way through imposing enemies and harsh terrain. Whatever it takes, free your family and find your way back home.

Momentum

Always. Keep. Moving. Employ Buck’s speed to run and jump through various stages and keep up the momentum as you race against time!

Combat

Wield Buck’s trusty carrot bat to smash your way through enemies and obstacles. Use it to your advantage and pave a way to victory!

Bullet Jump

Utilise Buck’s shotgun to propel yourself through the environment and around hazards. Make every shot count!

Challenge Yourself

Speed through various locations as fast as you can. Continue to challenge your best times and collect all the carrots throughout the levels!

Handcrafted Environments

Navigate through three distinctive stages with unique themes and aesthetics. Each environment has new mechanics and challenges to overcome.

store_data.about_the_game:
Awaken in the Kingdom of Asherah

Step into a pixel-art online realm rebuilt on the Intersect engine. Explore towns, forests, rivers, and dungeons in a world without rigid quests or classes—your story unfolds entirely through player choice in a persistent world that evolves with the community. Begin in benevolent Arthos, trade and take risks in chaotic Keld, or navigate the disciplined, orderly Rhine.

Craft Your Legacy

Dive into life-skills like mining, woodcutting, fishing, farming, cooking, alchemy, and blacksmithing. Level skills from novice to Master, crafting everything from basic tools to advanced gear. Experiment with multi-step recipes and manage your own housing instance. Every harvest and hammer strike contributes to your wealth in a player-driven economy.

Conquer and Evolve

Engage in skill-based combat with responsive swings, parries, and spells. Wield melee weapons, bows, or magic, and increase your combat skills to wield more powerful gear. Level up to 1000, mastering your favorite weapons and abilities. Face roaming monsters in dangerous wilds, and respawn at the Temple of Asherah in Arthos when you fall. Test your skills in PvP at the Arthos Coliseum for duels and team battles.

Forge Bonds in a Shared Realm

Form parties for efficient hunting or join guilds with shared halls, farms, mines, and territories. Explore instanced areas together, trade directly with other players, and host events like seasonal celebrations or guild competitions. Build lasting friendships in a respectful, family-friendly community, shaping the world through cooperation and rivalry.

A World Alive With Mystery

From lush animated tilesets and flowing rivers to ambient wildlife sounds, Asherah pulses with life. Explore interconnected continents by boat, manage survival needs like hunger and rest, and uncover hidden secrets in forests, caves, tundras, and marshes. Daily login bonuses and ongoing developer updates keep the world fresh and evolving.

store_data.about_the_game:
【Story Background: The Collapse of Project Immortality】
A corporate giant covertly initiated an experiment known as "Project Immortality," publicly touted as research into an immortality serum. You are a key employee dispatched to its top-secret laboratory, buried deep beneath the Deluo Mountains. Isolated from the world, all operations here were conducted in silence.
Until a routine energy activation experiment caused the specimen, codenamed "Primordial Mycelial Core," to undergo an uncontrollable mutation... The disaster begins now.

【Phase One: The 60-Second Scramble】
When the catastrophe struck, you were on the laboratory's uppermost level—a stroke of grim luck. The blaring alarms and flashing red lights are your only countdown—the central nerve-calming gas will be released in just over a minute, set to flood and seal everything.
This is the final moment of civilization's echo. You and your teammates have a frantic 60 seconds to make instinctual choices within the self-destructing lab: Do you rush to the storage for canned food and medicine? Or risk entering the data center to retrieve encrypted hard drives that might hold the truth? Every single item you take will become your sole means of struggling for survival in the unknown world ahead.

【Phase Two: Survival in the Misty Forest】
Escaping the collapsing lab is no liberation. You find yourselves in the remote, nearly uninhabited depths of the Deluo Mountain forest. Fortune smiles slightly—an abandoned forest observation station offers temporary shelter.
Now, the primary goal is simple: Survive. Await a rescue that may never come.

  • Build & Manage: Use your limited escaped supplies to build your refuge from scratch. Construct rain collectors for life-giving water, set animal traps for food, light campfires to ward off darkness and fear. The completion of each facility is a defiant strike against despair.

  • Explore & Gather: Explore diverse ecological maps from a third-person perspective. Try fishing by the serene lakeshore, scout for vantage points and rare resources on steep cliffs, mine for minerals in dark caverns, and muster the courage to enter the ominous ruins of the old research institute. Every expedition is fraught with danger and potential.

  • Respond to a Dynamic World: The forest itself is a living enigma. With over 500 randomized events, the game weaves your unique story. It might bring a boon—"Luminous mushrooms appear at the campsite after a night rain"; or a warning—"Unidentifiable, strangely elongated footprints are found by the warehouse"; or an internal crisis—"Under the weight of despair, a fierce argument erupts among teammates." Your every choice triggers unpredictable chain reactions.

  • Cooperation, Discord & The Truth: Cooperation is the cornerstone of survival, but it's not the only answer. You must divide tasks—some venture out, others focus on base-building and healing. However, resource scarcity, moral dilemmas, and the gradually surfacing dark truth can sow seeds of distrust within the team. Scattered experiment logs, anomalous traces, and supernatural encounters all point to a more terrifying question: Is the company's promised "rescue" a hope, or another trap?

【Multiple Endings, Authored by You】
The game's conclusion is not singular. Your key decisions, discoveries, and days survived will collectively lead to vastly different final chapters. The company could be your savior or the ultimate villain; this forest could be your final resting place or a home nurturing new hope. The truth awaits your unveiling...

【Every Game is a Unique Survival Epic】
Are you ready to fight for hope amidst the roar of a countdown, build a home within endless mist, and, in the crevices of survival, uncover a dark truth capable of consuming everything?

【Game Features】

  • Supports 4-player co-op

  • Third-person perspective

  • Over 500 random events

store_data.about_the_game:
I. Game Background

The game background of "DNA FIGHT" is set in a future fighting world, allowing a single fighter to master the skills of all fighting game characters. Starting as novice fighters with only regular attacks, through training and fierce arena battles, you will unlock each  new skill one by one, evolve into the most versatile fighter in history.

II. Role playing

Players take on the role of a future female clone fighter, obtaining DNA through battles and gradually unlocking skills and outfits.

III. How to Play

This is an arcade-style fighting game, players can play as a single player or engage in two person combat with friends.

1. Move & Attacks: Play with keyboard (default), game pad, or arcade stick. 

Move: Direction keys.

Attacks: A Punch, B Kick.

1）Keyboard Mode: Default or Custom

[Player 1]

Move: W, S, A, D

Attack: J, K

[Player 2]

Move: Numpad 5, 2, 1, 3

Attack: Numpad +, Enter

2）Gamepad or Joystick Mode: Custom

Custom Key Bindings: How to play Panel > Key Settings > Press your custom buttons in order (in sequence: Up, Down, Left, Right, Punch, Kick)

2. Skills: Choose from two control schemes to execute skills.

Normal Input Mode: Restoring the tactile sensation of arcade fighting rubbing and optimizing the rubbing instructions for easier execution.

One-Button Mode: Perfect for newcomers, simply press a single button to perform powerful skills, bypassing complex command inputs.

IV. Game Features

1. Simplified Controls

The fighting game controls have been simplified to just two basic buttons: Punch, Kick.

The combo system has relatively lenient judgment, allowing newcomers to quickly master various skill inputs.

2. Combo System

Normal attacks and skill attacks can be freely combined, enabling even beginners to easily create combos.

Mastering infinite combos and anti-infinite counterplays is key to victory.

3. Skill System

In most traditional fighting games, each character only has a few unique skills. However, in this game, you can unlock and possess all available skills.These include: projectiles, rush attacks, long-range command throws, multi-hit damaging moves, high-priority attacks, anti-infinite counter skills, healing moves, HP-cost strikes, and more.

The rich variety of skills incorporates classic fighting game techniques and combat styles, and even includes "emergency escape" moves and healing skills from arcade beat-'em-up games.

4. Protection Value

The protection value is displayed on the white protection bar above the HP bar in the game. If the protection value is 0, it is in armor piercing state and the damage is doubled when hit.

Protection value can be used to activate special powerful skills. For example, anti infinite combo technique, health regeneration technique, health depleted strike technique, etc.

When there is no protection value, it is extremely easy to be hit by infinite combos. The level of protection greatly affects the outcome of the battle.

5. Super Abilities
Super Abilities are extremely powerful and can be acquired directly by spending DNA. These abilities significantly enhance existing skills.
Examples include: attacks that restore health, automatic evasion when hit, skills that release additional projectiles.

6. Level System
Characters have levels that increase over time. Upon leveling up, players can choose to boost attributes such as Attack, Defense, or Health.
Newcomers can focus on leveling up to experience the thrill of overpowering opponents with stats.
Experienced players can choose not to level up and challenge higher-level opponents for a greater sense of achievement.

7. Rich Subsystems

The game includes various engaging subsystems such as dress up, clothing damage, leisure activities like resting or exercising in a bedroom setting.

V. Indie Game

This game's design, art, and programming were all developed by LM 195495770.

From the initial sketches on paper to detailed 3D modeling and animation in 3ds Max, and finally to coding and implementation, every part of the game was built from scratch.

No third-party resources were used in the making of this game—every part has been personally created. It is a pure original fighting game.

The demo of this game has already been released, you are welcome to download it for free! If you enjoy it, please add it to your wishlist. The full version is coming soon!

This is an arcade-style fighting game, players can play as a single player or engage in two person combat with friends.

1. Move & Attacks: Play with keyboard (default), game pad, or arcade stick. 

Move: Direction keys.

Attacks: A Punch, B Kick.

1）Keyboard Mode: Default or Custom

[Player 1]

Move: W, S, A, D

Attack: J, K

[Player 2]

Move: Numpad 5, 2, 1, 3

Attack: Numpad +, Enter

2）Gamepad or Joystick Mode: Custom

Custom Key Bindings: How to play Panel > Key Settings > Press your custom buttons in order (in sequence: Up, Down, Left, Right, Punch, Kick)

2. Skills: Choose from two control schemes to execute skills.

Normal Input Mode: Restoring the tactile sensation of arcade fighting rubbing and optimizing the rubbing instructions for easier execution.

One-Button Mode: Perfect for newcomers, simply press a single button to perform powerful skills, bypassing complex command inputs.

IV. Game Features

1. Simplified Controls

The fighting game controls have been simplified to just two basic buttons: Punch, Kick.

The combo system has relatively lenient judgment, allowing newcomers to quickly master various skill inputs.

2. Combo System

Normal attacks and skill attacks can be freely combined, enabling even beginners to easily create combos.

Mastering infinite combos and anti-infinite counterplays is key to victory.

3. Skill System

In most traditional fighting games, each character only has a few unique skills. However, in this game, you can unlock and possess all available skills.These include: projectiles, rush attacks, long-range command throws, multi-hit damaging moves, high-priority attacks, anti-infinite counter skills, healing moves, HP-cost strikes, and more.

The rich variety of skills incorporates classic fighting game techniques and combat styles, and even includes "emergency escape" moves and healing skills from arcade beat-'em-up games.

4. Protection Value

The protection value is displayed on the white protection bar above the HP bar in the game. If the protection value is 0, it is in armor piercing state and the damage is doubled when hit.

Protection value can be used to activate special powerful skills. For example, anti infinite combo technique, health regeneration technique, health depleted strike technique, etc.

When there is no protection value, it is extremely easy to be hit by infinite combos. The level of protection greatly affects the outcome of the battle.

5. Super Abilities
Super Abilities are extremely powerful and can be acquired directly by spending DNA. These abilities significantly enhance existing skills.
Examples include: attacks that restore health, automatic evasion when hit, skills that release additional projectiles.

6. Level System
Characters have levels that increase over time. Upon leveling up, players can choose to boost attributes such as Attack, Defense, or Health.
Newcomers can focus on leveling up to experience the thrill of overpowering opponents with stats.
Experienced players can choose not to level up and challenge higher-level opponents for a greater sense of achievement.

7. Rich Subsystems

The game includes various engaging subsystems such as dress up, clothing damage, leisure activities like resting or exercising in a bedroom setting.

V. Indie Game

This game's design, art, and programming were all developed by LM 195495770.

From the initial sketches on paper to detailed 3D modeling and animation in 3ds Max, and finally to coding and implementation, every part of the game was built from scratch.

No third-party resources were used in the making of this game—every part has been personally created. It is a pure original fighting game.

The demo of this game has already been released, you are welcome to download it for free! If you enjoy it, please add it to your wishlist. The full version is coming soon!

store_data.about_the_game:
Red Passport: Deported is an atmospheric first-person adventure that continues the story of the traveler from Red Passport: Ticket to Russia.

The fairy tale is over. You have been deported. You are standing in the port of Vladivostok, and all that separates you from your couch in Moscow is 9,000 kilometers and a complete lack of money. This game will show you the other side of travel: harsh, but romantic in its own way.

What to do in the game?

  • Plan your route: Choose how to move between cities. Hitchhiking is free but dangerous. Freight trains are fast, but cold and dirty.

  • Earn a living: Look for odd jobs at locations. Help unload a truck, find a lost cat, or fix a fence — any work pays.

  • Explore: Wander through train stations, markets, trains, and roadside cafes. Look for useful items that will grant access to closed areas.

  • Socialize: The world is populated by characters with their own problems. Dialogues will help you advance the plot and immerse yourself deeper into the atmosphere of life on the road.

You don't have to play the first part to understand the plot, but Deported offers a unique experience of contrast between comfortable tourism and forced survival.
