store_data.about_the_game:
In Butcher Shop Simulator, you run and grow your own neighborhood butcher shop: a hands-on, chaotic, and deeply satisfying simulation where precision, speed, and cleanliness matter. Break down whole carcasses, serve demanding customers, manage perishables, and expand your humble shop into a local institution.

From razor-sharp knife work to fridge management and customer flow, every decision affects your reputation, and your profits.

Cut, Prepare, and Sell Meat

Turn raw deliveries into premium cuts ready for sale.

• Break down beef, pork, poultry, and specialty meats
• Slice steaks, ribs, chops, and custom orders with precision
• Weigh, package, label, and price products correctly
• Avoid waste: spoiled meat costs you money and trust
• Unlock new cuts, tools, and preparation techniques as you progress

Knife skill matters. One bad cut can ruin the product.

A Shop That Lives and Breathes

Your butcher shop runs on tight margins and constant pressure.

• Manage cold storage, fridges, and display counters
• Track freshness, hygiene, and food safety standards
• Order inventory based on demand and budget
• Handle rush hours, special orders, and supply shortages
• Upgrade equipment to increase speed and efficiency

Cleanliness isn't optional, inspections can shut you down.

Serve Customers With Personality

Every customer has expectations, preferences, and patience limits.

• Fulfill specific cut and weight requests
• Deal with picky regulars and impatient walk-ins
• Upsell premium cuts, bundles, and prepared meats
• Handle complaints, refunds, and mistakes
• Build loyalty to unlock higher-value customers

Mess up an order, and word spreads fast.

Grow From Local Shop to Meat Empire

Start small, expand smart, and dominate the neighborhood.

• Expand your shop layout and cold storage
• Hire staff or automate repetitive tasks
• Unlock new meats, recipes, and specialties
• Customize your shop's look and workflow
• Balance speed, quality, and profit

Growth brings complexity — and higher stakes.

Play in Co-Op

Run the butcher shop together in online co-op.

• Split roles between cutting, sales, and logistics
• Coordinate during rush hours and deliveries
• Specialize or improvise under pressure
• Try to keep up when everything goes wrong at once

Because running a butcher shop alone is already hard enough.

store_data.about_the_game:
Emerald Flower tells the story of a 17-year-old boy who has lost everything in the war and is searching for a reason to live.

  • Rich Gameplay: Craft useful items from the materials you gather from the environment using the crafting and inventory system.

  • Diversified Combat Mechanics: Instead of just mashing buttons, find your enemy's weak point and strike there. Beware, those you thought were friends might actually be enemies. Carefully analyze every character you meet in this game.

  • Deep Character Relationships: In a civilization destroyed by the Emerald Flower, every character you meet matters. From a man giving advice on the road to a simple janitor, everyone has a good or bad nature and a story to tell.

  • Pixel Art Atmosphere: Feel this intimate yet ruthless world with 2D retro pixel art graphics.

Damlama Government Secret Archive Records: What is Known About the Emerald Flower Project

Biological Origin

The Emerald Flower (Stapelia Smaragdina) is a parasitic plant. It is a subspecies of Stapelia Gigantea. Although it is unknown exactly when and how it evolved, fossils dating back to the evolution of Homo heidelbergensis have been found. (Research is ongoing...)

Reproduction Strategy

While its cousin Stapelia Gigantea uses flies to reproduce, this subspecies, known as the Emerald Flower, uses mammals. Its infection strategy relies on emitting a dizzyingly beautiful scent to attract victims, especially chimpanzees and humans. When the victim smells the flower, the seeds attach to the brain's olfactory nerve. Since these seeds are microscopic in size, the victim walks away completely unaware of the parasite infection.

The seed slowly develops here by feeding on the moisture of the mucus and penetrates the brain. Once inside, the Emerald Flower accelerates its growth using glucose in the brain and extends its roots into the brain stem. These growing roots thin out to a microscopic level, splitting into nanofibers, and seep into the synaptic clefts, beginning to control all of the mammal's instincts. This process takes about 2 weeks. At the end of the 2 weeks, the fully possessed subject feels the need to consume about 4 times more food than normal and feels the urge to remove anything covering their skin, such as clothing.

If the infection reaches this stage, there is no turning back. From this point on, the victim must remain emotionally stable. If they suddenly experience emotions like fear, anxiety, or happiness, the hormones released from the victim's hypothalamus will cause the flower to activate. If the person can remain emotionally stable for a long period, the Emerald Flower completely takes over the brain and extends its roots into all of the victim's blood vessels, taking full control of the host.

If the flower activates before it has time to spread throughout the body, it constricts the Arteria Carotis (carotid artery) leading to the brain with its roots, cutting off blood flow and killing its host.

During the 3 hours following death, the Emerald Flower grows out of the victim's mouth and nose and blooms. This flower remains open for about 1 week; if it cannot find a new host, it withers and dies.

If another mammal approaches the corpse or tries to smell the flower during this time, the flower suddenly releases all its seeds into the air, attaching to that mammal's olfactory nerve and restarting the whole process.

Should We Be Worried?

Although the picture is alarming, humanity brought this Emerald Flower nightmare under control decades ago. All members of the flower were collected and burned, driving it to extinction. Only a single seed and its genetic code map were kept under high-security preservation at the ******** Laboratory. We celebrate the joy of being rid of this horrific parasite, which slaughtered millions of members of our species, globally every year in the first week of August as Emerald Flower Awareness Week. As long as humanity stands united, no organism can bring an end to our species.

(Edit 1) 12/02/2018

The last seed and genetic codes of the Emerald Flower were lost during an attack on the ******** Laboratory. Anyone who has seen the last seed or shares information about its whereabouts will be awarded 15 Million Rayet for themselves and their families. The world needs you...

(Edit 2) 04/08/2018

The Alpu Government has claimed responsibility for the theft of the Emerald Flower. They announced to the entire world that the flower had been reproduced and, through genetic modifications using advanced genetic technologies, its sap had been turned into a fuel 20 times more efficient than petroleum. The whole world is rejoicing that energy crises are ending and that we will achieve a new world order. The Alpu Government announced it is looking for human subjects for studies to prevent the Emerald Flower from infecting humans. Because it is suspected that the experiments will push ethical boundaries, our Government is putting political pressure on Alpu. The entire world has evaluated this pressure as the Damlama Government trying to block the Emerald Flower project because it can no longer be a petroleum giant. Tension is rising globally; the whole world is providing financial and political support to Alpu. Although our Government has repeatedly stated its dissatisfaction with this situation, the world fully supports this project, which will end their dependence on Damlama for energy.

(Edit 3) 25/01/2020

Our government did not want to take any risks, and despite knowing it would draw the ire of the entire world, organized a night-time Lightning Operation against Alpu, entering the laboratory where the Emerald Flower experiments were conducted and destroying all documents. Seizing the storage units containing the genetic code data and a few Emerald Flower samples, our government burned down the entire laboratory and the surrounding civilian living areas with napalm bombs. In the fires that broke out after the attacks, hundreds of thousands of civilians burned to death due to the inadequate infrastructure of the Alpu Government. The whole world is in an uproar. The entire world condemns our government and stands with Alpu. Although our Government states they did this to prevent humanity from being dragged into a great apocalypse because of this flower, global tensions are not dropping.

(Edit 4) 30/06/2020 Representatives from nations all over the world gathered at a congress called "Damlama's Noose" in response to this attack by our government, and after a few tense hours, it was announced that all states had formed a coalition. Following this, they declared war on our government. Officially, the Damlama Government is now at war with the entire world.

(Edit 4) 02/01/2021

These might be the last things I write here. I'm supposed to use a scientific tone, but f*ck Damlama and the scientific tone too. We are now in the 5th month of the war, and the government fell in the 3rd month. Soldiers are roaming all over the country, slaughtering anyone they want—elderly, women, children—without mercy. This has gone beyond war; it has turned into a vendetta. We thought they would stop after our government was overthrown, but instead, they grew more savage. I have witnessed the most horrifying aspects of humanity. They cut off the hands of my neighbor across the street and threw him out the window. Their only reason was that he spilled the coffee he made during a routine house raid onto a soldier because his hands were shaking. To find food for my 2-year-old son, I beat up a greengrocer the other day and stole a few tomatoes. I took a good beating myself, but at least my family and I are trying to survive somehow.

Where should the sofa go? Near the window or against the wall? is there enough room to breathe?

Room to Breathe is a cozy, thoughtful logic puzzle game where you design rooms not just to look good, but to feel right. Each client comes to you with a place and a set of personal needs, and preferences. Your task is to place furniture in a way that satisfies functional requirements and should feel right to you ( some times ).

Take your time, experiment freely, and trust your design instincts.

Room to Breathe is a calm, pressure-free experience—no timers, no penalties, just the satisfaction of turning empty rooms into spaces that truly belong to someone.

  • Design and place furniture to meet client-specific requirements

  • Balance accessibility, spacing, orientation, and room purpose

  • Solve relaxing spatial puzzles with multiple valid solutions

  • Progress through diverse rooms and clients, each with unique needs

  • A cozy, minimalist atmosphere focused on creativity and comfort

Create spaces that don’t just work—but breathe.

store_data.about_the_game:
The world didn’t end in a single flash—it unraveled. Decades of corruption, resource hoarding, and political ego escalated into a brief but devastating nuclear war. Cities burned, governments vanished overnight, and the survivors inherited a planet of ash, rust, and silence. 

Radiation, famine, and endless conflict reshaped humanity. Entire regions became uninhabitable. Communities fractured into nomadic clans, raider gangs, and isolated settlements clinging to the remains of the old world. Fuel, clean water, and ammunition became currencies - but none of them were truly rare anymore. Anything could be taken by force. 

Raider camps, warbands, and brutal enclaves dominate the desert routes. They kill, enslave, and burn anything that slows them down. Crossing the wasteland means pushing through them or dying where you stand. 

You are not a hero, nor a conqueror. You are a wanderer - shaped by hunger, loss, and exhaustion. You kill because the wasteland enforces a single law: take, or be taken. 

Every raider camp wiped out is not justice - it’s momentum. 

MADDMADD is a third-person shooter taking notes from the likes of Mad Max, Quake, Doom, and Body Harvest, and is set to drench you in the browns and bloods of a bygone era. 

Features:

  • Tanks!

  • Third-Person Action!

  • Beefy Guns!

  • Tough as Nails Combat!

  • Crusty Visuals

  • An Original Soundtrack by MEAT SKULL!

  • Exploration!

  • Resource Management!

store_data.about_the_game:
Virtual Driving School: Trucks brings professional heavy vehicle training into a high-fidelity driving simulator designed for learning, not shortcuts.

Built on the proven Virtual Driving School platform, this edition focuses on HGV and bus driving, where mistakes are costly and awareness matters. Practice complex manoeuvres, understand your load and vehicle height, manage restricted spaces, and make safe decisions under pressure — all before you ever turn a real key.

From urban deliveries to industrial sites, rural routes to depots, VDS: Trucks lets you rehearse real-world scenarios repeatedly, safely, and at your own pace.

This is not arcade trucking. It’s skills-first, rules-first, and realism-first.

What You’ll Learn

Heavy Vehicle Fundamentals

• Wide turns, off-tracking, swing-out and tail swing
• Braking distances, weight transfer, and stopping performance
• Cab visibility, mirror use, blind spots, and vulnerable road users
• Urban, rural, and motorway HGV driving

Know Your Load

• Vehicle height awareness; rigid vs articulated vehicles
• Load changes and daily trailer variation
• Route planning with height, weight, and access restrictions
• Consequences of poor planning… without real-world damage

Bridge Strikes & Infrastructure Risk

• Approaching low bridges with realistic signage and distractions
• Decision-making under pressure
• GOAL (Get Out And Look) training
• What to do if a strike occurs — safely and correctly

Level Crossings & High-Risk Zones

• Rail level crossings with varied signalling and sightlines
• Industrial estates, yards, depots, and restricted manoeuvring zones
• Tight loading bays, awkward approaches, and poor visibility

Specialist Vehicle Operation

• Vehicle-mounted crane mode
• Pick-up, placement, and precision load handling
• Managing stability, space, and surroundings while operating equipment

Why You’ll Learn Faster (and Safer)

• Bite-size drills (1–5 mins): Reverse into bays, judge height, negotiate tight turns, crane placement, crossing checks.
• Scenario-based drives (20–40 mins): Realistic routes with layered hazards and scoring.
• Unlimited retries: Practice mistakes without cost, damage, or risk.
• Playback & feedback: Review decisions, hazards, and outcomes.

Real Rules, Real Roads

• UK-focused road rules, signage, and infrastructure
• Accurate bridges, crossings, depots, and industrial layouts
• Realistic AI traffic, pedestrians, cyclists, and site workers
• Temporary roadworks, diversions, and poor signage scenarios

Vehicles & Handling

• Rigid trucks, articulated HGVs, buses, and specialist vehicles
• Authentic weight, braking, and steering response
• Distinct cab layouts, mirrors, and sightlines
• Designed to teach anticipation, not reflex gaming

Game Modes

• Training Modules: Structured lessons focused on HGV-specific risks
• Scenario Drives: End-to-end routes with scoring and feedback
• Specialist Tasks: Crane operation, depot work, complex deliveries
• Free Drive: Explore environments and practice without pressure

Hardware & Control Support

• Steering wheels supported (Logitech, Fanatec, Moza, and more)
• Multi-monitor and VR-ready
• Keyboard, controller, and accessibility options supported

Built for Learning, Not Luck

Virtual Driving School: Trucks is used as the foundation for professional driver training and safety research. It’s designed to build judgement, awareness, and confidence: the things that prevent accidents before they happen.

Disclaimer:
Virtual Driving School: Trucks is a training-focused simulation and a supplement to real-world instruction. It does not replace certified professional driver training or licensing. Always follow local laws, regulations, and employer procedures.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a playable demo of the game. Progress does not carry over to the full version.

When Lucas Vale loses all contact with his younger sister Clara after her vacation, he knows something is wrong.

Weeks pass without a single message.

Driven by fear and guilt, Lucas travels to the remote region where Clara and her friends—Tom Harris and Samantha Reed—were last seen. What begins as a search quickly turns into a descent into darkness.

The game opens in front of an isolated house.
Inside, a bed. A table.
A few bullets.
And a note left by Clara.

She has been hiding here for three days.
Searching nonstop.
Terrified.

A LAND RULED BY FEAR

As Lucas investigates the area, he encounters savage wolves roaming the night—and armed patrols who hunt anything that moves. These mysterious men abduct survivors and drag them into underground laboratories hidden beneath the land.

Who are they?
What are they experimenting on?
And why does no one ever return?

By following scattered clues, documents, and blood-stained environments, Lucas slowly uncovers the truth behind a shadowy organization known only as NØX Corporation.

NØX CORPORATION

Official records describe it as:

NØX Corporation
Neuro–Organism eXperiment Division

Experiments combining human consciousness with altered biology.
Irreversible. Inhumane. Classified.

But hidden messages reveal its true meaning:

NØX = No One eXits

Once you enter, you never leave.

The name itself comes from the Latin word “Nox” — Night.
Because the experiments happen in the dark.
The patrols move at night.
And the truth is buried in shadows.

store_data.about_the_game:
Coins pour from a pipe and pile up on your plateau. Robotic arms swing through the heap, sweeping them off the edge and into your collection. That's the loop. Now make it bigger.

Unlock up to 6 islands, each with its own arm. Upgrade speed, magnetism, critical hits, and sweep range. Push your flow rate higher. Watch bronze coins give way to silver, gold, platinum, diamond, emerald, and ruby, each worth more than the last.

Four realms stand between you and the top. Each one has its own islands, its own upgrades, and its own prestige track. Ascend when you are ready. Shift dimensions when you have conquered enough. The numbers only go up.

The whole thing runs as a small transparent widget on your desktop. It sits on top of everything, stays out of the way, and keeps earning while you do whatever else you want to do.

store_data.about_the_game:
Claiming the Noble Elf Mother is a linear, story-driven adult visual novel set in a rigid elven society where status defines everything.

You play as Noah, a low-born servant trapped at the very bottom of the social hierarchy. Serving noble elves means enduring constant humiliation, cruelty, and quiet contempt from those who see him as disposable labor.

Years of suppressed anger, resentment, and forbidden desire begin to surface.

What starts as silent obedience slowly evolves into something far more dangerous — a journey shaped by temptation, shifting power dynamics, and morally complex relationships. As Noah navigates the noble household, boundaries blur and tensions rise, especially when he becomes entangled with a noble elf mother whose presence challenges everything he once believed was untouchable.

This is a linear adult visual novel experience, focused on immersive storytelling, character development, and emotional tension. The story unfolds through fully illustrated scenes, expressive character portraits, and dialogue-driven progression.

🔥 What You Can Expect

A linear narrative structure (no branching paths)

Story-focused progression with character-driven development

Adult themes and mature content (18+)

Original background music and atmosphere-enhancing sound design

Animated scene and scene transitions

Approx. 1-+ hours of gameplay

Is this a story of revenge?

A twisted romance?

Or the awakening of desires that were never meant to exist?

store_data.about_the_game:
In this cozy life-simulation RPG, you play as a young artist who moves to a new city to pursue your dreams. Plan your schedule, balance life and career, explore the city, and meet new friends!

Live Your Dream Solo Life

Experience wholesome, wistful, and quirky moments as you live on your own. Spend a cozy year at your own pace. (You still gotta pay rent though!)

Manage Your Own Schedule

Juggle part-time jobs, yoga classes, cafe visits, dates, camping trips, or simply spend the day doing nothing. What do you do when you are not drawing? Will you give it your all or take it easy? Life is in your hands.

Meet Friends and Find Love

Get to know a curious cast of characters by sharing memories, discovering secrets and listening to their stories. Make friends, go on dates, and perhaps even fall in love.

Explore a living world

Journey out into the city to collect inspiration. Surprise encounters await you. Check out the newly opened bakery, sunbath on the beach, or go to an art show. Don’t forget to buy groceries and restock on stationaries on the way home.

Experience Rich Stories and Branching Dialogues

Sleep in on the weekend? Stand your ground in that argument? Follow the trend, or follow your heart? Make choices, big and small, and see where life takes you.

Unlock Multiple Endings

After a year, the game ends but life continues. How did the year go? What were you doing when you were not drawing? Unlock multiple career and relationship endings across multiple playthroughs. You Don’t Only Live Once.

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

When I’m Not Drawing is made by Hidden Moon, a solo indie developer based in California. The idea for the game first took its roots in 2019 and the actual development began in 2024. 5 years of day dreaming followed by 3 years of coding, drawing, writing and late night snacks later, the game will finally be born.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a haunted forest and rescue the neighbor's cat! 

Maple Blade is a short grid-based exploration game where you chop through the woods, fight off restless spirits, solve little puzzles, and help the townsfolk. Your sword can cut through nearly anything, including the tombstones of the dead... so be careful, or you'll end up getting  𝖈 𝖚 𝖗 𝖘 𝖊 𝖉 . . .

  • Cut your own path through the trees

  • Time only advances when you move, so even if combat gets hectic, you have plenty of time to chill and plan your next move

  • The autumn ambience and hand-drawn pixel art are cozy and relaxing :) 

  • Featuring a meditative original soundtrack by Tim Myers (@timbyt_music)!

  • The forest layout changes nightly, so every playthrough is different

  • You can explore freely, chopping paths through the trees, hopping across lily pads, stopping (or starting) forest fires, chunking pumpkins, and hunting for treasure

  • Between levels, you can hang out at the cozy Visitor Center, chatting with wise locals and clueless tourists. There's gift shops where you can buy useful items, magical charms, keychains, palette filters, and hats for the cat! The hats don't do anything, they're just cute :)

  • There's a short, spooky story-- solve the haunted mysteries of the Sage Grounds, purify the spirits of the dead, and keep the tourists happy. It's all in a day's work for Maple Montressor!

  • This game was made as a passion project, without the use of generative AI. There's no ads, in-app purchases, loot boxes, or bloat

  • It's a pure little mix of chunky pixel art and modern game design-- a roguelite where you can cut your own paths through the "dungeon walls", complete missions in any order, use items to customize your risk-vs-reward, and relax in a serene autumn world, even in the midst of combat. I hope you dig it :)

Now where did that cat run off to...?

store_data.about_the_game:
The galaxy is vast. Your cargo hold is empty. Your fuel is running low. And somewhere out there, a trade route is about to make you very, very rich... if the pirates don’t find you first. 

Warp to Sector One wears its influences on its sleeve. The CRT curvature, wireframe graphics, beautiful ALL CAPS TEXT and command-line interface, the text-driven gameplay all channels the spirit of computer screens in 80's sci-fi movies. 

EXPLORE. TRADE. FIGHT. CONQUER.

Every session begins the same way: you, a Merchant Scout, and a galaxy full of opportunity. What happens next is up to you.

A Living Galaxy

▸ Procedural Generation - 2,000 interconnected sectors filled to the brim with pirates, anomalies, hazards, one-way warps, rogue fighters, exploitable planets, trade hubs, starbases, pirate nests, and hidden discoveries.  No two galaxies are the same.

▸ Dynamic Economy - Five regional trade zones, supply and demand pricing, trade fatigue, distance bonuses, and risk premiums. Exploit market inefficiencies or ride the waves of random market events like Mining Collapses and Tech Embargoes.

▸ Epoch Events - Every 2,000 turns, the galaxy transforms. Pirate Uprisings flood space with hostiles. Trade Booms supercharge profits. Faction Wars turn every border into a battleground. Six unique epochs plus a permanent Final Epoch keep long sessions dynamic.

▸ Anomaly Adventures - Sector Anomalies that you have to scan down that yield unique loot/bonuses but only if succeed in completing the gauntlet of trials that guard each treasure.

▸ 10 Alien Factions - Territorial civilizations with patrol ships, capitals, and diplomatic standing. Hail neutral ships for intel, bribe hostile captains, build alliances, or wage war.

Five Career Paths, Five Ways to Win

Choose your career at game start. Each path grants unique gameplay bonuses and unlocks dedicated endgame content unique to each career with tiered victory conditions:

▸ Trader - Corner the market and become a wealthy space mogul.

▸ Warrior- Destroy 500 pirates and face The Pirate Alliance.

▸ Explorer - Chart 95% of the galaxy and find all lore discoveries.

▸ Diplomat - Achieve allied status with all major factions through negotiation and reputation building.

▸ Settler - Establish 25 colonies across the frontier.

Deep Tactical Combat

▸ Two Combat Systems - A deep timed Advanced Combat mode with multiple phases, multiple tactical stance choices, a momentum meter, and life or death mid-battle event choices for smaller skirmishes and a full blown fleet on fleet Combat Mode.  

▸ Scaled Threats - Pirate Hideouts near the core, Raider Bases in the midrange, and Corsair Strongholds in deep space. Rogue fighter swarms, faction patrol ships, and endgame boss encounters test your tactics at every stage.

▸ Fleet Combat - Your hired captains fight alongside you. Guild rank determines how many ships can coordinate in battle.

Build Your Empire

▸ 11 Ship Classes - From the nimble Fast Courier to the devastating Dreadnought. Each ship balances cargo capacity, hull strength, combat power, fuel range, special abilities and fighter bay size differently.

▸ Fleet Management - Hire AI captains at Guild Halls and assign them missions: Guard sectors, Patrol routes, Trade autonomously, or Follow your lead. Manage salaries, monitor performance, and grow your fleet to 25 ships at Admiral rank.

▸ Colony Network - Colonize planets to establish Mining, Agricultural, Manufacturing, or Fortress colonies. Generate passive resources and deploy fighter squadrons for territorial defense.

▸ Guild Rank Progression - Rise from Recruit to Admiral by meeting requirements across six categories: wealth, combat, exploration, colonization, fleet building, and lifetime earnings.

Join me on discord for latest news, sneak peeks, and to submit your feedback!

store_data.about_the_game:
Shoot. Dash. Collect. Upgrade. VCTR is a kinetic arcade shooter where two simple actions create countless strategies. Survive the wave of enemies by perfecting your timing and positioning. When to shoot or dash is as important as where you shoot and dash and what you shoot and dash into. One wrong decision and the wave is lost. Get in flow and turn the chaos into a series of high-risk, high-reward opportunities to net points.

Upgrades

Spend experience orbs collected during waves on upgrades to help shape your strategy and survive longer. You have limited slots to equip abilities, but plenty of meaningful upgrades to completely change how you can approach the waves.

Controls

Left Mouse Button: Shoot

Destroys enemies and collects orbs. Recharges after 1.5s

Right Mouse Button: HOLD to prepare Dash, RELEASE to execute Dash

Destroy enemies or collect orbs by dashing into them. Recharges after 1.5s

Wishlist

Wishlist now to follow development and upcoming updates.

Shoot enemies and the orbs they drop

You can aim your cursor anywhere to shoot enemies and collect orbs. However, it takes 1.5s to recharge between each shot, so you must time when to shoot and decide what to shoot to maximize each shot.

Dash into enemies

You can dash into any direction, destroying enemies and collecting any orbs along your path. Dashing recharges after 1.5s and is your only method of movement. Choose when and where to dash carefully, as it could be a make or break moment.

Collect orbs by dashing or shooting

Enemies drop experience orbs after your shoot or dash into them. You only score points for collecting orbs, so no matter how many enemies you destroy, it means nothing if you don't collect the orbs. Don't wait too long, because enemies will reclaim the orbs themselves on contact. 

Upgrade to improve shooting, dashing, and unlock new abilities and skills

Spend the orbs you collect on meaningful upgrades. From increasing the radius of your shot or dash impact, to completely new skills and abilities that change the dynamics of the game

store_data.about_the_game:
The Apparatus

  • A historical narrative adventure set in the Austro-Hungarian Empire at the beginning of the twentieth century.

  • Play as two protagonists, the Irish writer James Joyce and his partner Nora Barnacle, as they try (and fail) to avoid deep political intrigue.

  • A faithful reconstruction of Pola (modern day Pula) in 1904, a major Mediterranean military port, with real locations and people woven into the fiction.

  • Classic 90s point & click gameplay with light roleplaying elements and story branching.

The Trouble

Pola, the empire’s great war port, is loud with trams, cafés, uniforms, and the confidence of power that does not yet know what is coming.

A young James Joyce arrives with Nora Barnacle expecting work and a few ordinary days, but the city does not waste a couple of perfectly useful outsiders.

Thinking their greatest worry is a lack of heating in the coldest winter of the century, our unlikely heroes are quickly pulled into a major conspiracy for which they are entirely unprepared.

The Business of It

Silence, Exile, and Cunning is a narrative exploration of real geography and fictionalized history. You progress through scenes, interact with unusual characters, and solve puzzles through James’s wit and Nora’s practical sense.

Parts of the game reward different approaches. A conversation that is polite for James becomes procedural for Nora. A favor granted in a café becomes leverage in an office. A child insults you, only to be rewarded with a drink.

So it goes.

And as the story marches forward, tensions will rise, but always tempered by a gentlemanly kind of humour.

store_data.about_the_game:
[The Game We Create Together]

Your precious opinions not only lead to simple fixes but also create the direction of the game. If there is a direction or function you want, please feel free to deliver it via email. After review, if there are no issues, your idea will change the game for you, me, and us. Do not just purchase a simple game, but purchase the right to create your own game.

[Strategic Dessert Collection]

The map is filled with various desserts, each holding its own unique value. But be warned: the rarer and more valuable the dessert, the more dangerous its location may be, and the more difficult it will be to transport.

[Physics-Based Interactions]

In desperate moments while being chased by monsters, use the physics engine to your advantage. Neutralize monsters temporarily with specific impacts or use environmental objects to buy yourself some time. However, stay alert—a monster’s powerful area-of-effect attack can strip you of all your hard-earned collectibles in a single mistake.

[Cooperative Multiplayer]

Collecting every dessert alone is nearly impossible. Experience the thrill of cooperative play by dividing roles with your friends: have one person draw the monster's attention while the other safely transports the desserts.

This game is a claw machine simulation that begins with a visit to an arcade with your girlfriend, offering a unique experience that blends strategy and gambling elements. Rather than simply grabbing dolls, the core gameplay revolves around using various items and buffs to develop your own winning approach.

Players must manage limited resources while challenging the claw machine, selling the dolls they collect to earn currency. By acquiring items and buff effects through different methods, you can sell dolls at higher prices and satisfy your girlfriend along the way. Multiple endings are available depending on her affection level, and your choice of buffs and builds will greatly influence your playstyle and profit structure.

With its light and casual atmosphere, the game delivers the fun of strategic decision-making, featuring events with your girlfriend and hidden elements that encourage enjoyable replayability.

Plot tight approaches, burn at the right moment, use your tether to pick up orbiting salvage, and bring it safely back to the salvage depot. Master precision spaceflight, scarce fuel, and thread dangerous orbits in a game that rewards planning and execution as much as reflexes.

  • Fuel and hull management

  • Hand-crafted campaign with introductory tutorials

  • Daily procedural challenges and leaderboards

  • Rebindable controls and gamepad support

store_data.about_the_game:
CastleOn Scriptum is a tower defense game in which you protect your Keep either with static defences such as traps, gatehouses and towers manned by archers, crossbowmen and catapults, or by taking a more active approach and training different types of melee units like footmen and knights and slaughtering enemy up-close.

Defend your Keep

Stop the enemies from reaching your keep! Build towers and train over 20 different types of ranged units. Rain fire and arrows upon them!

Command your Armies

Train over 20 different types of footmen and knights, or hire various mercenaries to battle the invaders!

Place Traps

Killing pits, caltrops, boiling oil, rolling logs, moats and many more fun traps are at your disposal!

Manage the Economy

Make the peasants harvest gold and lumber! Construct farms, blacksmiths, lumber mills and more!

Customize

Upgrade your kingdom the way you want to, fine-tuning your playstyle! Most buildings have different upgrade paths, and your choices matter.

Factions

Do you prefer Norman longbow superiority, heavily armored Saxon Knights, or the Byzantine impenetrable walls? Every faction has unique units, buildings and playstyle.

Expand

Defeat bandits and brigands, claim their treasures and lands for your own!

Endless Mode

Every mission lasts between 10 and 20 minutes, but you can attempt Endless Mode on any missions, with increasingly difficult waves of enemies until you inevitably fall.

Features

- Play as Normans, Saxons, Franks, Slavs, Greeks and more, each with their own unique playstyle, units and buildings

- Over 50 different missions, each playable with any faction

- Multiple difficulty levels

- Highly replayable

- Over 50 hours of gameplay

store_data.about_the_game:
Meet Ember, Your Pet and New Best Friend

Take care of a furry friend in Stay: Your Forever Pet! In this cozy simulation game, explore a whimsical world, collecting resources and earning goods to decorate your pet and your home. Your Ember will bring magic and mischief into your space and take you on an adventure in a fantastical land. Believable behaviors and animation make Ember the world’s most spontaneous and vividly alive virtual pet ever made.

Low-Stress Gameplay

Play at your pace. You and your Ember work as a team to hunt for resources, banish thorny weeds, and explore the mysterious Otherlands.

Craft Your Look

Use the resources you forage every day to trade for treats, toys, pet clothes, decorations, and more. There are 100+ toys and clothes to choose from, so find an outfit that suits your Ember’s unique look and personality. From cozy pet beds to fancy wall art pieces, you can also trade for 100+ decorations to build a space you can both call home.

Features

Care for and bond with a unique virtual pet

  • Lifelike behaviors and animation respond to the world as it's happening

  • Explore a whimsical Otherlands together

  • Interact with Mosslings, delightful critters sometimes mischievous, other times helpful

  • Forage for resources while walking with your pet

  • Trade resources to receive decorations, accessories, treats, toys, and more

  • Dress up your companion to express your unique style

  • Customize your shared virtual home and yard 

These are the current features in Stay: Your Forever Pet! as early access. Additional content and new gameplay features will be added as the game further develops.

About the Team

Stay: Your Forever Pet! is developed by a team who helped bring you games like Peridot, Plants Vs. Zombies 2, Beasts of Maravilla Island, Wheel World, and Skulls of the Shogun.

store_data.about_the_game:
Maldhalla is a fast-paced survival roguelite where you fend off relentless waves of enemies, collect powerful weapons, and push your limits to survive just one more minute.

Pick from 21 unique characters — each with their own starting weapon, passive ability, and active skill — then dive into an ever-escalating battlefield. Weapons fire automatically, so your job is to move smart, choose upgrades wisely, and stay alive.

Survive the Onslaught

Enemies grow stronger every minute. Elite bosses arrive every 3 minutes — from charging Stone Giants to laser-firing Red Dragons — each demanding a different strategy. How long can you last?

32 Weapons, Endless Combos

Unlock new weapons through achievements and combine them during runs. Pair the right weapons together to activate Relics — powerful synergy bonuses that can turn the tide of battle.

Build Your Power Every Run

  • Gems — Collect 22 types of stat-boosting gems to shape your build: damage, crit, evasion, life steal, and more.

  • Altar Blessings — Choose from Common to Legendary power-ups on each level-up.

  • Active Skills — Every character has a unique cooldown ability. Dash through danger as the Ranger, go invincible as the Paladin, or buff all weapons as the Bard.

Unlock Everything Through Play

No pay-to-win. Every character, weapon, and relic is earned through achievements and progression. Each run teaches you something new, and every unlock opens up fresh strategies.

Key Features

  • 21 Playable Characters with distinct weapons, passives, and skills

  • 32 Weapons across melee, ranged, AOE, and elemental types

  • Boss Fights that escalate in pattern and intensity

  • Relic Synergies that reward creative weapon combinations

  • Deep Gem System for fine-tuned stat customization

  • Achievement-Driven Progression — unlock new content by mastering challenges

  • 9-Tier Competitive Ranking — climb from Rookie to Immortal with seasonal leaderboards

  • Accessible Yet Strategic — easy to pick up, hard to put down

store_data.about_the_game:
Slay The Hero reverses the bullet hell formula and gives the player the power to spawn a variety of units to swarm the hero and destroy them. The game encompasses three game modes with a variety of maps to play on allowing the player to experiment with all the different types of units. 

Survival mode 

In this mode you must kill all heroes within the time limit of 15 minutes. 

Waves 

In waves you will have 30 waves lasting 30 seconds each. The hero or heroes depending on the difficulty will level up at the end of each wave. Kill them all before wave 30! 

Endless

Play forever. Every time you kill a hero they will respawn with an additional hero.

Player can set the difficulty for each game mode. Difficulty is based on hero count.

For extra fun or challenge the player can choose to level up the hero at any time no matter the game mode they are playing in.

store_data.about_the_game:
Games are too stressful ... so I made one that literally plays itself

You stand on a small island, surrounded by water. Click the water to collect fish, then spend them to place penguins, bears, and fashionable penguins who help you gather even more fish. Unlock new islands over time and watch your peaceful little world grow at a gentle pace.

Autoplay mode: Play actively or enable autoplay, a fully idle mode where the game optimizes progress and plays on its own (till 100%). Perfect for relaxing, multitasking, or simply watching your world grow.

Multitasking: The game is designed to be unobtrusive. On PC, you can play in overlay mode, which allows the game to sit comfortably in a corner of your screen wherever you want it, on top of other windows, while you work or relax.

Xbox controller support: The entire game can be played using a mouse or an Xbox controller.

Trophy hunters: The game is perfect for fans of idle games and trophy hunters, and takes about 15 hours for 100% achievements.

Feature:

-          Chill idle / incremental gameplay with very simple mechanics

-          Collect fish through clicking, recruit helpers and expand your territory

-          Auto play mode for optimized full idle (Netfish and chill)

-          Overlay mode for multitasking

-          Trophies system (and Steam achievements)

-          Mouse and Xbox controller support

-          Around 15 hours to reach 100% completion

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive at Any Cost

Antarctic Grave is an atmospheric first-person survival horror where survival depends not on firepower, but on how well you use your surroundings.

Explore an isolated Antarctic research station, manage electricity, avoid deadly creatures, and uncover the mystery of a catastrophe buried beneath the ice.

Key Features

  • Story-driven single-player campaign (~2–2.5 hours)

  • Resource management to control electricity

  • Grotesque mutants and a constant stalking threat

  • Tactical survival instead of nonstop action

  • Four different endings

  • Atmospheric original soundtrack

Electricity as a Survival Tool

The station’s operation depends on a generator. Maintain fuel supplies to power lights, unlock new areas, and alter enemy behavior.

Fuel is more than just a power source — it can destroy obstacles, create traps, or be used for powerful weapons.

A Constant Threat

The station has been overrun by grotesque mutants — the result of an alien infection using ancient fossils as biological material. Each enemy requires its own survival strategy.

Environmental Storytelling

The story unfolds through exploration:

  • Notes and audio logs reveal the station’s past

  • Dialogues with survivors influence access to resources

  • Player decisions shape how the story is perceived

  • Your choices determine the ending

The game does not hold your hand — you must piece together the truth yourself.

store_data.about_the_game:
Do You Have What It Takes To Become Forklift Certified?

Fork It! is a brutal, physics based journey where you are put behind the wheel of a forklift. Navigate with precision through hazardous industrial environments where around every corner is an obstacle ready to catch you out. begin your journey in the warehouse and prove you deserve to be forklift certified by retrieving the flag at the summit of the mountain. However things wont be so simple, as you'll come to find out!

Features

Multiple Endings

Multiple ways for your certification to come to its conclusion whether that's passing, failing or discovering paths onwards.

Semi-Realistic Forklift Physics

From rear wheel steering to the full functionality of the forks you can test your skills on a lifelike forklift to see if you have what it takes to complete the Certification.

3 strikes and you're out! 

Any damage to your company issued forklift will result in an immediate strike being issued! After the 3rd strike is issued your certification is over and you will meet an explosive end.

Forklift Customisation

Customise your forklift with 6 base colours and discover many more Hidden cosmetics unlocked throughout your adventure.

A Diverse World to explore, and many secrets to find.

Experience a wacky journey upward proving that you can handle the diverse zones that scale in absurdity from a grounded start in the warehouse to uncovering a hidden plot by aliens and continuing your investigation on into the heart of their mothership, with many secrets to be discovered through all parts of your journey.

Fork It! blends grounded machinery with escalating absurdity, delivering a rage fuelled experience that's equal parts stressful and satisfying. 

Survive The Course.

Get Certified.

Or Fail Trying.

DRILL RIDER is an incremental game about getting in a big drill and diving into the planet to collect resources. Use a giant laser gun to blast away at the ground and suck up ores and gems. Start your journey on the surface of a planet after crash landing in a space ship. Your goal is simple: dive into the planet, collect resources, and turn those resources in for profit!

As you explore the many biomes on the planet you will progress through the multiple upgrade trees. Everything is upgradable. The damage of your laser, the power of your suction, buffs to the drill, to the amount earned from your loot. Maybe even get some upgrades to your suit that lets you carry some grenades along with you.

Complete the objectives given to you by the supervisor to unlock more powerful nodes on the upgrade trees. Need more damage? Level up the weapon upgrade tree. Ore not selling fast enough? Check out the economy upgrade tree. Want some more utility out of your drill? There's an upgrade tree for that!

store_data.about_the_game:
Concrete Polishing Simulator

Concrete Polishing Simulator is a hands-on, first-person simulation game where you step into the boots of a professional concrete finisher and build your way from small residential jobs to large-scale commercial contracts. Master the craft, grow your business, and turn raw, unfinished slabs into flawless, reflective surfaces.

This isn’t just about pushing a machine forward — it’s about understanding the process, choosing the right tools, and earning your reputation one floor at a time.

🔧 The Craft, Not Just the Grind

Every job is a process.
From initial surface prep to final polish and seal, you’ll work through real-world inspired steps that reward patience, precision, and planning.

  • Remove coatings, paint, and surface defects

  • Progress through multiple grinding and polishing stages

  • Apply densifiers, sealers, and finishes

  • Watch your floor transform visually as you work

Each pass matters. Cut corners, and it’ll show.

🏗️ Build Your Business

Start small and grow into bigger, better-paying contracts.

  • Take on residential, industrial, and commercial jobs

  • Upgrade and maintain your equipment

  • Manage your loadout before each job

  • Unlock new tools, machines, and capabilities as your reputation grows

Your name on the line means every job counts.

🛠️ Real Tools, Real Feel

Use a range of professional equipment inspired by real concrete polishing gear:

  • Hand grinders for detail work

  • Walk-behind and ride-on floor machines

  • Vacuums, tools, and accessories that change how the job feels and flows

Different tools mean different strategies. There’s more than one way to get a perfect finish.

🌆 Immersive Job Sites

Work across varied locations and environments, each with unique challenges:

  • Homes, warehouses, retail spaces, and industrial floors

  • Different lighting, floor conditions, and layouts

  • Dynamic surfaces that visually respond to your work

Every site tells a different story — and every floor becomes your signature.

🎮 Designed for Builders, Tinkerers, and Sim Fans

Whether you’re here for the satisfaction of watching a rough slab turn into a mirror finish or for the deeper systems behind the scenes, Concrete Polishing Simulator is built to reward curiosity and mastery.

⚙️ Features

  • First-person, hands-on concrete polishing simulation

  • Multi-stage floor processing system

  • Tool and equipment progression

  • Job-based contract and reputation system

  • Visually reactive floor surfaces

  • Sandbox-style gameplay with structured objectives

🏁 From Slab to Shine

This is a game about taking something unfinished and making it professional.Every floor starts rough. What it becomes is up to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
USE PORTALS

Use your portals to teleport. You can put a portal on any white surface, with a twist: you only get one portal. Instead of walking through portals to teleport, this one works a bit differently...

SLAM INTO WALLS

Teleportation is activated by changing your momentum. What does that mean? If you want to teleport, you need to slam into something. Jump off a ledge, fly into the roof, or run into a wall full speed to activate portals. Hit something hard enough and you'll be teleported through your portal.

MAINTAIN YOUR MOMENTUM

You keep your momentum when you teleport. However fast you're moving before you teleport is how fast you fly out of the portal, but what about the next one? Shoot a new portal mid-air to keep your momentum even longer. Chain portals together like this to finish the level.

PUZZLE FEATURES

Each puzzle will have different components. Buttons that open doors, blocks to hold down buttons, flying platforms, pools filled with toxic bacteria, and more! Each puzzle will require a combination of features to complete. Figure out how they all fit together and finish the puzzles as quickly as possible.

store_data.about_the_game:
"What you raise isn't an child—it is danger itself."

Are you mentally prepared?

【ALVAR】 Introduction

  • Free (Unless you want to see more special extra content. But that won't affect your experience.)

  • Simple Raising Gameplay (Very simple. You’ll get the hang of it soon. I guarantee it on the honor of ████.)

  • A Touching Story (Naturally. That is something every story must have, right? Uh, I forgot—this isn't a story.)

  • Various Beautiful CGs (Pretty faces everywhere. Total one, two, three, four, five... Hm? You ask why one is missing? Weren't we only counting the "pretty" ones?)

  • Over 15 Endings, and... oh, it looks like you're starting to remember something.

  • What else? Indeed... what else was there?

【Background】

You have arrived in 【NedTown】. This is your home. Yes, you just moved in, with your child together.

You say the environment looks a bit... strange? That is just your imagination. It is a new interior design style... probably. You have to trust me.

Anyway, there are many different things you can do here. There are mainly four actions, corresponding to four traits your child can develop.

You can try different approaches to help the child grow better, and to build better relationships with his friends.

You ask who the friends are? Let me introduce to you.

【Character Introduction】

【???】 Your Child

No one knows where he came from. He lives with you, and he is the one you must raise.

Why do you need to raise him? You can’t really explain it — but you know you must protect him.

His name? You’ll find out later. I promise.

【Reid】 The Oldest Friend

The little leader of the trio. Friendly and great at lifting the mood.
He constantly tries to get “your child” to join their group.

Sometimes he likes to tease others and can be a bit mischievous, but everyone likes him.

【Kai】 The Somewhat Strange Friend

You have arrived in 【NedTown】. This is your home. Yes, you just moved in, with your child together.

You say the environment looks a bit... strange? That is just your imagination. It is a new interior design style... probably. You have to trust me.

Anyway, there are many different things you can do here. There are mainly four actions, corresponding to four traits your child can develop.

You can try different approaches to help the child grow better, and to build better relationships with his friends.

You ask who the friends are? Let me introduce to you.

【???】 Your Child

His name? You’ll find out later. I promise.

store_data.about_the_game:
Each question has four possible answers, one of which is correct. The answers are randomly shuffled each time, so you'll have to rely solely on your knowledge, not your keystroke memory.

Counters track your progress in real time. After each answer—correct or not—you immediately move on to the next question. At the end, you'll receive a personal title reflecting your level of meme knowledge: from beginner to meme guru.

The game is translated into six languages. There are buttons to mute the music and sound—customize everything and enjoy the game.

Remember how we connected to the internet via a modem, listening to that epic squeal, and then waiting for ICQ to log in and show statuses with flowers? Or how an incoming "oooh" message would ring out in the silence of the night, making your heart beat faster? If those ICQ sounds still thrill you inside, the second part is already waiting!

"Classic Memes 2" is a continuation of that same artistic journey to the golden era of the Russian internet in the 2000s and 2010s, only even deeper and more captivating. We've once again taken the iconic memes of that era—the very ones that have endured for years and still evoke a smile of recognition—and brought them to life in a claymation style. All the same volumetric, textured, warm magic. The main feature remains the same: all the images are pure plasticine, no pixels or compressed JPGs from the past. Characters and scenes from our childhood/youth are now three-dimensional, cozy, and incredibly lifelike.

WHAT AWAITS YOU IN THIS PART:

Unique visuals 2.0: even richer, more detailed plasticine graphics—every meme has become funnier and more heartfelt.

Pro-level nostalgia questions: from ancient viral videos on a slipper to phrases we yelled during recess, in the smoking room, and on ICQ at 3 AM.

Discover your true level: the ranking system will mercilessly reveal whether you're still a Noob who only discovered the internet yesterday, or already a Legend who personally witnessed the birth of Zhdun and Upyachka.

That same atmosphere: minimalist game interface design, sounds from the past, and not a drop of modern fluff.

Just tried-and-true classics: the kind of humor we truly grew up with.

This second installment is another ticket back to a time when the internet was slow but sincere, the grass was greener, and the best jokes lived forever. Let's go revel in nostalgia again?

store_data.about_the_game:
It’s been 10,000 years since the Cataclysm.

The ground is gone.
The oceans vanished.
And all that remains of the old world are floating islands, drifting above an endless sea of clouds.

And where there are islands…

there will always be pirates.

⚓ Become a Sky Raider Captain

Your ship is a handmade flying beast, built from scraps of a forgotten civilization.

It may look like junk…

but in the right hands, it becomes a legend.

Take full control of your airship:

  • rise and descend through the skies

  • push forward with the wind at your back

  • steer with a real helm

  • keep the furnace burning — because without fuel, you’re not a pirate…
    you’re just a falling rock.

    🧭 Follow the Compass to Adventure

    The sky is vast, and getting lost is easy.

    But a true captain knows the way:

    set coordinates, mark islands, and sail toward places filled with:

    • ancient ruins

    • hostile defenses

    • dangerous creatures

  • and… something far more interesting.

    ⚔️ The Skies Are Not Safe

    These islands won’t give up their treasures for free.

    • monsters will attack your ship mid-flight

    • island turrets will open fire as you approach

    • every raid could be your last

    But pirates never fly for safety.

    They fly for loot.

    🏝️ Your Own Pirate Haven

    Every captain needs a home port.

    Your personal island is your base — a hidden refuge in the clouds, where you return after successful raids.

    Repair, prepare…

    and enjoy the rewards.

    😏 The Most Valuable Trophies (18+)

    Treasure comes in many forms.

    Sometimes it’s ore.
    Sometimes it’s photo or video.

    And sometimes…

    you bring back special “guests” from other islands, unlocking mature events and adult encounters reserved for the boldest captains.

    Because in Cloudrift Islands, the skies are full of danger…

    and pleasure.

    ✅ Fully controlled airship flight (altitude, thrust, steering)

    ✅ Furnace fuel system — flight depends on fire

    ✅ Compass navigation with island coordinates

    ✅ Hostile creatures and island defense turrets

    ✅ Resource добыча and loot progression

    ✅ Two collectible adult loot types: 18+ Images & 18+ Videos

    ✅ Home island base and return hub

    ✅ Pirate raids, exploration, mature events (18+)

    ✅ Free roaming across a floating archipelago

store_data.about_the_game:
■ The Last Seven Days with Puppy

Spend seven peaceful days in the garden with a little puppy.

There’s no time limit. No game over.

Just relax and enjoy a slow, calming experience.

Even players who don’t usually play games—or very young children—can enjoy it thanks to the simple controls.

■ Take Photos of Puppy

Use your camera to capture Puppy’s daily actions.

The points you earn change depending on what Puppy is doing when you take the photo. Aim for high scores!

You can take up to 10 photos per day.

■ Use Cards to Guide Puppy’s Actions

You have 10 action cards, each making Puppy do something different:

Sunny Spot – Puppy relaxes in a warm sunny patch.

Eat Food – Puppy eats its meal.

Sniff Around – Puppy sniffs around the garden.

Favorite Ball – Puppy plays with a ball.

Butterfly – Puppy chases and plays with a butterfly.

Take a Nap – Puppy takes a cozy nap.

Flower – Puppy sniffs a flower.

Gentle Rain – Puppy frolics in the soft rain.

Slow Walk – Puppy takes a slow, relaxing walk.

New Visitor – A friend comes to visit Puppy.

You can use up to 3 cards per day.

However, if you already used all 10 camera shots, the last card action won’t activate.

So it’s better to use cards before taking all your photos.

■Special Shot

A special shot is triggered under certain conditions.

Can you find out how to activate it?

■When you finish your tasks, the day will end

After using three cards and taking ten photos, the day will automatically conclude.

You can also choose to end the day manually at any time.

■ Get a Hat at the End of Each Day

When the day ends, you’ll see the points you’ve earned and the hat you unlocked.

Try putting the hat on Puppy!

Taking photos of Puppy in a hat will earn even more points.

■ After the Seventh Day…

When the final day ends, an ending scene will play and your total score will be ranked.

See how high you can climb!

Pack My Order is a meditative online shopping simulator created for you to relax and enjoy the moment. There is no rush, no timers, and no stress. Just you, a shopping list, and the aesthetics of a perfectly filled cart.

Study customer wishes

Each level is a new task from a customer. In it, a list of specific products and special wishes awaits you: for example, buy milk and bread, but don't forget to add "something for tea for guests." Carefully study the preferences and budget to collect exactly what is needed.

Choose products in the catalog

Choose products in the catalog and switch between categories, just like in a real online supermarket: from fresh vegetables and pastries to sweet and savory treats. Pick what fits the customer's request and add it to the cart, adjusting the required quantity immediately.

Control the contents of the cart

Go to the cart where you can control everything: adjust the quantity of items, delete unnecessary ones, or return to the catalog if you want to add something else. Monitor the total receipt in real-time — it’s important not to exceed the budget allocated by the customer.

Bring the order to perfection

Press the check button to submit the order. The system will immediately tell you if you did everything correctly: if it lights up red, it means the budget has been exceeded or some item from the customer's list was overlooked. Simply fix the error at your own pace and bring the order to perfection!

Move on to new meditative levels

Fulfilled all the conditions? Congratulations, the level is passed! Feel that pleasant joy of a completed task and move on to a new interesting list.

Game Features:

  • Relax Mode: Want to just collect beautiful products without restrictions? Turn on relax mode with a huge budget and free orders. Assemble your ideal cart just for pleasure!

  • Cozy in the details: Cute animations, soft colors, and ASMR interface sounds will create an atmosphere of complete tranquility for you.

  • Pleasant mindfulness: Order lists will make you linger in the catalog a little longer to find that very "crunchy movie snack" or the perfect breakfast. It's not difficult, but very addictive!

  • Anti-stress gameplay: The perfect game to turn on your favorite podcast or music in the background and relax after a workday.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE CLASSIC, REINVENTED
TetraDice takes the beloved block puzzle formula and injects it with pure adrenaline. It’s not just about fitting shapes: it’s about managing an economy, exploiting physics, and activating devastating powers when the situation seems hopeless.

PERKS AND ABILITIES
Why just rotate pieces when you can destroy them? Unlock and equip dozens of active and passive Perks during gameplay:

Controlled Chaos: Summon black holes, launch homing missiles, or use the "Mirror Dimension" to flip the entire grid.

Save the Game: Use the "Panic Button" to turn an inconvenient piece to dust, or rewind time when you make a fatal mistake.

Economy: Destroy gold blocks, collect Bits, and buy your survival.

ENDLESS CHALLENGE
Difficulty constantly increases. You don’t just have to be fast; you have to be smart. Will you pick a Perk that gives instant points or one that saves your life in 10 minutes?

MAIN FEATURES:

🎮 Physics-Based Gameplay: Blocks aren’t static; explosions and gravity can change everything in an instant.

⚡ Over 50 Perks: Infinite combinations for every match.

🎲 Dice Factor: Roll dice for sudden bonuses or penalties.

🏆 Leaderboards: Compete for the highest score in a system that rewards risk.

🕹️ Full Controller Support: Play with Mouse & Keyboard or relax with your Gamepad.

store_data.about_the_game:
Turnveil is a turn-based roguelike where every fight is a tactical puzzle built on three pillars: clever skill combos, using the environment, and choosing your targets wisely. One wrong move, and the enemies will tear you apart — they're getting smarter right alongside you.

⚔️ Combat: 1 Turn = 1 Action

You can only take one action per turn (move, attack, or use a skill). As soon as you act, it's the enemy’s turn — and they play by the exact same rules.

🗺️ Exploration: Danger Lurks Around Every Corner

Dive into procedurally generated mazes filled with secrets. Puzzles and hidden paths aren’t just about treasure — they might spring a trap, reveal a secret room, or unleash a powerful foe. Every step is a choice: press your luck, or play it safe?

💥 Combos & Environment: Let Your Imagination Be Your Weapon

Forget saving your ultimate for the boss. Chain skills into devastating combos and take down enemies fast — and with style. And don’t overlook the environment: traps aren't always hiding. Sometimes they’re begging you to shove an enemy into them before they do the same to you.

📈 Enemy Progression: They’re Learning Too

Feeling powerful after leveling up? So are your enemies. Turnveil doesn’t hand you an advantage just because your HP bar got bigger. Enemies grow with you, gaining new abilities and tactics. Let your guard down, and you’re done.

🃏 Character Progression: Every Run is a New Story

Pick a hero to set your playstyle — then carve your own path. Each time you level up, you’ll choose from a selection of new active and passive skills. What kind of build will you create today?

store_data.about_the_game:
LAST BAD IDEA

You and your friends were watching TV when the news suddenly announces a nuclear war. The signal cuts out. The broadcast goes silent. A strange light fills the sky outside. No instructions. No explanations.
Your only chance to survive is to reach the nearest bunker. A cooperative survival game where you survive together, make mistakes together, and suffer together.

CRAFTING AS A WAY TO SURVIVE

Crafting helps you endure the cold, dangers, and your team’s bad decisions - and most importantly, keep moving toward the bunker.
When a blizzard approaches or supplies run low, players have only minutes to decide: prepare, help each other, or take a risk and lose precious time.

LOCATIONS AND TRANSPORT

Each location is a separate challenge with its own risks and dead ends. Players can find abandoned cars, search for garages and fuel to continue the journey - or simply warm up inside.
Vehicles offer speed and protection, but they require fuel and caution. Getting stuck in the middle of a blizzard is worse than walking. Roads don’t always lead where you expect, and with enough skill, a car can even push through a forest.

HELPING FRIENDS AND FRIENDLY FIRE

You survive as a team, but sometimes you become a problem for each other. Friendly fire can knock out, injure, or leave a player helpless. Someone will have to protect them, keep them warm, or wait until they recover.
You can’t leave anyone behind - without the full team, the journey becomes far more dangerous. These moments turn into chaos, laughter, and stories you’ll remember long after the run ends.

WILDERNESS

Danger in this world is unpredictable. Every creature behaves differently: some stalk you silently and strike without warning, others charge straight through, unfazed by fire or vehicles.
Sometimes avoiding a threat is smarter than fighting it. Just remember - nature doesn’t play by your rules.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Sometimes, the hardest part of the day isn't getting out of bed, it's knowing what to do after you get up."

You have lived in this room for a long time. The outside world is too loud, too bright, and too dangerous. Your days are measured by the angle of the sunlight hitting the floor and the boiling water for your instant noodles.

But you are not entirely alone. Samantha is here.

Samantha is everything you are not. She is energetic. She wants to wear colorful clothes. She dreams of sitting on a park bench and watching the sky without fear. She is the one who convinces you to clean the trash that has been piling up for months. She is the one whispering that the front door isn't as high as Mount Everest.

The Story Follow the daily rituals of a recluse: the safety of old pajamas, the comfort of predictable silence, and the terrifying, heart-pounding attempt to step outside.

As you prepare for the biggest day of your life—a trip to the park—you will witness the struggle between the desire to live and the paralyzing fear of being seen. But as the mirror begins to crack, you must ask yourself:

If Samantha is the one speaking, why are her lips not moving?

Key Features:

• A Deeply Psychological Narrative: Explore themes of severe social anxiety, depression, and dissociation through an intimate monologue.

• Atmospheric Storytelling: Experience the suffocating comfort of isolation and the terrifying glare of the outside world.

• A Short, Impactful Experience: A linear story that focuses on emotion and atmosphere rather than complex mechanics.

Please read before playing:

1. This is a Kinetic Visual Novel: This project is a static, linear experience. There are no choices to make, no branching paths, and no "gameplay" in the traditional sense. It is a short story meant to be read, felt, and experienced visually.

2. A Personal Reflection: This story is a projection of a specific state of mind. It is a digital echo of personal struggles with isolation and mental health. It is not designed to be "fun"; it is raw, unpolished, and intentionally claustrophobic.

3. Mature Content Warning: This narrative deals with heavy topics including severe depression, self-neglect, hallucinations, and implied suicide. It explores the darker corners of the human psyche and the reality of living with untreated mental illness. Player discretion is strongly advised.

The Story Follow the daily rituals of a recluse: the safety of old pajamas, the comfort of predictable silence, and the terrifying, heart-pounding attempt to step outside.

As you prepare for the biggest day of your life—a trip to the park—you will witness the struggle between the desire to live and the paralyzing fear of being seen. But as the mirror begins to crack, you must ask yourself:

If Samantha is the one speaking, why are her lips not moving?

Key Features:

• A Deeply Psychological Narrative: Explore themes of severe social anxiety, depression, and dissociation through an intimate monologue.

• Atmospheric Storytelling: Experience the suffocating comfort of isolation and the terrifying glare of the outside world.

• A Short, Impactful Experience: A linear story that focuses on emotion and atmosphere rather than complex mechanics.

Please read before playing:

1. This is a Kinetic Visual Novel: This project is a static, linear experience. There are no choices to make, no branching paths, and no "gameplay" in the traditional sense. It is a short story meant to be read, felt, and experienced visually.

2. A Personal Reflection: This story is a projection of a specific state of mind. It is a digital echo of personal struggles with isolation and mental health. It is not designed to be "fun"; it is raw, unpolished, and intentionally claustrophobic.

3. Mature Content Warning: This narrative deals with heavy topics including severe depression, self-neglect, hallucinations, and implied suicide. It explores the darker corners of the human psyche and the reality of living with untreated mental illness. Player discretion is strongly advised.
store_data.short_description: "Noodles are the food of solitude." Trapped by agoraphobia and social anxiety, your only friend is Samantha. She is your courage to open the door. But in a room of broken mirrors, who is actually speaking? A short psychological visual novel about isolation and the lies we tell ourselves.

About This Game

Hypernova is a progression-driven space survival game where every sortie is a fight for time, resources, and control. Dive into hostile sectors, collect stars and rare materials, and turn each run into permanent power through research, world unlocks, and long-term collection.

Survive The Sortie

You start from the Command Center, launch into a world, and push your luck:

  • Collect stars, fragments, scrap, crystals, and world-specific resources

  • Survive hazards and escalating enemy waves as difficulty ramps up

  • Chain combos and clutch close calls for bonus score and better payouts

Build A Ship That Feels Yours

Upgrade your loadout and playstyle with weapon and utility choices:

  • Primary/secondary weapon progression with branching upgrades

  • Utilities like magnet pulls, dashes, cloaks, and time manipulation to turn bad situations around

  • Persistent upgrades that carry forward between runs

Expand The Galaxy

Unlock new worlds on a connected Galaxy Map and face fresh challenges:

  • World unlock costs combine multiple resources, some destinations require prerequisite worlds

  • Different worlds bring different hazards, pacing, and reward profiles

Research, Industry, And Long-Term Progress

Turn raw loot into long-term momentum:

  • Research upgrades for ship systems, weapons, utilities, galaxy bonuses, and infrastructure

  • Planet buildings with limited slots per world (Relays, Mines, Factories)

  • Crafting categories unlocked through factories and improved via research

Goals Beyond A Single Run

There’s always a reason to do “one more run”:

  • Achievements and quest cadences (daily/weekly/seasonal, plus event quests when active)

  • Cosmetic collection: skins, trails, thrusters, badges, titles, and more

  • Leaderboards and personal highlights to chase cleaner routes and bigger payouts

store_data.about_the_game:
In Dice Heroes, you play a hero on a quest across a hostile continent to finally discover who you are. To achieve your goal, you'll have to traverse different biomes, confront increasingly dangerous creatures, and survive the choices you make in every battle.

A risk-based combat system

Combat in Dice Heroes is turn-based and built around a simple but demanding core mechanic:
you only have one die.

Each turn:

  • you roll the die,

  • then decide how to distribute its value between Attack and Defense.

The more you invest in Attack, the more damage you can deal — but the more vulnerable you become.
Playing safe with Defense can keep you alive, but may lead to long and dangerous fights.

Every turn is a risk/reward decision.

Artifacts that change the rules

As you progress, you will collect powerful artifacts that make every run unique.
Artifacts can:

  • increase or modify your Attack and Defense,

  • alter how the die behaves,

  • invert or break combat rules,

  • create strong or chaotic synergies.

Luck plays a major role — but over time, you learn how to bend it to your will.

Progression and replayability

As you advance:

  • enemies become tougher,

  • your build evolves through artifact combinations,

An Infinite Mode is also available, allowing you to push your builds to their limits.

Content

The current version of Dice Heroes includes:

  • 1 biome with 8 different enemies

  • 1 playable character

  • Over 40 artifacts, each altering the game’s rules

  • Infinite Mode

store_data.about_the_game:
Hue Factory is a minimalist automation game about color theory. It’s just you, some conveyor belts, and a stream of colorful boxes waiting to be sorted.

Start with simple inputs and route them to their destinations to create colorful factories. As you encounter new levels, new colors appear, and your factory automation tactics will need to evolve.

The factory is your palette; a canvas waiting to be painted. Use machines to manipulate the supply chain and create new colors with machines such as:

  • Mixers: Blend two colors to create secondary or tertiary colors. The more complex the color, the greater the profit!

  • Splitters & Alternators: Redirect and cross conveyors to keep your lines as efficient as possible.

  • Pushers: Let multiple colors tag along on a single conveyor and redirect when needed with a Pusher.

And more!

Hue Factory's levels vary in size. On some levels, it won't just be about the output speed, but instead an efficient layout. If your layout gets cluttered, jams will form, and your profits will drop. Keep the belts moving to keep the factory alive.

In addition to evolving factory floor layouts, you will also encounter an increasing roster of colors to route. Replay each level and gain a new high score. All inputs spawn in new spots every time; think creatively to create an efficient automation each time you play.

Features:

  • Choose Your Theme: Unlock different themes to suit your style.

  • Colorful Progression: Master the basics of routing primary colors before unlocking complex mixing challenges.

  • Vibe Check: A soundtrack and soundscape designed to help you focus and relax while you build.

  • Accessibility Settings: Enable text-based labels on every box to ensure the factory remains accessible and playable for everyone, regardless of color perception.

store_data.about_the_game:
After a tragic accident, the protagonist falls into a coma. Upon awakening, he finds himself in an apparently perfect world: a solarpunk paradise of lush nature, harmonious architecture, and warm light. But beneath this idyllic surface lies something unresolved.

Deep within his mind, a profound sense of guilt is hidden.

To heal, you must venture deeper and deeper into the subconscious, crossing the different layers of the psyche. From the preconscious, a warm desert suspended between memory and repression, to the suffocating unconscious, where thoughts become distorted and oppressive. Finally, you will confront the Ego: a toxic, steampunk environment that mirrors his deepest fears.

Explore symbolic and interconnected environments, solve environmental puzzles, and let yourself be guided by an intense and moving narrative structure, all accompanied by a powerful, immersive, and emotional soundtrack that will change and evolve throughout each phase of the game.

The environment will be your ally:

  • Activate levers to unlock new paths

  • Move platforms to overcome obstacles

  • Use vines and vegetation to climb and reach hidden areas

Each mechanic is seamlessly integrated into the narrative: every puzzle solved represents a step toward self-acceptance.

This is not just an adventure, but an emotional journey. By exploring a world built from the protagonist’s subconscious, the player will experience a voyage through trauma, guilt, and loss. Only by confronting his fears will it be possible to rebuild what has been lost.

Are you ready to descend into the depths of the mind and find yourself again?

store_data.about_the_game:
UnDiced is a turn-based roguelike RPG where dice rolls drive both exploration and combat.

An archaeologist, driven by a passion for archaeology, broke into the royal tomb.

To earn a royal pardon, the archaeologist must delve into the dungeon with the crown’s backing and recover a legendary relic.

Roll the dice to gain Action Points, then explore the dungeon.

Move one tile at a time, and you’ll eventually discover the stairs leading down.

In battle, every action is shaped by the dice.

Each skill has its own success rate and payoff.

Items can help you manage the risks that come with these dice-driven fights.

As you explore, you can acquire a variety of skills and items—but you can only carry a limited selection at a time.

Plan ahead: decide which skills and items you want to rely on before you claim them.

Can you reach the deepest floor and claim the relic?

May luck be with you.
