store_data.about_the_game:
■ Story: A girl’s wish is to wake from the nightmare. A dive into the abyss to grant that wish.

Waking up in the darkness, a girl is greeted by a strange, yet strangely adorable, guide.

"Hey there. You have a wish you want granted, don't you?" "If you reach the bed at the very bottom, that dream will become reality."

Believing those words, the girl throws herself into the endless, deep hole. All for the sake of granting her one "true wish."

■ System: Thrilling Physics-Based Action

This title is a 3D physics-based action game centered on "falling and evading." Players control the girl as she continues her descent, skillfully dodging obstacles that shift according to physics and "Nightmare Phantasms" that block her path.

  • Dynamic Descent: Experience an ever-changing sense of gravity and speed. Enjoy pulse-pounding evasion action.

  • A Beautifully Eerie World: What first appears to be a sublime fantasy space gradually reveals its true form the deeper you go.

  • Diverse Gameplay via Physics: Collision detection and object movements are calculated in real-time, creating a unique sense of tension in every playthrough.

■ The Truth: What Awaits at the Bottom

When she finally lies upon the bed at the abyss's floor, the girl’s wish will be granted. However, once the true nature of that wish is revealed, the story will show a completely different face.

As she heads toward her chosen conclusion... If you happen to grasp "a certain possibility" during the journey, a different future—shrouded in dazzling light—may very rarely visit you.

——Fall, evade, dream, and pray to wake.

The nightmare journey of a girl’s wish begins now.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dice Beauty is a turn-based tactical roguelike where battles are fought with dice, cards, and elemental strategy.

Instead of traditional monsters, you face beautiful elemental heroines, each representing a different element with unique strengths, weaknesses, and behaviors. Victory depends not on luck alone, but on understanding how elements interact — and making the right decisions at the right time.

Tactical Dice Combat with Elemental Advantage

Combat in Dice Beauty is built around dice-based actions and elemental relationships.

Each enemy card represents an elemental heroine. Some elements dominate others, some are vulnerable, and some force you to rethink your approach entirely.

This is not about collecting perfect builds — it’s about reading the situation, managing risk, and exploiting elemental advantages:

  • choose actions based on elemental matchups

  • react to dice outcomes, not just roll them

  • turn bad rolls into survivable situations

  • punish enemies by using their weaknesses

Every fight becomes a tactical puzzle shaped by dice and elements.

A Roguelike Driven by Systems, Not Scripts

Each run offers a new challenge:

  • procedurally generated encounters

  • different combinations of elemental enemies

  • unpredictable dice outcomes

  • constant pressure between risk and reward

Failure is expected.
Learning how elements counter each other — and how to adapt when luck turns against you — is the real progression.

Elemental Knowledge Beats Pure Luck

Dice Beauty rewards understanding and planning:

  • knowing which elements counter others is crucial

  • positioning and timing matter more than raw numbers

  • one wrong decision can end a run

  • one smart elemental choice can completely flip a battle

Luck creates situations.
Your decisions decide the outcome.

Elemental Heroines and a Stylized Fantasy World

Encounters take the form of cards featuring elemental characters, each with their own visual identity and combat role.

The game’s style blends a cute, stylized anime aesthetic with a constant sense of tactical danger.
Charming on the surface — unforgiving underneath.

Key Features

  • Turn-based tactical combat

  • Dice-driven battle system

  • Element-based strengths and weaknesses

  • Card-style enemy encounters

  • Roguelike structure with unique runs

  • Single-player experience

  • 2D stylized visuals

  • Fantasy setting

Who Is This Game For?

Dice Beauty is for players who enjoy:

  • turn-based tactics

  • roguelikes focused on decision-making

  • elemental combat systems

  • risk management and adaptation

  • stylish games with real mechanical depth

store_data.about_the_game:
The Future of The Kingdom Rests Upon Your Words!

Every "Yes" or "No" echoing in the throne room opens the door to a new story. You are not just a ruler; you are a leader determining the destiny of a people through your decisions. Every visitor who comes to your door tells a tale that will either turn your kingdom into a legend or bury it in history.

The Balance of the Council: Five Powers, One Sovereign The People, the Nobility, the Clergy, the Army, and the Treasury... You must keep these five powers in balance simultaneously. To break the harmony of the council is to bid farewell to your throne. Remember, every group has its own agenda; pleasing one may enrage another.

Critical Quests and Unexpected Events Take on special quests from your palace and deal with event cards that can appear at any moment. Every event you encounter can steer the story's flow in a completely new and unpredictable direction.

Hundreds of Cards, Endless Variety! Throne of Decisions features a massive card library, each swaying the course of your kingdom in a different direction. Thanks to hundreds of different normal and event cards, no two game sessions are ever the same. With hidden story paths waiting to be discovered, the replayability offers a fresh experience every time.

Visitors and Deep Lore! Every character that comes to your door has their own unique background and a secret motive. Get to know these mysterious visitors, discover their story arcs, and witness firsthand how your decisions radically change these tales.

From Settlement to Empire! Start from a small settlement and surpass town and city levels. As your kingdom grows, the events you encounter, the quests you undertake, and the cards added to your deck will become more complex and challenging.

store_data.about_the_game:
Portal Fall is a turn-based roguelike focused on skill adaptation and character build experimentation. Each run challenges you to survive escalating waves of enemies while shaping your build through flexible skill choices that can shift your strategy mid-battle.

Fight through a series of unstable realms, each with its own rules, enemies, and twists on core mechanics. As battles unfold, you’ll make critical decisions about how to spend mana, manage cooldowns, and adjust your build on the fly to respond to unpredictable threats.

At the heart of each run is skill discovery. Unlock and experiment with abilities from an expanding skill tree, learning how different skills interact, scale, and synergize over time. Mastery comes not just from surviving, but from understanding how to combine skills into powerful — and sometimes game-breaking — builds.

An enigmatic mechanical Jester presides over the portals, reshaping reality and forcing you to adapt or fall. No two runs are the same, and long-term success depends on reading the battlefield, anticipating enemy intent, and applying hard-earned knowledge from past runs.

Key Features

  • Turn-based combat built around thoughtful skill use and high-impact decisions

  • Flexible skill builds that evolve during combat encounters

  • Skill discovery through an expanding skill tree with deep synergy potential

  • Procedurally generated runs across multiple distinct realms

  • A growing roster of enemies with clear, telegraphed actions

  • High-risk, high-reward decisions that reward experimentation and mastery

store_data.about_the_game:
Tired of the same old rod and reel? Ready for a fishing revolution!

Bungee Fisher is a groundbreaking physics-based action-adventure game. You are an extraordinary fisherwoman, tethered by a custom bungee cord. Leap from breathtaking heights, harness the mighty force of your plunge, and spear into rivers and ocean depths to catch exotic fish and mythical sea creatures—by hand! But the locals below aren't friendly. Every catch is a heart-pounding underwater brawl. Wrestle vicious giant fish, outmaneuver cunning monsters, and skillfully wear them down. Seize your moment of triumph as they tire, and claim your prize from the deep!

Core Combat: A Test of Strength

Dive into the immersive "Hunt vs. Tug-of-War" system. Once submerged, you're locked in a realistic physical struggle with your prey. Master directional control and rhythmic inputs to counter their wild thrashing and attacks. One wrong move, and they might break free—or drag you into even darker, more dangerous waters. The thrill of victory is unmatched. Build your collection from palm-sized glowing minnows to leviathans rivaling ships, fueling your drive to grow stronger and discover more.

Gear Up & Plumb the Depths

Brains and brawn are both essential. Use materials and gold from your catches to upgrade your bungee line, enhance your diving gear, and strengthen your body. Push your limits to descend into lightless abyssal zones and face greater challenges. But there's more than fish lurking below. Discover secrets of immense value—ancient shipwrecks and lost treasure chests await. Whispers tell of a medieval cargo ship, laden with immeasurable riches, that slumbers in the deepest trench of the Black Sea… Do you dare to explore the ultimate depths and uncover its treasures?

Endless Waters, Infinite Adventure

From sun-drenched tropical islands to the lightless depths of the Black Sea, you'll never know what awaits your next leap. Will it be a trove of priceless pearls? Or a desperate clash for survival against an epic sea monster? Take the plunge and find out!

Two moons past, a beacon scorched the night sky and stirred the once dormant pestilent rust into a frenzy. 

Homes destroyed, communities shattered. All must reach the safety of the northern peninsula or be consumed.

Rearrange your convoy as the situation demands, each day brings new challenges and keeping the convoy in order will prevent devastation.

Recruit friends (and sometimes foes) as you journey across the Red Isolation. Each new ally potentially brings unique vehicles, weapons and abilities. Manage the crews morale or they might abandon you and leave you for the pestilent rust.

store_data.about_the_game:
Newbie adventurer Amy returns home from a failed quest, only to be shipwrecked and stranded on a recently discovered island. Luckily, the island also has a local guild branch. Now all she needs to do is survive until the next ship sails toward the Kingdom.

In the meantime, she sets her goal on transforming from a newbie adventurer into one of the island’s best!

Chronicles of Clams Island is an RPG focused on adventuring and interacting with the locals. Complete quests, earn money, and find new locations to unlock and battle more enemies, eventually rising to become the highest-ranked adventurer.

Although Amy was shipwrecked on the island, that doesn’t stop her from learning to mingle with the islanders. Time to get acquainted with the nightlife! Amy starts off pure and virtuous, but little by little, she’ll discover that her new job comes with its own… interesting lessons.

Choices Matter

Different choices will impact Amy's morality as well as the game's events and endings.

Adventure

Discover different areas of the island, learn, upgrade, and improve Amy's

gear, skills, and adventurer rank to reach her goal!

Resource Management

Manage Amy's time, resources, as well as chastity. Some choices will allow an easier way to earn money, but there's always a cost.

No Game Overs

When defeated in battle, you will return to your base. Enjoy the game without any stress.

Recollection Room

Don't miss out on the past events. There's also an option to do mock battles!

Voice Acting

All erotic scenes are fully voiced.

store_data.about_the_game:
Blacksands is a Knowledge-based FPS imposing a nervous and thoughtful challenge to all Gladiators that wishes to venture here.

Prisoner of space and time

The unknown keep you prisoner in a temporal loop, condemned to relive the same fight again and again in an arena you ignore the depths. Lost in this environment you don’t understand, your only wish is to find a way out.

Fight your way through

Armed with nothing but a strange energy relic, dash and shoot through relentless waves of enemies in this fast-paced, nerve-shredding FPS. Fluid movement meets classic gunplay combined to deliver the most pure, unfiltered action.
Face dangerous and mysterious enemies: constant waves of harassing foes harassing you constantly in close range, or deadly turrets keeping you from approaching.

Explore and learn

Each loop is an opportunity to explore and decipher the arena’s complex structure. More intricate than it first appears, you will be challenged by different puzzles, finding secret interactions and unexpected paths.
Don't fear, every discovery you'd make will be carefully noted into an interactive map as you progress. Once understood, its systems will organically offer you new paths, enabling fast and seamless traversal through previously explored areas.

Use your environment

Destroy walls, activate jump pads, moving platforms and other mechanisms: use your creativity to think and discover new pathways, shortcuts and secrets under your feet, which may be the keys to freedom.

store_data.about_the_game:
🚀 The Next Dimension of Okey: Join the Fun at the Table of the Future!

Tired of the same old, ordinary Okey games? Okey Ability invites you to a table where neon lights meet deep strategy.

Whether you want to enjoy Classic Okey rules with your friends or shake things up by using unique abilities to disrupt the game—every round here is a brand-new thrill!

🎮 Easy to Learn, Thrilling to Master

If you know the basics of Okey, you’re already halfway there!

  • Smart Interface: Forget the clutter! Our system lets you sort your tiles with a single touch, allowing you to focus purely on the fun and your next move.

  • Built for Everyone: Whether you are a seasoned pro or a first-time player, Okey Ability is designed to provide an enjoyable experience for all skill levels.

🏆 The Path to Victory: Arrange Your Sets and Finish First!

In Okey Ability, all you need is the right strategy and a bit of timing. Whether through traditional tactics or with the help of your abilities, aim to be the fastest to clear your hand!

Create Runs and Sets: 

  • Runs: Line up consecutive numbers of the same color (e.g., Blue 5, 6, 7).

  • Sets: Group the same numbers with different colors (e.g., Blue 7, Red 7, Yellow 7).

Go for Pairs (Double): If you're feeling lucky, collect identical pairs to deliver a heavy blow to your opponents!

📊 End-Game Analysis: See the Unseen! Once the round ends, everything is revealed on the table!

  • Check the Remaining Points: See exactly how many points (or tiles) your opponents had left and which specific tile they were waiting for to win.

  • Master the Meta: Analyze your rivals' strategies, decode their playstyles, and come back to the table even stronger for the next round!

store_data.about_the_game:
7 Days in Dystopia is a psychological dystopian game set in a city where people hide behind masks not only to conceal their faces, but their emotions and intentions.

In this city, progress is not given.
It is earned by playing games.

Your experience unfolds across seven in-game days. Advancement depends on how well you perform, the choices you make, and how you respond to winning and losing.

Play Different Games, Face Different Challenges

  • A bullet-hell game, where you face increasing enemy waves, build your abilities over time, and attempt to keep up as the chaos escalates.

  • An action platformer, focused on movement and timing, where mistakes can quickly set you back.

  • An idle clicker game, where progress is driven by numbers, upgrades, and optimization, rewarding patience and long-term planning.

These games are not isolated.
Your performance in each one directly affects your overall progress and the days that follow.

Every Outcome Matters

You play, you choose, you win or you lose and every outcome has consequences.

Losing does not end the game, but it leaves you behind.

Winning pushes you forward, gradually pulling you closer to the system you are engaging with.

Characters and Dialogue

Alongside the games, you interact with a range of NPC characters through dialogue.

These conversations reflect your current state and challenge the way you see the city and yourself.

NPCs do not simply provide information.

They question your choices, mirror your behavior, and become an important part of how the experience unfolds across the seven days.

A Psychological Experience

7 Days in Dystopia does not rely on a traditional narrative structure.

Instead, it places you inside a controlled environment and observes how you adapt.

Your decisions and reactions across the seven days shape who you become by the end of the experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a classic long-form RPG inspired by the masterpieces of the 1990s JRPG era.

[System]

  • This is a side-view, command-input combat system. Faster characters can act more frequently.

  • Features a class change system. Characters can freely switch between two types of classes: main classes and subclasses.

  • Character-specific blue arts and class-specific red arts exist. Used effectively, you can significantly alter the course of battle.

  • The numerous side quests all feature compelling storylines.

  • Features include message acceleration, auto-recovery, and fast travel for a comfortable experience.

[Game Scale]

The game takes approximately 30 to 40 hours to complete.

*Assumes completion of all side quests on Normal difficulty.

[Story]

There was a world where islands floated above a sea of clouds.

The story begins with a certain boy being taken to one of those islands—Prison Island.

The boy's name was Levin.

He was born into a powerful noble family of the empire, yet he had been falsely accused of a crime.

Levin struck up a friendship with the cloud pirate Xanad, whom he met in prison, and resolved to escape the island...

[Development Tool]

This game was developed using RPG Maker MZ, so the system requirements are based on that.

store_data.about_the_game:
You wake up alone on a mysterious island with no memories and no answers. Something happened here. And whatever it was… still lingers.

LINGER is a survival adventure game focused on exploration, crafting, and atmosphere. Stranded in a hostile environment, you must gather resources, craft tools, build shelter, and uncover the secrets hidden across the island. store_data.about_the_game:
You move to the city for work and urgently need to find a place to live.

There’s a free room in a shared house. What you didn’t expect is that all your new roommates… want to fuck you.

Four women, all completely different, each want to be the one who ends up with you.

Daily life quickly turns into a game of sexual tension, where every day you choose who to spend your time with: going out partying, cooking together, playing video games, or giving in to plans that are much more… perverted.

Meet your new roommates:

🎉 Emma – The Party Girl

Wild and completely unfiltered. She lives in the moment and isn’t afraid to go after what she wants. She’ll be the first to drag you out for drinks… and the first to pull you into a bathroom for something more.

👩‍🍳 Sophie – The House Mom

Serious, responsible, and protective. An amazing cook who keeps everything in order. But beneath her controlled exterior lies a lonely woman who gives too much and never asks for anything in return. She’s hard to win over, but once you finally pull her panties down…

🎮 Zoey – The Nerd

A redhead with glasses who barely talks and is always lost in her own world. But once she discovers you share her love for anime and video games… she falls head over heels for you.

💜 Nina – The Femme Fatale

She plays with you like you’re a piece on her chessboard, but when she realizes you won’t let yourself be controlled like the others… you spark her interest.

As the days go by, you’ll grow closer and closer to them, and once you truly get to know them all… the time to choose will come.

Who will you choose?

FEATURES

  • Finally: animations! Some girls feature a special animated scene.

  • Animated H Scenes: find some H scenes that are animated as you progress through the story.

  • Shape the story: choose the protagonist’s name and build your own story, making decisions that create branching paths in the narrative.

  • Hide the interface: you can hide the interface at any time if you want to admire the scenery and the game’s artwork.

  • Gallery: as you progress through the story, you will unlock albums that let you easily revisit your favorite moments.

  • Navigation options: go hands-free by enabling auto-play text, or skip it entirely to reach your favorite parts! You can also go back at any time to change a decision.

  • Immersive audio: enjoy music, sound effects, voices, and "other effects." Adjust each volume independently or mute everything.

PLEASE NOTE

  • All characters depicted and visually represented in this game are over 18 years old, and no real or identifiable minors were used in the production of this game.

  • We’re still working on it: all improvements and new content we develop will be added to the game at no additional cost.

👉 Add Meow! to your wishlist and relax your mind with this cozy mirrored puzzle adventure

🐾 Cat Mirror

Cat Mirror is a deceptively simple puzzle game that will challenge the way you think. You don’t control one character —

you control two. And they always move together. What helps one… can trap the other.

🧩 How It Works

Every move is mirrored. Both cats move at the same time — but through different paths.

One step forward might solve half the puzzle…

and completely ruin the other half. You’ll need precision, timing, and smart positioning to keep both safe.

It looks easy.

It isn’t.

Control two characters simultaneously Mirrored movement puzzles that test your brain One mistake can break your entire solution Simple mechanics, increasingly complex challenges Clean visuals and focused gameplay Designed for quick sessions… or long frustration loops

  • One mistake can break your entire solution

store_data.about_the_game:
This is not a calm paddle game.

PaddleUP! is a loud, slightly evil arcade show where one rule matters:

Keep. The. Ball. Alive.

No bricks.
No safe patterns.
No mercy.

Just you, the paddle, the ball —
and an arena that fights back harder every second.

The crowd is watching.
The chaos escalates.
You either adapt… or lose.

Three fast, replayable modes built around survival, pressure, and “one more run” energy:

Classic

  • Old-school arcade structure with lives and round timers

  • Drop the ball → lose a life

  • Lose all lives and the run is over

  • Progress through escalating arenas and face the final boss

Arcade

  • Pure time-attack survival

  • The timer constantly drains

  • Every successful hit adds time back

  • Trick shots and streaks reward extra time

  • When the timer hits zero, the run ends instantly

Infinite

  • No timer

  • No lives

  • The ball respawns forever

  • Perfect for practice, warm-ups, or stress-free chaos

Playing safe keeps you alive. Playing stylish keeps you scoring.

  • Flip the paddle sideways for risky x2 hits

  • Arm 360° spin shots and catch the ball in a tight window for big bonuses

  • Fire 45° angle shots for clutch saves

  • Chain hits to build streaks and multipliers

  • Arenas evolve as your hit count climbs

  • Moving saws, spikes, and screen-wide hazards force constant movement

  • Weather effects and special events increase pressure

  • A final boss encounter turns survival into a full-screen challenge

  • A fake live chat reacts in real time

  • Clean streaks get hype

  • Missed hits get roasted

  • Announcer lines, pop-ups, and meme stickers amplify big moments

  • Screen shake, panic effects, fireworks, and punchy hit feedback

  • Music ramps up as pressure rises

  • Backgrounds evolve as you survive deeper into the run

Built as a love letter to arcade paddle games,

crowd pressure, and that feeling when you’re one mistake away from disaster —

but still queueing up “one more run.”

store_data.about_the_game:
A silent house. A single light. A choice that could kill you.

Step into a pitch-black mansion where the only thing guiding you is a narrow beam of light — and the knowledge that using it may attract something you cannot see.
Explore the halls, uncover hidden clues, and survive a psychological game of light and darkness where every decision feels uncertain.

There is no visible enemy stalking you.
There are no safe instructions.
Only tension, silence, and the sound of the house watching you back.

Each clue you collect triggers an unseen threat. A hidden timer begins, and you must decide whether to keep your flashlight on or turn it off — but the correct choice is never revealed. Hesitate, second-guess, or trust the wrong instinct, and the darkness will answer with a sudden, brutal shock.

The mansion is alive with subtle environmental audio: distant whispers, creaking furniture, echoing footsteps, and unsettling noises that may or may not be real. Silence becomes as frightening as sound, and every corridor feels different in the dark.

Key Features

  • Psychological Light-Based Survival – Your flashlight is both protection and danger.

  • Unpredictable Threat System – Hidden timers and randomized outcomes keep every clue tense.

  • Shock Jumpscares – Rare but intense moments designed to make you physically jump.

  • Dark Exploration – See what your light reveals.

  • Dynamic Environmental Audio – Objects and rooms emit eerie sounds as you move through them.

  • Minimal UI, Maximum Immersion – No hand-holding, no obvious warnings.

  • Replayable Fear – Randomized events ensure no two runs feel the same.

Capivara Zen is an indie, narrative-driven game that blends humor, adrenaline, chaos, mystery, and a touch of urban adventure, featuring engaging cutscenes, a complete story mode, and a frenetic arcade mode.

You follow an ordinary capybara, trapped in an empty, purposeless routine, until a visit to an old place turns its life upside down.

On the way to a job interview, it walks through abandoned streets, dirt, closed shops… a city without color, without life, without anything. Along the way, it discovers that the old CapiGames, an arcade abandoned for years, has reopened in the city center.

Upon entering and trying to turn on one of the machines, the capybara is sucked into the game.

After a wild interdimensional journey, it awakens as Zen, a stylized, confident, and aggressive version of itself, trapped in an unstable urban arcade world filled with obstacles, dangers, and unpredictable situations.
The game advances at an arcade pace, with constant challenges, money collection, and continuous progression. To free the capybara from this world, the player must reach increasingly higher stages, facing an environment that becomes progressively more chaotic. The story is told through cutscenes that can be rewatched from the main menu after completing progress in Story Mode.

Capivara Zen is a frenetic experience that combines fast-paced action, storytelling, and an urban atmosphere, a game about persisting, moving forward, and trying to escape when everything feels out of control.

Gameplay

  • Dodge NPCs, police officers, vehicles and obstacles in real time;

  • Use jumps and maneuvers to avoid collisions;

  • Collect coins scattered along the path;

  • Colliding with police officers or vehicles results in prison.

Each run is a new attempt to go further than before.

Progression and Upgrades

Money collected during gameplay can be spent in the shop to unlock upgrades that help you survive longer:

  • Upgrades that enhance the way you play;

  • Different skins for a broader and more fun experience;

Progression is based on trial, learning and adaptation.

Game Goals

  • Reach the highest level possible;

  • Get to Stage 10 to complete the main story;

  • After the introduction, access Arcade Mode directly without replaying the narrative;

  • Rewatch previously unlocked story scenes, plus an extra scene unlocked after completing the game.

Highlights

  • Indie arcade-style game;

  • Narrative integrated into gameplay;

  • Fast-paced action with progressive difficulty;

  • Upgrade system based on collection;

  • Simple and responsive controls.

store_data.about_the_game:
STOP MANAGING AN ARMY. START BECOMING A LEGEND.

In the modern era of card games, the battlefield has become a spreadsheet. You hide behind walls of minions, calculating favorable trades and watching animations play out while you wait for your turn. It’s slow. It’s impersonal. It dilutes the kill.

Apocalypse: The Hunger strips the genre down to its raw, violent core. We have removed the creatures entirely. There are no meat shields here. This is a Personal War.

IMMERSIVE AUDIO: THE VOICE OF THE APOCALYPSE

Don't just read the text—hear the threat. Fully voiced characters inject massive personality into every encounter. Whether it's the chrome-hardened slang of a Human merc, the guttural aggression of an Orc enforcer, or the raspy, radioactive whispers of a Ghoul, every race brings unique flavor to the fight. The soundscape is as lethal as the spells. The city doesn't just look dangerous; it talks to you.

THE RETURN OF THE STACK

Removing minions doesn't mean removing depth. We are bringing back The Stack—the gold standard of tactical interaction.

  • Real-Time Counterplay: Don’t just watch your opponent play solitaire. Respond to their moves in real-time.

  • Zero Decision Fatigue: Stop doing math on board states. Focus entirely on the immediate threat and the lethal spell in your hand.

  • Visceral Impact: Every card played impacts your Hero directly. The tension is immediate, constant, and personal.

THE EVOLUTION OF THE HERO’S JOURNEY

The "grind for packs" loop is broken. We replaced the static ladder climb with a true PVE RPG adventure set in the infinite, neon-soaked sprawl of the Metropolis.

  • Gear Upgrades: Don't just wish for a better card—discover one. Our Tradeskilling system allows you to upgrade items like legendary MMO weapons.

  • Stats That Matter: You aren't just a life total. Your Strength, Agility, and apocalyptic attributes dictate how your deck functions. Build a stealthy rogue or a tanky juggernaut; your stats define your cards, not the other way around.

TRUE ANTE: FEAR IS A MECHANIC

In the Metropolis, survival is not guaranteed. We have resurrected the Hardcore Ante system. In key encounters, you aren't playing for XP—you are playing for your gear.

  • Risk It All: Wager your rarest cards to access the city's depths and claim experimental technology.

  • Real Consequence: If you lose, you lose the card. This creates a level of adrenaline that modern, "safe" card games cannot replicate.

EXPLORE THE ENDLESS SPRAWL

Step out of the arena and into the streets. Our world-exploration system offers an endless urban landscape filled with procedurally generated encounters, secrets, and lore.

  • Meaningful Stakes: Your choices in the city impact your deck’s capabilities.

  • A Living World: This isn't just a menu of matches; it's a world you inhabit.

  • Mathematical Uniqueness: We utilize roughly 101.3 Billion possible unique enemy deck combinations when generating the world. The likelihood of a game session being identical is distinctively slim—it is always a fresh run when playing Apocalypse: The Hunger.

A RESPECTFUL ECOSYSTEM

No Loot Boxes. No Gacha. No Gambling. Apocalypse: The Hunger rejects the vulturous mechanics of the genre.

  • The Boxed Product Promise: A low entry price gets you the massive Core Game with 18 Starter Decks included.

  • Precision DLC: Want a new playstyle? Buy a Specialized Pack. You get a complete playset (6 copies) of every card plus an Exclusive Card in that archetype. You never buy a random booster pack hoping for a rare drop. You buy exactly what you want, when you want it.

The spreadsheet era is over. Welcome to the Apocalypse.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Experience the existential dread, of 2020s Britain."

"Each day strays from the past…"

"...Into a future where better things are not possible…"

"For it's what we deserve, and it's what we want…"

"...So keep calm, and carry on. Forever."

Overview

A survival horror game where you stay in a small English town to write a story for a national newspaper. You will live day-to-day getting to know the locals, finding leads, and unravelling scandals. All of which lead to the discovery of traditional horror dungeons referred to as "rabbit holes". 

Can you build a substantial enough story that's worthy enough to break the Mayor's eternal strangle hold on this proud town?

Setting

From the outside looking in, Barmford's best days are behind it. When the locals aren't waffling on about crosses they're minding their own business, forever in a loop or stuck in a rut. Most of them couldn't tell you Hallow's name or what he looks like, but know for a fact come election day he get's their little cross. Monsters? Strange noises in the night? The only monster these people know is Gregory after a few drinks.

Gameplay

Explore Barmford at Day and Night: Choose how you spend each day in Barmford, whether its uncovering the next rabbit hole, spending time with the locals or gathering scarce resources to prepare for what's next.

Exploration & Horrors: Journey to the far corners of the town at night, overcoming monsters and strange encounters through brute force combat, useful items or other means. 

Bosses within the depths: Colossal entities that will take more than a cricket bat or gun to overcome.

"Fast Pass" Calendar system: Plan ahead and fast forward time using your notebook calendar. Pick when to explore, meet up with contacts or begin an investigation.

Idle events: While resting up at your temporary home, several events may occur. Some may be minor such as Justine making herself useful round the house, others may be major, such as unwanted knock on the door at night.

Make it to the deadline: Every day the town, your surroundings and your sanity become increasingly depleted. You also need to make sure you have some form of report for your paper before the end of the month.

Style

Oblique perspective pixel art environments inspired by other classic titles in and around the genre. Alongside a mixture of 8-directional sprites and traditional pixel art sprites.

Disclaimer:

This game is a work of fiction. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or to real political parties, events, or organizations is purely coincidental.

store_data.about_the_game:
Start with a small field and grow into a true master of agriculture, a farming simulator focused on crop growth, leveling, and satisfying progression.

Plant seeds, care for your fields, and guide your crops through multiple stages of growth. Each plant has its own growth time, value, and experience reward. As you harvest and sell your produce, you gain XP to level up your farming mastery, unlocking new crop types, better tools, and powerful upgrades.

Instead of running a shop, you’ll sell your harvest directly to a merchant cart that arrives to collect your goods. Choose what to sell and when, and optimize your fields for the most profitable and efficient harvests.

As you progress, expand your farmland, improve your equipment, and refine your growing strategy. Whether you prefer slow, relaxing farming or efficient, optimized crop production, Crop Meister delivers a rewarding loop of:

Plant → Grow → Harvest → Sell → Level Up

Key Features:

- Crop-Focused Gameplay
Grow a wide variety of crops with unique growth cycles, values, and experience rewards.

- Leveling & Progression System
Earn XP from farming and selling. Unlock new seeds, tools, and upgrades as you level up.

- Sell to the Merchant Cart
Load harvested crops onto a traveling cart to convert your yield into profit — no store management, just pure farming.

- Growth & Planning Mechanics
Different crops thrive under different conditions, encouraging smart planning and land use.

- Upgrades & Expansion
Improve tools, unlock new farming areas, and increase crop yield and growth speed over time.
store_data.detailed_description:
Start with a small field and grow into a true master of agriculture, a farming simulator focused on crop growth, leveling, and satisfying progression.

Plant seeds, care for your fields, and guide your crops through multiple stages of growth. Each plant has its own growth time, value, and experience reward. As you harvest and sell your produce, you gain XP to level up your farming mastery, unlocking new crop types, better tools, and powerful upgrades.

Instead of running a shop, you’ll sell your harvest directly to a merchant cart that arrives to collect your goods. Choose what to sell and when, and optimize your fields for the most profitable and efficient harvests.

As you progress, expand your farmland, improve your equipment, and refine your growing strategy. Whether you prefer slow, relaxing farming or efficient, optimized crop production, Crop Meister delivers a rewarding loop of:

Plant → Grow → Harvest → Sell → Level Up

Key Features:

- Crop-Focused Gameplay
Grow a wide variety of crops with unique growth cycles, values, and experience rewards.

- Leveling & Progression System
Earn XP from farming and selling. Unlock new seeds, tools, and upgrades as you level up.

- Sell to the Merchant Cart
Load harvested crops onto a traveling cart to convert your yield into profit — no store management, just pure farming.

- Growth & Planning Mechanics
Different crops thrive under different conditions, encouraging smart planning and land use.

- Upgrades & Expansion
Improve tools, unlock new farming areas, and increase crop yield and growth speed over time.
store_data.short_description: Farming simulator focused on crop growth and progression. Plant, nurture, and harvest a wide variety of crops, sell them to a merchant cart, and level up to unlock new plants, tools, and farm upgrades.

store_data.about_the_game:
Inspired by the combat of Classic Final Fantasy, aesthetics of Caves of Qud, and game systems of Skyrim, 'Your Quest' is a text based CRPG set in a kingdom on the brink of collapse. You are a freed prisoner whose execution wagon crashes in the frontier, your past erased, your future unwritten. 

As as the threat of the demons loom, you must decide what kind of person you will become.

Explore Orynthia

  • Journey through peaceful villages, bustling trade cities, hidden elven settlements, and demon-corrupted wastelands

  • Dynamic day/night cycle changes the world: shops close, NPCs sleep, and the atmosphere shifts.

  • Uncover dark secrets and ancient mysteries across 100+ locations

Master Combat

  • Turn-based tactical battles with meaningful choices

  • Specialize in a variety of melee weapons, ranged combat, or magic

  • Learn weapon skills from trainers: execute devastating combos, shield techniques, and assassination moves

  • Command dozens of spells across five elements: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Dark, and Light

Craft Your Legend

  • Mine ore and fell trees to gather materials

  • Forge weapons and armor at the smithy

  • Brew potions that scale with your skill

  • Progress from the lowest tier equipment to legendary gear

Build Your Character

  • Detailed appearance customization with dynamic portrait and sprite rendering

  • Allocate skill points to shape your playstyle

  • Recruit adventurers from the guild to join your party

  • Your choices affect faction relationships and karma

Features

  • Fall in love and romance your companions 

  • Deep character progression with multiple viable builds

  • Extensive quest system with story-driven chains and guild contracts

  • Full inventory management and economy

  • Multiple save slots with import/export

Feedback

  • This game is still a work in progress and has missing portraits and sprites. Many more locations, quests, and features are planned.

  • If you have any feedback, bugs to report, or otherwise want to help shape the game, join the discord!

store_data.about_the_game:
CV:天音羽乃

You were just another disposable screw inside the Polaris Group.

Endless overtime. Parachuted managers. Emotional manipulation. Promotions that never came.

Until one night, outside the office, you met an otherworldly catgirl delivery girl whose ears actually twitched.

The moment you touched them, your life officially derailed.

Her name is Dacy.

Bubble tea shop owner. Intern. HR manager. Startup founder. Failed investor. And a wildly optimistic dreamer who plans to conquer the world with hand-shaken drinks.

You, on the other hand, are a former corporate drone. A master of spreadsheets, workflow fixes, and having your soul crushed by capitalism.

In this chaotic comedy interactive adventure game, you’ll dive into the most unreliable yet liberating startup journey imaginable:

☄ Deal with mysterious minerals that move on their own

🐈 Run a drink shop while cleaning up Dacy’s financial disasters

📋 Save an adorable company on the brink of bankruptcy

💥 Face landlords, failed investments, staff shortages, and absurd crises 



You can comfort her. Roast her. Go bankrupt together. Or spiral into even bigger chaos.

She wants to build skyscrapers to challenge mega-corporations. You just want to not work overtime today.

But maybe this time, fate can actually change.



🎮 Game Features

✔ Dark corporate humor × adorable otherworldly catgirl

✔ idle game

✔ Startup management mixed with daily disasters  ✔ Funny on the surface, painfully relatable underneath



Me: “...What kind of cult product is this supposed to be?”

Dacy: “Not only does it boost your luck when you drink it, it also lets you scan a QR code to adopt a virtual pet, join our membership system, and even enter a real claw-machine lottery!”

Me: “You’ve completely forgotten you’re running a drink shop, haven’t you?”

Dacy (dead serious): “A true soul-driven entrepreneur rides the trend waves. Otherwise the hurricane of the times will sweep you away!”

store_data.about_the_game:
Congratulations! You just landed a new job! A middle-management position in a sprawling corporation. Onboarding seems simple, until you realize your “work” consists entirely of playing a memory game with cards.

Something is wrong. The cards don’t stay the same. Your memory betrays you. Subtle changes creep in…  and each mistake draws a silent, patient monster closer. The office that promised stability now feels like a trap, and you begin to question your own sanity.

Survive the week. Collect your pay check and leave the job. If you don’t lose your mind first.

Experience a tense, oppressive horror, all set inside a windowless office. Nothing is as ordinary as it seems.

The flavor is intentional. Please do not question its benefits.

Play a classic memory game…

…with a deadly twist. Cards shift, subtle changes appear, and every mistake has consequences.

Not everything you need to worry about is on the desk.

Pay attention to what you can’t see, and use your flashlight to hold back whatever is waiting behind you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Search for Sol is a sci-fi 4X in the tradition of Reach for the Stars, Master of Orion, and Star Traders.

The factions of humanity's children search for the secrets of Sol to escape their perfect metallic bodies. Control Sol for 50 years to ascend.

Search a strategic turn based map combined with tactical auto-battles. 

Recover old technologies to counter-build enemy fleet compositions including kinetic, missile, railgun, and beam weapons and relevant defensive tech. Over 400 different visual hull combinations possible.

Fleets must continually adapt. The enemy will be constantly changing their fleet compositions to counter the last weaponry they encounter, making the usual "Deathball" strategy ineffective. Massive monolithic fleets will lose to smaller fleets with more diverse technology.

The galaxy has limited resources, so recycling technology is key to victory.

Each faction is adapted to certain types of worlds, one cyborg's trash is another's idyllic paradise.

Colonizing a sub-par planet may be worth it to deny your enemy a super colony.

Now available at all Babbages & EB Games locations!

Original system requirements:

System 7.1 or higher

2mb of RAM (Virtual Memory ok)

2mb free hard disk space

1.44mb floppy drive required

B&W Monitor capable of 640 × 480 resolution or higher

store_data.about_the_game:
🛠️ FORGING IN PROGRESS (Active Development)

PolyGuild Adventurers is a labor of love currently being forged. By joining now, you aren't just playing a game—you're helping us stabilize a new realm of VR. Please Read Before Purchasing:

  • EXPECT THE UNFINISHED: You will encounter bugs, "jank," and unpolished areas.

  • PROGRESS WIPES: Save data will be reset during major engine shifts to ensure game stability.

  • FREQUENT EVOLUTION: Features may be added, removed, or completely reworked based on your feedback.

If you want a polished, final experience, please Wishlist and Follow us for the 1.0 release! If you want to help build the future of VR RPGs, grab your headset and let's go.

🧬 A WORLD OF RADICAL SCALE

Step into a vibrant VR open world where your choice of race changes your literal perspective. Our unique World-Scaling system ensures that every player experiences the world differently:

  • The Pixie: The grass is a forest, a house is a mountain, and you have native Flight mechanics to navigate it all.

  • The Half-Giant: NPCs look like toys, and you dominate the battlefield with sheer size and presence.

  • The Mid-Scales: Humans, Elves, and Dwarves find the balance in between.

⚔️ FORGE YOUR LEGEND

Start as a Wanderer and unlock your true calling at Level 10. Choose from 7 Core Classes: Fighter, Adept, Initiate, Scout, Rogue, Occultist, or Squire. With 70+ masterable skills, your progression is as deep as the dungeons you’ll explore.

✨ BORN WITH AFFINITY

Every adventurer is born with a random Elemental Affinity. Whether you harness Fire, Ice, or the incredibly rare Nullbound, your affinity dictates your combat synergy and how you interact with the world’s magic.

store_data.about_the_game:
Orphic - The midnight shift

A night watch horror experience

Orphic is a first-person horror game about detecting anomalies and subtle changes in the environment.
The gameplay focuses on careful observation, memory, and noticing small changes in your surroundings.

Overview

You are assigned a single night shift inside a secluded museum.
From 11 PM until dawn, your task is to observe the rooms and identify anything that changes, moves, or behaves strangely.

When an anomaly appears, you must locate it and use a mysterious artifact to stabilize it before the situation spirals out of control.

Objects shift. Paintings change. Sounds emerge without cause.

Your role is to notice what doesn’t belong — before it’s too late.

You are not here to escape.
You are here to endure the night.

Fail to keep things under control, and the museum may not let you finish your shift.

Gameplay

Orphic is a first-person horror experience focused on observation, tension, and routine under pressure.

Each night the museum behaves differently.
Each shift lasts a full in-game night (about 30 minutes).

Events occur unpredictably, requiring constant attention.

When a disturbance appears, you must:

• Spot unusual changes in the environment
• Locate the anomaly
• Use the artifact to stabilize it

Observation and patience are essential.
Some anomalies only reveal themselves under certain conditions.

Atmosphere & Horror

Orphic focuses on slow-building dread rather than constant action.

• Unpredictable events
• Psychological pressure
• Occasional jump scares
• A persistent sense of being watched

Sometimes danger announces itself.
Sometimes it doesn’t.

Content Warning

This game contains horror elements, disturbing imagery, sudden scares, and themes that may not be suitable for all players.

content_descriptors.notes:
Orphic – The Midnight Shift - contains dark, suspenseful themes suitable for mature audiences. Players will encounter horror elements including monsters, haunted rooms, jump scares, and unsettling imagery such as statues, mummies, and eerie paintings.

Violence is mostly fantastical: monsters and enemies can attack or scare the player, causing the character to fall or show fear, but there is no graphic gore or realistic killing.

Nudity is minimal and non-sexual, mainly in the form of partially unclothed monsters or statues.

The game contains mild vocal reactions (screams, shouts) but no strong language.

Recommended for players 15+.

store_data.about_the_game:
ROLL TOGETHER: IS YOUR FRIENDSHIP LOG-PROOF?

One massive log, two players, and a long way down. Roll Together is a chaotic, physics-based co-op parkour game where coordination is your only hope and gravity is your worst nightmare.

COOPERATIVE MAYHEM

In this game, you are nothing without your partner! One of you controls the left side, the other controls the right.

  • Rolling in sync? You’ll hit turbo speeds.

  • Pulling in opposite directions? You’re a sitting duck. Mastering the art of the roll is easy to learn, but surviving the obstacles is a test of true patience (and friendship).

PHYSICS IS YOUR FRENEMY

The log’s balance is driven by a realistic physics engine, meaning every tilt and turn matters. Thanks to Ragdoll Physics, a single bump can send your characters flying like pinballs. Watch your angles, or prepare to kiss the track goodbye!

PLAY IT YOUR WAY

Got a friend sitting next to you? Cram onto the same keyboard or use controllers for some classic couch co-op. Friend far away? Dive into the chaos with Online Co-op and prove that distance is no match for your teamwork.

FALL, LEARN, REPEAT

The climb to the top is treacherous, but we’re not monsters. Strategically placed Checkpoints ensure that a single mistake won’t send you back to the very beginning. You’ll fall a lot, but you’ll always have a chance to try "one more time."

I ended up alone in a city full of those strange monsters. Who are they? What do they want?

They killed my family, but I managed to escape. I have to survive on my own now.

One day, a man has found and shot me, but I'm not dead... How is this possible?

I barricaded myself in an old, decaying house. It looks abandoned, but somehow feels alive.

What is it hiding?

ReEvolution Project is a post-apocalyptic story-driven horror game set in a long-abandoned city overrun by strange humanoid creatures. You have taken refuge in a forgotten house, your only safe place for now. Search for supplies, explore the decaying rooms, and uncover the secrets lurking beneath the surface.

FEATURES

  • The game focuses on exploration and atmosphere, offering a slow-paced, story-driven experience set in a desolate, post-apocalyptic world. Explore abandoned spaces, search for supplies, and uncover the mysteries hidden within.

  • Most small objects can be picked up, moved around, and thrown, physically interacting with the environment. Some items may be examined to reveal fragments of a forgotten story, while others can be collected and used later.

  • To progress, you'll need to solve puzzles that challenge the way you see the world. Some are required to move forward, while others are optional, rewarding curious players with deeper insight into the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Repair Systems Under Pressure

In HotFix Protocol, each mission focuses on restoring critical systems inside a failing facility.

Players enter environments where power, cooling, life support, and other infrastructure are already compromised. Objectives involve locating the problem, gathering the required equipment, and performing repairs while conditions continue to deteriorate.

Many tasks require preparation, timing, and sustained attention. Ignoring problems causes systems to regress or trigger additional hazards.

The challenge lies in maintaining control as multiple issues compete for attention.

Built for Co-op, Playable Solo

HotFix Protocol is designed as a cooperative experience. Missions often present multiple simultaneous problems that are difficult to manage alone, encouraging players to divide responsibilities and adapt to changing conditions.

There are no fixed classes or predefined roles. Players take on tasks as situations demand, repairing systems, securing areas, transporting equipment, or containing new failures as they emerge.

The game is fully playable solo, but handling every task alone increases pressure and reduces room for error. Cooperation makes recovery faster and more reliable.

Unstable Systems, Real-Time Decisions

Systems do not remain stable once they begin to fail. Power fluctuates, repairs degrade under stress, and new problems can appear while others are still being addressed.

Combat, movement, and repairs compete for attention. Teams must decide when to secure an area, when to disengage to prevent further breakdown, and when to commit fully to restoring a critical system.

Some repairs require locating tools or components and accessing unsafe areas, adding logistical pressure to already unstable conditions.

Maintaining control requires reacting to change rather than following a fixed plan.

When Software Failures Become Physical

The facility is overrun by an anomaly: system failures have taken physical form. Instability within the infrastructure manifests as hostile entities and disruptive phenomena inside the environment.

Bugs swarm repair sites and interfere with the team’s work. More severe failures, such as crashes or lags, alter the situation in distinct ways, forcing teams to respond differently rather than relying on a single tactic.

These threats are not living creatures, but expressions of malfunctioning logic. Each one represents a breakdown in the system, escalating disruption if left unmanaged.

As instability increases, the environment becomes less predictable. The objective remains the same: restore control before failure spreads beyond recovery.

A Controlled, Industrial Sci-Fi Setting

HotFix Protocol takes place inside active industrial facilities built around function rather than spectacle.

Spaces are dense with machinery, control systems, and infrastructure that must remain operational under stress. Areas can become unsafe due to failures, reduced visibility, or degraded controls, requiring teams to adapt as circumstances change.

The setting is technical, reactive, and grounded in function, reinforcing the focus on control, pressure, and recovery.

Recruit a party of characters from 6 different race-based classes, each with their own unique quirks and abilities.

Upon completing the main campaign, you are free to explore and complete a myriad of side quests at your leisure.

Ah, marriage - that magical time when love turns into a list of chores and the person you once adored now treats you like their personal errand service. In Misery Loves Company, that’s not just a metaphor - it’s the game play.

Your spouse demands items. You fetch them. If you take too long, they’ll come after you, empty your pockets, and remind you how little zest for life you have left. But hey, maybe things can still work out! Build their trust to earn some privileges (like car keys), raise their lust to rekindle the spark… or overdo it and watch them drain your spirit faster than your bank account.

Collect items, stash cash before it’s stolen, and find creative ways to feel alive again - from island activities to questionable new acquaintances who definitely don’t believe in marriage counseling.

Every choice pushes you closer to one of three fates: make it work, leave the island, or file for divorce.

It’s not about saving your marriage. It’s about seeing how long you can stand it.

The Control Group is an online, 2D, multiplayer party game made for creating and bonding friends through fast-paced and fun minigames. Made as a school project, this game is willing to bring you both a competitive and collaborative gaming experience. We offer 11 total minigames, 66 modifiers, a witty narrator, secrets, and more!

Each round, a random unique minigame is chosen and up to four players (four players recommended) are randomly split into the Control Group (up to three players) and the Experimental Group (one player). Modifiers are given to all of the players to make the game more interesting! The Experimental Group, being only one player, has the power to pick their own modifier to best defeat the Control Group in the minigame- all the while The Control Group must fight to win against the Experimental Group. Each minigame lasts 90 seconds. 

Don't forget to check out our Instagram for information about each minigame- as well as some hints towards a hidden minigame!

store_data.about_the_game:
First, we kindly ask all players: if you have even a little expectation for this game, please add it to your Steam wishlist — this will give us greater motivation. When writing this introduction, the game is still in development: currently, only two people are working on it full-time, and occasionally friends help in their free time. The specific release date has not been determined yet, but we promise: we will not perfunctory any details, only to make a truly fun action game. We deeply love and admire the Ori and The Legend of Zelda series, so we will learn from their advantages in many experience details, and their influence can also be seen in the art style; if this makes you uncomfortable, we extend our sincere apologies — they will always be the most admired works in our hearts.

Worldview: The Brave's Rebirth, Restart the Path of Redemption

       This is a fantasy world wrapped in desire. The once wild and ignorant Aku suffered heavy injuries and setbacks, not only pushing the people around him into trouble, but also putting himself in a desperate situation: with confused memories after severe injuries, he finally decided to embark on a path of pursuing truth and self-acceptance to achieve rebirth from the ashes. You will follow in Aku's footsteps, explore forgotten ancient secrets, unlock fragments of power from the past, uncover the mystery of the world's destruction, and complete the brave's exclusive path of redemption through battles and exploration. There is no redundant and complex narrative — every scene and every puzzle hides clues about the worldview, allowing you to gradually immerse yourself while playing.

Core Gameplay: Layered Design, Balancing Immersion and Excitement

       We have broken the genre barrier between Metroidvania and roguelike, adopting a layered gameplay design: in the early stages, non-linear Metroidvania exploration helps unlock core abilities (such as combat skills, gliding, etc.), combined with light puzzles to feel the pure joy of exploration; in the later stages, switching to the roguelike cycle mode with randomly generated levels, skills and enemies, combined with multiple combat build combinations, enhances the feel of hardcore combat — every attack and every dodge has clear feedback, balancing accessibility for beginners and hardcore challenges, and completely eliminating the monotony of repeated play.

Careful Polishing: No Perfunctoriness in Any Details, Live Up to Every Expectation

       Since the project started, we have never been in a hurry, nor can we be — those classic masterpieces we want to learn from have too many details worth polishing. We can only repeatedly test and adjust the feel of each skill, modify the AI logic of each enemy, take every detail seriously, and do our best to avoid a bad gaming experience. We know that without a large team and sufficient funds, creating an excellent indie game is full of challenges — we cannot guarantee that the game is perfect, but we can promise that every step is solid. We are willing to move every player who truly loves action games with our care in every detail. This time, we only want to focus on doing one thing well: creating a game that you are willing to spend time playing, share with friends, and revisit repeatedly.

       If you are looking forward to such a work that combines exploration, combat and warmth, we kindly ask you to add it to your Steam wishlist again. Every support from you is the greatest motivation for us to continue polishing; we also welcome your suggestions to make this game better together.

store_data.about_the_game:
LET THE REVELRY BEGIN!

Nakkash: A Miniature Adventure drops you into the heart of 17th-century Istanbul, right in the middle of the magnificent Ottoman festivities. But there’s a problem: the most precious ornaments of the Sultan’s giant Nahıl Treeare missing! The palace is in a frenzy, and the Bostancıbaşı is furious...

It falls to you, the Head Jester, to resolve this chaos. In this unique production where classical Ottoman miniature art (the Levni school) comes to life with modern game mechanics, you will visit guild tents, test your reflexes with different arcade games in each, and save the festival by recovering the lost pieces.

GUILDS AND CRAFTS

Each tent requires a different game mechanic and a unique mastery:

  • Guild of Bladesmiths: Showcase your timing and aiming skills against rotating targets.

  • Guild of Riders (Cündi): Feel the agility of Ottoman cavalry while leaping over obstacles on horseback.

  • Guild of Acrobats: Defy gravity, keep your balance, and reach the top without falling.

  • Guild of Fireworks & More: From rhythm to physics-based puzzles, a new surprise awaits you in every tent.

KEY FEATURES

  • A Living Museum: Through the vision of Hakan Yılmaz Studio and the craftsmanship of Umuro Game, static miniatures transform into a vibrant, interactive, and fun world for the first time.

  • Traditional Art, Modern Fun: Fast-paced and satisfying "Micro-game" mechanics in the style of WarioWaremeet historical texture.

  • A Cultural Bridge: A tough challenge for arcade enthusiasts and an interactive cultural tour for art lovers.

  • Hand-Drawn Visuals: A unique art direction entirely composed of collages from original miniatures.

Nakkash: A Miniature Adventure invites art, history, and gaming enthusiasts to an unprecedented festival in June 2026.

Fill your purse, find your balance, and become the hero of the festivities!

store_data.about_the_game:
Unmourned is a first-person psychological horror game where unsettling gameplay and a chilling story collide.

STORYLINE:

The unmourned are never at peace... and neither are you.

The story follows Jason, a man who moves into a new house and soon begins to experience disturbing paranormal activities. As he searches for answers, he is haunted by visions of the past, revealing a dark and tragic history tied to the previous owners. The family that once lived there mysteriously disappeared, and as Jason delves deeper into the house’s dark past, he uncovers a hidden door that reveals secrets meant to remain buried forever.

GAMEPLAY:

Transition between reality and visions as you're forced to experience haunting memories. Each shift reveals disturbing events, bringing you closer to the tragic story that ties the haunting to the house.

MECHANICS:

"Survive the darkness, or be consumed by it."

Unmourned features a set of mechanics designed to heighten the tension and terror of your experience:

  • Random Event System: Paranormal activities occur randomly throughout the house, ensuring no two experiences are the same. You never know what might happen next.

  • Sanity System: The longer you remain in the dark, the more your grip on reality weakens. As your sanity fades, the paranormal activity around you grows stronger, bringing you closer to the edge of insanity.

  • Night Vision Camera: A camera equipped with night vision, helping you navigate dark areas and escape lurking threats.

  • Photographic Camera: When the lights go out, the only way to uncover hidden truths is through the lens of your camera. Use it to reveal what the darkness conceals.

Diggin' It is a humorous upgrade-driven digging adventure where every shovel hit gets you closer to riches… or disaster.

Start with basic tools and a dream, then dig your way through. Along the way, you’ll unlock powerful upgrades, discover risky buffs, and rely on your faithful animal companions (Otto and Dea) to help you survive the depths.

🐾 You’re Not Digging Alone

Bring along your helpful (and sometimes chaotic) companions:

  • Your clever cat Otto.

  • Your loyal dog Dea.

They will gather all the resources that you find.

⚙️ Upgrade Everything

Turn your humble digging operation into a treasure-hunting powerhouse.

  • Improve tools

  • Improve bag

  • Dig Hard

  • Dig Deeper

  • Dig Faster

Every run lets you grow stronger and dig deeper.

Feeling lucky?

Find special buffs that give advantages… but come with hilarious and dangerous handicaps.

You might gain massive amounts of money while your vision blurs or other buff effects. Choosing when to take risks is key to mastering the depths.

It is time for the goblins to take over.

Every move on the grid counts as a turn. Plan your path before the difficulty scales up, and construct buildings on empty tiles to gain recruits, gold, or stats.

Combat is fully automatic.

Sit back and relax: Goblins Can Conquer is an auto-battler, so you can watch your horde fight the enemy, use special attacks, and cast powerful spells. Build a strong team to overwhelm the enemy.

Get stronger via the Skill Tree

Each match offers a Skill Tree to boost your goblins' stats, unlock bonuses, and more.

Grow your army

Each fight awards you a new random goblin: from the basic Goblin Commoner to the legendary Goblin Pyromancer!

The War Camp

Win or lose, don't stress it: you gain spoils every time you play. Use them to construct new structures in your War Camp, where your goblins relax after a hard day's work. Each building grants permanent bonuses or unlocks new features. You can even customize your in-game building loadout!

  • Grid exploration with turn-based mechanics

  • Buildings for bonuses and recruitment

  • Incremental stat scaling via the skill tree

  • 20+ unique goblin units, many unique spells and buildings

store_data.about_the_game:
Find Jumpscares and escape from the creepy looping building

In this location, a Jumpscare is defined as any of the following:

- Appears suddenly

- Approaches suddenly and rapidly

- Makes a loud noise

- Covers your entire field of vision

- Attacks you

Identify the jumpscares that appear and decide whether to go down the stairs to get to the ground floor

The types of jumpscares change randomly each time, with over 100 types, ranging from simple to hidden.

Explore and observe carefully to avoid missing the hidden jumpscares.

Some monsters will attack you, but don't worry, you have the legendary sword.

Story

You, who wielded the legendary sword "Scare Slayer," battle dangerous monsters that threaten all life in the world. Upon entering a building in a monster-infested village, you noticed something strange. No matter how many stairs you climbed, you seemed to return to the same floor. It appeared that the village monsters and the monsters you had previously defeated had been resurrected and had joined forces, attempting to imprison and destroy you with powerful magic. As you paced up and down the stairs, unsure of what to do, you suddenly stumbled upon a frame containing what appeared to be a clue to escaping the building. You had no idea who had placed it there or why, and it could be a trap, but your only option was to follow the instructions on the frame……

Warning

This game contains loud sounds and scare scenes.

If you feel tired while playing, take a break.

We cannot be responsible for any problems caused by playing this game.

About Streaming and uploading video

You can play this game live or upload videos at your own risk, and monetize those videos.

If possible, I would appreciate it if you could include a link to your store page in the description section

While exploring an abandoned industrial district you stumble across a mysterious, faceless building. Inside, among rusty shelving and forgotten folders, you find a dusty office. In the middle of the room sits an old IBM PS/2 computer that is still on. Its phosphor‑green screen blinks like a heartbeat from another era and the analog modem emits a periodic beep – someone or something seems to be waiting for input.

You have uncovered a portal to a digital past that was never meant to be reopened. Access the old terminal, explore its file system and interact with a text‑based interface reminiscent of DOS. Navigate corrupted files, decipher encrypted logs, access forbidden programs and uncover who — or what — was behind that screen. Every command you type reveals fragments of a buried story, one clue after another. A retro‑digital investigation where the only interface is you… and the truth lies hidden in a prompt that was never supposed to respond again.

Authors' note:

This "Retro terminal mystery" is a tiny personal project we put together over a weekend using Python, then enhanced and integrated into Unity. Don’t expect the game to guide you — there are no instructions, no tutorials. It’s up to you to observe, experiment, and figure things out. Your goal is to make sense of what you find on the computer: who used it, for what purpose, and what can still be done with it today. It doesn't aim to be anything fancy — it’s short, completely free, and we just hope you enjoy the experience :)

store_data.about_the_game:
BACKGROUND (REAL LIFE)

Please note that this game is being built as a "father daughter" project. My kid wants to be an AI Scientist and I thought this would be a good experiment to teach her about what GenAI can do today, how it may help humanity in the future, and how different computer mechanics today work together (software, audio, video, imagery, etc).

You will see a lot of similarities to Stardew Valley, Factorio, Starbound, Dwarf Fortress (her and my favorite games), but there is no chance this game would be anywhere near the quality/level of those games. I have a background in software engineering, but we don't have a team of top-notch veterans with years of experience in game development. We want to make a mini-playable game, but really this is about the making of the game itself.

The story, however, is pretty cool :)

THE GAME

You are Luma Hartwell, 25 years old, born aboard a ship you never chose. Three centuries ago, people you'll never meet decided what your life should look like -- the training you'd complete, the roles you'd fill, the challenges you'd face. None of it is natural. All of it is by design.

Your mother just passed away. The ship's recyclers are already processing her into nutrients for the gardens. In 750 years of voyage, sentiment cannot outweigh survival. Now it's just you, a ship full of people who knew her better than you did, and questions about your father that no one wants to answer.

So what do you do with a life someone else architected?

Build. Factory mechanics -- belts, inserters, circuits, materials -- but the factory is life support. Food production, atmosphere control, power systems. Inefficiency has human consequences.

Live. Enjoy your time aboard the ship or step into the Collective -- a virtual space where you can perform experimental research and building happens.

Connect. The people, and AI personalities, on your ship remember what you do and change over time. This isn't a quest log -- it's a community small enough that every person matters.

Discover. Learning what happened to your father takes you on a path of self-introspection.

A destination centuries away. A life designed by people long gone. What you make of it is up to you.

GAMEPLAY

The current idea is to have three core interwoven pillars: a fairly complex storyline that is not fully based on reality but fairly plausible, a factory simulation where players can harvest resources, manufacture goods, build production chains, and alter their ship and surrounding world, and finally, social interaction with other characters in the game which includes simulated humans and simulated AI "bots" (think Tesla's Optimus, but with personality).

Beyond the core factory loop of harvesting, crafting, and automating with belts, inserters, and circuits, players will manage maglev transport networks, ai bot guiding, power generation, fluid piping, farming, and logistics storage across multiple surfaces of the ship. The social side goes deeper than simple dialogue -- crew members have persistent memory, relationships, and reputation that evolve over time based on player decisions. Tying it all together is a generational narrative spanning 750 years and 7 generations aboard a colony ship, where the consequences of early choices ripple forward in ways players won't fully anticipate.

A NOTE ABOUT AI

We want to be upfront about AI usage in this project -- it is heavy. We use AI extensively for code assistance, game asset generation, voice synthesis, and more. It touches nearly every part of the development pipeline.

Beyond development, the game will actually ship with a local LLM (OpenHermes as of now, but that may change) running on the player's machine. This powers in-game dialogue generation and behavioral simulation, giving NPCs the ability to respond dynamically rather than through pre-written scripts.

That said, there is one area where AI was deliberately kept out: the game lore. The core plotlines, backdrop, and character arcs are entirely human-created. We do use AI to help fill in some narrative gaps and flesh out details, but the story itself -- the world, the characters, the choices that matter -- came from us. The reason is that the lore is part of our experience together -- asking ourselves what it means to get along with machines in the future, and how human tribalism evolves in the face of coexisting with semi-biological species that may not have real consciousness but are collectively more intelligent than all of humanity. This is something we talk about constantly, and it's the central theme across the entire game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Redshaw Valley is an RPG Adventure game that sees a group of friends race across time in an effort to thwart the evil mastermind Lotor. The story begins after the main characters best friend shows off her newest invention which goes wrong sending the group of friends into the future. This starts a chain of events taking the group of friends in an epic adventure to keep time from being re-written and restore it back to the way it was. Our main characters will earn experience and gather items to help them battle through the land wonderers and a few bosses along the way. As they gain experience they also gain gold which can be used to purchase items such as armour and weapons. The experience will also help you fight stronger and harder.

What makes Redshaw Valley unique is the mixture of Chibi style fully sized images of characters (not just the main ones either) and regular 2D playable characters. Add to that a great soundtrack and video animations and a good game becomes a great one. More and more unique features will be used in the future to bring this more to life and allow the player to feel the emotion behind what the characters are saying, rather than just reading the narrative.

Currently there is only the one game mode, however, it is planned to add a feature that allows a more choice based play once the main story is completed. The goal of the game, is for players to be thrown into the narrative and become part of the story. With the ability to play scenes from flashbacks adding a new dynamic to the way the story is told.

We hope you like the game and make sure you come visit us on our Discord page to give us some feed back.

This starts a chain of events taking the group of friends in an epic adventure to keep time from being re-written and restore it back to the way it was. Our main characters will earn experience and gather items to help them battle through the land wonderers and a few bosses along the way. As they gain experience they also gain gold which can be used to purchase items such as armour and weapons. The experience will also help you fight stronger and harder.

What makes Redshaw Valley unique is the mixture of Chibi style fully sized images of characters (not just the main ones either) and regular 2D playable characters. Add to that a great soundtrack and video animations and a good game becomes a great one. More and more unique features will be used in the future to bring this more to life and allow the player to feel the emotion behind what the characters are saying, rather than just reading the narrative.

Currently there is only the one game mode, however, it is planned to add a feature that allows a more choice based play once the main story is completed. The goal of the game, is for players to be thrown into the narrative and become part of the story. With the ability to play scenes from flashbacks adding a new dynamic to the way the story is told.

We hope you like the game and make sure you come visit us on our Discord page to give us some feed back.
store_data.short_description: Play along with the story on how a group of friends who unintentionally get sent to the future embark on a time-travelling journey to save the land known as Redshaw Valley. Collect items to be able to battle against enemies that roam the lands. Earn experience and collect gold along the way.
