store_data.about_the_game:
SILENCE IS BLINDNESS. SOUND IS DEATH.

You open your eyes, but see only impenetrable darkness. Your head is a void where memories once were, and an alien voice that knows more than it says.

RE:MEMBER is an atmospheric first-person horror game where normal vision is unavailable. The only way to navigate is echolocation. Every knock, step, or thrown object creates a visual wave that outlines the corridors and... those who inhabit them.

Your goal is to escape and reclaim your identity. But are you ready to discover the truth your past hides?

KEY FEATURES

1. SOUND VISUALIZATION

The game world is invisible. Use sound waves to "scan" your surroundings. Manage the noise level: quiet footsteps will provide little information but maintain stealth; A loud bang will illuminate the entire room, but will immediately attract attention.

2. SYMBIOSIS OR MADNESS?

You are not alone in your body. An entity has appeared within you. It grants you superhuman powers of perception and guides you, but who is it? The voice in your head can save your life or lead you into a trap. Trust it or resist it—it's up to you.

3. SMART ECOSYSTEM OF HORROR

Forget scripts. The enemies in the complex are blind but sensitive predators controlled by the adaptive AI system Stigma.

  • They listen: Monsters react to the slightest rustle.

  • They adapt: ​​If you hide too much, they will start checking for cover. If you run, they will ambush you.

  • They are unique: from the "Wanderers" patrolling the corridors to exotic monsters with their own unique logic.

PLOT

Waking up in a laboratory chamber, you realize you've lost your memory. All around you are the aftermath of a disaster: the bodies of staff and terrifying mutants. Your only connection to reality is a girl's voice on the radio and a terrifying whisper inside your own mind.

As you move deeper into the complex, you will discover fragments of your past. But with every step, with every use of your gift of echolocation, you will feel yourself changing.

RE:MEMBER is a story about what is more frightening: dying as a human or surviving by becoming something else.

Enter a magical world where knowledge is the greatest source of power!

In MIAUGICAL, you play as Lucy, a young witch apprentice who embarks on a journey to find her missing master. To do so, she will need to explore enchanted landscapes, discover ancient tomes of magic, and master increasingly powerful spells.

ABOUT THIS GAME ARALSK 7 is a psychological survival horror game set on the infamous Rebirth Island (Vozrozhdeniya).

STORY Daniyar, a young environmental science student, embarks on a dangerous expedition to the abandoned Aralsk-7 island. His mission is straightforward: collect soil and water samples to determine if this forgotten wasteland is fit for human life once again. But as he explores the decaying ruins, he discovers that some secrets were never meant to be unearthed.

KEY FEATURES

  • Investigation & Lore: Explore abandoned Soviet facilities, gathering documents, notes, and tapes that slowly reveal the island's tragic and horrific history.

  • Into the Depths: Locate the entrance to the pumping station and descend into the lower levels of a secret bunker to uncover the truth behind the experiments.

  • Survival Combat: Scavenge for ammo and medical supplies. You are not alone—prepare to face monstrous entities that now roam the shadows of the island.

  • Chilling Atmosphere: Experience a world where the grim silence of the Aral Sea and the encroaching darkness test your resolve to survive and discover the truth.

store_data.about_the_game:
Embark on a Journey Across the Stars

Step into the metallic shoes of a specialized android pilot serving the Spaceport Federation. In this meditative space odyssey, the destination is important, but the journey is everything.

Leave the frantic rush of the galaxy behind. Whether you’re cruising through nebula clouds or orbiting a distant moon, this is a space simulation designed for those who appreciate a slower, more reflective pace. Feel the hum of your engines and the vast emptiness of the cosmos as you carve out your career among the stars.

Choose Your Path

The Federation has plenty of work for a reliable pilot. How you spend your time in the cockpit is up to you:

  • Freight & Logistics: Transport vital cargo across star systems.

  • Passenger Transport: Ensure travelers reach their destinations safely and comfortably.

  • Resource Scanning: Descend toward mysterious planets to scan for rare materials.

  • Arcade Combat: Defend your ship and Federation interests in engaging, retro-style dogfights.

Fly, Earn, Upgrade

Every successful mission puts credits in your pocket. As you build your reputation with the Spaceport Federation, you’ll move from humble scout ships to massive, powerful spacecraft.

  • Progressive Fleet: Unlock ships with larger cargo holds, better passenger facilities, and tougher hulls.

  • The Android Experience: Experience the galaxy through the eyes of a synthetic being dedicated to the mission.

Features

  • Atmospheric Exploration: A focus on the "feeling" of space travel and discovery.

  • Variety of Gameplay: Seamlessly switch between peaceful hauling and action-packed encounters.

  • Simple yet Deep: Easy-to-pick-up controls with a rewarding progression system.

  • Zen-like Pace: Perfect for players who want to relax and lose themselves in the void.

The stars are calling. Are you ready to take the helm?

Free DLCs included

As of March, 2026 the game includes the first free DLC: enjoy the standalone Unit 098 story with:

  • 4 new mission types: Land combat, asteroid mining, building construction, probe recovery

  • New ships: 10 new ships

  • More achievements: 11 new achievements

As of April, 2026 we added the second free DLC to complete the android trilogy: Unit 099 is the last of his kind.

  • 3 new mission types: Bombing, Beacon Destroy, Signal Interception

  • New ship: 1 new ship

  • More achievements: 6 new achievements

  • Credit-less economy

4405240.name: The Door at the End of the Hall

store_data.about_the_game:
Trapped in a looping hallway, you must study subtle changes to choose the right doors. Each passage resets the hall, but slightly wrong. Observe carefully, make smart choices, and uncover the path that unlocks the mysterious door at the end of the hall.

Each time you step through a door, you find yourself back at the beginning. Something always changes. An item out of place. A detail that doesn’t belong. A feeling that the hall itself is watching to see if you notice.

The Door at the End of the Hall is a first-person, 3D psychological observation/anomaly finder game where progress depends on attention, intuition, and memory. You must choose between multiple doors, using subtle environmental clues to determine which path leads you closer to escape and which ones pull you deeper into the loop.

At the far end of the hallway stands a locked door.

To reach it, you’ll need to understand the rules of the hall, recognize what’s wrong, and learn how your choices shape each repetition. Every pass through the corridor tests your perception, rewarding careful observation, and punishing assumptions.

There is no guessing. Every change is deterministic and can be solved. The space changes when you aren’t looking—and dares you to notice.

Will you find the path that finally lets you leave?

Estimated Play Time

For a single, complete run: ~15 - 30 minutes

Including the post-game completionist mode: ~45m - 1hr

✔ Endless blame potential

store_data.about_the_game:
⚡ Read This First: Is This Game for You?

  • Players who love the crisp sensation of "popping bubble wrap" or are obsessed with organizing colors like a Rubik's Cube.
  • Players who want to sneak in a quick game on a corner of their screen while "slacking off" at work.
  • Impatient players who reject tedious grinding: No slow intros, no complex systems to learn—just jump in and play.
  • Minimalists: Players who dislike excessive visual effects and clutter, seeking only core gameplay.
  • Players with poor internet connections (or completely offline) who want a quick session during fragmented free time.
  • Fans of Chibi (Q-style) art and Match-3 games.

🎮 Game Introduction

This is an "Arcade-Style" Match-3 game that returns to the essence of gaming.
SanGuo Tactics: Touch to Match abandons tedious meta-progression, focusing entirely on the strategic deck-building of generals and the satisfying manipulation of 2x2 blocks.

There are no stats locked behind endless grinding, nor are there complex equipment systems.
As a pure premium indie game, you only need to move your fingers, stack blocks, and tap to eliminate them. Accompanied by crisp sound effects, watch as your army of Chibi soldiers rushes like a tide towards the enemy, enjoying a pure dopamine rush!

✨ Core Features


🧠 Pure Strategy: Team Building is Deck Building
No outside upgrades! No grinding for levels!
Strategy is entirely reflected in your "Pre-match Preparation." The game uses a unique "Pick 5 from 9" mechanic:
There are 9 types of blocks in the game (6 troop types + 3 special items), but in a single match, the board will only feature 5 types.
Which 5? It depends entirely on the Generals you bring!

Want to play a Cavalry Rush? You must bring Cavalry Generals so Cavalry blocks will appear on the board.
Want to play Defensive? Bring Shield and Fire Attack Generals to increase your base HP and prepare fire torches to burn your opponent.
General Traits: Generals not only determine block types but also buff their respective troops or unlock special artifacts.
All strategic decisions are made the moment you click "Start Game." The rest is a contest of pure skill and a bit of luck.

👆 Unique Feel: The Art of 2x2 Synthesis
This isn't just simple matching; it's spatial magic.
Your ultimate goal is to synthesize "2x2 Big Blocks" and tap to eliminate them. Different big blocks have different effects: summoning troops to charge, restoring morale, healing, setting fires, or even resetting the entire board!

No Dead Ends: Unlike traditional Match-3 games, all small blocks can be clicked to eliminate them. You can clear small blocks to adjust the layout and pave the way for big blocks.
Manual Trigger: The synthesized big blocks must be clicked by you to activate. It is you, not the system, who decides the timing of the burst!
Gravity Control: You can change the direction of gravity (Up, Down, Left, Right) at any time, using physics to create opportunities.

⚔️ Battlefield Tactics: Counters & Morale
Elimination is just the means; victory is the goal. This game recreates the pressure of a real battlefield:

Unit Counters: There are clear counter relationships between different troop types. Observe the enemy lineup and use counters to turn the tide even when outnumbered.
Battle Line Pressure: There is a dynamic "Battle Line" in the center. If the line is pushed past the center by the enemy for too long, your morale will drop continuously, making the situation critical.
Morale Determines Production: Morale directly affects the number of troops generated! When morale is high, clearing a big block summons more soldiers; if morale is low, troop production drops, making a comeback much harder.

🧑‍🎨 About the Developer & AI Statement

A Tribute to Classics:
This game pays homage to the classic Symbian era game "Point & Click Three Kingdoms" (指点三国), hoping to bring back the pure joy of playing anytime, anywhere.

Portable & DRM-Free:
For this convenient experience, this game is completely DRM-Free and does not force Steam online checks.
You can play completely offline (no fear of bad internet), or even copy the game to a USB drive, carry it with you, plug it into any computer, and play instantly.

🤖 About AI Technology:
Due to the limited energy and budget of a solo developer, the art assets in this project were generated using AI technology.

Final Words:
As a small-scale game made by a single person, it may not be perfect, nor does it have flashy visual effects, but I have poured my heart into the core gameplay.
If there are any design flaws, I ask for your understanding, My Lords. I hope it brings a smile to your face. Thank you for every click and your support!

store_data.about_the_game:
Pixel Airport Tycoon is an airport construction and management simulation game in which you design, build, and run your own airport.

Build your infrastructure
Construct terminals, runways, taxiways, and aprons. Place fuel stations, baggage handling facilities, and catering depots to ensure smooth airport operations.

Manage your operations
Fuel trucks refuel aircraft, baggage carts deliver luggage, and catering vehicles supply passengers. All vehicles navigate intelligently across your road network.

Research and expand
Unlock new buildings and technologies, construct larger runways for wide-body aircraft, and expand your airport grounds with additional zones.

Economy and finance
Earn money through aircraft handling, parking garages, and hotels. Take out bank loans to grow faster. Keep track of income and expenses with detailed statistics.

Safety first
Secure your premises with fences and make sure your airport meets safety standards before the first aircraft are allowed to land.

Features:

Airport Construction

25+ Building Types — Terminals, runways, taxiways, fuel stations, hotels, parking garages, fire stations, security buildings, and more.
3 Runway Sizes — Small, medium, and large runways for different aircraft classes.
4 Terminal Levels — From a simple terminal to a large-scale terminal with interior customization.
Terminal Interior Design — Place check-in counters, gates, security checkpoints, shops, restaurants, and restrooms inside your terminals.
Free Placement — Build on a large grid with rotation and expansion areas.
Land Purchase — Expand your airport by buying additional land.

Two Airport Types

Commercial Airport — Terminals, passengers, cargo traffic, and full infrastructure.

Private Propeller Airfield — Small runways, private parking positions, and propeller aircraft — a compact entry option without requiring terminals.

Flight Operations

3 Aircraft Classes — Small, medium, and large passenger aircraft with different requirements.
Cargo Aircraft — Dedicated cargo terminals and cargo parking positions.
Propeller Aircraft — Private light aircraft for the propeller airfield.
Arrivals & Departures — Runways can be individually configured for arrivals, departures, or both.
Landing Queue — Track incoming aircraft in real time.

Economy & Management

Dynamic Fuel Pricing System — Prices fluctuate daily between $4,000 and $12,000 with trend mechanics, bar charts, and color-coded indicators.
Multiple Revenue Streams — Passenger fees, fuel fees, baggage handling, catering, cargo services, hotel and parking income, terminal shops.
Banking System with Loans — Take out loans ($250k / $500k / $1M) with interest and daily repayments.
Research System — Unlock new buildings, vehicles, and upgrades via a research tree.
Statistics — Daily and total flights, income/expense breakdown, and financial balance charts.

Vehicles & Logistics

Fuel Trucks — Transport fuel from the depot to aircraft.
Baggage Carts — Deliver luggage between terminal and aircraft.
Catering Vehicles — Supply aircraft with food and services.
Cargo Transporters — Handle cargo aircraft for additional income.
Buses & Cars — Decorative and functional traffic within the airport grounds.

Rating Systems

Passenger Rating (6 Stars) — Improve your rating with hotels, parking garages, catering, baggage handling, bus stops, and more.
Security Rating (4 Stars) — Build fences, fire stations, security buildings, and windsocks to maximize safety.
Administration Building — Required for passenger and cargo operations.

Day/Night Cycle

Dynamic Time of Day — Visual transition between day and night.
Daily Events — Fuel prices change, income is calculated, loans are repaid.

User Interface

Clear HUD — Money, passengers, ratings, security, fuel prices, and game time at a glance.
First Steps Checklist — Step-by-step guidance for beginners.
Notification System — Log messages for income, price changes, and important events.
Comprehensive Help System — Full guide with controls, building explanations, and beginner tips.
Right-Click Context Menus — Manage and configure buildings directly via right-click.
Zoom & Camera Controls — Mouse wheel zoom and camera movement via WASD, arrow keys, or screen edge scrolling.

Saving & Options

Multiple Save Slots — Save and load different airports.
Bilingual — Fully playable in German and English.
Customizable Controls — Toggle screen-edge scrolling on or off.
3 Game Speeds — Pause, 1x, 2x, and 4x speed.

  • Polishing: Includes skinning, grinding, and final polishing. Process rough stones into finished jewelry.

  • Identification: Learn to distinguish natural jadeite from treated imitations. Understand how flaws, cracks, and inclusions affect market price.

  • Progression: Sell finished products to accumulate funds. Upgrade equipment and purchase higher-grade raw stones.

store_data.about_the_game:
Link Empire is a hexagon grid-based real-time strategy game. Unlike most traditional RTS games with a high barrier to entry, this game completely removes micromanagement and focuses on simplifying gameplay, allowing you to experience the pure joy of commanding forces!

Simplified Development

  • Build resource structures to automatically gather resources—no complex worker allocation or management needed.

  • Set unit production in barracks to automate the creation of specific units. No more worrying about forgetting to train units!

  • No complicated tech tree. As long as you have enough resources, you can immediately produce advanced units.

Simplified Controls

  • Link two nodes to move forcesfrom one to another. Units will automatically pathfind, engage enemies, and fight—all without manual input.

  • Worried the battlefield might be too vast to keep track of? No problem. Switch to the strategic view anytime for a God’s-eye perspective and manage the entire game easily.

  • Send forces to enemy nodes. Once your forces eliminate all enemy units and structures, you’ll capture the node. Occupy all nodes, and you win!

Other Features

  • Dozens of unique unit can be unlocked outside, freely compose, and led to battle under your command.

  • Multiple AI lords with varied personalities—some foolish and slow, others cunning and cruel.

  • 30 different map levels await your challenge.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Story

Deep within a top-secret underground facility on floor B9, you have successfully developed the vaccine for the zombie virus. Immediately after, the facility is overrun by the infected. Your mission is clear: Protect the vaccine and reach the rescue helicopter on the surface.

Game Play

Minus Nine is a survival shooter that combines classic arcade action with the strategic depth of a roguelite, presented in a Top-down Isometric View.

  • Explore to Survive Your journey begins at -9F. The layout of the facility changes every run through procedural generation. Utilize the isometric perspective to plan your route and locate hidden Generators in the dark. Only when full power is restored will the elevator gates to the next floor unlock.

  • Strategic Combat & Upgrades Ammo and health are scarce resources. Eliminate the zombie hordes and extract "Bio-Samples" from them. Use these samples at the Rest Area—the elevator between floors—to upgrade your Damage, Health, Ammo Capacity, and Speed.

  • Death and Rebirth Death is part of the process. If you fall to the infected, you will lose your gear and wake up back at -9F. But do not give up. Your skills and experience are the only keys to escaping this hell.

Key Features

  • Procedural Generation: A constantly changing labyrinth with randomized enemy spawns.

  • Isometric Action: Tactical top-down gameplay that requires precise aiming and positioning.

  • Upgrade System: Enhance 4 core stats (Health, Damage, Ammo, Speed) using Bio-Samples.

  • Intense Atmosphere: Dark underground environments, dynamic line-of-sight mechanics, and immersive sound design.

Learn Spanish or... Die!

The bird is no longer asking. In this first-person horror experience, you must master Español to escape a procedurally generated nightmare. Answer correctly to survive, or let Polly Glot make you her final lesson.

About This Game

Forget your daily streak, now you’re playing for your life.

Learn Spanish or... Die! is a heart-pounding survival horror game that turns language learning into a literal deathmatch. Trapped in a shifting labyrinth of retro-style corridors, you are hunted by Polly Glot, the unhinged mascot of a language app gone wrong. She doesn't want your money, she wants your fluency... and maybe your soul.

The Core Loop: Study or Suffer

To escape each level, you must locate 5 quizzes throughout the maze. You aren’t allowed to leave the screen until you get the answer right.

Key Features:

  • Linguistic Progression: Start with the basic words, and finally attempt to master useless phrases that might just save your life.

  • Procedural Nightmares: No two runs are the same. Our generation ensures a fresh, connected maze of terror every time you hit "Start."

  • Retro Aesthetic: Experience 90s-style raycast graphics featuring animated sprites and a gritty, lo-fi atmosphere.

  • Adaptive Difficulty: Polly Glot is a persistent hunter.

  • High-Stakes Learning: Success yields the sweet sound of progress and failure greets you with a jump scare and a game over.

Will you become fluent, or will you become a statistic?

Download Learn Spanish or... Die! and start your last lesson today.

store_data.about_the_game:
You have been chosen to study at the Fernhoof Academy, known for their jumping focused trainer program. Ride lessons to expand your knowledge and put your skills to the test in riding exams. Read up on equine theory to earn an A+ on your tests. Gain practical experience by training horses to improve their skills. If you wish to reach graduation, follow the designed degree and prove your expertise to the instructors.

    

Own horses and look after them at the academy stables. Prepare for training with satisfying horse care brushing and filling feed buckets. Adjust to your taste by taking on extra care jobs or outsourcing all of it to stable hands. Watch your equine friends show their appreciation for getting pampered.

    

Jump a course in the arena, gallop in the cross country fields or go for a relaxed bareback trail ride. The in-depth riding mechanics draw inspiration from real riding, including canter leads, realistic striding on jumps and preserving the horse's energy on a course. Tailor how you ride each horse based on their temperament and skills. Choose your preference to ride in third or first person.

    

Riding the training exercises with accuracy and good timing greatly affects how the horse learns from them. Getting the most out of a training session is not about repetition, but sharpening your own skills and directing the horse's limited focus on good execution. Help your own and client horses reach their full potential, and prove yourself in show jumping and cross country competitions.

    

Design training routines using the handy builder. Place riding patterns such as voltes and serpentines to practice agility and strength, or focus on jumping with a custom show jumping course. Collaborate with the community by sharing routines using easy text input.

    

Shop for new horses or sell yours at the Hightrail Horse Market. Keep an eye on their daily changing themes and choose the next member of the herd from a wide variety of looks and backgrounds. Go for a quick test ride at the market's arena before making a decision.

    

Visit the academy's own Tiny Tack Shop to purchase new items to your collection. Give each of your horses a unique look in the tack room by customizing their tack set and styling their mane, tail and forelock separately.

Desktop Cats brings a cute and lively experience to your desktop with a world full of 3D cats. Using only your mouse, you can feed, pet, name your cats and watch them walk, sleep, eat, drink, and play through charming animations. Solve Murder Cases

Investigate ten crime scenes set in a 17th-century maritime world.
Examine each scene carefully and determine how the death occurred and why.
Every case stands on its own, yet all are connected by a larger, unfolding story.

Search for Clues

Inspect objects, solve puzzles, search inventories, and explore letters to uncover key information, allowing you to reconstruct what happened in each scene.
Each clue adds context to the case.

Solve Riddles

Tackle a variety of logic puzzles woven into the investigation. Decode messages, restore documents, and piece together clues to uncover new information and move the case forward.

Identify Suspects

Work like a detective to identify each suspect.
Determine who is who, map their relationships to one another, and uncover the role each person played in the events of the case.

Reconstruct the Story

Reconstruct the events of each scene using the clues you have collected.
Connect the dots across scenes to form a larger story and reveal the full mystery.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE DESCENT

Trapped in a failing deep-sea diving bell, you descend to uncover the fate of a missing expedition. The crushing depth is relentless. Your systems are failing... and something is hunting you.

THE EXPEDITION

The ocean floor was supposed to be empty.

Your sonar tells a different story - movement in the darkness, shapes outside the viewport, signals that shouldn’t exist.

Piece together the expedition’s final moments through scattered logs, recovered data, and fragmented communications. Every dive reveals more... and the deeper you go, the worse it gets.

SURVIVE THE PRESSURE

Power. Oxygen. Temperature. Every system draws from the same failing supply.

Make impossible choices. Descend deeper each time.
Kill the power and sit in darkness - or keep your systems running and draw the creature closer.

Communication with the surface is unreliable. Instructions arrive in fragments. Long silences stretch between transmissions. You’re on your own.

GAMEPLAY

  • Narrative-driven survival horror set entirely inside a single diving bell

  • System-driven survival gameplay with resource and risk management

  • Story delivered through degraded communications and recovered expedition data

  • Approximately 90 minutes of tense, atmospheric gameplay

The Diving Bell is currently in active development. Visuals and features shown are being refined and improved as development progresses.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE APARTMENT LIES

The Apartment Lies is a first person anomaly horror game that challenges your perception, memory, and nerves. You are trapped inside a seemingly ordinary apartment building, but with each step forward, the environment subtly changes. Your task is simple in theory, yet terrifying in practice: spot what is wrong and choose the correct door to survive.

Gameplay Overview

The game is built around observation and decision making. As you move through the apartment, objects, rooms, and details may change without warning. A painting might be different. Furniture could be missing. Lights may behave strangely. Some anomalies are obvious. Others are barely noticeable.

If you detect a change, you must choose the correct door to progress. If you fail to notice an anomaly or make the wrong decision, the game reacts. Sometimes slowly. Sometimes instantly.

There is no safe routine. Every run keeps you guessing.

Psychological Horror and Real Fear

The Apartment Lies blends two forms of horror.

Psychological horror builds tension over time. Subtle visual changes, distorted sound, and the constant feeling of being watched create unease and paranoia. You begin to question your own memory and attention.

Real horror strikes without warning. Sudden jumpscares, disturbing events, and violent encounters can occur at any moment. Blood and explicit horror elements are used deliberately to shock and punish mistakes.

You never know when the game will stay quiet or when it will turn against you.

Observation Is Survival

Not every anomaly is dramatic. Some are intentionally subtle. Others are aggressive and unmistakable. Learning to slow down, observe carefully, and trust your instincts is the only way forward.

The environment itself becomes the enemy. Familiar spaces grow hostile. What felt safe moments ago may no longer be.

Features

  • First person anomaly horror gameplay

  • Strong focus on observation and memory

  • Psychological horror mixed with intense jumpscares

  • Unpredictable events and anomalies

  • Multiple endings based on player decisions

  • Short but intense play sessions with high replay value

    Content Warning

    This game contains jumpscares, blood, disturbing imagery, and psychological stress. It is not recommended for sensitive players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Alive Hunter 2 is a third person shooter, open world game with cinematic narrative, it's a direct sequel of Alive Hunter (2019)

Steve Wilson a ex criminal tried to live a life being a police officer, he meet a girl named miya, his police partner, but things aren't easy, steve left the job and got involved on something bigger, he find his twin broher, who proven being a psychophat, Steve has to murder his own brother, years after that events, Steve is older and angrier, after Meeting his long time partner miya, he must enter a new world: the futuristic metropolis of neo rumbler city.

He find that his brother is somehow alive and a bigger treat have appeared, the major of the city, a cruel ambicious man with a montain of a ego.

Many treats will close Steve path and way more questions pop up on a completely New adventure that will Challenge the thoughts of Steve and the players, on this journey that IS the last hunt and the epic conclusion of Steve's tale.


PEAK GAMEPLAY 

Alive Hunter 2 made a Lot of improvements on the gameplay, new freatures, combat mechanics and world exploration.

 The Game now have more playable characters, not just reskin, these characters have unique gameplay mechanics and now they work together with Steve with combined attacks and allies system.

A new city is presented, neo rumbler city is full of buildings and a lot of vertical exploration adding another layer of exploration.

NO BULSHIT SEQUEL

so, this is like the sequels released recently, that actually feel like a shitty DLC for a Full price?

No fucking way. This one is like the old games where sequel actually mean something, this is big, Very different that the First game, it's not a complement of the First game, this is the change of everything.

THE ZERO "A" GAME

Cute, now we have AAAA games, but guess what? this one is the zero A game.

Game made entirely by one person, original assets, zero budget, This game come to prove that games are about ideas not about money.

Made by a player for the players, let's beat the triple A industry, let's turn them into ashes and start the New era of games, games without ceo's and bureaucracy.

EMBRACE THE HUNT 

Alive Hunter 2 is a climax from beginning to the end, designed to impact and delivery the most epic journey ever.

Do not fear the hunt, be a part of it.

Let's fucking go.

-

CREATED AND DEVELOPED BY ARMANDO RODRIGUES 

With the great voices of

The Shattered Exile, Valerie Macias, Beau Sterling and John Becker

store_data.about_the_game:
🧠 How to Play 🧠

Listen carefully to each sound and type your answer in the text field.

If you get it wrong, don’t worry: certain incorrect answers trigger hints meant to guide you without taking away the joy of discovery, and sometimes just to create a small connection and bring you a smile.

Some levels simply ask you to identify a sound, while others are deductive puzzles: I’ll ask you a question, and you’ll have to listen closely to find the right answer. Use reasoning, context, and a pinch of intuition.

And remember, you don’t have to know everything.

Feel free to ask a friend, search online, or even consult ChatGPT.

What matters is having fun.

🔍 Main Features 🔍

🎵 More than one hundred sounds

🧩 Deductive levels that combine listening and logic

💡 Hints triggered by specific wrong answers

👫 Bring in friends to help you solve puzzles, like when we played together as kids

🔊 A clean, minimal interface designed to let the sound take the spotlight

🗿 Game Philosophy 🗿

Guess the Sound is a small personal project, created by a single developer with a lot of passion and curiosity for the world of sounds. 🎧

It’s not a game made to chase numbers or profit, it’s something I wanted to share because I love the idea that a simple sound can make someone smile, wonder, or spark an intuition.

Each level is a small, handcrafted puzzle designed to stimulate perception, logic, and creativity. No pressure, no judgment.

I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed creating it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chess meets Poker. Strategy meets risk. Every move is a bet.

Welcome to a tactical board game where chess combat, poker hands, and high-stakes betting collide. Each Odyssey is an 8 round run where smart positioning, clever captures, and bold poker plays determine how rich, or ruined, you become.

Capture enemy pieces to earn money, build poker hands from your cards and the board, and decide when to play it safe or push your luck. The deeper you go, the higher the stakes and the bigger the rewards.

Tactical Board Combat

• Capture enemy pieces to earn money

• Each piece has a unique value. Risk high captures for massive payouts

• Lose pieces and you may lose future opportunities

Poker-Driven Strategy

• Build poker hands using your cards and community cards

• Win your opponent’s winnings by outplaying them at the table

• Rare hands and smart timing can swing an entire run

High-Risk, High-Reward Betting

• Bets increase every round

• Capture streaks boost rewards but getting caught resets your multiplier

• Sometimes letting the enemy capture you is the smarter play

Odyssey Runs & Bonuses

• 8 rounds per Odyssey with escalating difficulty

• Earn powerful bonuses for fast wins, clean boards, and perfect runs

• Every Odyssey has its own strategy and optimal path

Designed for Replayability

• No two runs play the same

• Multiple viable strategies: aggressive, defensive, or deceptive

• Chase high scores across different categories

Outthink your opponent, outplay the board and know when to fold.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Infinity of Merrienight The year is 1920. While the ashes of war are still cold, Merrieland has lost itself in its own silence. Detective Marceline Richenwinnier embarks on a quest through the labyrinths of the mind and the city. Her goal is to reach the dark heart of Merrienight. Who is Lost? Is it the streets of Merrieland or the reflection in the mirror, Marceline? Whose Salvation? Is it Marceline who must escape this labyrinth, or this ancient realm she is trapped in? Protect Your Essence. Merrienight is no ordinary darkness; it targets our very essence, seeking to digest us in its own infinity.

Gameplay Features

·         Open World Survival: Explore the distorted streets of Merrieland. Scavenge for resources and fight against hostile creatures and enemies to survive the haze.

·         Action & Mystery: Engage in combat with entities blocking your path while uncovering the secrets of a world that functions like a complex puzzle.

·            The Puzzle of Merrienight: Marceline finds herself trapped in a riddle she didn’t create. Solve environmental and narrative puzzles to progress toward the heart of the mystery.

store_data.about_the_game:
Roars of the hellish minions deafen you as you try to simply focus.  As you feel iron steel blades stabbing you in the back and rat claws shredding your thighs, you feel your life dwindle down.  Your eyes become blurry as an inner rage flows through you to release massive electricity flowing through your fingers and into the crowd of vile vermin that surround you!  You see a revitalizing health potion floating your way as you fall to your knees gasping in pain.  Is the potion simply a mirage or is it real?  More importantly, even if it is real, will it reach you in time as you take your very last gasp?

What happens to you when your mobility is completely left to the wind?  Use only two keys to control your weapon direction in a 360 degree orbit while vile and dangerous dungeon baddies surround you!  In this realm, you will definitely die, but what kind of impression will you leave before you take your very last breath?

One life is all you have in this game that starts off simple enough but quickly demands your quick reflexes and wise character building choices.  In the heat of the action, only two keys are required.  Rotate left and Rotate right.  It can't be that hard to survive with only two keys that will determine whether you live or die, right?

Orbital Peril is a casual old-school adventure game with unique twists and turns that doesn't allow you any mobility control of your character.  Without being able to move your character to escape, your aim becomes much more critical as does the choices that you make as to exactly how you upgrade and develop your character as you progress through your game.

The game will feature thousands of possible character builds, dozens of different mobs, as well as many different powers to take the enemies out.  With all the different possibilities with the way you develop your character every game combined with the randomness of your characters movement, no two games should ever be the same!

store_data.about_the_game:
Shoot functions. Find intersections. Earn money.

In Lines Must Cross, every click spawns a mathematical function onto a living coordinate system. When your shot intersects the target function, it generates money, the farther from the origin the intersection occurs, the higher the reward.

Intersections don’t happen by chance alone.

Expanding the grid increases the space where valuable intersections can occur. Unlocking new function types raises the chance of multiple intersections per click. Every upgrade shifts the balance between reliability, reach, and reward.

Over time, a simple graph turns into a complex system.

What starts as a single line grows into layered functions, wider coordinate ranges, and richer intersection patterns.

Lines Must Cross is a calm, system-driven game about visual math, intuition, and growth. It rewards understanding over speed and curiosity over reflexes.

store_data.about_the_game:
DEADRIFT is a fast-paced, Immersive sci-fi shooter set inside a secret underground research facility. What was once humanity’s greatest scientific breakthrough teleportation has become its most terrifying mistake.

Scientists created a powerful blue serum to fuel the teleportation system, a substance capable of releasing unimaginable energy. But when it entered the human bloodstream, the serum began rewriting DNA, warping bodies into grotesque mutations and erasing all trace of sanity. One catastrophic failure was all it took for the entire facility to descend into chaos.

The experiment failed. The facility has fallen into decay, its corridors crawling with what should not exist. Every shadow watches. Every sound could be your last.

A Facility in Ruins

Explore a vast underground complex filled with laboratories, medical wards, containment zones, and teleportation chamber. Each location tells a story of ambition, failure, and the price of forbidden science.

Mutated Nightmares

The blue serum has turned scientists and test subjects into relentless creatures. Some attack in swarms, others hunt from the dark, and some have evolved into terrifying abominations with deadly abilities.

Fight to Stay Alive

Search for weapons, ammunition, and experimental technology as you push deeper into the facility. Resources are scarce, enemies are everywhere, and survival is never guaranteed.

store_data.about_the_game:
28 days ago, you got the call - your brother’s checkpoint had fallen. Now it’s surrounded by the dead.

He’s not like you. He’s a scientist, chasing a cure.

You’ve spent your life as a cop - fighting, surviving.

Now, to save him, you’ll need a reinforced ride and a plan to hand your own checkpoint over to the U.S. Army.

You’re the last surviving soldier at the only checkpoint still standing in the north of the city.
Your mission: save as many uninfected civilians as you can. If you let the infected slip out of Chicago, the entire world could fall. Hold the line. Buy more weapons and upgrade your defenses. The Army promises to arrive in 30 days - then comes the raid. You’ll fight your way through the ruins of Chicago to reach your brother… and try to save him at any cost.

Make cold, calculated decisions.

Every survivor has a story - and they’ll tell it to you. But don’t believe everything you hear. Inspect each one carefully and decide their fate.
Will you let them pass? Hold them for a second screening? Or are they too far gone - and need to be eliminated?
The choice is yours.

Gameplay

First-person gameplay that blends inspection sim and zombie action.

Screen refugees with a full-body scanner and other tools to detect signs of infection.

Decide each refugee’s fate: clear them to leave Chicago, hold them in a quarantine room for observation, or eliminate them.

Head out from the base to clear infested zones.

Earn cash to buy weapons and repair your car for the toughest raid across a ruined Chicago.

Tools

Use special gear to find out if a survivor is infected or smuggling contraband. Personal inspections, scanners, and a range of devices will help you.
So will a good shotgun.

Zombies

Zombie waves grow stronger by the day. Crawlers, Spitters, Aggressors, Marine Zombies… A good shotgun helps. But not always.

Preparing for the Raid

Repair your car and get it ready for the brutal run through Chicago to your brother’s checkpoint.
Save him—no matter the cost.

store_data.about_the_game:
Real gears that don’t slip in a physics sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, solve physics-based puzzles, fuse structures with superglue into stable mechanisms, and engineer intricate contraptions, precision machines, and complex mechanical systems. 

Build real mechanical systems in a physics sandbox where gears truly work.

Design precision machines, engineer complex mechanisms, and experiment with motion, force, sensors, and logic. From simple contraptions to intricate mechanical systems, everything is built from parts you control.

Real gears that transmit motion and force without slipping.

Teeth count, size, and bevel angles are fully customizable, allowing precise mechanical systems.

Resize parts freely to fit your design.

Shapes, gears, and components can be stretched and scaled without breaking physics.

No grid. No restrictions.

Place parts anywhere and build machines exactly the way you imagine.

Follow instruction kits to assemble complex machines step-by-step.

Perfect for learning the systems and building intricate creations.

Challenge your creativity and problem solving skills with engaging mechanical puzzles that push your engineering limits.

Personalize and fine tune every detail of your machines to build truly unique and innovative designs.

Achieve fast, smooth rotations and optimize your machines for powerful, high speed operation.

Fuse parts into a single stable structure with Super Glue.

Unlike traditional physics joints, fused structures stay rigid and stable even in large and complex machines.

Build intelligent machines using sensors, relays, and full logic gates.

Detect distance, motion, and signals to control mechanical systems, create programmable computers, and automate complex mechanisms.

Analog signals allow smooth control and dynamic systems.

Build regulators, oscillators, and mechanical control circuits.

A stormy night. A remote mountain cabin.
Someone is watching you.

A masked killer stalks the area and reacts to sound, light, and movement.
No combat. No second chances. Survival is about staying unseen, keeping calm, and making the right call under pressure.

Survive by mastering

  • Noise: every action matters — loud mistakes draw attention

  • Light: your flashlight can save you… or expose you

  • Movement: sprinting is risky; careful steps keep you alive

  • Hiding: when you’re spotted, you’re already behind

Designed for one intense sitting (60–90 minutes) — escalating tension, no filler, no downtime.

  • Stealth built around sound, light, and movement

  • Reactive enemy behavior and search patterns

  • Minimal HUD with real-time noise/visibility feedback

  • Interactive cinematic moments

Absorber is a tactical roguelike where you play as a digital consciousness fighting through a corrupted mainframe. Position yourself on a 7x7 grid, absorb enemies to fuel your abilities, and climb through 12+ increasingly hostile sectors to reach the core.

Every move matters. Every resource counts. Every death is permanent.

Features

  • Permadeath: High stakes, high rewards

  • Strategic Depth : 60+ programs with synergies

  • Progressive Difficulty: 12 sectors with scaling challenges

  • Boss Battles : Unique miniboss and boss encounters

  • Shop System : Buy programs, reroll inventory, swap slots

  • Identity System : Absorb enemies to gain their abilities

  • Multiple Languages : English, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese

store_data.about_the_game:
When you tell your girlfriend you want to break up, she refuses to accept it.  Is your resolve strong enough to become single or will you cave and stay together?  A 30-minute visual novel - Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

In this 30-minute visual novel (the length of a sitcom episode), your only goal is to break up with your girlfriend.  Easier said than done because sometimes breaking up is hard to do!

State Your Case

Your girlfriend Trish is going to want to know why you're ending things.  Are you prepared to say the hard truths?  Or are you going to try to let her down easy?

Don't Back Down

If you don't stick to your guns, she might just guilt you into staying together.  Time to put your foot down if you want to break up

Don't Look Back

She'll try everything in the book to make you stay.  Don't fall for it - hold your head up high and walk out that door single

Short and Sweet (or maybe Not-So-Sweet)

This family-friendly, 30-minute game is inspired by sitcom episodes where the character tries to break-up with a partner but finds it more difficult than expected

But to succeed in Breaking Up Is Hard To Do, you may just need to be anything but sweet to convince your girlfriend to split up

Is your resolve strong enough to become single?  Sometimes breaking up is hard to do!

THE CITY IS FULL OF LIARS. CAN YOU FIND THE TRUTH?

Welcome to Micro Mystery Investigator, the ultimate deduction challenge for fans of logic puzzles and classic detective fiction. Put away your revolver—your sharpest weapon here is your mind.

Forget scripted stories that you play once and forget. MMI is an engine of infinite mystery. Every time you hit "Start Investigation," the game procedurally generates a complex web of suspects, alibis, motives, and physical evidence. Your task is simple yet demanding: sift through the noise, find the contradictions, and pin the crime on the one person who fits the facts.

HOW IT WORKS

The game is built on pure logic elimination (similar to Einstein's Riddle or Logic Grid puzzles), wrapped in a gritty noir atmosphere.

  • ANALYZE: Read the generated clues. "The perpetrator was seen with red hair.", "A footprint of size 42 was found in the mud."

  • ELIMINATE: Does Suspect #3 have black hair? They are innocent. Cross them off.

  • SOLVE: Once you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains—however improbable—must be the truth.

KEY FEATURES

  • 🕵️ Infinite Replayability: Powered by an advanced procedural generation algorithm. Solve 10 different types of crimes, including Murder, Arson, Kidnapping, Poisoning, and Espionage. No two cases are ever the same.

  • 🧠 100% Logic, 0% Guessing: Every case is mathematically solvable. You don't need luck. You need attention to detail.

  • ⚙️ Adjustable Difficulty: Finding the suspects too careless? Switch to Hard Mode in the settings. This removes direct name-drops and relies entirely on ambiguous evidence, putting your true deductive skills to the test.

  • ⏳ Play At Your Own Pace: Hate ticking clocks? No problem. You can completely disable the case timer in the System Configuration menu (just set it to 0) and investigate without any pressure.

  • 🕯️ Atmospheric Noir Style: An immersive text-based interface with a retro color palette and dynamic weather descriptions, designed to evoke the mood of a detective’s personal terminal.

  • ☕ The Perfect "Coffee Break" Game: Solved a case in 5 minutes? Great. Have an hour to kill? Solve ten more.

  • 🚩 Red Herrings: Watch out for irrelevant details. Not every clue points to the culprit—some are just the noise of the city.

  • 🏆 Rise Through the Ranks: The game tracks your career. Start as a Rookie and solve enough cases to become a Chief Inspector. Can you maintain a perfect record?

  • 💡 IMMERSION TIP: Shut out the distractions of the outside world. Press F11 to switch to Fullscreen Mode and focus purely on the evidence.

Just one more case, Detective. The precinct is waiting.

[IMPORTANT NOTE]

The current gameplay previews and GIFs feature Chinese UI as the game is still in early development. Full English localization is confirmed and is currently being implemented. The upcoming Demo will support English. Please Wishlist to follow our progress!

Rituals & War: Shan Hai is a Strategic Turn-based RPG set in a world of collapsed myth.

Since the “Severing of Heaven and Earth” that divided gods and men, the deities have fallen silent and ancient beasts grow restless.

This is the realm of Shu, a world where myth has collapsed. As the “King” of Ancient Shu, you carry the oath of the “Lord”—a high priestess bound to her altar—and march by right of conquest into the fracture where Shanhai myth bleeds into the Central Plains.

Your journey will face:

  • A Core Question: Since Heaven’s will is severed, how shall mankind make Heaven and Earth hear one another again?

  • A Harsh Rule: Victory is forged in foresight and planning. Every move is a calculated risk; a single miscalculation can lead to total defeat.

  • A Fractured Investigation: Truth will not reveal itself. You must piece together forgotten answers through exploration, combat, and scattered remnants of the past.

Pre-set Commands · Simultaneous Resolution

Your foe’s lethal intent is laid bare—now it’s your turn to orchestrate your response.

This is a battle of simultaneous resolution: both you and your opponent pre-commit to a full action sequence, then resolve it on a single shared timeline.

Every order, link, and trade-off can trigger chain reactions as the two sequences interweave, continually reshaping the situation.

Anticipate correctly, and each strike lands with precision; miscalculate once, and the tide turns.

Strategic Depth: Yang Qi · Stance · Circulate Qi

Combat is more than just winning a single round—it is the art of managing three long games.

[Yang Qi] Power is never a gift. Drive your combos to stir your inner breath, transmuting Yin into Yang. —only then can you afford high-cost finishing strikes.

[Stance] A stance is not just a buff; it is a wager. If you are driven into Stance Break. your carefully maintained form will instantly collapse. In the heat of battle, spending actions to re-establish your stance often comes at a brutal price.

[Circulate Qi] The silence between blows is a tactic in itself. Circulate Qi to steady your rhythm and build momentum, ensuring your next round opens with a safer window and a firmer advantage.

A Shattered Truth: Reconstructing the “Severing of Heaven and Earth”

Truth does not reveal itself; it lies scattered in the world’s forgotten corners.

You will salvage fragments from ruins, broken slips, oracle-bone cracks, and whispered tales.. These shards come from many sources: from men, from beasts, and from the silence of the “above.”

Contradictory and incomplete, they all point to the same riddle: Why were Heaven and Earth severed—and why does blight rise now?

Only by pressing on—through conquest and discovery—can you piece together the forgotten answer from the seams between lies and omens.

Augury for the Path · Sacrifice to Leave a Mark

You will traverse the kingdoms of the Central Plains, crossing wild borders and wilderness, stepping into forgotten ruins and forbidden sanctums.

[Omens] The road ahead is veiled; you scorch the shell and ask the heavens. Before every move, the cracks burned into tortoise shell become your guide. These signs of fortune or calamity do more than shape what you will face—they directly tilt the coming battle.

[Rituals] To “Save” is no mere menu click—it is a rite that must be performed. At an altar, you must offer precious resources in sacrifice to appease silent deities; only then can you preserve your place upon the path.

Here, progress is not mere travel—it is a record of choices, each paid for in full.

store_data.about_the_game:
Martin’s Console is a narrative-driven psychological horror game.

In 2002, you are nine years old. In 2012, you are nineteen.

For an entire decade, you’ve been playing the same game console: LunaPulse.

Your friends don’t understand why you’re still obsessed with it.

What no one knows is that LunaPulse carries a hidden power—

one that will destroy human civilization in two days.

This is a story about nostalgia slipping out of control.

Made for game lovers and queers.

Features

  • Walking simulator? Puzzle game? Visual novel? First-person shooter?

    Martin’s Console blends genres and refuses to stay in one lane.

  • Low-poly, low-resolution visuals inspired by the PS1 era.

  • Every part of the game—code, writing, art, and music—was created by a single developer.

Recommend If You Like:

  • Films like I Saw the TV Glow or Bugonia

  • Stories about queer college students

  • Solo indie developers who do everything themselves

  • Indie electronic music

Martin’s Console is a free game.

Play now, and step into Martin’s world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shape the Galactic Arms Race

Step into the high-stakes world of the military-industrial complex as the CEO of a private space arms company. In Starship Tycoon, your battlefield is the boardroom, and your weapons are blueprints and balance sheets.

Evolutionary Modular Design

  • Precision Engineering: Every module choice—from reactors to weapon systems—impacts mass, energy consumption, and operational stats.

  • The Blueprint Aesthetic: Visualize your designs through high-fidelity, glowing wireframes that emphasize your role as the architect of war.

    Master the Arms Market

  • The Prototype Race: Compete against AI-controlled corporations to design the most efficient prototype for faction requests.

  • Mass Tenders: Once your design sets the galactic standard, scale your production lines to fulfill bulk orders while managing costs and reputation.

Research & Technological Epochs

Navigate through 5 distinct Technological Eras that render old designs obsolete and force constant innovation.

Meaningful Choices: Every research project involves critical decision milestones. Choose between specific materials or engineering philosophies that permanently define your company’s identity and make every playthrough unique.

A Journey of Corporate Growth

Navigate a three-stage progression path from a lone designer to an industrial titan:

  • Phase 1: The Garage Startup: Start as a freelance designer, selling blueprints to established firms to gather your initial capital.

  • Phase 2: Contracted Manufacturer: Earn the trust of major powers. Develop exclusive prototypes and manage specialized labs for galactic factions.

  • Phase 3: The Industrial Empire: Build your own shipyards and R&D facilities. Design massive Capital Ships and dictate technological trends across the stars.

Corporate Doctrine

Define your engineering philosophy through critical strategic milestones:

  • Technological Superiority: Invest in breakthrough research and exotic materials to create high-end, expensive masterpieces of destruction.

  • Mass Production: Optimize your assembly lines to churn out affordable, reliable vessels, dominating the market through sheer volume.

Political Maneuvering & War

A dynamic political system ensures that every sale has consequences:

  • Reputation & Profit: Galactic wars shift market demands and prices. Selling to Faction X will plummet your standing with their rivals.

  • The Black Market: When legitimate contracts fail, take the ultimate risk. High-profit illegal sales are available, but they may permanently stain your corporate reputation.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

This game combines retro visuals with mechanics built around creativity and interaction.

The world responds to what you do. Those responses can be used to modify the environment freely — digging into the ground, painting surfaces, building structures, or tearing them apart... Nothing is static.

Instead of abstract outcomes, actions have physical results.
Changes you make remain in the world and shape how you continue playing.

OPEN-ENDED GAMEPLAY

There is no fixed path or required way to play.

You are encouraged to experiment, discover the simple mechanics and how different interactions affect the world.

EARLY ACCESS & DEVELOPMENT

This game is currently in Early Access.

At this stage, the focus is on:

  • Core sandbox mechanics

  • World interactions

  • Iteration and stability

store_data.about_the_game:
You try to keep a small village alive in a world where time never stops.
At the start, you only have empty land and limited resources. By clearing areas, you build houses for villagers, barns for animals, open fields, and plant crops. Every building, every cost, and every decision shapes the fate of your village in the next time cycle.

The main goal is not to grow, but to survive.
Resources are never enough, and time never waits. You must carefully balance construction, production, and villagers’ needs. A wrong build or poor spending can put your village at risk in the next cycle.

Village life follows simple but harsh rules.
Land gives nothing if not worked, nothing can be built without clearing, and consumption cannot exist without production. You prepare fields, plant crops, and wait for harvest. All of this moves within the time cycle and forces constant planning.

The game combines a calm village atmosphere with constant pressure.
Expanding is tempting, but not always safe. Sometimes the best choice is not to build more, but to keep what you have alive.

How long your village survives depends entirely on your decisions.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

SkillGrid is a minimalist strategy game about control, pressure, and system mastery.

You start with a single tile.

That’s it.

From there, you expand across a living grid where every decision changes the balance of power. Grow too slowly and you’ll be swallowed. Grow recklessly and your own expansion becomes your weakness.

There are no scripted events.
No artificial difficulty spikes.
No hand-holding.

The challenge emerges from the system itself.

The Grid Fights Back

This is not a passive map.

An adaptive enemy force spreads across the grid with its own economy, production, and expansion logic. It reacts to your territory. It exploits openings. It pressures weak flanks.

The longer you survive, the smarter the battlefield becomes.

Every tile matters.
Every border matters.
Every mistake compounds.

Core Gameplay

  • Expand tile by tile across a dynamic grid

  • Manage production chains and resource flow

  • Reinforce vulnerable edges before they collapse

  • Outmaneuver an evolving AI opponent

  • Survive escalating systemic pressure

There is no micromanagement spam.
No click-per-second mechanics.

SkillGrid rewards clarity, foresight, and understanding the rules of the system.

Designed for Strategic Tension

SkillGrid is built around emergent pressure.

Small miscalculations can trigger chain reactions.
Overextension can collapse entire sectors.
Greed can cost you the run.

Victory isn’t about speed.
It’s about reading the board before it reads you.

Minimalist, but Not Simple

The clean visual design isn’t just aesthetic — it’s functional.

Every tile communicates state.
Every color shift tells a story.
You can read the battlefield at a glance.

The depth is in the mechanics, not visual noise.

Current State

SkillGrid is actively evolving.

The current version focuses on a strong core loop powered by dynamic systems and AI-driven expansion. Future updates will expand rule sets, meta progression, difficulty layers, and strategic variation.

If you enjoy systemic strategy games where mastery comes from understanding how everything interacts — SkillGrid is built for you.
